# Touch Padel: final system checklist

Generated 2026-10-30 from commit `6b781609`. Machine-readable twin: [final-checklist.json](final-checklist.json).

## What this document is

The last full pass over the whole Touch Padel system before the App Store and Google Play submissions and public production. It covers every page, screen, route and backend piece in the code, as **test points**: short sessions a tester runs end to end. It was built by reading the code, so every page names its source files and every step can be traced back to the code it checks.

## Why it exists

- **One finish line.** Features were built across many sessions and three apps. This is the single place that says "all of it works, together, on production".
- **The unhappy paths.** Launch failures come from the cases nobody walks: the internet drops mid-payment, the kitchen screen is closed, the printer is unplugged, the day was never opened, a waiter opens an owner page, the phone is in Arabic, the Qi Card payment fails. Each has its own point.
- **Submission evidence.** Store review and the client's sign-off need proof that account deletion, privacy, payments and sign-in work. The P0 points are that proof.

## How it is organised

```
System              Operator, Mobile, Website, Backend, Cross-system
  Page              a route, screen, edge function or domain            e.g. OP.TILL
    Components      the parts of the page (listed once, for reference)
    Test point      one session under one setup                         e.g. OP.TILL.T03
      Step          one thing to do and check, with the original IDs it covers
```

The checks were first written one per line (9947 of them). Many repeated the same action with one detail changed, such as the same "is this page refused?" check once per role, or the same Arabic check once per component. They are now grouped into **1885 test points** holding **9546 steps**:

- **Per component, normal conditions:** one walkthrough point for each component's main flow. Components with only one or two checks share one "other parts" point per page.
- **Money:** every money check on a page sits in one "money and totals" point, so totals are checked in one sitting.
- **Per condition, whole page:** one point per page for each condition: who can and cannot use it, no internet, coming back online, bad network, Arabic, themes, screen sizes, accessibility, iPhone vs Android, no data, lots of data, second branch, two people at once, midnight. Rare conditions with one or two checks on a page share an "other edge states" point.
- **Merged steps:** checks with the same wording and one detail changed (usually the role) became one step with **Repeat for each:** listing the variants.
- **Nothing dropped:** every step lists the original check IDs it covers. The build fails unless each of the 9947 original IDs appears exactly once. Points longer than 12 steps are split into parts.

A step reads:

> `- [ ]` **Component** `CONDITION` · what to do. **Expect:** what must be true. `IDs`

## How to use it

1. **Set up** a production-like environment: the hosted project (or a staging copy), the latest operator tag on real stations (desk, till, KDS, shop), the release mobile build on one iPhone and one Android phone, the production website, and staff logins for every role.
2. **Fix the blockers first** in [Problems found](#problems-found-while-building-this-list). Several will fail points below.
3. **Run P0 points first**, every system, then P1, then P2. A point takes the priority of its most important step. A failed P0 stops the launch until fixed and re-tested.
4. **Run a point in one sitting.** Set up its condition once (the [condition catalogue](#condition-catalogue) says how), then walk its steps in order.
5. **Batch condition points across pages.** Run every "With no internet" point while the network is off, every "In Arabic" point while the device is in Arabic, every "Who can and cannot use it" point while signed in as a low role.
6. **Record results** by ticking steps here or setting the point's `status` in the JSON (`todo`, `pass`, `fail`, `blocked`, `n/a`). A bug names the step's IDs, the device, build, language and condition.
7. **Re-run the whole point** after a fix, not just the failed step.

## Priorities and types

| Priority | Meaning |
| --- | --- |
| P0 | Blocks launch: money, data loss, security, privacy, store rejection, or a core flow that cannot be finished. |
| P1 | Core flow or common case. Must pass before public production; a known workaround may be accepted in writing. |
| P2 | Polish, rare edge case, or cosmetic. Log it; it does not block launch. |

| Type | What it tests |
| --- | --- |
| functional | Does the feature do what it says on the happy path. |
| offline | Behaviour with no internet, while queued, and on reconnect. |
| degraded | A dependency is missing or partly broken: printer, KDS, LAN peer, vendor, flag, old version. |
| permission | Who may and may not see or do this (role, branch, blocked page). |
| validation | Bad, missing, or out-of-range input is refused with a clear message. |
| money | Totals, rounding, IQD, cash boxes, refunds, deposits: every dinar accounted for. |
| data | Data is saved, shown, and kept correctly; nothing is lost or duplicated. |
| realtime | Changes made elsewhere show up live without a reload. |
| i18n | Arabic and English text, right-to-left layout, digits and dates. |
| a11y | Screen readers, labels, contrast, tap/click target size, keyboard. |
| security | Secrets, tokens, injection, data exposure, headers. |
| performance | Speed, memory, large data, timeouts. |
| ui | Layout, states and visual consistency. |

## Size of the pass

| System | Pages | Test points | Steps | Original checks covered | P0 points | P1 points | P2 points |
| --- | ---: | ---: | ---: | ---: | ---: | ---: | ---: |
| Operator (desktop station app + Electron shell) | 147 | 1042 | 5336 | 5705 | 475 | 468 | 99 |
| Mobile app (iOS + Android) | 111 | 430 | 2164 | 2168 | 152 | 234 | 44 |
| Website (Next.js on Vercel) | 21 | 106 | 552 | 552 | 61 | 38 | 7 |
| Backend + platform (Supabase, edge functions, CI/CD, vendors) | 30 | 219 | 1135 | 1163 | 175 | 40 | 4 |
| Cross-system journeys + role matrix | 22 | 88 | 359 | 359 | 61 | 23 | 4 |
| **Total** | **331** | **1885** | **9546** | **9947** | **924** | **803** | **158** |

## Problems found while building this list

Reading the code to write these points turned up problems that will fail points below or need a decision before launch. Fix or decide them before the test pass starts. **Blocker** = fix before submission. **High** = fix before public production. **Decision** = the owner has to choose.

Each item carries its status after the 2026-11-01 fix pass: **fixed** (built and tested, not yet pushed), **accepted** (owner decided no change), **deferred** (owner will do it later), **other-dept** (handed to another department), **owner** (Majed is doing it). Re-run the points below against the fixed build; a fixed item is only closed once its points pass.

Decide the launch value of each flag. *Where:* `apps/mobile/eas.json, src enabled.ts` **Status (2026-11-01): fixed.** Online payments off in every EAS profile, guarded by a test; every online-pay entry point unreachable. | `APP_NOT_INSTALLED` | App not installed | Use a phone or browser without the app | web | 3 |

| `COACH_RETIRED` | Coach retired | Operator coaching admin > retire the coach | mobile | 3 |

| `KDS_CLOSED` | No kitchen screen running | Close the KDS station app, then send an order from the till | cross, operator | 3 |
| `LOCK_TIMEOUT` | A migration cannot take its lock within lock_timeout on the live database | Push a migration that alters a busy table while a long transaction holds it (rehearse on local only) | backend | 3 |
| `MATCHES_OFF` | Open matches not running (online payments not live and pay at desk off, or the branch switch off) | Owner turns off Open matches at this branch, or Players pay at the desk while online payments are not live | operator | 3 |
| `MIGRATION_OUT_OF_ORDER` | A local migration sorts before the newest version already on the remote ledger | Add a migration file with an ordinal lower than the newest remote one | backend | 3 |
| `MODEL_NOT_PRICED` | Chosen model has no rates in the pricing table | Remove a model row from the llm pricing table on a test stack, then pick or ask with that model | operator | 3 |
| `NEGATIVE_NET` | Deductions and lateness exceed salary plus bonuses | Salary 100,000 IQD; approve deductions totalling 150,000 IQD in the same pay month. | operator | 3 |
| `NO_OPENING_HOURS` | Court opening hours not set | Clear the court opening hours in Setup on a test branch | operator | 3 |
| `PAYMENT_CANCELLED` | Left Qi Card's page without paying | Close the in-app browser sheet or press cancel on Qi's page | mobile | 3 |
| `PAYMENT_RETURNED` | Returned from Qi Card's page | Complete or leave the Qi page so it redirects to touchpadel://pay/return?ref=... | mobile | 3 |
| `PREVIEW_DEPLOY` | A Vercel Preview deployment (branch or PR), not Production | Push a non-main branch; Vercel builds a preview URL | backend | 3 |
| `RECEIPT_READING` | Scanned receipt still being read | Scan a receipt and open its review before receipt-scan finishes (or block the edge function so the reading passes 3 minutes) | operator | 3 |
| `RETRYABLE_DB_ERROR` | Postgres answers a retryable error (40001, 40P01, 55P03, 57014, 53300, 53400) | Hold a row lock in psql (select ... for update) while the function writes the same row so lock_timeout fires | backend | 3 |
| `RPC_MISSING` | Server lacks the read RPC (older database than the app) | Point a new operator build at a database without the latest coaching / matches / ranks migration | operator | 3 |
| `SCREEN_CAPTURE` | Screenshot or recording by staff | Take a screenshot or start a screen recording while signed in as a non-owner staff role | mobile | 3 |

| `SHIFT_ELSEWHERE` | My shift is open on another station | Start a shift on TILL1, sign in on TILL2 | operator | 3 |
| `SMARTSCREEN` | Unsigned build on Windows | Download Setup.exe in a browser while releases are unsigned | operator | 3 |
| `SOCIAL_SIGN_IN` | Google or Apple session on a staff account | Sign in with Google or Apple using a staff account's email | mobile | 3 |
| `STATION_LOCKED_BREAK` | Station locked by a break / covered by another person | Start a break from the rail; or cover the station with another PIN | operator | 3 |

| `BUILD_CACHE_STALE` | A NEXT_PUBLIC_* change redeployed with the build cache so the old value stays inlined | Change a NEXT_PUBLIC_ var in Vercel and Redeploy with Use existing Build Cache ticked | backend | 2 |
| `LAN_NO_PRIVATE_IP` | Till has no private IPv4 | Disconnect the till from the LAN (or give it only a public address) and start it | operator | 2 |
| `LLM_TIMEOUT` | Answer runs past the 50 s wall clock | Ask a broad question over many scopes and a long range (or throttle the edge host) so the turn passes 50 s | operator | 2 |
| `LONG_ANSWER` | Very long answer or very long question | Ask for a full day by day breakdown of a quarter, or paste a 4000 character question | operator | 2 |
| `MATCH_DESK_MODE` | Open matches in pay-at-desk mode (match_payment_mode = desk, or forced while payments are paused by 0371) | Operator Setup > Settings > Matches: payment mode desk; or leave online_payments_live false | cross | 2 |
| `NEGATIVE_STATEMENT` | Statement total below zero | Refund lessons after a statement was approved so the next statement's adjustments exceed the coach share (total_iqd < 0) | operator | 2 |
| `OFFLINE_MODE_OFF` | The owner offline-mode switch is off for the branch (venue_settings.offline_mode_enabled = false, the default since 0248) | select offline_mode_enabled from venue_settings where venue_id = <branch>; Settings > Venue details > Offline mode off | backend | 2 |
| `OTA_KEY_LOST` | The EAS Update private signing key is missing | eas update without --private-key-path, or the key not in the password manager | backend | 2 |
| `OWN_PIN` | Signed-in person types their own manager PIN to leave | Sign in as a manager and enter your own PIN in Quit or Exit forced full screen | operator | 2 |
| `OWN_STATEMENT` | A manager who is also a coach opens their own statement (CM-11) | Link a manager's profile to a coach with lessons, draft the statement, open it as that manager | operator | 2 |
| `PARTIAL_RELEASE` | A release draft exists but an asset is missing | Cancel the macos job mid-upload on a test tag in a fork | backend | 2 |
| `PAYLOAD_UNREADABLE` | Queued payload cannot be decrypted | Queue rows, then open queue.db under a different Windows account or after a profile reset | operator | 2 |
| `PERMISSION_DENIED_OS` | OS permission denied (camera, photos) | Deny camera or photo library access when asked, or revoke it in OS settings | mobile | 2 |
| `PIN_CACHE_EMPTY` | PIN never verified online on this station | Use a manager PIN offline that was never used online on this machine | operator | 2 |
| `PRICE_TARGET_CHANGED` | The priced item, size, add-on, promotion, rate, lesson type or coach price changed after approval | Start a price change for an item, then change that item (rename a size or switch it off) before the apply step | operator | 2 |
| `QUEUE_ENCRYPTION_UNAVAILABLE` | OS encryption (safeStorage) unavailable | Run on a Linux test box with no keyring, or a Windows profile where DPAPI fails | operator | 2 |

| `SEAT_RACE` | An app player takes the seat while the desk is adding one | Open Add player on the desk, take the same last seat from the guest app, then press Add player | operator | 2 |

## Operator (desktop station app + Electron shell)

The Windows/macOS app on every station in the club: desk, till, kitchen screen, shop, back office and the owner's management workspace. It keeps taking money when the internet drops, so it carries a durable offline queue, a PIN cache, a LAN link to the kitchen screen and local printing.

147 pages, 1042 test points, 5336 steps (475 P0 points).

### OP.STATION_SETUP: Station first-run setup

Shown instead of sign-in on an Electron machine with no station.json: names the machine and picks what it is for (café cashier, desk, kitchen screen, Touch Shop desk); a kitchen screen pairs to a café cashier on the LAN with a code.

**Source:** `apps/operator/src/routes/__root.tsx`, `apps/operator/src/features/setup/StationSetupContainer.tsx`, `apps/operator/src/features/setup/StationSetupScreen.tsx`, `apps/operator/src/features/setup/stationSetup.ts`, `packages/i18n/src/catalogs/ws/shell.en.ts`

**Components:** Mode choice · Station name field · Kitchen screen pairing (code, LAN search, address) · Finish setup / save station

#### OP.STATION_SETUP.T01 · P0 · Mode choice: main flow

- [ ] P1 · Choose Café cashier. **Expect:** The details step opens with Station name pre-filled TILL-01 and no pairing fields. `OP.STATION_SETUP.MODE_PICK.01`
- [ ] P1 · Go back and choose Desk, then Kitchen screen, then Touch Shop desk. **Expect:** The station name pre-fills DESK-01, KDS-01 and SHOP-01 respectively; Back returns to the mode list each time. `OP.STATION_SETUP.MODE_PICK.02`
- [ ] Choose Kitchen screen. **Expect:** The details step also shows "Pairing code from the café cashier" (hint explains Settings › Computers & screens › Kitchen screens on the café cashier) and a link "Enter the café cashier address yourself". `OP.STATION_SETUP.MODE_PICK.03`

#### OP.STATION_SETUP.T02 · P1 · Station name field: main flow

- [ ] Type "till 02" in Station name. **Expect:** It normalises to TILL-02 as you type (uppercase, space becomes a dash). `OP.STATION_SETUP.STATION_NAME.01`
- [ ] P2 · Type "till_3#!". **Expect:** It becomes TILL-3 (underscore to dash, symbols dropped). `OP.STATION_SETUP.STATION_NAME.02`
- [ ] Clear the name, or type "-TILL" or "1TILL". **Expect:** "Use capitals, digits and dashes, starting with a letter." shows and Finish setup stays disabled. `OP.STATION_SETUP.STATION_NAME.03`
- [ ] P2 · Paste a 50-character name. **Expect:** It is cut to 32 characters. `OP.STATION_SETUP.STATION_NAME.04`

#### OP.STATION_SETUP.T03 · P0 · Kitchen screen pairing (code, LAN search, address): main flow

- [ ] P1 · On a Kitchen screen setup, type a 9-character code and try Find the café cashier. **Expect:** "The code is 10 letters and digits." shows and the search does not start. `OP.STATION_SETUP.KDS_PAIRING.01`
- [ ] Type the 10-character code shown on the till (Settings › Computers & screens › Kitchen screens › Show the code), with the till on the same network, and press Find the café cashier. **Expect:** "Looking for the café cashier on this network…" shows, then with exactly one till answering the station saves ("Saving and restarting…") and restarts as a kitchen screen connected to that till. `OP.STATION_SETUP.KDS_PAIRING.02`
- [ ] P1 · Do the same with two tills on the network that both accept the code. **Expect:** "More than one café cashier answered. Pick the one for this kitchen." with one button per till address; picking one saves. `OP.STATION_SETUP.KDS_PAIRING.03`
- [ ] P1 · Search with a wrong but well-formed code while the till is on. **Expect:** "A café cashier answered but did not accept that code..." with "Type the code again", which clears the code field. `OP.STATION_SETUP.KDS_PAIRING.05`
- [ ] P2 · Open "Enter the café cashier address yourself" and type 192.168.1.300. **Expect:** "Enter a local network address like 192.168.1.10." and the step cannot continue. `OP.STATION_SETUP.KDS_PAIRING.07`
- [ ] P2 · While "Looking for the café cashier…" is showing, press Back, then search again. **Expect:** Back returns to the details with the code kept; the late result of the first search is ignored and does not jump the screen. `OP.STATION_SETUP.KDS_PAIRING.10`

#### OP.STATION_SETUP.T04 · P0 · Finish setup / save station: main flow

### OP.IDLE_LOCK: Idle lock (Station locked)

After till_idle_lock_seconds (default 900 s) without a touch the screen locks over the work in progress; unlock with the person's own PIN or password.

**Route:** `(overlay on any signed-in screen)` · **Roles:** cashier, prep, court_desk, manager, owner, head_barista, barista, head_chef, chef, driver, marketing, assistant_barista, waiter, shop_staff

**Source:** `apps/operator/src/routes/__root.tsx`, `apps/operator/src/lib/settings.ts`

#### OP.IDLE_LOCK.T01 · P0 · Idle lock (Station locked): Station idle-locked

*Setup:* `IDLE_LOCKED` (Station idle-locked)

- [ ] Leave a signed-in Manager station untouched for 15 minutes (default) with an unsaved form open. **Expect:** A full-screen navy lock with the lockup and a card headed by the person's name and role badge appears; the form behind is preserved and continues after unlock. `OP.IDLE_LOCK.01`
- [ ] While locked press Tab repeatedly and click on the dark area, then press Escape. **Expect:** Focus stays inside the lock card; nothing behind it can be reached or activated; Escape does not dismiss the lock. `OP.IDLE_LOCK.02`
- [ ] P1 · Lock as a Manager (has a PIN), type a wrong PIN, Unlock. **Expect:** "Incorrect PIN." shows, the PIN clears and focus stays in the PIN field; the PIN field accepts digits only and shows left-to-right even in Arabic. `OP.IDLE_LOCK.03`
- [ ] Type the correct PIN and press Unlock (or Enter). **Expect:** The lock lifts and the screen is exactly as it was. `OP.IDLE_LOCK.04`
- [ ] P1 · Lock as a Cashier with no PIN set. **Expect:** The card opens straight on the password field with "This account has no unlock PIN, so enter your password." and no "Use PIN instead" link. `OP.IDLE_LOCK.05`
- [ ] P2 · As a Manager with a PIN press "Use password instead", then "Use PIN instead". **Expect:** The field switches each time, clears, and keeps focus. `OP.IDLE_LOCK.06`
- [ ] P2 · Press Unlock with an empty field. **Expect:** "Type your PIN first." (or "Type your password first.") and no request is sent. `OP.IDLE_LOCK.07`
- [ ] P2 · While locked, have the owner remove the PIN of the locked person, then try their old PIN. **Expect:** NO_PIN_SET switches the card to the password field without an error. `OP.IDLE_LOCK.08`
- [ ] P1 · Press "Not <name>? Sign out" on the lock. **Expect:** The session ends and the sign-in screen shows; with the person's till shift open, the leaving guard shows first. `OP.IDLE_LOCK.10`

#### OP.IDLE_LOCK.T02 · P0 · Idle lock (Station locked): ge

*Setup:* `OFFLINE` (No internet), `ON_BREAK_COVERED` (Signed-in person on break, someone covering), `FEATURE_FLAG_OFF` (A feature switched off), `ARABIC_RTL` (Arabic, right to left)

- [ ] `OFFLINE` Lock a station, unplug the network, then try to unlock with the correct PIN and then with the password. **Expect:** Both fail with "No connection. Check your internet and try again." and the lock stays (verify_own_pin and the password check are online only). Only "Not <name>? Sign out" works. Confirm with the owner that an offline till cannot be unlocked by PIN before launch. `OP.IDLE_LOCK.09`
- [ ] `ON_BREAK_COVERED` P1 · Set the station on break with a cover; let it idle. **Expect:** The lock asks for the cover's PIN ("<name> is covering this station. Enter their PIN to continue.") with a "Not <cover>? <name> is back" link that switches to ending the break with the owner's own PIN. `OP.IDLE_LOCK.11`
- [ ] `ON_BREAK_COVERED` P2 · While the person is away on break with no cover, wait past the idle time. **Expect:** The idle lock does not appear on top of the break screen (the break screen is the lock). `OP.IDLE_LOCK.12`
- [ ] `FEATURE_FLAG_OFF` P2 · Set till_idle_lock_seconds to 0 in cafe settings (DB) and idle. **Expect:** The idle lock never appears. Note: there is no screen in the operator to change this value. `OP.IDLE_LOCK.13`
- [ ] `ARABIC_RTL` P2 · Lock and unlock in Arabic. **Expect:** All lock text is Arabic; the long "Not <name>? Sign out" button keeps its icon on the same line. `OP.IDLE_LOCK.14`

### OP.CRASH: Error boundary and Screen not found

A screen that throws shows a recovery panel instead of a blank kiosk; an unknown address shows Screen not found.

**Route:** `(any route)` · **Roles:** cashier, prep, court_desk, manager, owner, head_barista, barista, head_chef, chef, driver, marketing, assistant_barista, waiter, shop_staff

**Source:** `apps/operator/src/main.tsx`, `apps/operator/src/components/CrashScreen.tsx`, `apps/operator/src/lib/telemetry.ts`

#### OP.CRASH.T01 · P0 · Error boundary and Screen not found: main checks

- [ ] Force a render error in one screen (dev: throw in a component, or corrupt a cached query shape) and open it. **Expect:** "This screen stopped working" / "The rest of the app still works." with "Try this screen again", "Go to my home screen", "Restart the app" and a "Technical details" disclosure; the rail stays usable. `OP.CRASH.01`
- [ ] P1 · Press "Try this screen again" after fixing the cause (e.g. reconnecting). **Expect:** The screen re-renders without restarting the app. `OP.CRASH.02`
- [ ] P1 · Press "Go to my home screen". **Expect:** It opens the person's home route (e.g. /till for a cashier). `OP.CRASH.03`
- [ ] P1 · Open "Technical details". **Expect:** The error name and message are shown for support; no tokens, PINs or passwords appear. `OP.CRASH.04`
- [ ] P2 · Force an error above the router (shell-level, e.g. in AuthProvider). **Expect:** The crash panel shows full screen with Try again and Restart the app but no home button. `OP.CRASH.05`
- [ ] P2 · Check telemetry after a crash. **Expect:** The exception is captured with boundary "route" or "app". `OP.CRASH.06`
- [ ] P1 · Open an unknown address (browser build: /#/nope; station: a stale bookmark or push link). **Expect:** "Screen not found" / "There is no screen at this address. Your home screen has everything your role can open." with "Go to my home screen". `OP.CRASH.07`

*Setup:* `ARABIC_RTL` (Arabic, right to left)

- [ ] View both panels in Arabic. **Expect:** All text Arabic and mirrored. `OP.CRASH.08`

- [ ] Press Decline as a Head barista without a reason. **Expect:** "Decline the idea" stays disabled until "Why it is declined" is filled; after declining: "Declined. Its author will see why." `OP.SUGGESTIONS.IDEAS.02`
- [ ] Press Decline as the Owner without a reason. **Expect:** The reason is optional for the owner and the decline goes through. `OP.SUGGESTIONS.IDEAS.03`
- [ ] Press "Start as a new item". **Expect:** The release start sheet opens pre-filled from the idea, carrying its photos ("Starting it carries these photos into the proposal."). `OP.SUGGESTIONS.IDEAS.04`

#### OP.SUGGESTIONS.T03 · P1 · Recipe changes card and sheet: main flow

- [ ] As Owner with a waiting request, open Protocols and the Recipe changes card. **Expect:** Card shows "<n> waiting" and each request "<name> asked, <time>"; "See every request" opens Waiting / Decided / All. `OP.SUGGESTIONS.RECIPE_CHANGES.01`
- [ ] Open a request and press Approve. **Expect:** Toast "Approved. The recipe now reads as the request asked."; the request moves to Decided; the recipe shows the new lines. `OP.SUGGESTIONS.RECIPE_CHANGES.02`
- [ ] P2 · Press Decline and confirm with a reason. **Expect:** "Declined." and the head reads the reason. `OP.SUGGESTIONS.RECIPE_CHANGES.03`

#### OP.SUGGESTIONS.T04 · P1 · Suggestion list: main flow

- [ ] Post a suggestion from a waiter's phone, then open New. **Expect:** Card shows the waiter's name and role, time, the full text with line breaks kept, and Mark as seen. `OP.SUGGESTIONS.LIST.01`
- [ ] P2 · View a suggestion whose author left. **Expect:** Author reads 'Someone no longer on staff'. `OP.SUGGESTIONS.LIST.02`
- [ ] P2 · Open All. **Expect:** Unmarked ones carry 'Not seen yet'; seen ones 'Seen by <name>, <time>'. `OP.SUGGESTIONS.LIST.03`

#### OP.SUGGESTIONS.T05 · P1 · Staff ideas (suggestion box): other parts

- [ ] **Suggestions (page)** Open /suggestions as manager and owner. **Expect:** Title 'Suggestions', lead, tabs New, Seen, All; New selected. `OP.SUGGESTIONS.01-2`
- [ ] **Suggestions (page)** With 4 new suggestions check the rail badge and tab. **Expect:** Badge 4 and tab 'New (4)'. `OP.SUGGESTIONS.03-2`
- [ ] **Mark as seen** Press Mark as seen on a new suggestion. **Expect:** Toast 'Marked as seen.'; card leaves New, appears in Seen with 'Seen by <you>, <time>'; badge drops by 1. `OP.SUGGESTIONS.MARK_SEEN.01`
- [ ] **Mark as seen** P2 · Check the author's phone after marking. **Expect:** Author sees that it was seen (no reply, no push). `OP.SUGGESTIONS.MARK_SEEN.04`

#### OP.SUGGESTIONS.T06 · P1 · Staff ideas (suggestion box): Who can and cannot use it

*Setup:* `WRONG_ROLE` (Signed in with a role that may not use this)

- [ ] Sign in as a Cashier account (role cashier, no second job, nothing blocked) and try to reach Staff ideas (/suggestions): look on the rail and in Options, then open the address directly (browser build URL bar, or a deep link from a push or the assistant on a station). **Expect:** No rail row, family tab, section button or Go to entry leads to Staff ideas. Opened directly, the screen shows the card "Not allowed for your role: Opening this screen needs the Manager role. The control stays here so you can see what is available; ask someone with that role to do it." with a "Go to my home screen" link that lands on /till. No data from the page is fetched or shown. **Repeat for each:** Court desk account role court_desk (expect: /desk/today.); Driver account role driver (expect: /tasks.); Marketing account role marketing (expect: /plan.); Waiter account role waiter (expect: /tasks.); Shop assistant account role shop_staff (expect: /shop.). `OP.SUGGESTIONS.08 OP.SUGGESTIONS.10 OP.SUGGESTIONS.15 OP.SUGGESTIONS.16 OP.SUGGESTIONS.18 OP.SUGGESTIONS.19`
- [ ] Sign in as a Kitchen (retired prep) account (role prep, no second job, nothing blocked) and try to reach Staff ideas (/suggestions): look on the rail and in Options, then open the address directly (browser build URL bar, or a deep link from a push or the assistant on a station). **Expect:** The kitchen board has no rail, so nothing on it leads there. Opened directly, the screen shows the card "Not allowed for your role: Opening this screen needs the Manager role. The control stays here so you can see what is available; ask someone with that role to do it." with a "Go to my home screen" link that lands on /kds. No data from the page is fetched or shown. **Repeat for each:** Head barista account role head_barista; Barista account role barista; Head chef account role head_chef; Chef assistant account role chef; Assistant barista account role assistant_barista. `OP.SUGGESTIONS.09 OP.SUGGESTIONS.11 OP.SUGGESTIONS.12 OP.SUGGESTIONS.13 OP.SUGGESTIONS.14 OP.SUGGESTIONS.17`
- [ ] **Ideas from the team (reviewer sheet)** P2 · As a Barista look for the review list. **Expect:** Not shown (reviewIdeas is head_barista, head_chef, manager, owner); baristas send ideas from the phone. `OP.SUGGESTIONS.IDEAS.05`
- [ ] **Recipe changes card and sheet** Open a request as Manager. **Expect:** The sheet is read-only with "Only the owner approves or declines a recipe change." `OP.SUGGESTIONS.RECIPE_CHANGES.05`
- [ ] **Suggestions (page)** Open as waiter, chef and marketing. **Expect:** Refusal card naming manager. `OP.SUGGESTIONS.02-2`

*Setup:* `OFFLINE` (No internet)

- [ ] Press Mark as seen offline. **Expect:** The error line shows "No connection. Check your internet and try again." and the card stays in New. `OP.SUGGESTIONS.04`
- [ ] **Recipe changes card and sheet** Approve offline. **Expect:** The error shows "No connection..." and nothing changes. `OP.SUGGESTIONS.RECIPE_CHANGES.06`

- [ ] **Mark as seen** `CONCURRENT_EDIT` P2 · Two managers mark the same suggestion seen. **Expect:** Both succeed; the first mark (name and time) is kept. `OP.SUGGESTIONS.MARK_SEEN.02`

### OP.ADMIN.MENU: Menu items

Edits café and shop menu items: names, description, photo, highlight, cost, sizes and prices, add-on groups, availability; managers propose new café items and price changes through protocols.

**Route:** `/admin/menu` · **Roles:** manager, owner

**Source:** `apps/operator/src/routes/admin/menu.tsx`, `apps/operator/src/features/admin/menu/MenuEditor.tsx`, `apps/operator/src/features/admin/menu/ItemForm.tsx`, `apps/operator/src/features/admin/menu/VariantsEditor.tsx`, `apps/operator/src/features/admin/menu/ItemModifierGroups.tsx`, `apps/operator/src/features/admin/menu/menuLogic.ts`, `apps/operator/src/features/admin/menu/availability.ts`, `apps/operator/src/features/admin/menu/photo.ts`, `apps/operator/src/features/admin/menu/useAdminMenu.ts`

**Components:** Category column, search and items table · New item / Propose a new item · Item editor (details, photo, highlight, cost, status, availability) · Sizes and prices · Add-on choices on this item

#### OP.ADMIN.MENU.T01 · P1 · Category column, search and items table: main flow

- [ ] P2 · Pick a category, then type "latte" in "Search items in every category". **Expect:** Matches from every category show, each naming its category; the reorder arrows are replaced by "Showing matches from every category. Clear the search to change the order." `OP.ADMIN.MENU.LIST.01`
- [ ] P2 · In a plain category view press the down arrow on the first item. **Expect:** It moves one place down, the order saves (reorder_menu_items) and the café cashier and guest menu show the new order after refresh. `OP.ADMIN.MENU.LIST.03`
- [ ] Check the status badges on items. **Expect:** Inactive, Sold out, Off today, Blocked by stock and In release badges show where they apply; Price (IQD) shows the default size price formatted as IQD. `OP.ADMIN.MENU.LIST.06`
- [ ] Toggle Sold out from the list row for an item. **Expect:** The badge flips immediately and the till grid greys the item within a few seconds (menu realtime); toggling back restores it. `OP.ADMIN.MENU.LIST.08`

#### OP.ADMIN.MENU.T02 · P1 · Item editor (details, photo, highlight, cost, status, availability): main flow

- [ ] Change an item's Arabic description and press Save. **Expect:** Toast "Saved."; the change shows on the guest menu in Arabic after refresh; "Unsaved changes" disappears. `OP.ADMIN.MENU.ITEM_FORM.01`
- [ ] P2 · Fill the Flavour line in English only and save. **Expect:** "Enter the flavour line in both languages, or leave both empty." (HOOK_PAIR_MISMATCH). `OP.ADMIN.MENU.ITEM_FORM.02`
- [ ] P2 · Type a Flavour line longer than the stated maximum. **Expect:** The field stops or flags at the maximum from the hint "Up to <max> characters, both languages or neither." `OP.ADMIN.MENU.ITEM_FORM.03`
- [ ] Upload a 4000 x 3000 JPEG as Photo. **Expect:** It is resized to at most 1200 px square and saved as WebP ("Square, up to 1200 px. Saved as WebP."); the photo shows on the guest menu. `OP.ADMIN.MENU.ITEM_FORM.04`
- [ ] P2 · Upload a non-image file (PDF) as Photo. **Expect:** The file is refused with an error and nothing is saved. `OP.ADMIN.MENU.ITEM_FORM.06`
- [ ] Switch Active off for an item and save. **Expect:** "Switched off, the item is hidden from the café cashier and the guest menu." The till grid no longer shows it. `OP.ADMIN.MENU.ITEM_FORM.10`
- [ ] Open an item that is blocked by stock. **Expect:** "Blocked by stock" card: "Set by stock — not a toggle", the out-of-stock ingredient names ("Out of stock: <names>"), or "The blocking ingredient could not be named from this station." when unknown. `OP.ADMIN.MENU.ITEM_FORM.13`
- [ ] P2 · Read the "now" line under Availability for each state. **Expect:** It says "Guests can order this now." or the specific reason (switched off, sold out, off today, blocked). `OP.ADMIN.MENU.ITEM_FORM.14`
- [ ] P2 · Edit an item, then click another item without saving. **Expect:** A prompt "You have unsaved changes. Leave anyway?" appears; cancelling keeps the edit. `OP.ADMIN.MENU.ITEM_FORM.17`

#### OP.ADMIN.MENU.T03 · P0 · Menu items: money and totals

- [ ] **Category column, search and items table** P1 · With items lacking a cost, read the notice "Items without a cost" and press "Show them". **Expect:** The table lists exactly those items; "Show all items" returns; with none: "Every active item has a cost." `OP.ADMIN.MENU.LIST.05`
- [ ] **Item editor (details, photo, highlight, cost, status, availability)** Set Cost (IQD) to 1,750 on an item priced 5,000 and save. **Expect:** The list chip shows the margin (65% margin) and the item leaves "Items without a cost". `OP.ADMIN.MENU.ITEM_FORM.07`
- [ ] **Item editor (details, photo, highlight, cost, status, availability)** Type a negative or decimal cost (-100 or 12.5). **Expect:** The input refuses it or shows a validation error; only whole IQD 0 or more are saved. `OP.ADMIN.MENU.ITEM_FORM.08`
- [ ] **Item editor (details, photo, highlight, cost, status, availability)** P1 · Clear Cost and save. **Expect:** Cost is stored as unknown (chip "No cost"), not 0. `OP.ADMIN.MENU.ITEM_FORM.09`
- [ ] **Sizes and prices** As Owner add a size "Large" / Arabic name with Price 6,500 IQD and save. **Expect:** The size appears with "6,500" IQD; the café cashier offers it at 6,500 and the guest menu shows it. `OP.ADMIN.MENU.SIZES.01`
- [ ] **Sizes and prices** Enter a price with decimals (6500.5), a negative, or letters. **Expect:** Refused: prices are whole IQD 0 or more. `OP.ADMIN.MENU.SIZES.02`
- [ ] **Sizes and prices** P1 · Enter a very large price (99,999,999). **Expect:** It is either refused by a range check or saved and displayed fully with thousands separators; record which. `OP.ADMIN.MENU.SIZES.03`
- [ ] **Sizes and prices** P1 · Mark a different size as Default. **Expect:** "The default size is the one the café cashier and the guest menu pick first." The till now picks it first. `OP.ADMIN.MENU.SIZES.04`

#### OP.ADMIN.MENU.T04 · P1 · Menu items: other parts

- [ ] **Whole page** Open Menu items from Café & shop › Menu (tab Menu items). **Expect:** A spinner (RoutePending) shows while the screen code loads, then "Menu items" with the lead "What the café cashier, the guest menu and the kitchen sell...", a Categories column, the items table (Item, status badges, Price (IQD)) and the right-hand editor pane "Choose an item to edit it, or add a new one." `OP.ADMIN.MENU.01`
- [ ] **Whole page** P2 · Open the Menu family tabs. **Expect:** Tabs under the title: Menu items, Menu groups, Extras, Café cashier suggestions; the Menu row stays lit on each. `OP.ADMIN.MENU.11`
- [ ] **New item / Propose a new item** As Owner in a café category press "New item", fill English and Arabic names, save. **Expect:** The item is created and opens in the editor; "Save the item to manage sizes, add-ons and availability." disappears once saved. `OP.ADMIN.MENU.NEW_ITEM.01`
- [ ] **New item / Propose a new item** Try to save a new item with only the English name. **Expect:** Save is disabled with "Fill in both names first." `OP.ADMIN.MENU.NEW_ITEM.04`
- [ ] **Add-on choices on this item** Switch on an add-on group (e.g. Milk) on an item. **Expect:** It moves under "Offered on this item"; the till asks for the choice when the item is added. `OP.ADMIN.MENU.ADDON_GROUPS.01`
- [ ] **Add-on choices on this item** P2 · Press "Show other groups" / "Hide other groups". **Expect:** Unlinked groups expand and collapse. `OP.ADMIN.MENU.ADDON_GROUPS.04`

#### OP.ADMIN.MENU.T05 · P0 · Menu items: Who can and cannot use it

*Setup:* `WRONG_ROLE` (Signed in with a role that may not use this)

- [ ] **New item / Propose a new item** As Manager in a café category look at the add button. **Expect:** It reads "Propose a new item" with "New café items go through a product release, and the owner launches them."; pressing it opens /protocols with the product release start. `OP.ADMIN.MENU.NEW_ITEM.02`
- [ ] **New item / Propose a new item** P1 · As Manager in a shop category press New item. **Expect:** A normal create form opens (the propose rule is for café categories only); saving switched on is refused by the server unless the role launches directly; it is saved hidden. `OP.ADMIN.MENU.NEW_ITEM.03`
- [ ] **Item editor (details, photo, highlight, cost, status, availability)** P1 · As Manager open an item that is in a product release. **Expect:** "In release: <run>" with "Its prices come from the release, and it goes on sale when the owner launches it." and "Open the release". `OP.ADMIN.MENU.ITEM_FORM.15`
- [ ] **Item editor (details, photo, highlight, cost, status, availability)** As Manager try to switch Active on for a never-launched café item. **Expect:** The switch is replaced by "Put on sale", which starts the owner approval (shop_launch / release) instead of launching. `OP.ADMIN.MENU.ITEM_FORM.16`
- [ ] **Sizes and prices** As Manager open the sizes of an item on sale. **Expect:** Note "This item is on sale, so its sizes’ prices and names change through Change the price, with the owner’s OK."; price fields are locked and "Change the price" starts the protocol. `OP.ADMIN.MENU.SIZES.06`
- [ ] **Sizes and prices** P1 · As Manager try renaming an on-sale size. **Expect:** Blocked with "Renaming a size or an option that is on sale goes through “Change the price”, with the owner’s OK." `OP.ADMIN.MENU.SIZES.07`
- [ ] **Add-on choices on this item** As Manager switch on a required group that contains paid options. **Expect:** Refused: "This would make guests pay more: a paid option they would have to pick, or a free one taken away. Only the owner makes this change." `OP.ADMIN.MENU.ADDON_GROUPS.02`

#### OP.ADMIN.MENU.T06 · P0 · Menu items: With no internet

*Setup:* `OFFLINE` (No internet)

- [ ] Disconnect the station from the internet (unplug ethernet or turn Wi-Fi off), wait for the top strip to turn red, then open Menu items. **Expect:** The strip reads "Not connected — changes are saved here and will sync once the connection is back." The page shows its last loaded data if it was opened earlier this session, otherwise the error "This could not be loaded." with "Try again". Any save fails with "No connection. Check your internet and try again." and nothing is queued: after reconnecting, the change is NOT on the server and must be redone. `OP.ADMIN.MENU.03`
- [ ] **Category column, search and items table** P2 · Reorder while offline. **Expect:** The move fails with "No connection. Check your internet and try again." and the list snaps back to the saved order. `OP.ADMIN.MENU.LIST.04`
- [ ] **Item editor (details, photo, highlight, cost, status, availability)** P2 · Upload a photo while offline. **Expect:** The upload fails with an error under the field and the old photo stays. `OP.ADMIN.MENU.ITEM_FORM.05`
- [ ] **Sizes and prices** Save a price change while offline. **Expect:** Refused with the network line; the till keeps charging the old price. `OP.ADMIN.MENU.SIZES.08`

#### OP.ADMIN.MENU.T07 · P1 · Menu items: With no data yet

*Setup:* `EMPTY_DATA` (Nothing recorded yet)

- [ ] P2 · Open Menu items on a branch with no categories. **Expect:** "No categories yet." with "Create a category first; items live inside categories." and a "New category" button; New item is not offered. `OP.ADMIN.MENU.09`
- [ ] **Category column, search and items table** P2 · Search for a word nothing matches. **Expect:** "No items match the search." `OP.ADMIN.MENU.LIST.02`
- [ ] **Category column, search and items table** P2 · Switch a category empty of items. **Expect:** "No items in this category yet." with "Add the first item; it appears on the café cashier and the website as soon as it is saved." `OP.ADMIN.MENU.LIST.07`
- [ ] **Sizes and prices** With an item with no sizes, look at the list. **Expect:** "No sizes yet. Add one so the item has a price." and the item cannot be sold. `OP.ADMIN.MENU.SIZES.05`
- [ ] **Add-on choices on this item** P2 · Open an item when no add-on groups exist. **Expect:** "No add-on groups exist yet. Create them in Add-ons." with "Edit groups in Add-ons". `OP.ADMIN.MENU.ADDON_GROUPS.03`

#### OP.ADMIN.MENU.T08 · P0 · Menu items: ge

*Setup:* `SLOW_NETWORK` (Slow network), `BACKEND_DOWN` (Server unreachable while the LAN is up), `ARABIC_RTL` (Arabic, right to left), `BLUE_MODE` (Blue colour mode), `SECOND_BRANCH` (Two branches), `SMALL_SCREEN` (Small station screen), `LARGE_DATA` (Large data volume), `TIMEZONE_EDGE` (Midnight / business-day boundary (Asia/Baghdad)), `CONCURRENT_EDIT` (Two people change the same thing)

- [ ] `SLOW_NETWORK` P2 · Open Menu items with the network throttled to Slow 3G in dev tools (browser build) or on a weak venue Wi-Fi. **Expect:** A loading state (spinner or skeleton) holds the layout until data arrives; no half-filled form is editable before its saved values land, and nothing flashes an empty-state message first. `OP.ADMIN.MENU.02`
- [ ] `BACKEND_DOWN` P1 · With the station online, stop the backend (local stack: supabase stop; hosted: block the API host in the hosts file) and open Menu items. **Expect:** The page shows "This could not be loaded." (or the network line) with a "Try again" button instead of a blank screen; pressing Try again after the backend is back loads the page without a restart. `OP.ADMIN.MENU.04`
- [ ] `ARABIC_RTL` P1 · Switch the app to Arabic (Options › العربية) and open Menu items. **Expect:** Every label, button, hint and toast on the page is Arabic; the layout mirrors (rail on the right, inline-start padding on the right); IQD amounts, times, dates and IDs that are Latin stay readable and are not reversed. `OP.ADMIN.MENU.05`
- [ ] **Sizes and prices** `ARABIC_RTL` P2 · View sizes in Arabic. **Expect:** Size names Arabic, prices formatted for Arabic with IQD, number inputs stay left-to-right. `OP.ADMIN.MENU.SIZES.09`
- [ ] `BLUE_MODE` P2 · Switch Options › Blue mode on, open Menu items, then switch back to Light mode. **Expect:** Text, borders, inputs, badges and buttons stay legible in both modes; no white-on-white or blue-on-blue text; the choice persists after restarting the app. `OP.ADMIN.MENU.06`
- [ ] `SECOND_BRANCH` On the owner's unregistered PC with two open branches, open Menu items, note what it shows, then pick the other branch in the rail's Branch switcher. **Expect:** The screen remounts and reloads for the new branch: the categories and items are the selected branch's menu (each branch has its own copied menu). An unsaved edit made before switching is gone, never saved into the new branch. `OP.ADMIN.MENU.07`

### OP.ADMIN.CATEGORIES: Menu groups (categories)

Creates, edits, hides and orders menu categories, with tax group and category photo.

**Route:** `/admin/categories` · **Roles:** manager, owner

**Source:** `apps/operator/src/routes/admin/categories.tsx`, `apps/operator/src/features/admin/menu/CategoryEditor.tsx`

**Components:** Category editor · Category order

#### OP.ADMIN.CATEGORIES.T01 · P1 · Category editor: main flow

- [ ] Press "New category", fill both names, pick a Tax group, save. **Expect:** The category appears in the table and in the Menu items category column; "Items in this category: 0". `OP.ADMIN.CATEGORIES.EDITOR.01`
- [ ] P2 · Save with one name empty. **Expect:** Save disabled: "Fill in both names first." `OP.ADMIN.CATEGORIES.EDITOR.02`
- [ ] Switch "Shown on the café cashier and the guest menu" off and save. **Expect:** The category shows "Hidden"; none of its items can be ordered on the till or guest menu. `OP.ADMIN.CATEGORIES.EDITOR.04`
- [ ] P2 · Upload a wide category photo (16:9). **Expect:** It shows at the top of the category on the guest menu. `OP.ADMIN.CATEGORIES.EDITOR.05`
- [ ] P2 · Leave the editor with unsaved changes. **Expect:** "You have unsaved changes. Leave anyway?" `OP.ADMIN.CATEGORIES.EDITOR.06`

#### OP.ADMIN.CATEGORIES.T02 · P0 · Menu groups (categories): money and totals

- [ ] **Category editor** Change a category's Tax group and save. **Expect:** "Sets the tax on every item in this category." New till bills for items in it carry the new tax; past bills are unchanged. `OP.ADMIN.CATEGORIES.EDITOR.03`

#### OP.ADMIN.CATEGORIES.T03 · P1 · Menu groups (categories): other parts

- [ ] **Whole page** Open Menu groups from Café & shop › Menu (tab Menu groups). **Expect:** A spinner (RoutePending) shows while the screen code loads, then "Categories" with the lead about menu sections, a table (Category, Items, Status, Order) and the editor "Choose a category to edit it, or add a new one." `OP.ADMIN.CATEGORIES.01`
- [ ] **Category order** P2 · Move a category up with its arrow. **Expect:** The order saves and the café cashier and guest menu show the sections in the new order. `OP.ADMIN.CATEGORIES.ORDER.01`
- [ ] **Category order** P2 · Move the first category up / last down. **Expect:** The arrow is disabled at the ends. `OP.ADMIN.CATEGORIES.ORDER.02`

### OP.ADMIN.ADDONS: Extras (add-ons)

Add-on groups and sub-groups (choices like milk type), their options with extra charges, choice limits and reveals.

**Route:** `/admin/addons` · **Roles:** manager, owner

**Source:** `apps/operator/src/routes/admin/addons.tsx`, `apps/operator/src/features/admin/addons/AddonsPage.tsx`, `apps/operator/src/features/admin/addons/GroupEditor.tsx`, `apps/operator/src/features/admin/addons/OptionsEditor.tsx`, `apps/operator/src/features/admin/addons/RevealsEditor.tsx`, `apps/operator/src/features/admin/addons/ChoiceLimits.tsx`, `apps/operator/src/features/admin/addons/addonsLogic.ts`

#### OP.ADMIN.ADDONS.T01 · P1 · Group editor: main flow

- [ ] Create "New group" Milk, tick three items under "Offered on these items", save. **Expect:** "Selected: 3"; the till asks for Milk on those items. `OP.ADMIN.ADDONS.GROUP.01`
- [ ] Set "At least" 1 and "At most" 1. **Expect:** The rule reads "Required · choose 1"; the till will not add the item without a choice. `OP.ADMIN.ADDONS.GROUP.02`
- [ ] Set At least 3 and At most 2. **Expect:** "“At least” cannot be more than “at most”." and save is blocked. `OP.ADMIN.ADDONS.GROUP.03`
- [ ] P2 · Set At least -1 or At most 0. **Expect:** "“At least” must be 0 or more." / "“At most” must be 1 or more." `OP.ADMIN.ADDONS.GROUP.04`

#### OP.ADMIN.ADDONS.T02 · P1 · Reveals (sub-groups asked after an option): main flow

- [ ] Create a sub-group "Syrup" and set option "Iced" to reveal it. **Expect:** Sub-group meta reads "Asked after: Iced"; on the till picking Iced then asks for Syrup. `OP.ADMIN.ADDONS.REVEALS.01`
- [ ] P2 · Try to make a sub-group reveal another sub-group. **Expect:** "Sub-groups can only nest one level deep." (REVEAL_DEPTH). `OP.ADMIN.ADDONS.REVEALS.02`
- [ ] P2 · Clear all reveals for an option. **Expect:** Confirm "Clear every revealed sub-group for this option?"; after yes the sub-group shows "No option asks for it yet". `OP.ADMIN.ADDONS.REVEALS.03`

### OP.ADMIN.HERO: Guest app home screen (hero)

What guests see at the top of the menu after scanning a table card: menu only, photo/video, or a featured item with tag and discount; scrolling ticker lines; waiter bell help.

**Route:** `/admin/hero` · **Roles:** manager, owner

**Source:** `apps/operator/src/routes/admin/hero.tsx`, `apps/operator/src/features/admin/hero/HeroBuilder.tsx`, `apps/operator/src/features/admin/hero/HeroPreview.tsx`, `apps/operator/src/features/admin/hero/TickerEditor.tsx`, `apps/operator/src/features/admin/hero/ticker.ts`, `apps/operator/src/lib/settings.ts`

**Components:** Top of the menu mode · Featured item tag and discount · Scrolling lines (ticker) · Preview and save bar

#### OP.ADMIN.HERO.T01 · P1 · Top of the menu mode: main flow

- [ ] P2 · Choose Menu only and save. **Expect:** "Everything is saved."; the guest menu opens straight on the menu. `OP.ADMIN.HERO.MODE.01`
- [ ] Choose Photo or video without uploading media and save. **Expect:** "Upload a photo or video for this choice." and save is blocked. `OP.ADMIN.HERO.MODE.02`
- [ ] Upload a 12 MB MP4. **Expect:** Refused: videos are limited to 8 MB ("an MP4 or WebM video up to 8 MB"). `OP.ADMIN.HERO.MODE.03`
- [ ] P2 · Upload a 3000 px wide JPEG. **Expect:** It is scaled to at most 1600 px wide and under about 800 KB before upload. `OP.ADMIN.HERO.MODE.04`
- [ ] P2 · Replace the media, save, and check storage. **Expect:** The old file is removed from storage after the new one is saved. `OP.ADMIN.HERO.MODE.05`
- [ ] Choose Featured item without picking an item. **Expect:** "Choose the item to feature." `OP.ADMIN.HERO.MODE.06`

#### OP.ADMIN.HERO.T02 · P2 · Scrolling lines (ticker): main flow

- [ ] Add a line with English only and save. **Expect:** "Every line needs both English and Arabic text." `OP.ADMIN.HERO.TICKER.01`
- [ ] Add 12 lines, then try a 13th. **Expect:** "That is the most lines there can be: 12." and Add a line is disabled. `OP.ADMIN.HERO.TICKER.02`
- [ ] Paste a 150-character line. **Expect:** "A line is too long, or there are too many lines." (limit 120). `OP.ADMIN.HERO.TICKER.03`
- [ ] Remove a line and save. **Expect:** The guest ticker no longer shows it. `OP.ADMIN.HERO.TICKER.04`

#### OP.ADMIN.HERO.T03 · P2 · Preview and save bar: main flow

- [ ] Change the mode and look at Preview before saving. **Expect:** The preview updates immediately ("How the top of the menu looks on a phone."); "You have unsaved changes." shows. `OP.ADMIN.HERO.PREVIEW.01`
- [ ] Press "Discard changes". **Expect:** Everything returns to the saved settings and "Everything is saved." shows. `OP.ADMIN.HERO.PREVIEW.02`
- [ ] Switch "Show how the waiter bell works" on and save. **Expect:** First-time guests see the waiter bell explanation on the guest menu. `OP.ADMIN.HERO.PREVIEW.03`

#### OP.ADMIN.HERO.T04 · P0 · Guest app home screen (hero): money and totals

- [ ] **Featured item tag and discount** As Owner set Discount (%) to 20 on a 5,000 IQD featured item and save. **Expect:** The guest hero and café cashier sell it at 4,000 IQD while featured; the receipt shows the discount. `OP.ADMIN.HERO.FEATURED_DISCOUNT.01`
- [ ] **Featured item tag and discount** Enter 0, 100, 150 or a decimal discount. **Expect:** Out-of-range or fractional values are refused; record the accepted range. `OP.ADMIN.HERO.FEATURED_DISCOUNT.02`
- [ ] **Featured item tag and discount** Check the IQD rounding of a 15% discount on 3,250 IQD. **Expect:** The discounted price shown on the guest hero equals what the till charges (same rounding). `OP.ADMIN.HERO.FEATURED_DISCOUNT.03`

#### OP.ADMIN.HERO.T05 · P1 · Guest app home screen (hero): other parts

- [ ] **Whole page** Open Guest app from Customers & marketing › Guest app. **Expect:** A spinner (RoutePending) shows while the screen code loads, then "Guest site home screen" with "At the top of the menu" mode choice (Menu only, Photo or video, Featured item), Scrolling lines, Waiter bell help and a phone-sized Preview. `OP.ADMIN.HERO.01`
- [ ] **Featured item tag and discount** P2 · Fill Line above the name and Badge in English and Arabic and save. **Expect:** Both show on the guest hero in the guest's language. `OP.ADMIN.HERO.FEATURED_DISCOUNT.06`

#### OP.ADMIN.HERO.T06 · P0 · Guest app home screen (hero): Who can and cannot use it

*Setup:* `WRONG_ROLE` (Signed in with a role that may not use this)

- [ ] P1 · Sign in as a Cashier account (role cashier, no second job, nothing blocked) and try to reach Guest app (/admin/hero): look on the rail and in Options, then open the address directly (browser build URL bar, or a deep link from a push or the assistant on a station). **Expect:** No rail row, family tab, section button or Go to entry leads to Guest app. Opened directly, the screen shows the card "Not allowed for your role: Opening this screen needs the Manager role. The control stays here so you can see what is available; ask someone with that role to do it." with a "Go to my home screen" link that lands on /till. No data from the page is fetched or shown. **Repeat for each:** Court desk account role court_desk (expect: /desk/today.); Driver account role driver (expect: /tasks.); Marketing account role marketing (expect: /plan.); Waiter account role waiter (expect: /tasks.); Shop assistant account role shop_staff (expect: /shop.). `OP.ADMIN.HERO.09 OP.ADMIN.HERO.11 OP.ADMIN.HERO.16 OP.ADMIN.HERO.17 OP.ADMIN.HERO.19 OP.ADMIN.HERO.20`

Opened directly, the screen shows the card "Not allowed for your role: Opening this screen needs the Manager role. No data from the page is fetched or shown. **Repeat for each:** Head barista account role head_barista; Barista account role barista; Head chef account role head_chef; Chef assistant account role chef; Assistant barista account role assistant_barista. `OP.ADMIN.HERO.10 OP.ADMIN.HERO.12 OP.ADMIN.HERO.13 OP.ADMIN.HERO.14 OP.ADMIN.HERO.15 OP.ADMIN.HERO.18`
- [ ] **Featured item tag and discount** As Manager open a hero with a stored discount. **Expect:** "A <pct>% discount is stored for <item>." with "Switch the discount off" and "Change the discount" (starts a protocol); the discount field is locked; Featured mode is locked with "Featured mode puts the stored discount on sale. Switch the discount off first, or change it in Protocols." `OP.ADMIN.HERO.FEATURED_DISCOUNT.04`
- [ ] **Featured item tag and discount** P1 · As Manager press "Switch the discount off". **Expect:** Confirm "Switch the featured discount off?" / "The featured item goes back to its full price..." with "Switch it off" and "Keep it"; after yes: "The featured discount is off." `OP.ADMIN.HERO.FEATURED_DISCOUNT.05`

#### OP.ADMIN.HERO.T07 · P0 · Guest app home screen (hero): ge

*Setup:* `SLOW_NETWORK` (Slow network), `BACKEND_DOWN` (Server unreachable while the LAN is up), `OFFLINE` (No internet), `ARABIC_RTL` (Arabic, right to left), `BLUE_MODE` (Blue colour mode), `SECOND_BRANCH` (Two branches), `SMALL_SCREEN` (Small station screen), `EMPTY_DATA` (Nothing recorded yet)

- [ ] `SLOW_NETWORK` P2 · Open Guest app with the network throttled to Slow 3G in dev tools (browser build) or on a weak venue Wi-Fi. **Expect:** A loading state (spinner or skeleton) holds the layout until data arrives; no half-filled form is editable before its saved values land, and nothing flashes an empty-state message first. `OP.ADMIN.HERO.02`
- [ ] `BACKEND_DOWN` P1 · With the station online, stop the backend (local stack: supabase stop; hosted: block the API host in the hosts file) and open Guest app. **Expect:** The page shows "This could not be loaded." (or the network line) with a "Try again" button instead of a blank screen; pressing Try again after the backend is back loads the page without a restart. `OP.ADMIN.HERO.04`
- [ ] `OFFLINE` Disconnect the station from the internet (unplug ethernet or turn Wi-Fi off), wait for the top strip to turn red, then open Guest app. **Expect:** Saving fails with "No connection..." and the optimistic change rolls back to the saved settings (set_cafe_settings is online-only). `OP.ADMIN.HERO.03`
- [ ] `ARABIC_RTL` P1 · Switch the app to Arabic (Options › العربية) and open Guest app. **Expect:** Every label, button, hint and toast on the page is Arabic; the layout mirrors (rail on the right, inline-start padding on the right); IQD amounts, times, dates and IDs that are Latin stay readable and are not reversed. `OP.ADMIN.HERO.05`
- [ ] **Preview and save bar** `ARABIC_RTL` P2 · Switch the operator to Arabic and look at the preview. **Expect:** The preview keeps showing the guest's own language layout correctly mirrored. `OP.ADMIN.HERO.PREVIEW.04`
- [ ] `BLUE_MODE` P2 · Switch Options › Blue mode on, open Guest app, then switch back to Light mode. **Expect:** Text, borders, inputs, badges and buttons stay legible in both modes; no white-on-white or blue-on-blue text; the choice persists after restarting the app. `OP.ADMIN.HERO.06`
- [ ] `SECOND_BRANCH` On the owner's unregistered PC with two open branches, open Guest app, note what it shows, then pick the other branch in the rail's Branch switcher. **Expect:** The screen remounts and reloads for the new branch: its list and values are the second branch's, not the first's. An unsaved edit made before switching is gone, never saved into the new branch. `OP.ADMIN.HERO.07`
- [ ] `SMALL_SCREEN` P2 · Make the window narrow (about 1024 px wide, a small till screen) and open Guest app. **Expect:** Nothing overlaps or is cut off; tables scroll inside their own box; primary buttons stay reachable without horizontal page scroll. `OP.ADMIN.HERO.08`
- [ ] **Top of the menu mode** `EMPTY_DATA` P2 · Choose Featured item on a branch with no menu. **Expect:** "There are no items on the menu yet." `OP.ADMIN.HERO.MODE.07`

### OP.ADMIN.QR: Table QR codes

Café tables, their printed QR cards and waiter bells; the owner can replace a card's QR (rotate token) for one table or all.

**Route:** `/admin/qr` · **Roles:** manager, owner

**Source:** `apps/operator/src/routes/admin/qr.tsx`, `apps/operator/src/features/admin/qr/QrPage.tsx`, `apps/operator/src/features/admin/qr/TableForm.tsx`, `apps/operator/src/features/admin/qr/QrCard.tsx`, `apps/operator/src/features/admin/qr/qrCardGeometry.ts`

**Components:** Add / edit table · Card panel and printing · Waiter bell switch · Replace QR code (one or all)

#### OP.ADMIN.QR.T01 · P1 · Add / edit table: main flow

- [ ] Add table 12, Zone Terrace, 4 seats, In use. **Expect:** Row "12 · Terrace · 4"; the café cashier lists table 12. `OP.ADMIN.QR.TABLE_FORM.01`
- [ ] P2 · Save with no table number. **Expect:** "Enter a table number." `OP.ADMIN.QR.TABLE_FORM.02`
- [ ] Add a second table with an existing number. **Expect:** Refused with a duplicate error; record the message. `OP.ADMIN.QR.TABLE_FORM.03`
- [ ] Switch In use off. **Expect:** "Its card stops working and it leaves the café cashier. Nothing is deleted." The table moves to "Tables not in use (<n>)". `OP.ADMIN.QR.TABLE_FORM.04`

#### OP.ADMIN.QR.T02 · P0 · Card panel and printing: main flow

- [ ] Pick table 12 and press "Print this card". **Expect:** The print dialog shows one A6 card with "TABLE 12", the QR, and "Scan · Order · Relax"; scanning the printed QR opens the guest menu for table 12. `OP.ADMIN.QR.CARD_PRINT.01`
- [ ] P1 · Press "Print all cards (<n>)". **Expect:** One card per page for every table in use. `OP.ADMIN.QR.CARD_PRINT.02`
- [ ] P1 · Scan a printed card for a table switched off. **Expect:** The guest page refuses the table (card stops working). `OP.ADMIN.QR.CARD_PRINT.04`

#### OP.ADMIN.QR.T03 · P0 · Table QR codes: other parts

- [ ] **Whole page** P1 · Open Table QR codes from Café & shop › Table QR codes. **Expect:** A spinner (RoutePending) shows while the screen code loads, then "Table QR codes" with "Every table has a printed card with its own QR code...", Add table, "Print all cards (<n>)", a search "Find a table or zone", the Tables table (Table, Zone, Seats, Waiter bell, Card) and a card panel "Pick a table to see its card". `OP.ADMIN.QR.01`

- [ ] **Replace QR code (one or all)** As Owner open table 12, "Card lost or photographed?", press "Replace QR code". **Expect:** Confirm "Replace the QR code for table 12?" explains the old card stops working at once; after yes: "Table 12 has a new QR code. Print its card now." Scanning the old card no longer reaches the menu. `OP.ADMIN.QR.ROTATE.01`
- [ ] **Replace QR code (one or all)** As Owner press "Replace every QR code". **Expect:** Confirm "Replace the QR code on every table (<n>)?"; progress "Replacing <done> of <total>…"; then "Table codes rotated — reprint the cards." `OP.ADMIN.QR.ROTATE.02`

### OP.ADMIN.COURTS: Courts

The bookable courts: names, descriptions, indoor/outdoor, booking lengths (60/120/180), photo, open for booking, calendar order, delete or switch off.

**Route:** `/admin/courts` · **Roles:** manager, owner

**Source:** `apps/operator/src/routes/admin/courts.tsx`, `apps/operator/src/features/admin/courts/CourtsAdmin.tsx`, `apps/operator/src/features/admin/courts/courtsLogic.ts`

**Components:** Court editor · Switch off / delete court · Calendar order

#### OP.ADMIN.COURTS.T01 · P0 · Court editor: main flow

- [ ] Press Add court, fill both names, choose Indoor, tick 60 and 120 min, Open for booking on, press Add court. **Expect:** The court appears in the table with "60 min, 120 min" and "Open for booking"; the desk calendar shows a new column. `OP.ADMIN.COURTS.FORM.01`
- [ ] P1 · Untick every booking length. **Expect:** "Choose at least one length." and the save is disabled ("Choose at least one duration."). `OP.ADMIN.COURTS.FORM.02`
- [ ] P2 · Save with one name empty. **Expect:** "Fill in both names first." `OP.ADMIN.COURTS.FORM.03`
- [ ] P2 · Upload a court photo. **Expect:** It shows in the guest app court list. `OP.ADMIN.COURTS.FORM.05`
- [ ] P2 · Edit a court, then press Close with unsaved changes. **Expect:** "Unsaved changes" is shown and Discard changes is offered before closing. `OP.ADMIN.COURTS.FORM.06`

#### OP.ADMIN.COURTS.T02 · P0 · Switch off / delete court: main flow

- [ ] Switch off a court that has upcoming bookings. **Expect:** "Upcoming bookings on this court: <n>. Move or cancel them at the desk before switching it off." with "Open the desk calendar"; save is blocked ("Move its upcoming bookings first."). `OP.ADMIN.COURTS.SWITCH_OFF_DELETE.01`
- [ ] P1 · Switch off a court with no upcoming bookings. **Expect:** Confirm "Switch off <court>?" explains it leaves the calendar and guest app; after "Switch off" the status reads "Switched off"; past reports keep its name. `OP.ADMIN.COURTS.SWITCH_OFF_DELETE.02`
- [ ] Press "Delete court" on a court with past bookings. **Expect:** "<court> cannot be deleted because the records still use it. Bookings: <n>. Repeat bookings: <n>. Price rules: <n>." with "Switch off instead" (COURT_IN_USE). `OP.ADMIN.COURTS.SWITCH_OFF_DELETE.03`
- [ ] P2 · Delete a brand new unused court. **Expect:** Confirm "Delete <court>?" / "...This cannot be undone."; then "Court deleted." and it is gone from the calendar. `OP.ADMIN.COURTS.SWITCH_OFF_DELETE.04`
- [ ] P2 · Toggle "Hide switched-off courts" / "Show switched-off courts (<n>)". **Expect:** Switched-off courts hide and show. `OP.ADMIN.COURTS.SWITCH_OFF_DELETE.05`

#### OP.ADMIN.COURTS.T03 · P1 · Courts: money and totals

- [ ] **Court editor** Add a 180 min length to a court with no 180 min price under Court prices. **Expect:** The court saves; record that the hint says "Each length needs a price under Rates" and that the desk cannot price a 180 slot until a rate covers it. `OP.ADMIN.COURTS.FORM.04`

### OP.ADMIN.RATES: Court prices (rate rules)

Rate rules price a court booking by court, weekday, time window, validity and duration; ties are flagged; the owner edits, a manager proposes through Protocols.

**Route:** `/admin/rates` · **Roles:** manager, owner

**Source:** `apps/operator/src/routes/admin/rates.tsx`, `apps/operator/src/features/admin/RateRuleEditor.tsx`, `apps/operator/src/features/admin/rateRuleLogic.ts`

**Components:** Rule editor

#### OP.ADMIN.RATES.T01 · P1 · Rule editor: main flow

- [ ] Leave every duration price blank. **Expect:** Save disabled: "Enter a price for at least one duration." `OP.ADMIN.RATES.RULE_FORM.05`
- [ ] P2 · Untick every day. **Expect:** "Choose at least one weekday." `OP.ADMIN.RATES.RULE_FORM.06`
- [ ] Set Valid to before Valid from. **Expect:** Refused with a validation message; record it. `OP.ADMIN.RATES.RULE_FORM.08`

#### OP.ADMIN.RATES.T02 · P0 · Court prices (rate rules): money and totals

- [ ] **Rule editor** As Owner create "Weekday base": All courts, every day, 08:00–24:00, priority 0, 60 min 20,000 IQD, 120 min 38,000 IQD, Active; save. **Expect:** "Rule saved."; a new desk booking of 60 min at 10:00 is priced 20,000 IQD and 120 min 38,000 IQD. `OP.ADMIN.RATES.RULE_FORM.01`
- [ ] **Rule editor** Add "Peak" for Court 1 only, Thu–Fri, 18:00–23:00, priority 0, 60 min 30,000. **Expect:** A Thursday 19:00 Court 1 booking is 30,000 (one-court rule beats all-courts); Court 2 stays 20,000. `OP.ADMIN.RATES.RULE_FORM.02`
- [ ] **Rule editor** Create two all-courts rules covering the same Friday 20:00 with the same priority. **Expect:** Both get a "Ties" badge and the "Rules that tie" panel lists the pair "first on Fri"; inside the form "Ties with <name> (Fri). Change the priority so one of them wins." `OP.ADMIN.RATES.RULE_FORM.03`
- [ ] **Rule editor** Type 20000.5 or -1 in a price. **Expect:** Refused: "Whole IQD per duration." `OP.ADMIN.RATES.RULE_FORM.07`
- [ ] **Rule editor** Change a price and save, then look at an existing booking made before the change. **Expect:** "Saving changes the price of new bookings only. Past bookings keep their price." The old booking keeps its old price. `OP.ADMIN.RATES.RULE_FORM.09`
- [ ] **Rule editor** P1 · Switch a rule off. **Expect:** It shows "Off" and hides under "Show switched-off rules (<n>)"; bookings fall back to the next matching rule. `OP.ADMIN.RATES.RULE_FORM.10`

#### OP.ADMIN.RATES.T03 · P1 · Court prices (rate rules): other parts

- [ ] Open Court prices from Courts › Court settings (first tab Court prices). **Expect:** A spinner (RoutePending) shows while the screen code loads, then "Court rates" with the lead "What a court booking costs, by day and time. A change applies to new bookings only...", New rule, and the rules table (Rule, Court, Days, Time, Prices, Priority). `OP.ADMIN.RATES.01`

#### OP.ADMIN.RATES.T04 · P0 · Court prices (rate rules): Who can and cannot use it

*Setup:* `WRONG_ROLE` (Signed in with a role that may not use this)

Propose a new rate or a change here and follow it in Protocols."; "Propose a new rate" instead of New rule; opened rules are read-only with "Change this rate" (starts a protocol) and a "Not allowed for your role" notice naming Owner. `OP.ADMIN.RATES.10`

Opened directly, the screen shows the card "Not allowed for your role: Opening this screen needs the Manager role. ### OP.ADMIN.BOOKING_RULES: Booking rules

Free cancellation window, time to finish a booking (hold), how far ahead guests can book, slots one guest can hold; owner edits, manager reads.

**Route:** `/admin/settings/booking` · **Roles:** manager, owner

**Source:** `apps/operator/src/routes/admin/settings.tsx`, `apps/operator/src/features/admin/settings/SettingsPages.tsx`, `apps/operator/src/features/admin/settings/venueParts.tsx`, `apps/operator/src/features/admin/settings/venueDetailsLogic.ts`

**Components:** Booking rules form

#### OP.ADMIN.BOOKING_RULES.T01 · P1 · Booking rules form: main flow

- [ ] Enter 200 hours in Free cancellation. **Expect:** "Enter a number from 0 to 168." `OP.ADMIN.BOOKING_RULES.FORM.02`
- [ ] Enter 0 in Time to finish a booking, then 61. **Expect:** "Enter a number from 1 to 60." for both. `OP.ADMIN.BOOKING_RULES.FORM.03`
- [ ] P2 · Enter 731 days in How far ahead. **Expect:** "Enter a number from 0 to 730."; 0 means no limit. `OP.ADMIN.BOOKING_RULES.FORM.04`
- [ ] P2 · Enter 0 or 11 in Slots one guest can hold. **Expect:** "Enter a number from 1 to 10." `OP.ADMIN.BOOKING_RULES.FORM.05`
- [ ] P2 · Type 2.5 in any field. **Expect:** "Enter a whole number." `OP.ADMIN.BOOKING_RULES.FORM.06`
- [ ] P2 · Change a value, see "Unsaved changes", press Discard. **Expect:** Fields return to saved values. `OP.ADMIN.BOOKING_RULES.FORM.07`

#### OP.ADMIN.BOOKING_RULES.T02 · P0 · Booking rules: money and totals

- [ ] **Booking rules form** As Owner set Free cancellation to 12 hours and save. **Expect:** "Venue details saved."; "Booking rules apply to new bookings as soon as you save." A guest cancelling 13 hours before is free, 11 hours before is not. `OP.ADMIN.BOOKING_RULES.FORM.01`

#### OP.ADMIN.BOOKING_RULES.T03 · P1 · Booking rules: other parts

- [ ] Open Booking rules from Courts › Court settings (tab Booking rules). **Expect:** A spinner (RoutePending) shows while the screen code loads, then "Booking rules" with "These apply to guests booking online and to the desk." and the fields Free cancellation (hours), Time to finish a booking (minutes), How far ahead guests can book (days), Slots one guest can hold at once (slots). `OP.ADMIN.BOOKING_RULES.01`

#### OP.ADMIN.BOOKING_RULES.T04 · P0 · Booking rules: Who can and cannot use it

*Setup:* `WRONG_ROLE` (Signed in with a role that may not use this)

- [ ] As Manager open Booking rules. **Expect:** The values show read-only (facts, e.g. "Up to 24 hours before", "No limit") with "Only the owner can change the venue name, phone and booking rules." `OP.ADMIN.BOOKING_RULES.09`
- [ ] P1 · Sign in as a Cashier account (role cashier, no second job, nothing blocked) and try to reach Booking rules (/admin/settings/booking): look on the rail and in Options, then open the address directly (browser build URL bar, or a deep link from a push or the assistant on a station). **Expect:** No rail row, family tab, section button or Go to entry leads to Booking rules. Opened directly, the screen shows the card "Not allowed for your role: Opening this screen needs the Manager role. The control stays here so you can see what is available; ask someone with that role to do it." with a "Go to my home screen" link that lands on /till. No data from the page is fetched or shown. **Repeat for each:** Court desk account role court_desk (expect: /desk/today.); Driver account role driver (expect: /tasks.); Marketing account role marketing (expect: /plan.); Waiter account role waiter (expect: /tasks.); Shop assistant account role shop_staff (expect: /shop.). `OP.ADMIN.BOOKING_RULES.10 OP.ADMIN.BOOKING_RULES.12 OP.ADMIN.BOOKING_RULES.17 OP.ADMIN.BOOKING_RULES.18 OP.ADMIN.BOOKING_RULES.20 OP.ADMIN.BOOKING_RULES.21`
- [ ] P1 · Sign in as a Kitchen (retired prep) account (role prep, no second job, nothing blocked) and try to reach Booking rules (/admin/settings/booking): look on the rail and in Options, then open the address directly (browser build URL bar, or a deep link from a push or the assistant on a station). **Expect:** The kitchen board has no rail, so nothing on it leads there. Opened directly, the screen shows the card "Not allowed for your role: Opening this screen needs the Manager role. The control stays here so you can see what is available; ask someone with that role to do it." with a "Go to my home screen" link that lands on /kds. No data from the page is fetched or shown. **Repeat for each:** Head barista account role head_barista; Barista account role barista; Head chef account role head_chef; Chef assistant account role chef; Assistant barista account role assistant_barista. `OP.ADMIN.BOOKING_RULES.11 OP.ADMIN.BOOKING_RULES.13 OP.ADMIN.BOOKING_RULES.14 OP.ADMIN.BOOKING_RULES.15 OP.ADMIN.BOOKING_RULES.16 OP.ADMIN.BOOKING_RULES.19`

#### OP.ADMIN.BOOKING_RULES.T05 · P0 · Booking rules: ge

*Setup:* `SLOW_NETWORK` (Slow network), `BACKEND_DOWN` (Server unreachable while the LAN is up), `OFFLINE` (No internet), `ARABIC_RTL` (Arabic, right to left), `BLUE_MODE` (Blue colour mode), `SECOND_BRANCH` (Two branches), `SMALL_SCREEN` (Small station screen)

- [ ] `SLOW_NETWORK` P2 · Open Booking rules with the network throttled to Slow 3G in dev tools (browser build) or on a weak venue Wi-Fi. **Expect:** A loading state (spinner or skeleton) holds the layout until data arrives; no half-filled form is editable before its saved values land, and nothing flashes an empty-state message first. `OP.ADMIN.BOOKING_RULES.02`
- [ ] `BACKEND_DOWN` P1 · With the station online, stop the backend (local stack: supabase stop; hosted: block the API host in the hosts file) and open Booking rules. **Expect:** The page shows "This could not be loaded." (or the network line) with a "Try again" button instead of a blank screen; pressing Try again after the backend is back loads the page without a restart. `OP.ADMIN.BOOKING_RULES.04`
- [ ] `OFFLINE` Disconnect the station from the internet (unplug ethernet or turn Wi-Fi off), wait for the top strip to turn red, then open Booking rules. **Expect:** The strip reads "Not connected — changes are saved here and will sync once the connection is back." The page shows its last loaded data if it was opened earlier this session, otherwise the error "This could not be loaded." with "Try again". Any save fails with "No connection. Check your internet and try again." and nothing is queued: after reconnecting, the change is NOT on the server and must be redone. `OP.ADMIN.BOOKING_RULES.03`
- [ ] **Booking rules form** `OFFLINE` P1 · Save offline. **Expect:** Network error; the rule is unchanged on the server. `OP.ADMIN.BOOKING_RULES.FORM.08`
- [ ] `ARABIC_RTL` P1 · Switch the app to Arabic (Options › العربية) and open Booking rules. **Expect:** Every label, button, hint and toast on the page is Arabic; the layout mirrors (rail on the right, inline-start padding on the right); IQD amounts, times, dates and IDs that are Latin stay readable and are not reversed. `OP.ADMIN.BOOKING_RULES.05`
- [ ] `BLUE_MODE` P2 · Switch Options › Blue mode on, open Booking rules, then switch back to Light mode. **Expect:** Text, borders, inputs, badges and buttons stay legible in both modes; no white-on-white or blue-on-blue text; the choice persists after restarting the app. `OP.ADMIN.BOOKING_RULES.06`
- [ ] `SECOND_BRANCH` On the owner's unregistered PC with two open branches, open Booking rules, note what it shows, then pick the other branch in the rail's Branch switcher. **Expect:** The screen remounts and reloads for the new branch: its list and values are the second branch's, not the first's. An unsaved edit made before switching is gone, never saved into the new branch. `OP.ADMIN.BOOKING_RULES.07`
- [ ] `SMALL_SCREEN` P2 · Make the window narrow (about 1024 px wide, a small till screen) and open Booking rules. **Expect:** Nothing overlaps or is cut off; tables scroll inside their own box; primary buttons stay reachable without horizontal page scroll. `OP.ADMIN.BOOKING_RULES.08`

### OP.ADMIN.ONLINE_DEPOSIT: Online deposit (Qi Card)

Deposit rules for guests booking courts in the app: Off / Optional / Required, percent (rounded up to 250 IQD), min, max, time to pay, no-show handling. Shown only when online payments are live.

**Route:** `/admin/settings/deposit` · **Roles:** manager, owner

**Source:** `apps/operator/src/features/admin/settings/SettingsPages.tsx`, `apps/operator/src/features/deposits/DepositSettingsPanel.tsx`, `apps/operator/src/features/deposits/depositSettingsLogic.ts`, `apps/operator/src/features/deposits/useOnlinePaymentsLive.ts`, `apps/operator/src/lib/navAccess.ts`

**Components:** Deposit rules form · Setup: Online deposit (Qi Card) (page) · Deposit rules

#### OP.ADMIN.ONLINE_DEPOSIT.T01 · P1 · Deposit rules: main flow

- [ ] Set largest below smallest **Expect:** "The largest deposit cannot be less than the smallest." `OP.ADMIN_DEPOSIT.RULES.03`
- [ ] Set 0 % or 150 % **Expect:** The range error shows (1 to 100 %) `OP.ADMIN_DEPOSIT.RULES.04`
- [ ] P2 · Set time to pay 1 minute or 45 minutes **Expect:** Range error (2 to 30 minutes) `OP.ADMIN_DEPOSIT.RULES.05`
- [ ] P2 · Have the server refuse a field (INVALID_ARGUMENT with details) **Expect:** The error lands on that field; other refusals show "This was not accepted. Check it and save again." `OP.ADMIN_DEPOSIT.RULES.06`
- [ ] Make a desk booking with Required on **Expect:** No deposit is asked (desk bookings never need a deposit) `OP.ADMIN_DEPOSIT.RULES.09`

#### OP.ADMIN.ONLINE_DEPOSIT.T02 · P0 · Online deposit (Qi Card): money and totals

- [ ] **Deposit rules form** As Owner choose Optional, Deposit size 30%, Smallest 5,000, Largest empty, Time to pay 10 minutes; save. **Expect:** "Deposit rules saved."; a 25,000 IQD court booked in the app offers a deposit of 7,500 IQD (30% rounded up to the nearest 250). `OP.ADMIN.ONLINE_DEPOSIT.FORM.01`
- [ ] **Deposit rules form** Check rounding: 30% of 22,100 IQD. **Expect:** Deposit 6,750 IQD (6,630 rounded up to the next 250), never more than the court price. `OP.ADMIN.ONLINE_DEPOSIT.FORM.02`
- [ ] **Deposit rules form** Set Smallest 10,000 and book a court costing 8,000. **Expect:** The deposit is 8,000 (never more than the court price), not 10,000. `OP.ADMIN.ONLINE_DEPOSIT.FORM.03`
- [ ] **Deposit rules form** Choose Required. **Expect:** Body "A booking is confirmed only once the deposit is paid. Guests marked "No deposit needed" can still book without one."; app bookings now wait for payment. `OP.ADMIN.ONLINE_DEPOSIT.FORM.05`
- [ ] **Deposit rules form** Choose "Keep the deposit" for no-shows. **Expect:** A no-show keeps the deposit; a cancelled booking (guest or desk) always refunds it ("A booking cancelled by the guest or the desk always gets its deposit back."). `OP.ADMIN.ONLINE_DEPOSIT.FORM.06`
- [ ] **Deposit rules** Set Optional, 30 %, smallest 5,000, largest empty, time 10 min, keep on no-show, Save **Expect:** "Deposit rules saved." and "Applies to new bookings as soon as you save." `OP.ADMIN_DEPOSIT.RULES.01`
- [ ] **Deposit rules** Verify deposit for a 35,000 IQD court at 30 % **Expect:** The app asks 10,500 rounded up to the nearest 250 IQD = 10,500 IQD, never more than the court price `OP.ADMIN_DEPOSIT.RULES.02`
- [ ] **Deposit rules** Choose "Refund the deposit" for no-shows, then no-show a booking with a deposit **Expect:** The deposit refund is started; the booking panel shows "Refund on its way" `OP.ADMIN_DEPOSIT.RULES.08`
