- [ ] `ONLINE_PAYMENTS_PAUSED` P2 · With payments paused, open /admin/settings/matches directly. **Expect:** The page opens; record whether the rules show (pay at desk locked with "Tickets need online payment, which is not connected yet, so seats are paid at the desk.") or the paused empty state. `OP.ADMIN.OPEN_MATCHES_SETTINGS.02`
- [ ] `SLOW_NETWORK` P2 · Open Open matches rules with the network throttled to Slow 3G in dev tools (browser build) or on a weak venue Wi-Fi. **Expect:** A loading state (spinner or skeleton) holds the layout until data arrives; no half-filled form is editable before its saved values land, and nothing flashes an empty-state message first. `OP.ADMIN.OPEN_MATCHES_SETTINGS.04`
- [ ] `BACKEND_DOWN` P1 · With the station online, stop the backend (local stack: supabase stop; hosted: block the API host in the hosts file) and open Open matches rules. **Expect:** The page shows "This could not be loaded." (or the network line) with a "Try again" button instead of a blank screen; pressing Try again after the backend is back loads the page without a restart. `OP.ADMIN.OPEN_MATCHES_SETTINGS.06`
- [ ] `ARABIC_RTL` P1 · Switch the app to Arabic (Options › العربية) and open Open matches rules. **Expect:** Every label, button, hint and toast on the page is Arabic; the layout mirrors (rail on the right, inline-start padding on the right); IQD amounts, times, dates and IDs that are Latin stay readable and are not reversed. `OP.ADMIN.OPEN_MATCHES_SETTINGS.07`
- [ ] `BLUE_MODE` P2 · Switch Options › Blue mode on, open Open matches rules, then switch back to Light mode. **Expect:** Text, borders, inputs, badges and buttons stay legible in both modes; no white-on-white or blue-on-blue text; the choice persists after restarting the app. `OP.ADMIN.OPEN_MATCHES_SETTINGS.08`
- [ ] `SECOND_BRANCH` On the owner's unregistered PC with two open branches, open Open matches rules, note what it shows, then pick the other branch in the rail's Branch switcher. **Expect:** The screen remounts and reloads for the new branch: its list and values are the second branch's, not the first's. An unsaved edit made before switching is gone, never saved into the new branch. `OP.ADMIN.OPEN_MATCHES_SETTINGS.09`
- [ ] **Open match rules form** `SECOND_BRANCH` P1 · Choose "All branches" and change Fill deadline. **Expect:** "Changing these changes them at every branch." The other branch shows the new deadline. `OP.ADMIN.OPEN_MATCHES_SETTINGS.FORM.04`
- [ ] `SMALL_SCREEN` P2 · Make the window narrow (about 1024 px wide, a small till screen) and open Open matches rules. **Expect:** Nothing overlaps or is cut off; tables scroll inside their own box; primary buttons stay reachable without horizontal page scroll. `OP.ADMIN.OPEN_MATCHES_SETTINGS.10`
- [ ] **Rules form** `VENDOR_DOWN` Try to turn off Players pay at the desk while online payments are not live **Expect:** Locked on: Tickets need online payment, which is not connected yet, so seats are paid at the desk. `OP.MATCH_SETTINGS.FORM.04`

### OP.ADMIN.COACHES: Coaches (coaches, lesson types, hours, lesson rules)

Makes guests into coaches, edits their profile, branches, lesson types and own prices; lesson types and prices; coach weekly hours and time off; lesson rules (owner).

**Route:** `/admin/coaches` · **Roles:** manager, owner

**Source:** `apps/operator/src/routes/admin/coaches.tsx`, `apps/operator/src/features/admin/coaches/CoachesAdmin.tsx`, `apps/operator/src/features/admin/coaches/CoachesTab.tsx`, `apps/operator/src/features/admin/coaches/CoachEditor.tsx`, `apps/operator/src/features/admin/coaches/PromoteCoachDialog.tsx`, `apps/operator/src/features/admin/coaches/LessonTypesTab.tsx`, `apps/operator/src/features/admin/coaches/LessonTypeEditor.tsx`, `apps/operator/src/features/admin/coaches/CoachHoursTab.tsx`, `apps/operator/src/features/admin/settings/CoachingSettingsPanel.tsx`

**Components:** Make a coach · Coach editor (profile, branches, lesson types, own prices, status) · Lessons & prices (lesson types) · Coach hours and time off · Lesson rules (coaching settings)

#### OP.ADMIN.COACHES.T01 · P1 · Make a coach: main flow

- [ ] Press "Make a coach", pick a guest account, fill both display names, tick this branch and two lesson types, press "Make coach". **Expect:** "<name> is now a coach."; the coach shows "Waiting for the coach to accept" until they accept in the app. `OP.ADMIN.COACHES.PROMOTE.01`
- [ ] P2 · Try to continue without picking an account / names / branch. **Expect:** "Pick a guest account first." / "Both display names are needed." / "Tick at least one branch." `OP.ADMIN.COACHES.PROMOTE.02`
- [ ] Pick an account that is already a coach. **Expect:** ALREADY_COACH: an "Open <name>" link to the existing coach instead of a duplicate. `OP.ADMIN.COACHES.PROMOTE.03`
- [ ] Look for staff accounts in the account picker. **Expect:** Only guest accounts appear; the made coach cannot sign in to the operator. `OP.ADMIN.COACHES.PROMOTE.05`

#### OP.ADMIN.COACHES.T02 · P1 · Coach editor (profile, branches, lesson types, own prices, status): main flow

- [ ] P2 · Change a coach's Link name to "Bad Slug!". **Expect:** "Use 2 to 48 lowercase letters, numbers and dashes, starting with a letter or number." `OP.ADMIN.COACHES.COACH_EDITOR.01`
- [ ] P2 · Change the Link name and save. **Expect:** Hint warned "Changing it stops the old link working."; the old share link 404s, the new one works. `OP.ADMIN.COACHES.COACH_EDITOR.02`
- [ ] Press Pause with a note. **Expect:** "<name> is paused."; not bookable and hidden from guests; booked lessons stay. `OP.ADMIN.COACHES.COACH_EDITOR.08`
- [ ] P2 · Open a coach whose guest account was deleted. **Expect:** "Account deleted: the bio and photo were cleared; the display name stays on their statements." `OP.ADMIN.COACHES.COACH_EDITOR.10`
- [ ] P2 · Toggle "Show retired coaches (<n>)". **Expect:** Retired coaches show with "Retired. Their statements stay under Coach pay." and "Make a coach again". `OP.ADMIN.COACHES.COACH_EDITOR.11`

#### OP.ADMIN.COACHES.T03 · P1 · Lessons & prices (lesson types): main flow

- [ ] Enter Length 45 or 300. **Expect:** "From 30 to 240 minutes, in steps of 30." `OP.ADMIN.COACHES.LESSON_TYPES.02`
- [ ] Group session: Places 6, Minimum 8. **Expect:** "The minimum can't be above the places." `OP.ADMIN.COACHES.LESSON_TYPES.03`
- [ ] Group session: Minimum 3 with Cut-off 0 hours. **Expect:** "At least 1 hour when the minimum is above 1." `OP.ADMIN.COACHES.LESSON_TYPES.04`
- [ ] P2 · Try to change the kind of a saved type. **Expect:** "The kind can't change once saved. Make a new lesson type instead." `OP.ADMIN.COACHES.LESSON_TYPES.06`
- [ ] Try to change the length of a type on sale. **Expect:** "Make a new lesson type to change its length, sessions or party size." with "Make a new lesson type…" `OP.ADMIN.COACHES.LESSON_TYPES.07`
- [ ] P2 · Look at a type with a pending price change. **Expect:** Badge "Price change in progress". `OP.ADMIN.COACHES.LESSON_TYPES.09`
- [ ] P2 · Switch an on-sale type off. **Expect:** "<name> is off sale."; booked lessons stay. `OP.ADMIN.COACHES.LESSON_TYPES.10`

#### OP.ADMIN.COACHES.T04 · P1 · Coach hours and time off: main flow

- [ ] Pick a coach, add Monday 16:00–21:00, press "Copy to every day", save. **Expect:** "Hours saved."; every day shows 16:00–21:00; the desk Coaches schedule offers those times. `OP.ADMIN.COACHES.HOURS.01`
- [ ] P2 · Add a window 16:15–17:00. **Expect:** "Windows start and end on the half hour." `OP.ADMIN.COACHES.HOURS.02`
- [ ] P2 · Add 18:00–17:00. **Expect:** "The window has to start before it ends." `OP.ADMIN.COACHES.HOURS.03`
- [ ] P2 · Add two overlapping windows on one day. **Expect:** "Overlaps another window on this day." `OP.ADMIN.COACHES.HOURS.04`
- [ ] Add time off tomorrow 10:00–14:00 with a reason. **Expect:** "Time off added."; the coach is not bookable then. `OP.ADMIN.COACHES.HOURS.06`
- [ ] P2 · Add time off with the end before the start / only one side. **Expect:** "The end has to be after the start." / "Choose the start and the end." `OP.ADMIN.COACHES.HOURS.07`
- [ ] P2 · Cancel a time off. **Expect:** Confirm "Cancel this time off?"; "Time off cancelled." `OP.ADMIN.COACHES.HOURS.08`

#### OP.ADMIN.COACHES.T05 · P0 · Coaches (coaches, lesson types, hours, lesson rules): money and totals

- [ ] **Coach editor (profile, branches, lesson types, own prices, status)** Set the coach's own price for Private lesson to 40,000 IQD as Owner. **Expect:** "Price saved."; the desk books this coach's private lesson at 40,000 instead of the lesson type price. `OP.ADMIN.COACHES.COACH_EDITOR.03`
- [ ] **Coach editor (profile, branches, lesson types, own prices, status)** P1 · Clear the own price. **Expect:** "<coach> now uses the lesson type's price." `OP.ADMIN.COACHES.COACH_EDITOR.04`
- [ ] **Coach editor (profile, branches, lesson types, own prices, status)** P1 · Untick a lesson type the coach has an own price for. **Expect:** Confirm "Remove <coach>'s own price?" / "Unticking <type> also removes <coach>'s own price for it." `OP.ADMIN.COACHES.COACH_EDITOR.06`
- [ ] **Coach editor (profile, branches, lesson types, own prices, status)** Press Retire on a coach with 3 upcoming lessons, with an empty note. **Expect:** Retire requires a note ("A note is needed to retire a coach."); after a note: "<name> is retired: 3 cancelled."; everyone booked is told; online money goes back; desk money becomes a refund due. `OP.ADMIN.COACHES.COACH_EDITOR.09`
- [ ] **Lessons & prices (lesson types)** As Owner create a Private lesson 60 min, Largest party 4, Price 35,000 IQD, Court share 10,000; "Create draft", then "Put on sale". **Expect:** "<name> saved as a draft." then "<name> is on sale."; guests can book it at 35,000; the venue keeps 10,000 per session before the coach share. `OP.ADMIN.COACHES.LESSON_TYPES.01`
- [ ] **Lessons & prices (lesson types)** Press "Put on sale" with no price. **Expect:** "Set a price first." `OP.ADMIN.COACHES.LESSON_TYPES.05`
- [ ] **Lesson rules (coaching settings)** As Owner set Coach's share to 60% and save. **Expect:** "Lesson settings saved."; a new 35,000 lesson with 10,000 court share pays the coach 15,000 (60% of 25,000); lessons already booked keep their old share. `OP.ADMIN.COACHES.LESSON_RULES.01`
- [ ] **Lesson rules (coaching settings)** Enter 60.555 or 101 in Coach's share. **Expect:** "A percentage from 0 to 100, with at most two decimals." `OP.ADMIN.COACHES.LESSON_RULES.02`

- [ ] `FEATURE_FLAG_OFF` P2 · With lessons switched off at the branch, open Coaches. **Expect:** Notice "Lessons are switched off at this branch. Coaches and lesson types can be set up now; guests see nothing until the owner switches lessons on." `OP.ADMIN.COACHES.09`

### OP.ADMIN.DAY_CLOSE: End of day count (Day close)

Opens the business day with a float, walks the close (open tabs, sync, cash count, card total), closes the day online, and hands each drawer's cash to the safe; lists discounts, voids, refunds, waste, unpaid played bookings, till shifts, unfinished checklists, money outside the drawer.

**Route:** `/admin/day-close` · **Roles:** manager, owner

**Source:** `apps/operator/src/routes/admin/day-close.tsx`, `apps/operator/src/features/admin/DayClose.tsx`, `apps/operator/src/features/admin/DayCloseOnline.tsx`, `apps/operator/src/features/admin/HandInToSafe.tsx`, `apps/operator/src/features/admin/dayCloseLogic.ts`, `apps/operator/src/features/admin/handInLogic.ts`, `apps/operator/src/features/shop/DayCloseShop.tsx`, `apps/operator-shell/src/main/index.ts`, `apps/operator-shell/src/main/queue.ts`

**Components:** Open the day · Close steps (tabs, sync, count, card) · Close the day and results · Discounts, voids, refunds, waste and adjustments · Unpaid played bookings, till shifts, checklists, money outside the drawer · Hand cash to the safe · Day open and Day close (page) · Open the day · Close steps · Close the day · The day record · Day close queue card (page) · Let this station finish syncing · Dismiss a stuck row

#### OP.ADMIN.DAY_CLOSE.T01 · P0 · Close steps: main flow

- [ ] Dismiss a row with a PIN shorter than 4 digits or a wrong PIN **Expect:** The dismiss button is disabled under 4 digits; a wrong PIN shows "pin not recognised" `OP.DAY_CLOSE.STEPS.04`
- [ ] P1 · Try to dismiss a pending (not failed) row **Expect:** Dismiss is disabled for it (not-resolvable) `OP.DAY_CLOSE.STEPS.05`
- [ ] P2 · Leave the card batch empty **Expect:** Step says card optional; close is allowed; the confirm says card "not entered" `OP.DAY_CLOSE.STEPS.08`
- [ ] P2 · Look at checklists not finished **Expect:** A warning panel lists checklists with unticked lines; close stays open `OP.DAY_CLOSE.STEPS.12`

#### OP.ADMIN.DAY_CLOSE.T02 · P0 · End of day count (Day close): money and totals (1 of 2)

- [ ] **Close steps (tabs, sync, count, card)** With two open tabs, look at step 1. **Expect:** "Settle or void every open tab" shows "2 still open" with each tab ("Table <n>" or "Tab without a name") and "Open at the café cashier"; the state badge reads "Open tabs left"; Close the day is disabled with "Settle or void the open tabs first (step 1)." `OP.ADMIN.DAY_CLOSE.CLOSE_STEPS.01`
- [ ] **Close steps (tabs, sync, count, card)** Make one queued write be refused by the server (e.g. pay a tab that was voided elsewhere) and open step 2. **Expect:** The row shows "Failed — will not retry" with the reason; "Dismiss" asks for a Manager PIN ("Dismiss a change the server refused" explains what it carried is NOT recorded); after a valid PIN the row goes and step 2 can complete. `OP.ADMIN.DAY_CLOSE.CLOSE_STEPS.04`
- [ ] **Close steps (tabs, sync, count, card)** Enter Counted cash 1,250,000 and Card terminal total 400,000. **Expect:** Step 3 shows "Counted"; the hint says the float is included; step 4 accepts the card total ("Leave it blank if nobody paid by card."). `OP.ADMIN.DAY_CLOSE.CLOSE_STEPS.06`
- [ ] **Close steps (tabs, sync, count, card)** Enter counted cash with a decimal or negative value. **Expect:** Refused: whole IQD 0 or more. `OP.ADMIN.DAY_CLOSE.CLOSE_STEPS.08`
- [ ] **Close steps (tabs, sync, count, card)** P1 · With court desk cash taken today, read step 3. **Expect:** "Already in the cash taken today. It is in the court desk’s cash box, so count that box too." `OP.ADMIN.DAY_CLOSE.CLOSE_STEPS.09`
- [ ] **Close the day and results** Press "Close the day" with float 100,000, cash sales 1,150,000, counted 1,250,000. **Expect:** Confirm "Close business day <date>?" lists "Counted cash: 1,250,000. Card terminal: <n>." and "This cannot be undone, and the café cashier cannot take orders until the next day is opened."; after yes the closed view shows Cash expected 1,250,000, Cash counted 1,250,000, Difference "Matches". `OP.ADMIN.DAY_CLOSE.CLOSE.01`
- [ ] **Close the day and results** Close with counted 1,240,000 against expected 1,250,000. **Expect:** Difference shows "Short by 10,000" (and "Over by <n>" when counted is higher). `OP.ADMIN.DAY_CLOSE.CLOSE.02`
- [ ] **Close the day and results** P1 · Leave the card total blank and close. **Expect:** The confirm reads "Card terminal: not entered" and the close succeeds. `OP.ADMIN.DAY_CLOSE.CLOSE.03`
- [ ] **Discounts, voids, refunds, waste and adjustments** With two discounts and one void today, read the summary. **Expect:** "Discounts and price overrides" and "Voided lines" each show "<n> recorded" and "PINs entered by" names; each line opens those entries in the audit log. `OP.ADMIN.DAY_CLOSE.SUMMARY.01`
- [ ] **Discounts, voids, refunds, waste and adjustments** P1 · Open "Each discount and price override". **Expect:** Rows show Time, What ("10% off", "Amount off", "Price override"), Amount, Reason, Who and "PIN: <name>"; a promotion shows reason "Promotion". `OP.ADMIN.DAY_CLOSE.SUMMARY.02`
- [ ] **Unpaid played bookings, till shifts, checklists, money outside the drawer** With a booking played today but unpaid. **Expect:** "Played today, not paid" with "<n> not paid", each row with the guest (or "Guest without a name") and "Still owed <amount>", "Open booking"; "You can still close the day." `OP.ADMIN.DAY_CLOSE.SIDE_PANELS.01`

#### OP.ADMIN.DAY_CLOSE.T15 · P0 · End of day count (Day close): ge

*Setup:* `BLUE_MODE` (Blue colour mode), `SECOND_BRANCH` (Two branches), `SMALL_SCREEN` (Small station screen), `TIMEZONE_EDGE` (Midnight / business-day boundary (Asia/Baghdad)), `SHIFT_NOT_OPEN` (Till shift state edge), `UPLOAD_BLOCKED` (Server reachable but queued writes cannot be sent), `QUEUED_WRITE_REFUSED` (A queued write is refused by the server after replay), `TWO_STATIONS_OFFLINE` (Two stations offline at the same time)

- [ ] `BLUE_MODE` P2 · Switch Options › Blue mode on, open End of day count, then switch back to Light mode. **Expect:** Text, borders, inputs, badges and buttons stay legible in both modes; no white-on-white or blue-on-blue text; the choice persists after restarting the app. `OP.ADMIN.DAY_CLOSE.06`
- [ ] `SECOND_BRANCH` On the owner's unregistered PC with two open branches, open End of day count, note what it shows, then pick the other branch in the rail's Branch switcher. **Expect:** The screen remounts and reloads for the new branch: the second branch's business day, drawers and figures. An unsaved edit made before switching is gone, never saved into the new branch. `OP.ADMIN.DAY_CLOSE.07`
- [ ] `SMALL_SCREEN` P2 · Make the window narrow (about 1024 px wide, a small till screen) and open End of day count. **Expect:** Nothing overlaps or is cut off; tables scroll inside their own box; primary buttons stay reachable without horizontal page scroll. `OP.ADMIN.DAY_CLOSE.08`
- [ ] **Close the day and results** `TIMEZONE_EDGE` Close at 01:30 Asia/Baghdad with the business day starting at 06:00. **Expect:** The day closed is yesterday's business date (the open session), and sales between midnight and 01:30 belong to it. `OP.ADMIN.DAY_CLOSE.CLOSE.05`
- [ ] **Open the day** `TIMEZONE_EDGE` P1 · Open the day just after midnight Baghdad time when the business-day start hour is 6 **Expect:** The business date is the one the business-day rule gives (previous date before the start hour), and the subtitle shows that date `OP.DAY_CLOSE.OPEN_DAY.05`
- [ ] **Unpaid played bookings, till shifts, checklists, money outside the drawer** `SHIFT_NOT_OPEN` With a till shift still open. **Expect:** "Cashier shifts" shows "<n> still open" and "Closing the day ends an open shift without a count. Ask its holder to end it at the café cashier, or close it there with a manager’s PIN." `OP.ADMIN.DAY_CLOSE.SIDE_PANELS.03`
- [ ] **Unpaid played bookings, till shifts, checklists, money outside the drawer** `SHIFT_NOT_OPEN` P1 · With cash taken while no shift was open at a station. **Expect:** "Taken outside a shift" lists the station with Cash taken / Cash refunded / Card taken. `OP.ADMIN.DAY_CLOSE.SIDE_PANELS.04`
- [ ] **Close steps** `UPLOAD_BLOCKED` With queued writes on this station, look at step "sync" **Expect:** It lists each unsynced write by kind (e.g. payment, void) with its state; Close is disabled until they sync `OP.DAY_CLOSE.STEPS.02`
- [ ] **Close steps** `QUEUED_WRITE_REFUSED` Dismiss a failed queue row with a manager PIN ("Dismiss") **Expect:** The row is parked as resolved (kept with who and when) and stops blocking; the write it carried is NOT applied `OP.DAY_CLOSE.STEPS.03`
- [ ] **Let this station finish syncing** `TWO_STATIONS_OFFLINE` Try to close the day on the till while the cafe cashier on another station still has queued rows **Expect:** Refused "A cafe cashier still has queued offline writes - let it finish syncing." `OP.DAYCLOSE_QUEUE.SYNC_STEP.05`

### OP.ADMIN.PROMOTIONS: Discounts & offers (Promotions list)

Lists promotions with status filters; the owner creates and edits; a manager proposes through Protocols and may switch one off.

**Route:** `/admin/promotions` · **Roles:** manager, owner

**Source:** `apps/operator/src/routes/admin/promotions.tsx`, `apps/operator/src/features/admin/promotions/PromotionsList.tsx`, `apps/operator/src/features/admin/promotions/promotionLogic.ts`, `apps/operator/src/features/admin/promotions/PriceChangeStart.tsx`

**Components:** Promotions table and switch

#### OP.ADMIN.PROMOTIONS.T01 · P0 · Discounts & offers (Promotions list): money and totals

- [ ] **Promotions table and switch** P1 · Read a live 10% promotion row. **Expect:** Discount "10% off", When e.g. "Any day, any time" or "<from>–<to>", Applies to "All cafe items" or "Courts: <n>", code "Code <code>" and "single use" where set. `OP.ADMIN.PROMOTIONS.LIST.01`
- [ ] **Promotions table and switch** As Owner switch a live promotion off. **Expect:** Status becomes Off; new bills no longer get it; history stays. `OP.ADMIN.PROMOTIONS.LIST.02`

#### OP.ADMIN.PROMOTIONS.T02 · P1 · Discounts & offers (Promotions list): other parts

- [ ] **Whole page** Open Discounts & offers from Customers & marketing › Marketing (tab Discounts & offers). **Expect:** A spinner (RoutePending) shows while the screen code loads, then "Promotions" with "A bill gets one promotion at most: the one that takes the most off...", New promotion, a Show filter (All, Live, Starting later, Off, Ended), search "Search by name or code" and the table (Name, Discount, When, Applies to, Status). `OP.ADMIN.PROMOTIONS.01`
- [ ] **Whole page** P2 · Compare the rail tab name with the page title. **Expect:** Tab reads "Discounts & offers", page title "Promotions"; record for the owner. `OP.ADMIN.PROMOTIONS.09`
- [ ] **Promotions table and switch** P2 · Filter Ended and search a code. **Expect:** Only ended promotions matching show; "No promotion matches." when none. `OP.ADMIN.PROMOTIONS.LIST.06`

#### OP.ADMIN.PROMOTIONS.T03 · P0 · Discounts & offers (Promotions list): Who can and cannot use it

*Setup:* `WRONG_ROLE` (Signed in with a role that may not use this)

- [ ] Sign in as a Cashier account (role cashier, no second job, nothing blocked) and try to reach Discounts & offers (/admin/promotions): look on the rail and in Options, then open the address directly (browser build URL bar, or a deep link from a push or the assistant on a station). **Expect:** No rail row, family tab, section button or Go to entry leads to Discounts & offers. Opened directly, the screen shows the card "Not allowed for your role: Opening this screen needs the Manager role. The control stays here so you can see what is available; ask someone with that role to do it." with a "Go to my home screen" link that lands on /till. No data from the page is fetched or shown. **Repeat for each:** Court desk account role court_desk (expect: /desk/today.); Driver account role driver (expect: /tasks.); Marketing account role marketing (expect: /plan.); Waiter account role waiter (expect: /tasks.); Shop assistant account role shop_staff (expect: /shop.). `OP.ADMIN.PROMOTIONS.11 OP.ADMIN.PROMOTIONS.13 OP.ADMIN.PROMOTIONS.18 OP.ADMIN.PROMOTIONS.19 OP.ADMIN.PROMOTIONS.21 OP.ADMIN.PROMOTIONS.22`
- [ ] Sign in as a Kitchen (retired prep) account (role prep, no second job, nothing blocked) and try to reach Discounts & offers (/admin/promotions): look on the rail and in Options, then open the address directly (browser build URL bar, or a deep link from a push or the assistant on a station). **Expect:** The kitchen board has no rail, so nothing on it leads there. Opened directly, the screen shows the card "Not allowed for your role: Opening this screen needs the Manager role. The control stays here so you can see what is available; ask someone with that role to do it." with a "Go to my home screen" link that lands on /kds. No data from the page is fetched or shown. **Repeat for each:** Head barista account role head_barista; Barista account role barista; Head chef account role head_chef; Chef assistant account role chef; Assistant barista account role assistant_barista. `OP.ADMIN.PROMOTIONS.12 OP.ADMIN.PROMOTIONS.14 OP.ADMIN.PROMOTIONS.15 OP.ADMIN.PROMOTIONS.16 OP.ADMIN.PROMOTIONS.17 OP.ADMIN.PROMOTIONS.20`
- [ ] **Promotions table and switch** P1 · As Manager switch a live promotion off. **Expect:** Allowed: it turns off. `OP.ADMIN.PROMOTIONS.LIST.03`
- [ ] **Promotions table and switch** As Manager try to switch an Off promotion on. **Expect:** The switch is disabled; a "Switch on" button starts the owner approval in Protocols instead. `OP.ADMIN.PROMOTIONS.LIST.04`
- [ ] **Promotions table and switch** As Manager look at the new button. **Expect:** "Propose a promotion" (starts a protocol) instead of "New promotion"; the note "The owner approves new promotions..." shows. `OP.ADMIN.PROMOTIONS.LIST.05`

#### OP.ADMIN.PROMOTIONS.T04 · P0 · Discounts & offers (Promotions list): ge

*Setup:* `SLOW_NETWORK` (Slow network), `BACKEND_DOWN` (Server unreachable while the LAN is up), `OFFLINE` (No internet), `ARABIC_RTL` (Arabic, right to left), `BLUE_MODE` (Blue colour mode), `SECOND_BRANCH` (Two branches), `SMALL_SCREEN` (Small station screen), `EMPTY_DATA` (Nothing recorded yet)

- [ ] `SLOW_NETWORK` P2 · Open Discounts & offers with the network throttled to Slow 3G in dev tools (browser build) or on a weak venue Wi-Fi. **Expect:** A loading state (spinner or skeleton) holds the layout until data arrives; no half-filled form is editable before its saved values land, and nothing flashes an empty-state message first. `OP.ADMIN.PROMOTIONS.02`
- [ ] `BACKEND_DOWN` P1 · With the station online, stop the backend (local stack: supabase stop; hosted: block the API host in the hosts file) and open Discounts & offers. **Expect:** The page shows "This could not be loaded." (or the network line) with a "Try again" button instead of a blank screen; pressing Try again after the backend is back loads the page without a restart. `OP.ADMIN.PROMOTIONS.04`
- [ ] `OFFLINE` Disconnect the station from the internet (unplug ethernet or turn Wi-Fi off), wait for the top strip to turn red, then open Discounts & offers. **Expect:** The strip reads "Not connected — changes are saved here and will sync once the connection is back." The page shows its last loaded data if it was opened earlier this session, otherwise the error "This could not be loaded." with "Try again". Any save fails with "No connection. Check your internet and try again." and nothing is queued: after reconnecting, the change is NOT on the server and must be redone. `OP.ADMIN.PROMOTIONS.03`
- [ ] **Promotions table and switch** `OFFLINE` P1 · Toggle a promotion offline. **Expect:** The switch snaps back with the network error. `OP.ADMIN.PROMOTIONS.LIST.07`
- [ ] `ARABIC_RTL` P1 · Switch the app to Arabic (Options › العربية) and open Discounts & offers. **Expect:** Every label, button, hint and toast on the page is Arabic; the layout mirrors (rail on the right, inline-start padding on the right); IQD amounts, times, dates and IDs that are Latin stay readable and are not reversed. `OP.ADMIN.PROMOTIONS.05`
- [ ] `BLUE_MODE` P2 · Switch Options › Blue mode on, open Discounts & offers, then switch back to Light mode. **Expect:** Text, borders, inputs, badges and buttons stay legible in both modes; no white-on-white or blue-on-blue text; the choice persists after restarting the app. `OP.ADMIN.PROMOTIONS.06`
- [ ] `SECOND_BRANCH` On the owner's unregistered PC with two open branches, open Discounts & offers, note what it shows, then pick the other branch in the rail's Branch switcher. **Expect:** The screen remounts and reloads for the new branch: its list and values are the second branch's, not the first's. An unsaved edit made before switching is gone, never saved into the new branch. `OP.ADMIN.PROMOTIONS.07`
- [ ] `SMALL_SCREEN` P2 · Make the window narrow (about 1024 px wide, a small till screen) and open Discounts & offers. **Expect:** Nothing overlaps or is cut off; tables scroll inside their own box; primary buttons stay reachable without horizontal page scroll. `OP.ADMIN.PROMOTIONS.08`
- [ ] `EMPTY_DATA` P2 · Open with no promotions. **Expect:** "No promotions yet." / "Create one to offer a percentage or fixed amount off, limited by date, weekday, hour, court, category or item." `OP.ADMIN.PROMOTIONS.10`

### OP.ADMIN.PROMOTION_EDITOR: Promotion editor

Creates or edits one promotion: type and value, dates, weekdays, hours, scope (courts, categories, items), limits, minimum bill, automatic or code, switched on.

**Route:** `/admin/promotions/$id` · **Roles:** manager, owner

**Source:** `apps/operator/src/routes/admin/promotions.tsx`, `apps/operator/src/features/admin/promotions/PromotionEditor.tsx`, `apps/operator/src/features/admin/promotions/promotionLogic.ts`, `apps/operator/src/features/admin/promotions/promotionsApi.ts`

**Components:** What it offers · When it applies · Scope, limits and how it applies

#### OP.ADMIN.PROMOTION_EDITOR.T01 · P1 · When it applies: main flow

- [ ] Set Starts to yesterday. **Expect:** "The start cannot be in the past." and Save says "Move the start to today or later to save." `OP.ADMIN.PROMOTION_EDITOR.WHEN.01`
- [ ] P2 · Leave Ends blank. **Expect:** "Leave blank for no end. It stops by itself after this day."; runs indefinitely. `OP.ADMIN.PROMOTION_EDITOR.WHEN.02`
- [ ] P2 · Set only the From hour. **Expect:** "Set both times, and make them different." `OP.ADMIN.PROMOTION_EDITOR.WHEN.04`
- [ ] P2 · Select no weekdays. **Expect:** "None selected means every day." `OP.ADMIN.PROMOTION_EDITOR.WHEN.05`
- [ ] P2 · Open an ended promotion. **Expect:** "Ended on <date>. It no longer applies to any bill." `OP.ADMIN.PROMOTION_EDITOR.WHEN.06`

#### OP.ADMIN.PROMOTION_EDITOR.T02 · P0 · Promotion editor: money and totals

- [ ] **What it offers** Create "Morning coffee" 15% off and save. **Expect:** "Promotion saved."; a qualifying 4,000 IQD coffee bill gets 600 IQD off at the till. `OP.ADMIN.PROMOTION_EDITOR.VALUE.01`
- [ ] **What it offers** Enter 0%, 100% or 150%. **Expect:** "Percent must be between 1 and 99." `OP.ADMIN.PROMOTION_EDITOR.VALUE.02`
- [ ] **What it offers** Fixed amount 5,000 IQD on a 3,000 IQD qualifying bill. **Expect:** The bill is never negative: the discount is capped at what is discountable; record the till result. `OP.ADMIN.PROMOTION_EDITOR.VALUE.04`
- [ ] **What it offers** 15% on a 3,250 IQD item. **Expect:** Record the rounding (487.5): the till and receipt agree, and the amount is whole IQD. `OP.ADMIN.PROMOTION_EDITOR.VALUE.05`
- [ ] **Scope, limits and how it applies** Choose nothing under scope. **Expect:** "Choose nothing to discount every cafe item on the bill. Court fees are never discounted." A court fee on the bill is not discounted. `OP.ADMIN.PROMOTION_EDITOR.SCOPE_LIMITS.01`
- [ ] **Scope, limits and how it applies** P1 · Pick Courts 1 and 2. **Expect:** "Only bills for bookings on these courts qualify." `OP.ADMIN.PROMOTION_EDITOR.SCOPE_LIMITS.02`
- [ ] **Scope, limits and how it applies** Set Uses per guest 1 and ring a bill with no named guest. **Expect:** The bill does not get the promotion ("With a per-guest limit, a bill with no named guest does not get this promotion."). `OP.ADMIN.PROMOTION_EDITOR.SCOPE_LIMITS.04`
- [ ] **Scope, limits and how it applies** Set Total uses 2 and use it on three bills. **Expect:** The third bill does not get it. `OP.ADMIN.PROMOTION_EDITOR.SCOPE_LIMITS.05`
- [ ] **Scope, limits and how it applies** Set Minimum bill 20,000 and ring 19,750. **Expect:** No discount; at 20,000 it applies. `OP.ADMIN.PROMOTION_EDITOR.SCOPE_LIMITS.06`
- [ ] **Scope, limits and how it applies** Tick "Each code works once" and use the code twice. **Expect:** The second use is refused. `OP.ADMIN.PROMOTION_EDITOR.SCOPE_LIMITS.08`
- [ ] **Scope, limits and how it applies** Create two promotions that both fit one bill. **Expect:** Only the one that takes the most off applies ("If several promotions fit one bill, only the one that takes the most off applies."). `OP.ADMIN.PROMOTION_EDITOR.SCOPE_LIMITS.09`

#### OP.ADMIN.PROMOTION_EDITOR.T03 · P1 · Promotion editor: other parts

- [ ] **Whole page** P2 · Open /admin/promotions/<unknown id>. **Expect:** "This promotion could not be found." with a way back. `OP.ADMIN.PROMOTION_EDITOR.01`
- [ ] **Whole page** P2 · Edit, then press Back with unsaved changes. **Expect:** "You have unsaved changes" / "Everything you changed here will be lost. Are you sure you want to close?" with "Discard changes" and "Keep editing". `OP.ADMIN.PROMOTION_EDITOR.03`

- [ ] **What it offers** P2 · Save with only the English name. **Expect:** "Enter both the English and the Arabic name." `OP.ADMIN.PROMOTION_EDITOR.VALUE.06`
- [ ] **Scope, limits and how it applies** Choose "Only with a code" on a new promotion. **Expect:** "Save the promotion first, then generate a code."; after saving, "Generate code" creates a code; without one: "Without a code this promotion can never apply." `OP.ADMIN.PROMOTION_EDITOR.SCOPE_LIMITS.07`

### OP.ADMIN.STAFF: Staff accounts

Owner-only: add staff accounts, set names, roles, passwords, PINs, branches, break allowance, cover stations, second jobs and blocked pages, remove or give back access.

**Route:** `/admin/staff` · **Roles:** owner

**Source:** `apps/operator/src/routes/admin/staff.tsx`, `apps/operator/src/features/admin/staff/StaffList.tsx`, `apps/operator/src/features/admin/staff/StaffAccountEditor.tsx`, `apps/operator/src/features/admin/staff/staffModel.ts`, `apps/operator/src/features/admin/staff/hirePrefill.ts`, `apps/operator/src/features/admin/staff/staffParts.tsx`, `packages/core/src/staff/access.ts`, `packages/core/src/staff/roles.ts`

**Components:** Add staff member · Manage one account (name, role, access on/off) · Password and PIN · Access: second jobs and blocked pages · Branches, cover stations and break allowance

#### OP.ADMIN.STAFF.T01 · P1 · Staff accounts: main checks

- [ ] Open Staff from Team › Staff. **Expect:** A spinner (RoutePending) shows while the screen code loads, then "Staff" with "Everyone who can sign in to this app, and what each of them can open.", "Add staff member", and the table (Name, Role, PIN Set/Not set, Access Can sign in/No access, Manage); your own row is marked "You". `OP.ADMIN.STAFF.01`
- [ ] With only one owner account, open Staff. **Expect:** Notice "There is only one owner account, and nobody can remove or re-role their own. Add a second owner as a safeguard." `OP.ADMIN.STAFF.09`
- [ ] P2 · Toggle "Show people without access (<n>)" / "Hide people without access". **Expect:** Removed people show and hide; their rows say "No access". `OP.ADMIN.STAFF.10`

#### OP.ADMIN.STAFF.T02 · P0 · Add staff member: main flow

- [ ] Press "Add staff member", fill Name, Email, Role Cashier, Branch, Password of 10+ characters, save. **Expect:** "Account created."; the person can sign in at once with that email and password and lands on /till. `OP.ADMIN.STAFF.ADD.01`
- [ ] P1 · Type a 7-character password. **Expect:** "Too short: add 3 more." live, and the step will not continue ("Use at least 10 characters."). `OP.ADMIN.STAFF.ADD.02`
- [ ] P2 · Type "bob@" as email. **Expect:** "This does not look like an email address." `OP.ADMIN.STAFF.ADD.03`
- [ ] P2 · Leave name or email empty. **Expect:** "Type their name." / "Type the email they sign in with." `OP.ADMIN.STAFF.ADD.04`
- [ ] P1 · Use an email that already has an account. **Expect:** "An account with this email already exists." (EMAIL_IN_USE) `OP.ADMIN.STAFF.ADD.05`
- [ ] P1 · Open the Role list. **Expect:** Hireable roles only: Cashier, Waiter, Court desk, Shop assistant, Manager, the barista and chef roles, Driver, Marketing; Owner and Kitchen (retired prep) are not offered. `OP.ADMIN.STAFF.ADD.06`
- [ ] P2 · Force a prep role through the API. **Expect:** "Kitchen is no longer given to anyone. Choose Barista or Chef assistant." (ROLE_RETIRED) `OP.ADMIN.STAFF.ADD.07`
- [ ] P1 · Open Staff from a hiring run link (protocol step) for a picked candidate. **Expect:** "From a hiring run" banner: "<name> was picked for <role>. Add their account here..."; the role is locked "Set by the hiring run..."; after saving "Account added. The hiring run is finished." `OP.ADMIN.STAFF.ADD.08`
- [ ] P2 · Open a hiring link whose step is not waiting on you, or names a role that cannot be given. **Expect:** "This hiring step is not waiting on you, so nothing is filled in." / "The position names a role an account cannot be given here..." `OP.ADMIN.STAFF.ADD.10`

#### OP.ADMIN.STAFF.T03 · P0 · Manage one account (name, role, access on/off): main flow

- [ ] P2 · Press Manage on a cashier, change "Name shown in the app", press "Save name". **Expect:** "Saved."; the rail and receipts show the new name; the email is unchanged ("The sign-in email cannot be changed here..."). `OP.ADMIN.STAFF.EDITOR.01`
- [ ] Change the role to Court desk and press "Change role". **Expect:** Confirm "Change <name>’s role to Court desk?" / "The change applies straight away; their menus update the next time they sign in." then "Role changed." `OP.ADMIN.STAFF.EDITOR.02`
- [ ] P1 · After changing a signed-in cashier to Court desk, watch their station for a minute. **Expect:** Within the role re-check (about 60 s or on focus) their rail becomes the Court desk rail, or they see the change at next sign-in; record which. `OP.ADMIN.STAFF.EDITOR.03`
- [ ] P1 · Press "Give access back" on a removed person. **Expect:** Confirm "Give <name> access again?" / "They can sign in again with their old password, in the role shown. They will need a new PIN."; then "Access given back." `OP.ADMIN.STAFF.EDITOR.05`
- [ ] P2 · Try to change the role of a removed person. **Expect:** "Give this person access again before changing their role." `OP.ADMIN.STAFF.EDITOR.06`
- [ ] Open your own account as owner. **Expect:** "This is your own account. Only another owner can change your role or remove your access." Role and access controls are disabled ("You cannot change your own account."); only the name can change. `OP.ADMIN.STAFF.EDITOR.07`
- [ ] Try to change the only other owner to Manager when they are the last owner. **Expect:** "This is the only owner. Make someone else an owner first." (LAST_OWNER) `OP.ADMIN.STAFF.EDITOR.08`

#### OP.ADMIN.STAFF.T04 · P0 · Password and PIN: main flow

- [ ] P1 · Press "Set a new password", type 12 characters, press "Set password". **Expect:** "Password changed."; the old password stops working at once ("Their current password stops working as soon as you save."). `OP.ADMIN.STAFF.PASSWORD_PIN.01`
- [ ] Press "Set PIN" for a manager and type 482916. **Expect:** "PIN saved."; the PIN column shows "Set"; the manager can approve a discount at the till with it. `OP.ADMIN.STAFF.PASSWORD_PIN.02`
- [ ] Type 12345, 111111 or 123456. **Expect:** "A PIN is 6 to 12 digits." / "That PIN is too easy to guess. Avoid repeated digits and runs like 123456." (PIN_FORMAT / PIN_WEAK) `OP.ADMIN.STAFF.PASSWORD_PIN.03`
- [ ] P2 · Type letters into the PIN field or more than 12 digits. **Expect:** Only digits are kept and input stops at 12. `OP.ADMIN.STAFF.PASSWORD_PIN.04`
- [ ] P1 · Press "Remove PIN". **Expect:** Confirm "Remove the PIN for <name>?" / "They will not be able to approve discounts, voids or price changes at the café cashier until a new PIN is set."; then "PIN removed." `OP.ADMIN.STAFF.PASSWORD_PIN.05`
- [ ] P2 · Read the PIN panel for a cashier vs a manager. **Expect:** Cashier: "Set. It starts and ends their breaks and unlocks the station." Manager: "Set. They can approve discounts and voids at the café cashier, take breaks and unlock the station." `OP.ADMIN.STAFF.PASSWORD_PIN.06`

- [ ] Look for any control that changes a person **Expect:** There is none besides Refresh and Audit log `OP.OBS_ACTIVITY.BOARD.12`

#### OP.ADMIN.AUDIT.T05 · P0 · Change history (audit log): ge

*Setup:* `SLOW_NETWORK` (Slow network), `BACKEND_DOWN` (Server unreachable while the LAN is up), `OFFLINE` (No internet), `ARABIC_RTL` (Arabic, right to left), `BLUE_MODE` (Blue colour mode), `SECOND_BRANCH` (Two branches), `SMALL_SCREEN` (Small station screen), `EMPTY_DATA` (Nothing recorded yet), `LARGE_DATA` (Large data volume), `TIMEZONE_EDGE` (Midnight / business-day boundary (Asia/Baghdad))

- [ ] `SLOW_NETWORK` P2 · Open Change history with the network throttled to Slow 3G in dev tools (browser build) or on a weak venue Wi-Fi. **Expect:** A loading state (spinner or skeleton) holds the layout until data arrives; no half-filled form is editable before its saved values land, and nothing flashes an empty-state message first. `OP.ADMIN.AUDIT.02`
- [ ] `BACKEND_DOWN` P1 · With the station online, stop the backend (local stack: supabase stop; hosted: block the API host in the hosts file) and open Change history. **Expect:** The page shows "This could not be loaded." (or the network line) with a "Try again" button instead of a blank screen; pressing Try again after the backend is back loads the page without a restart. `OP.ADMIN.AUDIT.04`
- [ ] `OFFLINE` Disconnect the station from the internet (unplug ethernet or turn Wi-Fi off), wait for the top strip to turn red, then open Change history. **Expect:** The strip reads "Not connected — changes are saved here and will sync once the connection is back." The page shows its last loaded data if it was opened earlier this session, otherwise the error "This could not be loaded." with "Try again". Any save fails with "No connection. Check your internet and try again." and nothing is queued: after reconnecting, the change is NOT on the server and must be redone. `OP.ADMIN.AUDIT.03`
- [ ] `ARABIC_RTL` P1 · Switch the app to Arabic (Options › العربية) and open Change history. **Expect:** Every label, button, hint and toast on the page is Arabic; the layout mirrors (rail on the right, inline-start padding on the right); IQD amounts, times, dates and IDs that are Latin stay readable and are not reversed. `OP.ADMIN.AUDIT.05`
- [ ] `BLUE_MODE` P2 · Switch Options › Blue mode on, open Change history, then switch back to Light mode. **Expect:** Text, borders, inputs, badges and buttons stay legible in both modes; no white-on-white or blue-on-blue text; the choice persists after restarting the app. `OP.ADMIN.AUDIT.06`
- [ ] `SECOND_BRANCH` On the owner's unregistered PC with two open branches, open Change history, note what it shows, then pick the other branch in the rail's Branch switcher. **Expect:** The screen remounts and reloads for the new branch: its list and values are the second branch's, not the first's. An unsaved edit made before switching is gone, never saved into the new branch. `OP.ADMIN.AUDIT.07`
- [ ] `SMALL_SCREEN` P2 · Make the window narrow (about 1024 px wide, a small till screen) and open Change history. **Expect:** Nothing overlaps or is cut off; tables scroll inside their own box; primary buttons stay reachable without horizontal page scroll. `OP.ADMIN.AUDIT.08`
- [ ] `EMPTY_DATA` P2 · Pick a period and filters that match nothing. **Expect:** "Nothing matches those filters." `OP.ADMIN.AUDIT.09`
- [ ] `LARGE_DATA` P1 · Load a period with more than 200 entries. **Expect:** "Showing the latest 200 of <total> in this period. Narrow the period or the filters to reach older entries." `OP.ADMIN.AUDIT.10`
- [ ] **Filters and export** `TIMEZONE_EDGE` P2 · Open a period spanning the business-day start (e.g. 03:00 entries). **Expect:** Entries are dated in the venue timezone (Asia/Baghdad). `OP.ADMIN.AUDIT.FILTERS_EXPORT.03`

### OP.ADMIN.TELEGRAM: Telegram notifications

Owner-only: staff group notifications for new orders and waiter calls, group choice, message language, test message, who may tap buttons, diagnosis and sent messages.

**Route:** `/admin/telegram` · **Roles:** owner

**Source:** `apps/operator/src/routes/admin/telegram.tsx`, `apps/operator/src/features/admin/telegram/TelegramSettings.tsx`, `apps/operator/src/features/admin/telegram/DetectedGroups.tsx`, `apps/operator/src/features/admin/telegram/ButtonPeople.tsx`, `apps/operator/src/features/admin/telegram/DiagnosePanel.tsx`, `apps/operator/src/features/admin/telegram/OutboxList.tsx`, `apps/operator/src/features/admin/telegram/telegramStatus.ts`

#### OP.ADMIN.TELEGRAM.T01 · P1 · Settings and status: main flow

- [ ] Switch "Send notifications to Telegram" on with no group chosen. **Expect:** Health: "No staff group is chosen." and the test button is disabled ("Switch notifications on and choose the staff group first."). `OP.ADMIN.TELEGRAM.SETTINGS.01`
- [ ] P2 · Type the group chat ID by hand as "abc". **Expect:** "A group chat ID is 5 to 20 digits, and may start with a minus sign." `OP.ADMIN.TELEGRAM.SETTINGS.02`
- [ ] P2 · Leave the example placeholder id saved. **Expect:** Status shows "The example number, not a real group". `OP.ADMIN.TELEGRAM.SETTINGS.03`
- [ ] P2 · Choose Arabic as Message language. **Expect:** New order messages arrive in Arabic regardless of the app language. `OP.ADMIN.TELEGRAM.SETTINGS.04`
- [ ] Press "Send test message" with everything set. **Expect:** "Waiting for Telegram to confirm…" then "Test message delivered." and the group receives it. `OP.ADMIN.TELEGRAM.SETTINGS.05`
- [ ] P2 · Press Send test twice quickly. **Expect:** "A test message is already on its way." `OP.ADMIN.TELEGRAM.SETTINGS.07`

- [ ] P2 · Allow without choosing the staff member. **Expect:** "Choose which staff member this is first." `OP.ADMIN.TELEGRAM.BUTTON_PEOPLE.02`

### OP.ADMIN.KITCHEN_SCREENS: Kitchen screens (pairing)

Owner-only, on the café cashier machine: a manager PIN reveals the pairing code and LAN address a new kitchen screen needs.

**Route:** `/admin/settings/kitchen` · **Roles:** owner

**Source:** `apps/operator/src/features/admin/settings/SettingsPages.tsx`, `apps/operator/src/features/admin/KitchenPairing.tsx`, `apps/operator/src/features/setup/StationSetupScreen.tsx`, `apps/operator/src/features/setup/stationSetup.ts`, `apps/operator-shell/src/main/pairing-code.ts`, `apps/operator-shell/src/main/lan-discover.ts`, `apps/operator-shell/src/main/index.ts`, `apps/operator-shell/src/main/lan-kds-server.ts`

**Components:** Pair a kitchen screen · Kitchen screens (pairing) (page) · Pairing code reveal (till side) · Kitchen screen first-run setup · Pair a kitchen screen card (page) · PIN gate and code reveal

#### OP.ADMIN.KITCHEN_SCREENS.T01 · P0 · Pair a kitchen screen: main flow

- [ ] On the till as Owner press "Pair a kitchen screen", enter a manager PIN, "Show the code". **Expect:** Steps "On the kitchen screen’s setup, choose Kitchen screen." / "Type this code:" with the 10-character Pairing code and the till's LAN address; "Done" closes. `OP.ADMIN.KITCHEN_SCREENS.PAIR.01`
- [ ] Enter a wrong PIN. **Expect:** "Incorrect PIN." and no code shows. `OP.ADMIN.KITCHEN_SCREENS.PAIR.02`
- [ ] P2 · On a till set up with a custom --lan-psk. **Expect:** "This café cashier was set up with a custom key from the command line..." `OP.ADMIN.KITCHEN_SCREENS.PAIR.04`

#### OP.ADMIN.KITCHEN_SCREENS.T02 · P0 · Pairing code reveal (till side): main flow

- [ ] P1 · Press "Pair a kitchen screen", type a valid manager PIN and press "Show the code" **Expect:** Two numbered steps: "On the kitchen screen's setup, choose Kitchen screen." and "Type this code:" with the code as XXXXX-XXXXX, plus "If it cannot find this café cashier, ... type 192.168.x.x"; "Done" closes `OP.KDS_PAIRING.REVEAL.01`
- [ ] P2 · Type three digits **Expect:** "Show the code" stays disabled until at least four digits; letters are stripped as typed `OP.KDS_PAIRING.REVEAL.02`
- [ ] Type a wrong PIN while online **Expect:** "Incorrect PIN." shows under the field; no code is revealed and the wrong PIN is not cached `OP.KDS_PAIRING.REVEAL.03`
- [ ] P1 · Type wrong PINs until locked **Expect:** "Too many wrong PINs — locked for a few minutes." and no code `OP.KDS_PAIRING.REVEAL.04`
- [ ] P2 · On a till set up with a custom --lan-psk flag, reveal **Expect:** Message "This café cashier was set up with a custom key from the command line. Pair kitchen screens with the same --lan-psk flag." and no code `OP.KDS_PAIRING.REVEAL.06`
- [ ] P1 · On a till whose station.json has no lan_psk, reveal **Expect:** Message "This café cashier has no pairing key. Remove station.json and set the station up again." `OP.KDS_PAIRING.REVEAL.07`
- [ ] P2 · On a till with no private network address, reveal **Expect:** Code shows with "This café cashier has no local network address yet; kitchen screens will find it once it is on the venue network." `OP.KDS_PAIRING.REVEAL.08`

- [ ] On a fresh PC choose "Kitchen screen", keep KDS-01, type the till's code and press "Find the café cashier" **Expect:** "Looking for the café cashier on this network…" then, with one till answering, "Saving and restarting…" and the app restarts as a kiosk KDS showing the sign-in `OP.KDS_PAIRING.FIRST_RUN.01`
- [ ] P2 · Type the code in lower case with spaces, O for 0 and I/L for 1 **Expect:** The field normalises to upper case with look-alikes mapped and shows XXXXX-XXXXX once ten characters are in `OP.KDS_PAIRING.FIRST_RUN.02`

- [ ] Type a valid-looking but wrong code **Expect:** "A café cashier answered but did not accept that code. Check the code on the café cashier and type it again." with "Type the code again", which clears the code `OP.KDS_PAIRING.FIRST_RUN.04`
- [ ] P2 · Type an address like 192.168.1 or 10.0.0.300 in Advanced **Expect:** "Enter a local network address like 192.168.1.10." and the action is held `OP.KDS_PAIRING.FIRST_RUN.07`

- [ ] P2 · Make station.json unwritable (or already present) and finish setup **Expect:** "The station could not be saved." with Try again, or "This station is already set up. Restart the app." with no retry `OP.KDS_PAIRING.FIRST_RUN.10`

### OP.ADMIN.BRANCHES: Branches

Branch cards (Open / Preparing / Closed) opening each branch's details; owner opens a new branch as a copy, works the readiness checklist, opens to guests and closes.

**Route:** `/admin/branches` · **Roles:** manager, owner

**Source:** `apps/operator/src/routes/admin/branches.tsx`, `apps/operator/src/features/admin/branches/BranchesAdmin.tsx`, `apps/operator/src/features/admin/branches/TimezonePicker.tsx`, `apps/operator/src/features/admin/branches/branchesLogic.ts`, `apps/operator/src/features/admin/branches/timezoneLogic.ts`, `apps/operator/src/lib/venue.tsx`

**Components:** Branch cards · Open a new branch (wizard) · Before it opens checklist, Open to guests, Close branch

#### OP.ADMIN.BRANCHES.T01 · P2 · Open a new branch (wizard): main flow

- [ ] Leave one name empty or 1 character. **Expect:** "Type the name in both languages, 2 to 80 characters each." `OP.ADMIN.BRANCHES.CREATE.03`
- [ ] Short name "-Bad Slug". **Expect:** "The short name takes 2 to 32 lowercase letters, digits and dashes, starting with a letter or digit." `OP.ADMIN.BRANCHES.CREATE.04`
- [ ] Skip the source branch. **Expect:** "Pick the branch to copy." `OP.ADMIN.BRANCHES.CREATE.05`
- [ ] Phone "abc". **Expect:** "This does not look like a phone number." `OP.ADMIN.BRANCHES.CREATE.06`

### OP.ADMIN.RANKS: Player ranks

Board and results (record, void), rules and levels (owner edits), levels to check; manager reads rules, records and voids.

**Route:** `/admin/ranks` · **Roles:** manager, owner

**Source:** `apps/operator/src/routes/admin/ranks.tsx`, `apps/operator/src/features/ranks/RanksScreen.tsx`, `apps/operator/src/features/ranks/RecordResultDialog.tsx`, `apps/operator/src/features/ranks/PlayerPicker.tsx`, `apps/operator/src/features/ranks/ranksLogic.ts`, `apps/operator/src/features/ranks/useRanks.ts`

**Components:** Rules and levels · Record and void results · Player ranks (page) · Results and Void · Public board and Adjust points · Rules and levels · Record a result (desk enters) · Levels to check

#### OP.ADMIN.RANKS.T01 · P1 · Rules and levels: main flow

- [ ] As Owner set Win 3, Loss 1, Draw 2, Board period This month, Players on the board 20; "Save rules". **Expect:** "Saved."; new confirmed games use these points; games already counted keep theirs. `OP.ADMIN.RANKS.RULES_LEVELS.01`
- [ ] P2 · Enter a value outside its range. **Expect:** "Between <min> and <max>." `OP.ADMIN.RANKS.RULES_LEVELS.02`
- [ ] P2 · Add 11 levels. **Expect:** "Up to 10 levels." `OP.ADMIN.RANKS.RULES_LEVELS.03`
- [ ] P2 · Give a level a start not above the one before, or a 25-character name. **Expect:** "Each level starts above the one before it." / "Each level needs a name in English and in Arabic, up to 24 characters." `OP.ADMIN.RANKS.RULES_LEVELS.04`

#### OP.ADMIN.RANKS.T02 · P1 · Record and void results: main flow

- [ ] Press "Record a result", pick two players per side, choose Side A won, score 6-4, "Record result". **Expect:** "Result recorded. Points added."; it shows Confirmed with source "Entered by staff"; the board updates. `OP.ADMIN.RANKS.RESULTS.01`
- [ ] P2 · Leave a side empty / pick the same player twice / no winner / score 100. **Expect:** "Each side needs at least one player." / "A player can be on the court only once." / "Choose who won." / "Fill both sides of a set with 0 to 99, or leave the set empty." `OP.ADMIN.RANKS.RESULTS.02`
- [ ] Void a confirmed result with a 2-character reason. **Expect:** Reason needs at least 3 characters; after a valid reason "Result voided. Its points came off." `OP.ADMIN.RANKS.RESULTS.03`

#### OP.ADMIN.RANKS.T03 · P1 · Results and Void: main flow

- [ ] P2 · Filter Waiting **Expect:** Player reports waiting for the opponent confirm; source Reported in the app `OP.RANKS.RESULTS.01`
- [ ] Void a confirmed result with a 10 character reason **Expect:** Result voided. Its points came off.; players see Voided `OP.RANKS.RESULTS.02`
- [ ] P2 · Void with a 2 character reason **Expect:** Refused (at least 3) `OP.RANKS.RESULTS.03`
- [ ] P2 · Void a result that lapsed or was rejected **Expect:** Void not offered (pending or confirmed only) `OP.RANKS.RESULTS.04`

#### OP.ADMIN.RANKS.T04 · P1 · Public board and Adjust points: main flow

- [ ] Read the board **Expect:** <period> · Since <date> · Top n with rank, name or Player, level and n pts `OP.RANKS.BOARD.01`
- [ ] P2 · As the owner add 50 points with a reason **Expect:** Points adjusted for <name>.; the board moves `OP.RANKS.BOARD.02`
- [ ] P2 · Adjust with no player or a short reason **Expect:** Choose a player. / Write a reason of at least 3 characters. `OP.RANKS.BOARD.03`
- [ ] P2 · Enter 1,001 points **Expect:** Refused (1 to 1,000) `OP.RANKS.BOARD.04`

- [ ] `SMALL_SCREEN` P2 · Make the window narrow (about 1024 px wide, a small till screen) and open Player ranks. **Expect:** Nothing overlaps or is cut off; tables scroll inside their own box; primary buttons stay reachable without horizontal page scroll. `OP.ADMIN.RANKS.08`

- [ ] **Levels to check** `TIMEZONE_EDGE` P2 · Read last played near midnight **Expect:** Report: dates use the fixed venue timezone, not the branch timezone; fine for one timezone, check for a second branch `OP.RANKS.LEVEL_REVIEWS.04`

### OP.TILL: Till (cafe cashier)

The cafe cashier's selling screen: floor plan of tables and courts, then a tab's menu, basket, bill, payments, discounts, loyalty and splits. Search params ?tab=<uuid> and ?reservation=<uuid>.

**Route:** `/till` · **Roles:** cashier, manager, owner

**Source:** `apps/operator/src/routes/till/_children.ts`, `apps/operator/src/routes/till.tsx`, `apps/operator/src/features/till/TillScreen.tsx`, `apps/operator/src/features/till/tillSearch.ts`, `apps/operator/src/lib/auth.tsx`

**Components:** Floor view and spot dialog · New order wizard · Category strip and item grid · Item sheet (size, modifiers, qty, note) · Line note dialog · Keyboard map and barcode wedge · Basket and Send to kitchen · Tab panel: lines, totals, actions · Bring to... (order delivery) · Payment dialog (cash / card) and shift gate · Split bill (evenly / by item) · Charge to booking · Guest bill and receipt print · Discounts at the till · Member on the bill (loyalty) · Offline tabs · Waiter calls · Scanned order slips

#### OP.TILL.T01 · P0 · Till (cafe cashier): main checks

- [ ] Sign in as a cashier on a till station and wait for the landing screen **Expect:** The app lands on /till showing the Floor view: heading 'Floor', Cafe/Courts switch, the plan of tables, the 'New order' button with F6, and the dark-blue service rail (Waiter calls, Scanned orders, shift panel, Other open tabs) `OP.TILL.01`
- [ ] P1 · Open /till?tab=<uuid of a live tab> (e.g. from Open tabs) **Expect:** The till opens straight on that tab in the order view (menu left, tab panel right) and the URL is rewritten to plain /till, so Back or reload does not re-apply it `OP.TILL.02`
- [ ] P1 · Open /till?reservation=<uuid of tonight's booking with no live tab> (Desk > open tab on booking) **Expect:** The 'New order' wizard opens pre-bound: the booking step shows 'Bound to booking' with the time, court and guest; Start order opens a tab on that booking `OP.TILL.03`
- [ ] P2 · Open /till?tab=hello&reservation=123 (values that are not uuids) **Expect:** Both params are dropped (validateTillSearch); the plain Floor view shows, no error and no dialog `OP.TILL.04`

#### OP.TILL.T02 · P0 · Floor view and spot dialog: main flow

- [ ] With one open tab on Table 3, tap Table 3 on the plan **Expect:** Table 3 is green with the open-tab look; the tap goes straight to that tab in the order view (no dialog) `OP.TILL.FLOOR.01`
- [ ] Open two tabs whose orders are brought to Table 5, then tap Table 5 **Expect:** The dialog 'Table 5 has more than one tab' lists both, oldest first, each with its label (or 'Tab 1/Tab 2'), item count, 'Open <age>' and 'since <time>'; picking one opens it `OP.TILL.FLOOR.02`
- [ ] P1 · Tap a free (plain) table **Expect:** A small dialog titled 'Table N' says nothing is on it yet and orders start at the counter; its 'New order' button opens the New order wizard (no tab is opened on the table directly) `OP.TILL.FLOOR.03`
- [ ] P2 · Put a tab into awaiting_payment on a table and look at the plan **Expect:** That table shows a thick amber edge and the 'Waiting for payment' / 'Paying' state; the legend lists Free, Open tab, Waiting for payment, Guest is calling `OP.TILL.FLOOR.04`
- [ ] P1 · Raise a waiter call from a table QR and look at that table **Expect:** The table carries the calling mark and its accessible name ends with 'Guest is calling'; the mark goes once the call is acknowledged/resolved `OP.TILL.FLOOR.05`
- [ ] P1 · Switch to Courts with tonight's bookings; tap a booking with no live tab **Expect:** Each court shows a board (Playing now / Next booking / Also today); the booking tap asks 'Open a tab for this booking?' with time, court and guest; 'Open tab' opens it and goes to the menu `OP.TILL.FLOOR.06`
- [ ] P1 · Tap a court booking that already has a live tab **Expect:** It goes straight to that tab; the Courts switch label shows '(N open)' counting live court tabs `OP.TILL.FLOOR.07`
- [ ] P1 · Open a counter tab with no table (New order, no name) and look at the service rail **Expect:** 'Other open tabs' lists it with a green dot, its label and 'Paying' badge when awaiting payment; tapping it opens the tab. Note: this list is not capped at 3 `OP.TILL.FLOOR.09`

#### OP.TILL.T03 · P0 · New order wizard: main flow

- [ ] Press F6 (or New order), leave the name empty, go to Review and press Start order **Expect:** Review shows 'Name: Next counter number' and 'Booking: No booking'; the tab opens with the next counter number and the till goes to its order view `OP.TILL.NEW_TAB.01`
- [ ] P2 · Type a name of only spaces, then Start order **Expect:** The name is trimmed to nothing and the tab takes the next counter number (never a blank label) `OP.TILL.NEW_TAB.02`
- [ ] Type 'Ali' and pick tonight's 19:00 booking card, then Start order **Expect:** Review shows 'Ali' and '19:00 . Court N'; the tab opens bound to that booking and its header shows 'Charged to booking . <court>' `OP.TILL.NEW_TAB.03`
- [ ] P1 · Open the booking step when tonight has an open match booking and a lesson court row **Expect:** Neither the open match booking nor the lesson row is offered (tillMayBill); bookings that already have an open or settling tab are also absent `OP.TILL.NEW_TAB.04`
- [ ] P1 · Open /till?reservation=<id of a booking that already has a live tab> **Expect:** The booking step shows the refused note 'That booking is not available to open a tab on (already has a tab, or not today).' `OP.TILL.NEW_TAB.05`
- [ ] P2 · Press Escape or Cancel on the wizard with a name typed **Expect:** The dialog closes and no tab is opened `OP.TILL.NEW_TAB.09`

#### OP.TILL.T04 · P0 · Category strip and item grid: main flow

- [ ] Open a tab, press a single-size item with no modifier groups (e.g. Water) three times **Expect:** The basket shows one line '3x Water (size)', not three rows (mergeQuickLine); the estimate is 3 x price in IQD `OP.TILL.GRID.01`
- [ ] P1 · Press an item with several sizes or a modifier group **Expect:** The item sheet opens instead of adding; the tile shows 'from <price>' and the more icon `OP.TILL.GRID.02`
- [ ] P2 · Right-click a quick-add tile **Expect:** The item sheet opens for that item so qty and note can be set `OP.TILL.GRID.03`
- [ ] P1 · Focus a sold-out or out-of-stock tile with the arrow keys and press Enter, then right-click it **Expect:** Nothing is added and no item sheet opens (only the ready state is interactive); the hover title explains why (unavailable or out-of-stock hint) `OP.TILL.GRID.04`
- [ ] P1 · As manager mark an item sold out (or paused for today), then look at its tile **Expect:** The tile is disabled with a dashed border and 'Unavailable - set by staff'; the legend under the grid appears; clicking does nothing `OP.TILL.GRID.05`
- [ ] P1 · Count a required ingredient down to 0 on hand **Expect:** Tiles of items needing it turn solid muted with 'Out of stock' and no price; legend shows; they clear when stock is received `OP.TILL.GRID.06`
- [ ] P1 · Change availability on the admin menu while the till is open **Expect:** Tiles update without reload via the 'menu' broadcast (menu_changed) `OP.TILL.GRID.07`
- [ ] P1 · Type 'lat' in the filter **Expect:** Matching items across all cafe categories show, no category is highlighted; with no match the grid reads 'No items match “lat”.' `OP.TILL.GRID.09`
- [ ] P1 · Check whether a shop (Touch Shop) category or product is on the cafe grid **Expect:** No shop-kind category or its products appear; they sell only at the shop desk `OP.TILL.GRID.10`
- [ ] P2 · Slow the network and open a tab with an uncached menu **Expect:** 'Loading the menu...' with a skeleton of the same height shows; then tiles appear without the layout jumping `OP.TILL.GRID.11`

#### OP.TILL.T05 · P1 · Item sheet (size, modifiers, qty, note): main flow

- [ ] Open an item with a required group (min 1) and choose nothing **Expect:** Add is disabled and says '“<group>” needs between 1 and 1 choices.' `OP.TILL.ITEM_SHEET.02`

### OP.TILL_TABS: Open tabs

The board of every open tab on the floor (cafe, booking and web-order tabs) with search, sort, open, merge and removal of empty tabs. Used by cashiers and management at the till.

**Route:** `/till/tabs` · **Roles:** cashier, manager, owner

**Source:** `apps/operator/src/routes/till/_children.ts`, `apps/operator/src/features/till/OpenTabs.tsx`

**Components:** Open tabs table · Remove an empty tab · Merge tabs · Open tab from the board

#### OP.TILL_TABS.T01 · P1 · Open tabs table: main flow

- [ ] Open three tabs (table 4, a booking tab on Court 2, a named walk-in) and view the board **Expect:** All three rows appear with their labels; the booking tab sits under its court group "Court 2" with a count and the court fee note under the table `OP.TILL_TABS.BOARD.01`
- [ ] Type a table number, a court name and a guest name into "Search table, court or guest…" **Expect:** The list narrows to matching rows each time; a search with no hit shows "No open tabs match this search." `OP.TILL_TABS.BOARD.02`
- [ ] P2 · Change "Sort by" between Table, Court and Name **Expect:** Rows reorder by the chosen key and the choice persists while the screen stays open `OP.TILL_TABS.BOARD.03`
- [ ] Place a web (QR) order on a table and look at the board **Expect:** The tab row carries the "Web order" badge `OP.TILL_TABS.BOARD.05`
- [ ] Press "Open" on a row **Expect:** The till opens with that tab selected (/till?tab=<id>) `OP.TILL_TABS.BOARD.06`
- [ ] P2 · Leave the board open for 10 minutes **Expect:** The "Open for" column ticks forward (since time shown, day and time when it was opened on an earlier day) `OP.TILL_TABS.BOARD.07`
- [ ] Raise a waiter call from a table QR while the board is open **Expect:** A chime plays, the waiter-call strip appears above the board and the tabs list refreshes (floor realtime topic) `OP.TILL_TABS.BOARD.10`

#### OP.TILL_TABS.T02 · P0 · Remove an empty tab: main flow

- [ ] P1 · On an empty tab press "Remove", then "Yes, remove", pick a reason and submit **Expect:** The confirm "Are you sure? You are about to delete the {name} tab." appears, then the reason prompt with the consequence text; after submit the row leaves the board `OP.TILL_TABS.REMOVE_EMPTY.01`
- [ ] P2 · Press "Keep" on the confirm **Expect:** Nothing is removed and the board is unchanged `OP.TILL_TABS.REMOVE_EMPTY.02`
- [ ] Try to remove a tab that has an order, a payment, a discount, a booking, or is settling **Expect:** Remove is not offered; the row explains the blocker in words (e.g. "Something has been ordered on this tab. Settle it, or void the lines first.", "This tab belongs to a booking, and the court fee is owed on it. Settle it instead.") `OP.TILL_TABS.REMOVE_EMPTY.03`
- [ ] P1 · Pick reason "other" and type a note **Expect:** The stored reason is "other: <note>" and appears in the audit log `OP.TILL_TABS.REMOVE_EMPTY.08`

#### OP.TILL_TABS.T03 · P0 · Open tabs: money and totals

- [ ] **Open tabs table** Compare "Total so far" of an open tab with the bill on the till for the same tab **Expect:** The board total equals the tab total in IQD (running total from compute_tab_totals mirror, or the server-stamped total_iqd once stamped) `OP.TILL_TABS.BOARD.04`
- [ ] **Merge tabs** Press "Merge" on table 4, choose table 5 as the tab that closes and press confirm **Expect:** Table 5 lines and payments move into table 4, table 5 leaves the board, and table 4 total = old table 4 total + old table 5 total in IQD `OP.TILL_TABS.MERGE.01`
- [ ] **Merge tabs** Merge two tabs where one has a booking court fee **Expect:** The merge either keeps the court fee on the surviving tab or is refused with a clear message; the court fee is never lost or doubled `OP.TILL_TABS.MERGE.05`

#### OP.TILL_TABS.T04 · P1 · Open tabs: other parts

- [ ] **Merge tabs** P2 · Open the merge dialog without choosing a donor tab **Expect:** The confirm button is disabled with the reason "pick a tab" (ws.cashier.merge.pickDonor) `OP.TILL_TABS.MERGE.02`
- [ ] **Open tab from the board** Press "Open tab", pick a free table and confirm **Expect:** The dialog closes, the till opens on the new tab and the board shows it `OP.TILL_TABS.NEW_TAB.01`

- [ ] **Remove an empty tab** P1 · Disconnect, then remove an empty tab **Expect:** The row shows the "removal queued" badge (wifi-off icon) instead of disappearing; the write is on the durable queue `OP.TILL_TABS.REMOVE_EMPTY.04`

*Setup:* `WRONG_ROLE` (Signed in with a role that may not use this), `STAFF_ACCESS_BLOCKED` (Owner blocked a page for this person (0345)), `EMPTY_DATA` (Nothing recorded yet), `BACKEND_DOWN` (Server unreachable while the LAN is up), `SHIFT_NOT_OPEN` (Till shift state edge), `ARABIC_RTL` (Arabic, right to left), `BLUE_MODE` (Blue colour mode), `LARGE_DATA` (Large data volume), `REALTIME_DISCONNECTED` (Realtime channel down, polling only), `SECOND_BRANCH` (Two branches)

### OP.TILL_CORRECTIONS: Tab corrections

The money corrections on a selected till tab that the till selling checks do not cover in depth: refund (management only, manager PIN), change price (price override), void after send edge cases and promotions. Refund, override and void ride the durable queue; promotions are online only.

**Route:** `/till?tab=<id>` · **Roles:** cashier, manager, owner

**Source:** `apps/operator/src/features/till/TabDetailPanel.tsx`, `apps/operator/src/features/till/ManagerActions.tsx`

**Components:** Refund · Change price · Void a sent line · Promotion

#### OP.TILL_CORRECTIONS.T01 · P0 · Tab corrections: money and totals

- [ ] **Refund** As a manager on a settled 11,500 IQD cash tab press "Refund", choose the payment, enter 3,000, manager PIN and reason **Expect:** The refund is recorded; payments list shows the refund; the refund max hint showed "up to 11,500 IQD" before `OP.TILL_CORRECTIONS.REFUND.01`
- [ ] **Refund** Enter an amount above what is left on the payment (e.g. second refund of 9,000 after 3,000 on 11,500) **Expect:** The refund button is disabled with the max reason (max 8,500 IQD); the server also refuses REFUND_EXCEEDS_PAYMENT `OP.TILL_CORRECTIONS.REFUND.02`
- [ ] **Refund** Refund a lesson or tournament payment from the till **Expect:** The cap is the amount due back (lesson) and the reasons offered are lesson_refund / lesson_goodwill or tournament_refund / tournament_goodwill; the goodwill switch lifts the cap to the payment remainder `OP.TILL_CORRECTIONS.REFUND.10`
- [ ] **Change price** Press a line, "Change price", type a new unit price, enter manager PIN and reason **Expect:** The line shows the new unit price and the total recalculates; the audit log has the reason and authoriser `OP.TILL_CORRECTIONS.OVERRIDE.01`
- [ ] **Void a sent line** Press a sent line, choose "Void", enter a manager PIN and reason "wrong_item" **Expect:** The dialog warns "This item has already gone to the kitchen. Voiding it records it as waste…"; after submit the line moves to "Voided" crossed out and the total drops by its line total `OP.TILL_CORRECTIONS.VOID.01`
- [ ] **Promotion** Apply a second promotion to the same tab **Expect:** Only one promotion stays on the tab (hint "One promotion per tab.") `OP.TILL_CORRECTIONS.PROMO.03`

- [ ] **Refund** P2 · Enter 0 IQD **Expect:** The refund button stays disabled `OP.TILL_CORRECTIONS.REFUND.03`
- [ ] **Refund** P1 · Tick items to refund (refund items section) **Expect:** The refund carries those order items; stock and reports reflect the returned items `OP.TILL_CORRECTIONS.REFUND.06`
- [ ] **Change price** P2 · Leave the new price equal to the current price **Expect:** The confirm is disabled with "Type a different price to change it." `OP.TILL_CORRECTIONS.OVERRIDE.02`
- [ ] **Change price** Type a negative or non-numeric price **Expect:** The field refuses it (money input) and the confirm stays disabled `OP.TILL_CORRECTIONS.OVERRIDE.03`
- [ ] **Void a sent line** Enter a wrong manager PIN in the void dialog **Expect:** The PIN error shows in the dialog (PIN_INVALID) and nothing is voided `OP.TILL_CORRECTIONS.VOID.02`
- [ ] **Promotion** P2 · Apply with no eligible promotion **Expect:** "No promotion applies to this tab right now." shows; totals unchanged `OP.TILL_CORRECTIONS.PROMO.01`
- [ ] **Promotion** P2 · Type a real code that does not fit the tab **Expect:** "That code is real, but it does not apply to this tab — check its items, times or minimum spend." shows `OP.TILL_CORRECTIONS.PROMO.02`

- [ ] **Void a sent line** `CONCURRENT_EDIT` P1 · Void the same line on two stations at once **Expect:** The second answers duplicate/no-op; the line is voided once and the waste is recorded once `OP.TILL_CORRECTIONS.VOID.05`

### OP.SHIFT: Till shift

The rail row and dialogs for a cashier/desk/shop person to start a shift with a counted float, end it with a blind count signed by their PIN or a manager PIN, and the payment gate that asks for a shift first. All shift writes are online only.

**Roles:** cashier, court_desk, shop_staff, manager, owner

**Source:** `apps/operator/src/features/tillShift/ShiftRailControl.tsx`, `apps/operator/src/features/tillShift/ShiftDialog.tsx`, `apps/operator/src/features/tillShift/ShiftProvider.tsx`, `apps/operator/src/features/tillShift/tillShiftLogic.ts`, `apps/operator/src/features/tillShift/api.ts`, `apps/operator/src/features/tillShift/LeaveShiftDialog.tsx`, `apps/operator/src/features/tillShift/LockLeaveGuard.tsx`, `apps/operator/src/features/tillShift/ShiftReport.tsx`

**Components:** Start my shift · End my shift / close a shift · Payment gate · Sign out and lock with a shift open · Shift report

#### OP.SHIFT.T01 · P0 · End my shift / close a shift: main flow

- [ ] Enter a wrong own PIN at the sign step **Expect:** PIN error shows; the shift stays open `OP.SHIFT.CLOSE.04`
- [ ] P1 · As a person with no PIN, end the shift **Expect:** The dialog says "You have no PIN yet, so a manager signs this count." and asks for a manager PIN `OP.SHIFT.CLOSE.05`
- [ ] P1 · Switch to "use manager PIN" and sign with a manager PIN **Expect:** The shift closes with closed_via manager_pin and the result says "Signed by <manager>" `OP.SHIFT.CLOSE.06`
- [ ] P2 · Press "change count" on the sign step **Expect:** Returns to the count step with the number kept `OP.SHIFT.CLOSE.08`

#### OP.SHIFT.T02 · P1 · Sign out and lock with a shift open: main flow

- [ ] With my shift open, press Sign out on the rail **Expect:** The dialog says "Count the drawer and end your shift before you sign out…" with End my shift, Sign out anyway (leave.signOutAnyway) and Cancel `OP.SHIFT.LEAVE.01`
- [ ] Choose "End my shift" **Expect:** The close dialog opens and, after closing, signs out `OP.SHIFT.LEAVE.02`
- [ ] Choose "Sign out anyway" **Expect:** Signs out; the shift stays open and the next person sees "<name> shift is open" on the rail `OP.SHIFT.LEAVE.03`
- [ ] P2 · On the lock screen, press sign out with my shift open **Expect:** The card says "<name>’s shift is still open here. Signed out, it stays open until a manager closes it." with Back and Sign out anyway (lock.signOutAnyway) `OP.SHIFT.LEAVE.04`

#### OP.SHIFT.T03 · P0 · Till shift: money and totals

- [ ] **Start my shift** Press "Start my shift", accept the prefilled float as counted, confirm **Expect:** The shift opens; the rail shows "End my shift" over "My shift · since HH:MM"; a toast confirms `OP.SHIFT.START.01`
- [ ] **Start my shift** After a previous shift left 50,000 IQD, start a new shift **Expect:** The dialog says "<name> left 50,000 IQD in the drawer at HH:MM." and asks to confirm that amount `OP.SHIFT.START.02`
- [ ] **Start my shift** Press "different" and count 48,000 instead of 50,000 **Expect:** The shift opens and the confirmation says it started with 2,000 IQD less than handed over `OP.SHIFT.START.03`
- [ ] **End my shift / close a shift** Press "End my shift", count 120,000 IQD, press next, enter own PIN and press end **Expect:** The result shows Float, Cash in, Cash out, Expected, Counted and the sign word ("The drawer matches", "Short by X" or "Over by X") where difference = counted - expected `OP.SHIFT.CLOSE.01`
- [ ] **End my shift / close a shift** Verify expected cash: float 50,000 + cash payments 80,000 - cash refunds 10,000 **Expect:** Expected shows 120,000 IQD; a count of 118,000 shows "Short by 2,000 IQD" `OP.SHIFT.CLOSE.02`
- [ ] **End my shift / close a shift** End the shift and read "{amount} stays in the drawer for the next shift." **Expect:** The amount equals the counted cash and is the next shift handover prefill `OP.SHIFT.CLOSE.03`
- [ ] **End my shift / close a shift** P1 · Count 0 IQD on a drawer that should hold cash **Expect:** The close goes through only with an explicit 0 count and shows "Short by <expected>" `OP.SHIFT.CLOSE.10`

#### OP.SHIFT.T04 · P1 · Till shift: other parts

- [ ] **Whole page** Sign in as a cashier on the till station with the day open and no shift **Expect:** The rail shows "Start my shift" (data-testid rail.shift.start) `OP.SHIFT.01`
- [ ] **Whole page** Sign in as a manager on the till **Expect:** No "Start my shift" is demanded; manager may take payment with a banner when another person shift or no shift is open `OP.SHIFT.03`
- [ ] **Start my shift** Enter a count above 999,999,999,999 IQD or a negative amount **Expect:** The input refuses it or the server refuses INVALID_COUNT/INVALID_FLOAT and the error shows `OP.SHIFT.START.04`
- [ ] **Start my shift** On a desk station and on a shop station, start a shift **Expect:** Both stations have a drawer and the shift opens with the station id shown in reports `OP.SHIFT.START.12`
- [ ] **Shift report** Open the shift report for a week **Expect:** Each shift shows day, person, station, times, float, expected, counted and difference; open shifts say "open" `OP.SHIFT.REPORT.01`
- [ ] **Shift report** P2 · Export the shift report to CSV **Expect:** The CSV has the same rows and raw IQD numbers `OP.SHIFT.REPORT.03`

### OP.BREAKS: Breaks and cover

The rail "Go on break" control, the full-screen break overlay that locks the station, and cover by another staff member with their PIN (0105). All online RPCs: break_status, start_break, end_break, cover_station.

**Roles:** cashier, court_desk, shop_staff, waiter, barista, head_barista, assistant_barista, chef, head_chef, prep, manager, owner

**Source:** `apps/operator/src/features/breaks/BreakProvider.tsx`, `apps/operator/src/features/breaks/BreakRailControl.tsx`, `apps/operator/src/features/breaks/BreakOverlay.tsx`, `apps/operator/src/features/breaks/BreakPinDialog.tsx`, `apps/operator/src/lib/breaks.ts`

**Components:** Start and end a break · Cover the station

#### OP.BREAKS.T01 · P1 · Start and end a break: main flow

- [ ] Enter a wrong PIN on Start break **Expect:** The PIN error (PIN_INVALID) shows and no break starts `OP.BREAKS.START_END.02`

- [ ] Enter the wrong PIN for the colleague **Expect:** The PIN error shows and the station stays locked `OP.BREAKS.COVER.02`

- [ ] **Start and end a break** `OFFLINE` Try to start a break offline **Expect:** The PIN dialog shows the no-connection error and no break starts (start_break is online only) `OP.BREAKS.START_END.05`
- [ ] **Start and end a break** `OFFLINE` Go offline during a break and press "I’m back" **Expect:** End fails with the no-connection message; the overlay stays until the network returns (a manager can still Quit with PIN if needed) `OP.BREAKS.START_END.06`
- [ ] **Cover the station** `EMPTY_DATA` P2 · Open the overlay when nobody is assigned to cover **Expect:** It says "Nobody can cover this station yet. The owner assigns cover staff under Staff." `OP.BREAKS.COVER.03`
