### OP.STATION_STATUS: Station status, queue and leaving

Shell-wide pieces every front-of-house screen relies on: the permanent connectivity strip (ok, degraded, upload blocked, offline), the toast for a queued write refused later, offline tab restore, and Quit / Exit full screen with a manager PIN.

**Roles:** cashier, court_desk, shop_staff, prep, barista, head_barista, assistant_barista, chef, head_chef, waiter, manager, owner

**Source:** `apps/operator/src/components/VenueStatusBanner.tsx`, `apps/operator/src/components/QueueFailureToasts.tsx`, `apps/operator/src/lib/queueResults.ts`, `apps/operator/src/lib/offlineTabs.ts`, `apps/operator/src/routes/__root.tsx`

**Components:** Connectivity strip · Queued write refused later · Quit and exit full screen

#### OP.STATION_STATUS.T01 · P1 · Quit and exit full screen: main flow

- [ ] As a cashier on a locked station choose Quit and enter a manager PIN **Expect:** The app quits after confirmation `OP.STATION_STATUS.LEAVE_STATION.01`
- [ ] As a manager try to Quit with your own PIN **Expect:** Refused with "own pin"; another manager PIN is needed `OP.STATION_STATUS.LEAVE_STATION.02`
- [ ] P2 · As the owner choose Quit **Expect:** Only the confirmation is asked, no PIN (leaveStationWithoutPin) `OP.STATION_STATUS.LEAVE_STATION.03`

#### OP.STATION_STATUS.T02 · P1 · Station status, queue and leaving: other parts

- [ ] **Connectivity strip** Look at the strip on a healthy station **Expect:** Green strip with a check icon and the ok text (data-connectivity="ok"); it is always visible, even when nothing is wrong `OP.STATION_STATUS.STRIP.01`
- [ ] **Queued write refused later** Have a write refused while mutate() is still waiting (online, under 8 s) **Expect:** The refusal shows beside the control that sent it, not as a toast `OP.STATION_STATUS.QUEUE_TOASTS.02`
- [ ] **Queued write refused later** P2 · Have a server refusal with an unknown code **Expect:** A generic message shows (UNKNOWN) instead of a raw code `OP.STATION_STATUS.QUEUE_TOASTS.03`

#### OP.STATION_STATUS.T03 · P0 · Station status, queue and leaving: ge

*Setup:* `OFFLINE` (No internet), `UPLOAD_BLOCKED` (Server reachable but queued writes cannot be sent), `DEGRADED_MODE` (Venue offline mode on the server), `OFFLINE_THEN_RECONNECT` (Offline, then back online), `ARABIC_RTL` (Arabic, right to left), `BLUE_MODE` (Blue colour mode), `QUEUED_WRITE_REFUSED` (A queued write is refused by the server after replay)

- [ ] **Connectivity strip** `OFFLINE` Unplug the network **Expect:** Within one heartbeat the strip turns red with a wifi-off icon and the offline text; nothing on screen moves (fixed height) `OP.STATION_STATUS.STRIP.02`
- [ ] **Quit and exit full screen** `OFFLINE` P1 · Offline, Quit with a manager PIN that was used online in the last 14 days **Expect:** The offline PIN cache accepts it; a PIN never seen online is refused `OP.STATION_STATUS.LEAVE_STATION.04`
- [ ] **Connectivity strip** `UPLOAD_BLOCKED` Block only the replay function while reads work **Expect:** The strip shows the red hourglass upload-blocked state `OP.STATION_STATUS.STRIP.03`
- [ ] **Connectivity strip** `DEGRADED_MODE` Take the till station offline for longer than the heartbeat window and look at the desk station **Expect:** The desk strip shows amber degraded: the app and website are locked out of near-term writes and the desk is the only channel selling `OP.STATION_STATUS.STRIP.04`
- [ ] **Connectivity strip** `OFFLINE_THEN_RECONNECT` P1 · Reconnect **Expect:** The strip returns to ok within a heartbeat `OP.STATION_STATUS.STRIP.05`
- [ ] **Connectivity strip** `ARABIC_RTL` P2 · Make the strip text long in Arabic **Expect:** It stays one line with ellipsis and the full text in the title tooltip `OP.STATION_STATUS.STRIP.06`
- [ ] **Connectivity strip** `BLUE_MODE` P2 · Check strip colours in blue mode and paper mode **Expect:** Each state keeps its icon and readable contrast in both modes `OP.STATION_STATUS.STRIP.07`
- [ ] **Queued write refused later** `QUEUED_WRITE_REFUSED` Queue a booking offline for a slot someone books online meanwhile, reconnect **Expect:** A short toast says the write was refused with the mapped reason (e.g. slot taken); Day close sync step lists it as failed/conflict `OP.STATION_STATUS.QUEUE_TOASTS.01`

#### OP.DESK.T02 · P0 · Drag to move: main flow

- [ ] P1 · Drag a booking by its grip to a free slot on another court and release **Expect:** The preview names "Move to {court} at {time}"; on release the reason prompt opens; after a reason the booking sits in the new place with the same length `OP.DESK.DRAG_MOVE.01`

- [ ] P1 · Move a linked customer booking into a time kept for the other gender (gender hours) **Expect:** The server decides; any refusal shows as the move conflict/refusal notice and the booking stays where it was `OP.DESK.DRAG_MOVE.09`

#### OP.DESK.T08 · P0 · Desk calendar: ge

*Setup:* `WRONG_ROLE` (Signed in with a role that may not use this), `STAFF_ACCESS_BLOCKED` (Owner blocked a page for this person (0345)), `EMPTY_DATA` (Nothing recorded yet), `BACKEND_DOWN` (Server unreachable while the LAN is up), `ARABIC_RTL` (Arabic, right to left), `SMALL_SCREEN` (Small station screen), `SECOND_BRANCH` (Two branches), `REALTIME_DISCONNECTED` (Realtime channel down, polling only), `TIMEZONE_EDGE` (Midnight / business-day boundary (Asia/Baghdad)), `LARGE_DATA` (Large data volume), `CONCURRENT_EDIT` (Two people change the same thing), `QUEUED_WRITE_REFUSED` (A queued write is refused by the server after replay)

- [ ] `BACKEND_DOWN` P1 · Block the API with no cached data and open /desk **Expect:** An error state with retry shows instead of a blank grid `OP.DESK.07`
- [ ] `ARABIC_RTL` P1 · Switch to Arabic **Expect:** Courts run right-to-left, times read correctly, the keyboard arrows still mean previous/next in reading order, and the drag preview label "Move to {court} at {time}" reads in Arabic `OP.DESK.08`
- [ ] `SMALL_SCREEN` P2 · Open on a 1280x720 station **Expect:** All courts fit or scroll horizontally inside the grid; the last row of the night is reachable `OP.DESK.09`
- [ ] `SECOND_BRANCH` As the owner switch branch in the rail while on /desk **Expect:** The calendar remounts with the other branch courts and bookings; no draft from the first branch survives `OP.DESK.10`
- [ ] **Day grid** `REALTIME_DISCONNECTED` P1 · Block realtime and book on another station **Expect:** The grid catches up on its polling interval `OP.DESK.DAY_GRID.07`
- [ ] **Day grid** `TIMEZONE_EDGE` P1 · Look at the night after midnight (e.g. 01:00 bookings when the trading night runs past midnight) **Expect:** Bookings after midnight show on the same trading night, not on the next calendar day `OP.DESK.DAY_GRID.08`
- [ ] **Day grid** `LARGE_DATA` P2 · Seed 80 bookings on one night **Expect:** The grid stays responsive while scrolling and dragging `OP.DESK.DAY_GRID.09`
- [ ] **Drag to move** `CONCURRENT_EDIT` Move a booking while another desk takes the target slot first **Expect:** The move is refused SLOT_TAKEN and the conflict notice "The move was refused. The booking stays where it was." shows; never a silent revert `OP.DESK.DRAG_MOVE.06`
- [ ] **Drag to move** `QUEUED_WRITE_REFUSED` Queue a move offline to a slot that is booked online meanwhile, reconnect **Expect:** The replay is refused SLOT_TAKEN; a refusal toast shows and Day close lists it; the booking stays in its original slot `OP.DESK.DRAG_MOVE.08`

### OP.DESK_CUSTOMER: Customer record

One customer: summary cards, contact, flags, staff notes, history, series, cafe orders, loyalty, discount, hold standing, open matches (plays as, ban, tickets), lessons and level. Most writes are direct online RPCs.

**Route:** `/desk/customers/$id` · **Roles:** court_desk, cashier, manager, owner

**Source:** `apps/operator/src/features/desk/customers/CustomerRecord.tsx`, `apps/operator/src/features/desk/customers/RecordCards.tsx`, `apps/operator/src/features/desk/customers/recordSummary.ts`, `apps/operator/src/features/coaching/CustomerLessonsPanel.tsx`, `apps/operator/src/features/coaching/CoachBadge.tsx`, `apps/operator/src/features/players/PlayerCard.tsx`, `apps/operator/src/features/players/PlayerFactsDialog.tsx`, `apps/operator/src/features/players/usePlayers.ts`, `apps/operator/src/features/players/playerLogic.ts`

**Components:** Flags · Staff notes · Bookings, series and cafe orders · Level and age band · Open matches on the record · Tickets panel · Lessons and coach · Loyalty panel · Customer discount · Hold standing · Customer record Lessons panel (page) · Lessons panel · Player card · Player facts dialog

- [ ] P2 · Write a note and press "Save note" **Expect:** The note shows with "by {name}" and the time `OP.DESK_CUSTOMER.NOTES.01`
- [ ] P2 · Press Save with an empty note **Expect:** "Write the note first." `OP.DESK_CUSTOMER.NOTES.02`
- [ ] P2 · Edit a note **Expect:** It shows "edited" `OP.DESK_CUSTOMER.NOTES.03`
- [ ] Check a printed receipt and the guest app for that customer **Expect:** Staff notes never appear on any printable or guest-facing surface `OP.DESK_CUSTOMER.NOTES.04`

- [ ] P2 · Type 0 points or leave reason empty **Expect:** "Type a number of points other than 0." / "Say why." `OP.DESK_CUSTOMER.LOYALTY.04`

- [ ] P1 · Type an amount of 0 **Expect:** "Enter an amount of at least 1 IQD." `OP.DESK_CUSTOMER.DISCOUNT.05`
- [ ] P2 · Set both parts to None and Save **Expect:** "Set a discount on the café, the court fee, or both." `OP.DESK_CUSTOMER.DISCOUNT.06`

### OP.DESK_SERIES_NEW: New series

Books the same court at the same time week after week: who, when it repeats, live date preview with clashes resolved per row (preview_series), then create_series. Online only.

**Route:** `/desk/series/new` · **Roles:** court_desk, manager, owner

**Source:** `apps/operator/src/features/desk/series/SeriesCreate.tsx`, `apps/operator/src/features/desk/series/seriesLogic.ts`

**Components:** Who it is for · When it repeats · Live preview and clashes

#### OP.DESK_SERIES_NEW.T01 · P1 · Who it is for: main flow

- [ ] Find an account and pick it **Expect:** The series links to the customer `OP.DESK_SERIES_NEW.WHO.01`
- [ ] Type a name without a phone **Expect:** "Enter a phone number." ("So the desk can call if a date has to move.") `OP.DESK_SERIES_NEW.WHO.02`
- [ ] P2 · Type letters in the phone **Expect:** "Enter a phone number in digits." `OP.DESK_SERIES_NEW.WHO.03`
- [ ] Leave both empty **Expect:** "Enter a name, or find their account." `OP.DESK_SERIES_NEW.WHO.04`

#### OP.DESK_SERIES_NEW.T02 · P1 · When it repeats: main flow

- [ ] Choose Every week, Court 1, first date next Monday 19:00, 90 min, By count 8 **Expect:** The sentence reads "Every Monday on Court 1 From {first} to {last}" and 8 dates list `OP.DESK_SERIES_NEW.PATTERN.01`
- [ ] Choose Every 2 weeks with count 2 **Expect:** Hint "Sessions sit two weeks apart: 2 books two sessions, 14 days between them." and 2 dates 14 days apart `OP.DESK_SERIES_NEW.PATTERN.02`
- [ ] Choose Chosen days Mon and Wed, 3 weeks **Expect:** Hint "This counts calendar weeks…"; 6 dates `OP.DESK_SERIES_NEW.PATTERN.03`
- [ ] P2 · Choose Chosen days with no day ticked **Expect:** "Pick at least one day." `OP.DESK_SERIES_NEW.PATTERN.04`
- [ ] Set a past first date **Expect:** "The first date cannot be in the past." `OP.DESK_SERIES_NEW.PATTERN.05`
- [ ] P2 · Set the last date before the first **Expect:** "The last date must be after the first." `OP.DESK_SERIES_NEW.PATTERN.06`
- [ ] P2 · Enter 0 sessions **Expect:** "Enter a number of at least one." `OP.DESK_SERIES_NEW.PATTERN.07`

#### OP.DESK_SERIES_NEW.T03 · P0 · Live preview and clashes: main flow

- [ ] P1 · Complete the pattern **Expect:** "Checking the dates…" then "{count} dates · {conflicts} clash"; no check button `OP.DESK_SERIES_NEW.PREVIEW.01`
- [ ] With two taken dates **Expect:** "2 dates are already taken. Choose what to do with each one below." and the button names what is missing `OP.DESK_SERIES_NEW.PREVIEW.02`
- [ ] P1 · Choose "Skip this date" on one and "Move to Court 3" on the other **Expect:** Rows read "Skipped" and "Moved to Court 3"; "Every taken date has a choice."; button "Book 7 sessions" `OP.DESK_SERIES_NEW.PREVIEW.03`
- [ ] P2 · A clash with no other court free **Expect:** "No other court is free at this time — skip it." `OP.DESK_SERIES_NEW.PREVIEW.04`
- [ ] P2 · Skip every date **Expect:** "Every date is skipped, so there is nothing to book." and the button disabled `OP.DESK_SERIES_NEW.PREVIEW.05`
- [ ] P1 · Press "Book 7 sessions" **Expect:** "Series booked: 7 sessions, 1 dates skipped." with Open series and Book another series `OP.DESK_SERIES_NEW.PREVIEW.06`
- [ ] P2 · Change the pattern after the preview **Expect:** The preview re-runs automatically (debounced) `OP.DESK_SERIES_NEW.PREVIEW.07`

#### OP.DESK_SERIES_NEW.T04 · P1 · New series: money and totals

- [ ] **Live preview and clashes** Check the price of series sessions **Expect:** Each occurrence is priced by the server like a normal booking; the court fee is collected per occurrence at the desk `OP.DESK_SERIES_NEW.PREVIEW.11`

#### OP.DESK_SERIES_NEW.T05 · P1 · New series: other parts

- [ ] Open /desk/series/new from the calendar "New series" **Expect:** Three blocks: Who it is for, When it repeats, What will be booked (sentence and dates list) `OP.DESK_SERIES_NEW.01`

#### OP.DESK_SERIES_NEW.T06 · P0 · New series: ge

*Setup:* `WRONG_ROLE` (Signed in with a role that may not use this), `TIMEZONE_EDGE` (Midnight / business-day boundary (Asia/Baghdad)), `CONCURRENT_EDIT` (Two people change the same thing), `OFFLINE` (No internet), `EMPTY_DATA` (Nothing recorded yet)

- [ ] `WRONG_ROLE` P1 · Open as a cashier **Expect:** Role refusal `OP.DESK_SERIES_NEW.02`
- [ ] **When it repeats** `TIMEZONE_EDGE` P2 · Choose a series crossing the clocks or the business-day start (e.g. 00:30 start) **Expect:** Dates are the trading-night dates, consistent with the calendar `OP.DESK_SERIES_NEW.PATTERN.08`
- [ ] **Live preview and clashes** `CONCURRENT_EDIT` Have another desk book one of the previewed free dates before pressing Book **Expect:** The create follows the server: the clash is refused or reported; nothing is double-booked `OP.DESK_SERIES_NEW.PREVIEW.08`
- [ ] **Live preview and clashes** `OFFLINE` P1 · Preview or book offline **Expect:** Preview cannot run and Book fails with the no-connection message; nothing is queued (create_series is not a queued type) `OP.DESK_SERIES_NEW.PREVIEW.09`
- [ ] **Live preview and clashes** `EMPTY_DATA` P2 · Before pressing Book, empty preview **Expect:** "Pick a court, a first date and a start time to see every date this series books." `OP.DESK_SERIES_NEW.PREVIEW.10`

### OP.DESK_SERIES: Series detail

An existing series and its occurrences: played ones untouchable, open one, cancel one (reservation.update cancel, queued) or cancel the series with a scope (cancel_series, online).

**Route:** `/desk/series/$id` · **Roles:** court_desk, manager, owner

**Source:** `apps/operator/src/features/desk/series/SeriesDetail.tsx`

**Components:** Occurrences · Cancel series

#### OP.DESK_SERIES.T01 · P1 · Series detail: main checks

- [ ] Open a series **Expect:** Pattern, Court, Customer, Range and "{total} total · {played} played · {upcoming} upcoming" `OP.DESK_SERIES.01`
- [ ] P2 · Open an unknown series id **Expect:** "This series does not exist." `OP.DESK_SERIES.02`
- [ ] P2 · Open a cancelled series **Expect:** "This series is cancelled." `OP.DESK_SERIES.03`

- [ ] Press "Cancel series", choose "Future occurrences only", Continue, give a reason **Expect:** "Series cancelled."; future dates freed on the calendar; played ones untouched ("Played occurrences are never touched.") `OP.DESK_SERIES.CANCEL_SERIES.01`

### OP.KDS: Kitchen display

The wall-mounted, navless, dark ticket board for the bar and the kitchen: every cafe ticket from the till and the guest website in arrival order, bumped Start -> Ready -> Complete by touch or keyboard. Falls back to the cafe till's LAN feed when the cloud is down.

**Route:** `/kds` · **Roles:** prep, head_barista, barista, assistant_barista, head_chef, chef, manager, owner

**Source:** `apps/operator/src/routes/kds.tsx`, `apps/operator/src/features/kds/KdsBoard.tsx`, `apps/operator/src/features/kds/KitchenDisplayScreen.tsx`, `apps/operator/src/routes/__root.tsx`, `apps/operator/src/lib/auth.tsx`

**Components:** Board header · Ticket arrival · Ticket card · Ticket bump (Start / Ready / Complete) · Item ready ticks · Sound and stale alarms · Keyboard bumping · LAN fallback (offline kitchen)

#### OP.KDS.T01 · P0 · Kitchen display: main checks

- [ ] Sign in as prep on a station set up as Kitchen screen **Expect:** The app opens straight on /kds (homeRoute) with the dark board, no rail, header "Kitchen display", a centred clock, the connection pill and the key legend at the bottom `OP.KDS.01`
- [ ] P1 · On a production (kiosk) KDS station on macOS, look at the top corners while the board is up **Expect:** No traffic-light buttons and no OS titlebar show over the header (pushChromeless while the navless workspace is up); the window cannot be minimised `OP.KDS.02`
- [ ] P1 · Sign in as head_barista and as head_chef on the same KDS station and compare the tickets shown **Expect:** Both see the same full list (bar drinks and kitchen food together). There is no bar-only or kitchen-only filter by role: kitchen_board takes no station argument. Record this as a known gap if separate bar and kitchen screens are expected at launch `OP.KDS.05`

#### OP.KDS.T02 · P1 · Board header: main flow

- [ ] Load the board with three open tickets and one completed in the last two minutes **Expect:** Header reads "3 open" (completed tickets are not counted); the clock sits in the middle column and does not move when the count changes from 9 to 10 `OP.KDS.HEADER.01`
- [ ] P2 · Watch the connection pill on a healthy network **Expect:** Pill shows "Connecting" (amber dot) then "Live" (green dot) `OP.KDS.HEADER.02`
- [ ] Sign in as a barista (has /tasks) and look at the header **Expect:** "My tasks" pill shows; with pending steps it reads "My tasks (N)" with a green ring; pressing it opens /tasks without the rail, and /tasks leads back to the board `OP.KDS.HEADER.04`
- [ ] P2 · Sign in as head_chef with team ideas waiting for review **Expect:** My tasks count = steps to do + ideas to review (head roles only); a barista's count excludes ideas `OP.KDS.HEADER.05`
- [ ] P2 · As a prep-only account, look for any way off the board **Expect:** No "Leave kitchen display" button and no rail: the board is navless `OP.KDS.HEADER.07`
- [ ] As a manager open /kds and press "Leave kitchen display" **Expect:** With one other workspace it lands on that workspace home; with several it opens the workspace switcher in the light palette (no invisible titles on the black background) `OP.KDS.HEADER.08`
- [ ] P2 · Press the "Guide" pill at the end of the key legend, or press ? **Expect:** The workspace guide opens as a dialog; while it is open the board keys (1, S, Space) do nothing to the tickets `OP.KDS.HEADER.09`

#### OP.KDS.T03 · P0 · Ticket arrival: main flow

- [ ] Send an order from the cafe till ("Send to kitchen") while the board is open **Expect:** A new card rises in at the end of the list within about a second and a ticket chime plays; its tag shows the table or tab name and source "Cafe cashier" `OP.KDS.TICKET_FEED.01`
- [ ] Place a guest QR/web order for a table **Expect:** The card arrives with the globe icon and "QR"/web source and the table tag; it chimes like a till ticket `OP.KDS.TICKET_FEED.02`
- [ ] P2 · Reload the board with tickets already open **Expect:** Cards appear in arrival order without the rise animation (only tickets that arrive after first paint rise) `OP.KDS.TICKET_FEED.03`
- [ ] P2 · Minimise focus (click another window) and send two orders, then focus the board again **Expect:** Window title reads "(2) Kitchen display · Touch" while unfocused and resets to "Kitchen display · Touch" on focus; chimes play for both `OP.KDS.TICKET_FEED.04`
- [ ] P1 · Void a line on the till after it was sent **Expect:** The voided line disappears from the card on the next update; a ticket voided entirely leaves the board `OP.KDS.TICKET_FEED.05`
- [ ] P1 · Make a shop sale at the Touch Shop desk **Expect:** No ticket appears on the KDS (a shop sale makes no ticket on the server and is skipped from the LAN feed) `OP.KDS.TICKET_FEED.06`
- [ ] P2 · Leave the board with completed tickets for three minutes **Expect:** A completed ticket stays faded for two minutes (COMPLETED_LINGER_MS, server window too) then drops off without a reload `OP.KDS.TICKET_FEED.11`

#### OP.KDS.T04 · P0 · Ticket card: main flow

- [ ] Send an order for table 7 with a size, two modifiers (one x2) and a note "no sugar" **Expect:** Card tag "Table 7"; item line "1× Latte (Large)", modifiers line "2× Extra shot · Oat milk" in muted text, note chip with the note icon reading "no sugar" `OP.KDS.TICKET_CARD.01`
- [ ] P2 · Send an order on a booking tab for Court 2 as cashier, and view it as cashier/manager and as chef **Expect:** Tag shows the court name; the guest name after " · " shows only for the till and management (kitchen roles get the court only) `OP.KDS.TICKET_CARD.02`
- [ ] P1 · On the till choose Pick up for a counter order (0351) **Expect:** The card leads with a filled "PICK UP" mark before the tag `OP.KDS.TICKET_CARD.03`
- [ ] P1 · Send a counter order to be brought over with no table attached (0352), then attach table 4 on the till **Expect:** Card shows the outlined "No table yet" mark; after the table is attached the card re-reads to "Table 4" and the mark goes `OP.KDS.TICKET_CARD.04`
- [ ] P1 · Watch a ticket with no target over 11 minutes **Expect:** Band has no fill and "On time" under 5:00, amber "Getting late" 5:00-9:59, red "Late" from 10:00; the age reads m:ss `OP.KDS.TICKET_CARD.05`
- [ ] P1 · Send an item whose ticket target is 4 minutes **Expect:** The band turns red "Late" at 4:00, not 10:00; hovering the age shows "Target 4 min" `OP.KDS.TICKET_CARD.06`
- [ ] P2 · Set the KDS PC clock two minutes ahead of the server **Expect:** A brand-new ticket reads 0:00 "On time" and never shows a negative age (clamped) `OP.KDS.TICKET_CARD.08`
- [ ] P2 · Bump a ticket from a Telegram tap (0032) and view the card **Expect:** The meta line shows the actor label (e.g. "Telegram: Ahmed") truncated, after the status and source `OP.KDS.TICKET_CARD.09`
- [ ] P2 · Read a card with three items from three metres **Expect:** Item names are the biggest text on the card; one-item tickets show no "0 of 1 ready" line; multi-item tickets show "N of M ready" `OP.KDS.TICKET_CARD.10`

#### OP.KDS.T05 · P0 · Ticket bump (Start / Ready / Complete): main flow

- [ ] On a queued ticket press "Start" (S), then "Ready" (R), then "Complete" (C) **Expect:** Status line goes Queued -> Preparing -> Ready -> Completed instantly (optimistic); Start sits in the left column, Ready then Complete in the right, so the button under the hand never jumps `OP.KDS.LIFECYCLE.01`
- [ ] P2 · On a queued ticket press "Ready" without Start **Expect:** Allowed (queued -> ready); the card shows Ready with a Complete button `OP.KDS.LIFECYCLE.02`
- [ ] P1 · Look for a way to un-bump (Recall / Undo) a ticket marked Complete by mistake **Expect:** There is none on the board: a completed ticket stays faded two minutes with no actions and then leaves. Confirm with Majed whether launch needs a recall; otherwise staff re-send from the till `OP.KDS.LIFECYCLE.05`
- [ ] P1 · Watch a stale ticket after pressing Start **Expect:** The alarm ring and the repeating alarm stop for that ticket as soon as it leaves Queued `OP.KDS.LIFECYCLE.10`

#### OP.KDS.T06 · P1 · Item ready ticks: main flow

- [ ] Tick two of three items on a ticket **Expect:** Ticked lines strike through in muted colour with the note still legible; footer reads "2 of 3 ready" `OP.KDS.ITEM_MARKS.01`
- [ ] Tick an item on KDS 1 and watch KDS 2 **Expect:** KDS 2 shows the tick within a second (item_ready broadcast) and after a reload the tick is still there `OP.KDS.ITEM_MARKS.02`
- [ ] P2 · Press Complete on a ticket with unticked items **Expect:** Allowed; ticks are informational and do not block Complete `OP.KDS.ITEM_MARKS.06`

#### OP.KDS.T07 · P1 · Sound and stale alarms: main flow

- [ ] Open the board in a browser (not Electron) **Expect:** Amber strip "Sound is off on this screen. Turn it on so new orders and late tickets chime." with "Turn on sound"; pressing it hides the strip and chimes start working `OP.KDS.ALARMS.01`
- [ ] Open the board in the Electron KDS station **Expect:** No sound strip (audio is armed on mount) and a new ticket chimes without any click `OP.KDS.ALARMS.02`
- [ ] Leave a ticket in Queued for 90 seconds **Expect:** At 90 s the card gains the red inset alarm ring, its status reads "Waiting too long", an alarm sound plays once and the red banner "⚠ N tickets need attention — not started in time" appears without shifting the grid `OP.KDS.ALARMS.03`
- [ ] P2 · Leave the stale ticket another minute **Expect:** The alarm repeats every 30 s per stale ticket; three tickets going stale together sound one alarm, not three `OP.KDS.ALARMS.04`
- [ ] P2 · Turn the KDS PC volume to zero **Expect:** Visuals still show stale ring and banner; note that the app cannot tell the volume is off `OP.KDS.ALARMS.06`

#### OP.KDS.T08 · P1 · Keyboard bumping: main flow

- [ ] Press 2, then S **Expect:** Ticket 2 is selected with a visible ring and DOM focus, and S starts it `OP.KDS.KEYBOARD.01`
- [ ] P2 · Press Right/Left arrows, Down twice, then Space **Expect:** Selection moves between tickets; Down moves the item cursor; Space ticks the item under the cursor (Space with no cursor lands on the first item first) `OP.KDS.KEYBOARD.02`
- [ ] P2 · Press C on a queued ticket **Expect:** Nothing happens (illegal transition is a no-op, no refusal round trip) `OP.KDS.KEYBOARD.03`
- [ ] P2 · Bump the selected ticket to Complete and wait for it to drop off **Expect:** The selection moves to the ticket now in its old slot instead of vanishing `OP.KDS.KEYBOARD.05`
- [ ] P2 · Press Ctrl+S or Alt+R **Expect:** No bump: chords are ignored `OP.KDS.KEYBOARD.06`

#### OP.KDS.T09 · P0 · Kitchen display: other parts

- [ ] Connect to port 47810 with a wrong PSK (e.g. websocat with a bad bearer) or send a malformed frame **Expect:** The till closes the socket with 4401 "bad psk"; a malformed frame gets an error frame and nothing is queued `OP.KDS.LAN_FALLBACK.10`

#### OP.KDS.T10 · P1 · Kitchen display: Who can and cannot use it

*Setup:* `WRONG_ROLE` (Signed in with a role that may not use this), `STAFF_ACCESS_BLOCKED` (Owner blocked a page for this person (0345))

- [ ] `WRONG_ROLE` Sign in as cashier, court_desk, waiter or shop_staff and type /kds **Expect:** The role refusal shows; no tickets are fetched (kitchen_board would also answer FORBIDDEN for these roles) `OP.KDS.03`
- [ ] `STAFF_ACCESS_BLOCKED` As owner, block /kds for a chef in Staff Access, then sign in as that chef **Expect:** The kitchen display stays shut with the blocked-page notice `OP.KDS.04`
- [ ] **Board header** `WRONG_ROLE` P2 · Sign in as prep, then as manager, and look for My tasks **Expect:** Neither prep nor manager/owner gets a My tasks pill (/tasks is not theirs) `OP.KDS.HEADER.06`

#### OP.KDS.T11 · P0 · Kitchen display: With no internet

*Setup:* `OFFLINE` (No internet)

- [ ] **Ticket bump (Start / Ready / Complete)** P1 · In browser mode take the board offline and press Start **Expect:** ticket.status is a queued write: the card moves at once; after reconnect the status lands on the server and the card stays put on refetch `OP.KDS.LIFECYCLE.07`
- [ ] **Item ready ticks** P2 · Go offline in browser mode and tick an item **Expect:** The tick fails (item marks are not on the offline queue) and rolls back with the network message `OP.KDS.ITEM_MARKS.04`
- [ ] **LAN fallback (offline kitchen)** Unplug the venue internet (LAN stays up), then send an order from the cafe till **Expect:** Within the query retry window the KDS shows the grey strip "Offline — tickets arriving from the café cashier over the local network." and the new ticket arrives over LAN with item names from the cached menu and a "#xxxxxx" tag `OP.KDS.LAN_FALLBACK.01`
- [ ] **LAN fallback (offline kitchen)** P2 · In LAN mode with no tickets **Expect:** Empty state reads "Offline — waiting for tickets from the café cashier over the local network." `OP.KDS.LAN_FALLBACK.02`
- [ ] **LAN fallback (offline kitchen)** P2 · In LAN mode check ages and colours **Expect:** Ages use the generic 5/10-minute thresholds (no target over LAN); stale at 90 s still alarms; no Pick up is lost (service travels in the frame) `OP.KDS.LAN_FALLBACK.03`
- [ ] **LAN fallback (offline kitchen)** P1 · Take only the cafe till offline (its own cable) while the KDS keeps internet, then send an order **Expect:** The order queues on the till; the KDS stays on the cloud board, so the LAN frame is not shown and the ticket appears only when the till's queue uploads. Record the delay and confirm with Majed `OP.KDS.LAN_FALLBACK.08`

#### OP.KDS.T12 · P1 · Kitchen display: Flaky or slow network, backend down

*Setup:* `SLOW_NETWORK` (Slow network), `BACKEND_DOWN` (Server unreachable while the LAN is up)

- [ ] **Ticket arrival** `SLOW_NETWORK` P2 · Throttle the network and open the board **Expect:** Three dark skeleton cards on the board grid with the key legend visible; no count in the header until loaded `OP.KDS.TICKET_FEED.08`
- [ ] **Ticket arrival** `BACKEND_DOWN` In browser (non-Electron) mode block the API and open /kds **Expect:** Error panel "Tickets could not be loaded" with "Check this screen's network connection. The board keeps trying by itself every 30 seconds." and a Retry button that refetches `OP.KDS.TICKET_FEED.09`
- [ ] **Item ready ticks** `BACKEND_DOWN` P2 · Make set_order_item_ready fail (block the API) and tick an item **Expect:** The tick rolls back for that one item and the error shows in the red notice row `OP.KDS.ITEM_MARKS.03`

#### OP.KDS.T13 · P1 · Kitchen display: Café cashier (LAN peer) unreachable

*Setup:* `LAN_PEER_DOWN` (Café cashier (LAN peer) unreachable)

- [ ] **Ticket bump (Start / Ready / Complete)** Pull the KDS network cable (cloud and LAN both down for this PC) and press Start **Expect:** In the Electron app the board switches to LAN mode; with no till connection the bump goes nowhere (sendLanStatus returns false and nothing on screen says it failed). Record whether the card stays Queued `OP.KDS.LIFECYCLE.06`
- [ ] **Item ready ticks** P2 · In LAN mode look at a ticket's items **Expect:** No checkboxes: a dot sits where the box was and the footer says "Ticking items comes back when the connection does." `OP.KDS.ITEM_MARKS.05`
- [ ] **LAN fallback (offline kitchen)** In LAN mode close the cafe till app (or unplug its LAN) for a minute, then bring it back **Expect:** KDS client retries with backoff (2 s doubling to 30 s) and reconnects on its own; tickets resync via snapshot. While the till is down nothing new arrives and no on-screen message says the till is unreachable `OP.KDS.LAN_FALLBACK.06`
- [ ] **LAN fallback (offline kitchen)** In LAN mode, with nobody signed in on the till, press Start on the KDS **Expect:** The till refuses ("till has no staff session") and the bump is not queued; the KDS card does not change. Check that the kitchen notices `OP.KDS.LAN_FALLBACK.07`

#### OP.KDS.T14 · P0 · Kitchen display: ge (1 of 2)

*Setup:* `SECOND_BRANCH` (Two branches), `ARABIC_RTL` (Arabic, right to left), `SMALL_SCREEN` (Small station screen), `LARGE_DATA` (Large data volume), `OLD_APP_VERSION` (Station build older than the server), `REALTIME_DISCONNECTED` (Realtime channel down, polling only), `EMPTY_DATA` (Nothing recorded yet), `KDS_CLOSED` (No kitchen screen running), `TIMEZONE_EDGE` (Midnight / business-day boundary (Asia/Baghdad)), `CONCURRENT_EDIT` (Two people change the same thing)

- [ ] `SECOND_BRANCH` Register a KDS station at branch 2 and send an order on a branch 1 till **Expect:** The branch 2 board does not show the branch 1 ticket (kitchen_board reads the station's branch via visible_venue_ids) `OP.KDS.06`
- [ ] `ARABIC_RTL` P1 · Switch the language to Arabic on the KDS **Expect:** Board mirrors right-to-left; "Kitchen display", age words (On time / Getting late / Late), Start / Ready / Complete and the legend read in Arabic; the clock, table numbers and m:ss ages stay isolated (bdi) and readable `OP.KDS.07`
- [ ] **Keyboard bumping** `ARABIC_RTL` P1 · Switch the Windows keyboard layout to Arabic and press the S key and the 3 key **Expect:** S still starts the selected ticket (physical key code), 3 selects ticket 3, Arabic-Indic digits also work; under RTL the left/right arrows are mirrored `OP.KDS.KEYBOARD.04`
- [ ] `SMALL_SCREEN` P2 · Open /kds on a 1280x720 screen with six tickets **Expect:** Cards flow into as many 22rem columns as fit, nothing overlaps, the legend stays on one or two lines and the board scrolls vertically `OP.KDS.08`
- [ ] `LARGE_DATA` P1 · Seed 60 open tickets and leave the board running for 30 minutes **Expect:** Board stays responsive (the clock ticks every 5 s, no visible stutter when bumping), memory does not climb steadily, only the first nine cards carry a digit key `OP.KDS.09`
- [ ] `OLD_APP_VERSION` P2 · With an operator update downloaded, look at the board **Expect:** A floating update pill appears (there is no rail on the kitchen screen) and the board keeps working until restarted `OP.KDS.10`
- [ ] **Board header** `REALTIME_DISCONNECTED` P1 · Block the realtime websocket only **Expect:** Pill turns "Disconnected" in red; the board still re-reads every 30 s (BOARD_REFETCH_MS) so new tickets appear within 30 s `OP.KDS.HEADER.03`
- [ ] **Sound and stale alarms** `REALTIME_DISCONNECTED` P2 · With the board idle and no realtime traffic, wait for a ticket to cross 90 s **Expect:** It still goes stale (10 s reconcile timer), no message needed `OP.KDS.ALARMS.05`
- [ ] **Ticket arrival** `EMPTY_DATA` P2 · With no tickets open, open the board **Expect:** Empty state with a green tick: "No tickets — all caught up" and "Orders sent from the website or the café cashier appear here the moment they are placed."; no "0 open" in the header `OP.KDS.TICKET_FEED.07`
- [ ] **Ticket arrival** `KDS_CLOSED` Close the KDS app, send three orders from the till, wait five minutes, then reopen the KDS **Expect:** The till shows only "Order sent." (it never shows kitchen state); all three tickets wait server-side and appear on reopen with their true age, already red/stale with the alarm `OP.KDS.TICKET_FEED.10`
- [ ] **Ticket card** `TIMEZONE_EDGE` P2 · Leave a ticket open overnight **Expect:** Age reads "{h}h {m}m" past an hour and "{d}d" past a day, never a four-digit minute count `OP.KDS.TICKET_CARD.07`
- [ ] **Ticket bump (Start / Ready / Complete)** `CONCURRENT_EDIT` P1 · Bump the same ticket to Ready on two KDS screens at the same moment **Expect:** One wins; the other gets INVALID_TRANSITION ("That status change is not allowed.") shown inline in the red notice row (never only a toast) and its card rolls back, then self-heals on the refetch `OP.KDS.LIFECYCLE.03`

#### OP.KDS.T15 · P0 · Kitchen display: ge (2 of 2)

*Setup:* `CONCURRENT_EDIT` (Two people change the same thing), `OFFLINE_THEN_RECONNECT` (Offline, then back online), `QUEUED_WRITE_REFUSED` (A queued write is refused by the server after replay), `APP_KILLED_MIDFLOW` (Station app closed or power cut mid-flow), `STATION_KIND_MISMATCH` (Wrong kind of station for the action)

- [ ] **Ticket bump (Start / Ready / Complete)** `CONCURRENT_EDIT` P1 · While one bump is in flight, bump a different ticket **Expect:** Both cards move; a refusal of the first restores only that ticket and does not undo the second `OP.KDS.LIFECYCLE.04`
- [ ] **Ticket bump (Start / Ready / Complete)** `OFFLINE_THEN_RECONNECT` Bump three tickets while offline (Electron, via the till over LAN), then restore the internet **Expect:** The till's queue replays each ticket.status after the order it bumps; once the board reads the cloud again the cards show the same states, none bounced back to Queued `OP.KDS.LIFECYCLE.08`
- [ ] **LAN fallback (offline kitchen)** `OFFLINE_THEN_RECONNECT` In LAN mode press Start then Ready on a LAN ticket **Expect:** The till accepts it onto its own queue and echoes status.update; every KDS on the LAN shows the new state; after internet returns the server ticket matches `OP.KDS.LAN_FALLBACK.04`
- [ ] **Ticket bump (Start / Ready / Complete)** `QUEUED_WRITE_REFUSED` P1 · Bump a ticket offline that someone voids on another station before reconnect **Expect:** On replay the bump is refused and a refusal toast appears on the station that owns the queued write (QueueFailureToasts) and on Day close; the board shows the server state `OP.KDS.LIFECYCLE.09`
- [ ] **LAN fallback (offline kitchen)** `APP_KILLED_MIDFLOW` P1 · Restart the KDS app in the middle of an outage **Expect:** On reconnect to the till it receives a ticket.snapshot of up to 500 of today's kitchen tickets and redraws them with their states `OP.KDS.LAN_FALLBACK.05`
- [ ] **LAN fallback (offline kitchen)** `STATION_KIND_MISMATCH` P1 · Take a desk-mode or shop-mode station offline and place a cafe order from it **Expect:** That order never reaches the KDS over LAN (only a till-mode station runs the LAN server); it appears only after the station reconnects and uploads `OP.KDS.LAN_FALLBACK.09`

### OP.SHOP: Touch Shop till (Sell)

The shop desk's cashier: scan or tap shop products, the basket adds up, Cash or Card takes the payment on the spot through the durable queue (one shop tab per sale), the receipt prints. Used by shop_staff on the shop PC; management can open it.

**Route:** `/shop` · **Roles:** shop_staff, manager, owner

**Source:** `apps/operator/src/routes/shop.tsx`, `apps/operator/src/routes/shop/_children.ts`, `apps/operator/src/features/shop/ShopTill.tsx`, `apps/operator/src/features/shop/shopTillLogic.ts`

**Components:** Product grid and scanner · Sale (basket) · Cash / Card sale · Member on a shop sale · Unfinished sales · Receipt after every sale · Sales reward hints · Supplier price watch crawler

#### OP.SHOP.T01 · P0 · Product grid and scanner: main flow

- [ ] P1 · Look at the grid with two shop sections and a product with two sizes **Expect:** Chips "All", then the shop sections in their order; tiles name the size only where a product has several ("Racket X · Pro"); no cafe item ever appears `OP.SHOP.CATALOGUE.01`
- [ ] P2 · Type part of a name, a SKU, then a barcode into "Search by name, SKU or barcode…" **Expect:** Tiles narrow to matching sizes each time (English or Arabic names) `OP.SHOP.CATALOGUE.02`
- [ ] Scan a product barcode with the USB scanner **Expect:** One unit is added to the Sale and the search box is cleared; a SKU typed by the scanner also matches (case-insensitive) `OP.SHOP.CATALOGUE.03`
- [ ] P1 · Scan a code no product has **Expect:** Refusal message "No product has the code {code}." above the tiles; nothing is added `OP.SHOP.CATALOGUE.04`
- [ ] P1 · Scan while the payment dialog or a PIN prompt is open **Expect:** Nothing is added to the basket behind the dialog `OP.SHOP.CATALOGUE.05`
- [ ] P1 · Mark a product sold out or switch it off in the menu **Expect:** Its tile is greyed with "Out of stock" and cannot be tapped `OP.SHOP.CATALOGUE.06`

#### OP.SHOP.T02 · P1 · Supplier price watch crawler: main flow

- [ ] Sign in as shop_staff on the shop PC with three supplier links set, wait 30 s **Expect:** Each due link is read one at a time about 3 s apart; on Products each shows "Checked {time}. Price read: {price}." `OP.SHOP.PRICE_WATCH_CRAWLER.01`
- [ ] Have a supplier change a price to one the shop does not sell at, then wait for the hourly pass **Expect:** A toast on whatever page is open: "A supplier changed a price. Open Products to apply it." (or "{count} supplier prices changed..."); the owner and the branch shop staff get a push naming the product only, never the price `OP.SHOP.PRICE_WATCH_CRAWLER.02`
- [ ] P2 · Sign in as manager on the shop PC **Expect:** The crawler runs (manager may open /shop) but managers get no push (owner and shop_staff only) `OP.SHOP.PRICE_WATCH_CRAWLER.03`
- [ ] Link a page priced in USD, a page with a size range, and a home page **Expect:** "The page is not priced in Iraqi dinars.", "The page shows more than one price..." and "No price found on this page." respectively; no price is applied `OP.SHOP.PRICE_WATCH_CRAWLER.08`
- [ ] P2 · Restart the shop PC twice within 10 minutes **Expect:** Links read less than 30 minutes ago are not read again `OP.SHOP.PRICE_WATCH_CRAWLER.09`

#### OP.SHOP.T03 · P0 · Touch Shop till (Sell): money and totals

- [ ] **Sale (basket)** Add item A (25,000 IQD) twice and item B (7,500 IQD) once **Expect:** Lines "A 50,000 IQD" (qty 2) and "B 7,500 IQD"; Total 57,500 IQD; "3 items · At the shelf price. The receipt shows what was charged." `OP.SHOP.BASKET.01`
- [ ] **Sale (basket)** P1 · Press minus on a qty-1 line, and the x on another line **Expect:** The line is removed at zero; the total recalculates at once `OP.SHOP.BASKET.02`
- [ ] **Sale (basket)** With tax configured as exclusive, compare the basket total with the amount on the payment **Expect:** The basket shows the shelf-price estimate; the payment asks the server total (tax and rounding) read after the order is sent; the difference is explained by the estimate note `OP.SHOP.BASKET.05`
- [ ] **Cash / Card sale** With a shift open, basket 57,500 IQD, press Cash, tender 60,000 and settle **Expect:** Payment pane asks 57,500 IQD; after settle "Change: 2,500 IQD" shows and the receipt opens; the drawer log shows a cash payment of 57,500 with change 2,500 `OP.SHOP.CHARGE.01`
- [ ] **Cash / Card sale** Press Card for a 32,000 IQD basket and settle **Expect:** Card payment of 32,000 IQD recorded, no tender or change fields; trying cash-given on card gives "Cash given and change are for cash payments only." `OP.SHOP.CHARGE.02`
- [ ] **Cash / Card sale** Pay part of a sale (amount less than due), then the rest **Expect:** After the part payment the pane stays open with the remaining due recomputed from the server (total - paid); the second payment settles it; two payments show on the receipt `OP.SHOP.CHARGE.04`
- [ ] **Member on a shop sale** As shop_staff press "Member", identify a member, then press Cash **Expect:** Member chip shows with the pending note; after Cash the member step modal opens with the total, the member's standing discount applied by itself, Use points and Rewards; Continue opens the payment with the due recomputed `OP.SHOP.MEMBER.01`
- [ ] **Member on a shop sale** Redeem 5,000 IQD of points on a 40,000 IQD sale in the member step **Expect:** Payment asks 35,000 IQD; receipt shows the points line `OP.SHOP.MEMBER.03`
- [ ] **Unfinished sales** Press Cash, then close the payment pane without paying **Expect:** The sale appears under "Unfinished sales" ("Rung up but not paid...") labelled with its time; "Take payment" reopens it with the due read from the server `OP.SHOP.UNFINISHED.01`
- [ ] **Receipt after every sale** Compare the receipt total with the drawer entry and the Day close Shop block **Expect:** Same IQD amount in all three `OP.SHOP.RECEIPT.04`
- [ ] **Sales reward hints** P1 · Owner sets the sales reward to 10%, shop_staff opens /shop **Expect:** Each tile shows "You earn {amount}" (price x 10% rounded down), the basket "You earn {amount} on this sale", the header "This month you earned {amount} from {sales} of shop sales" `OP.SHOP.SALES_REWARD.01`

### OP.OPS: Today

The manager's home in Management: one "Needs you" to-do list (queues open in place), what is on the floor now, the checks before closing, stock to watch, so far today and who worked. One read (app.ops_overview) polled every 30 s and refreshed on the floor, courts and kds broadcasts. An owner who opens /ops is sent to the Overview (/panel), which shares the same "Needs you" body.

**Route:** `/ops` · **Roles:** manager, owner

**Source:** `apps/operator/src/routes/`, `apps/operator/src/features/ops/OperationsOverview.tsx`, `apps/operator/src/features/ops/TodaySections.tsx`, `apps/operator/src/features/ops/NeedsYou.tsx`, `apps/operator/src/features/ops/OpsVisuals.tsx`, `apps/operator/src/features/ops/opsLogic.ts`, `apps/operator/src/features/ops/LessonRefundsDuePanel.tsx`

**Components:** Needs you · Online refunds needing attention (Qi Card) · Lesson refunds due · Player reports · On the floor now · Before you close · The day is not open · Stock to watch · So far today · Who worked today · Lesson refunds due panel

#### OP.OPS.T01 · P1 · Today: main checks

- [ ] Sign in as a manager and open Today (/ops) **Expect:** Title "Today" with the subtitle "{weekday}, {date} · open since {time}" (business day), "Updated {time}" and a Refresh button; Needs you, On the floor now and Who worked today on the wide side, Before you close, Stock to watch and So far today on the narrow side `OP.OPS.01`
- [ ] P2 · Sign in as the owner and type /ops **Expect:** The app replaces the route with /panel (Overview); Today is not rendered as a second copy `OP.OPS.02`
- [ ] P2 · Press Refresh in the header **Expect:** The button shows busy while ops_overview refetches and "Updated {time}" moves to now `OP.OPS.07`

#### OP.OPS.T02 · P1 · Needs you: main flow

- [ ] Create one open waiter call, one late kitchen ticket, a failed online refund and expired stock, then open Today **Expect:** Rows appear in this order: Tables calling for a waiter, Kitchen orders running late, Online refunds needing attention, Expired stock on the shelf (order is by who is waiting, never by count); the header pill shows the row count `OP.OPS.NEEDS_YOU.01`
- [ ] Look at each row's action **Expect:** Waiter calls has "Answer calls" (opens /till/tabs); late orders shows the words "Tell the kitchen" with no button; refunds, lesson refunds and player reports have Review buttons with a chevron; expired "See expired" opens /stock/expiry; low "See which" opens /stock?filter=low `OP.OPS.NEEDS_YOU.02`
- [ ] Press "Review refunds" on the online refunds row **Expect:** The queue opens in place under the row (aria-expanded true, chevron up) showing its rows and actions; pressing again folds it `OP.OPS.NEEDS_YOU.03`
- [ ] P2 · Open Today with a refund that Qi has not answered for over a day as the only refund row **Expect:** The online refunds row count is amber (warn), not red; with a failed refund present it is red `OP.OPS.NEEDS_YOU.07`
- [ ] P2 · From an open lesson refunds row with a share Qi could not refund, press its "Online refunds" link **Expect:** The online refunds row opens in place and scrolls into view, unfolding View more first if it was hidden `OP.OPS.NEEDS_YOU.08`
- [ ] Seed driver purchases to receive, a till shift closed short, protocol steps waiting, and marketing plans waiting (owner) **Expect:** Rows "Driver's purchases to receive" (Receive goods), the till shifts row (to /admin/day-close), "Protocol steps waiting on you" (to /protocols?filter=waiting) and the plan row (owner only) appear with their counts `OP.OPS.NEEDS_YOU.09`
- [ ] Raise a waiter call from a table QR while Today is open **Expect:** The waiter calls row appears or its count rises within moments (floor broadcast) or at worst 30 s (poll) `OP.OPS.NEEDS_YOU.12`

#### OP.OPS.T03 · P0 · Online refunds needing attention (Qi Card): main flow

- [ ] Open the refunds row with a refund_failed deposit **Expect:** The row shows guest name (or "Guest with no name"), phone, court and slot time, the amount in IQD, badge "Refund failed", hint "Qi Card did not accept the refund. Try again, or pay the guest back another way.", "Why: ..." reason, "Refund asked for {time}", and buttons "Try again" and "Settled another way" `OP.OPS.DEPOSIT_ATTENTION.01`

- [ ] P2 · Mark a sandbox payment row **Expect:** A "Test" badge shows with the tooltip "A test payment. No real money moved." `OP.OPS.DEPOSIT_ATTENTION.19`

### OP.PANEL: Overview (management panel)

The owner's landing screen: the wages-due reminder, "Needs you" with the owner's own rows, the live floor, then the period figures (app.panel_headline) in Earned / Taken in payments and breakdown cards, each figure drilling to its transactions, and a full export.

**Route:** `/panel` · **Roles:** owner

**Source:** `apps/operator/src/routes/`, `apps/operator/src/features/panel/ManagementPanel.tsx`, `apps/operator/src/features/panel/figures.ts`, `apps/operator/src/features/panel/exportAll.ts`, `apps/operator/src/features/panel/PanelNeedsYou.tsx`, `apps/operator/src/features/floor/LiveFloor.tsx`, `apps/operator/src/features/floor/floorData.ts`, `apps/operator/src/features/floor/floorModel.ts`, `apps/operator/src/features/floor/floorScene.ts`, `apps/operator/src/features/floor/dessertData.ts`, `apps/operator/src/features/floor/dessertCase.ts`

**Components:** Earned and Taken in payments · Breakdown cards · Export · Needs you (owner) · Wages due reminder · Live floor (3D) (page) · Counts and key · The 3D plan · Tooltips and dessert case

### OP.OBS_REQUESTS: Staff requests

The owner's confirmation queue for leave, shift swaps, wage advances and record corrections (app.staff_requests_page, app.decide_staff_request). Decisions are final; the note is optional.

**Route:** `/observation/requests` · **Roles:** owner

**Source:** `apps/operator/src/routes/observation.tsx`, `apps/operator/src/routes/observation/_children.ts`, `apps/operator/src/features/observation/StaffRequests.tsx`, `apps/operator/src/features/observation/requestTypes.ts`

**Components:** Request list · Approve or decline

#### OP.OBS_REQUESTS.T01 · P1 · Request list: main flow

- [ ] Have staff submit leave (2 days), a shift swap and a 100,000 IQD advance; open the page **Expect:** Filter "Awaiting decision" with the pending count badge; rows show Who (name + role), Asking for, Detail ("{from} to {to}" for leave, "100,000 IQD" for the advance), Submitted, Status "Awaiting decision" `OP.OBS_REQUESTS.LIST.01`
- [ ] P2 · Switch to Decided and All **Expect:** Decided shows only approved, declined and withdrawn rows with "By {name} on {date}" and the decision note; All shows everything `OP.OBS_REQUESTS.LIST.02`
- [ ] Owner submits their own request (as staff) and views the list **Expect:** Their own row shows no Approve or Decline at all `OP.OBS_REQUESTS.LIST.05`

#### OP.OBS_REQUESTS.T02 · P1 · Approve or decline: main flow

- [ ] Press Decline and confirm with the note empty **Expect:** The decline goes through without a reason (0361); toast "Request declined" `OP.OBS_REQUESTS.DECIDE.02`
- [ ] P2 · Read the Decline dialog body **Expect:** KNOWN COPY ISSUE: body says "A declined request has to say why" while the field is "Reason for declining (optional)"; record if still present `OP.OBS_REQUESTS.DECIDE.03`
- [ ] Look for a way to reverse an approved request **Expect:** There is none; a wrong approval is answered with a new request `OP.OBS_REQUESTS.DECIDE.04`

#### OP.OBS_REQUESTS.T03 · P0 · Staff requests: money and totals

- [ ] **Approve or decline** Press Approve on a wage advance, add a note and confirm **Expect:** Dialog "Approve this request?" with "{name} asked for Wage advance. Approving is recorded against your name and cannot be undone."; toast "Request approved"; the row moves to Decided with "By {owner}" `OP.OBS_REQUESTS.DECIDE.01`
- [ ] **Approve or decline** Approve a wage advance, then open the Wages and Safe pages **Expect:** The advance appears where wages record it; it is paid from the Wages page (not from the request), and the Safe shows the advance row only once paid `OP.OBS_REQUESTS.DECIDE.07`

#### OP.OBS_REQUESTS.T04 · P2 · Staff requests: other parts

- [ ] Open /observation (no child) **Expect:** The app redirects to /panel `OP.OBS_REQUESTS.01`

*Setup:* `WRONG_ROLE` (Signed in with a role that may not use this), `ARABIC_RTL` (Arabic, right to left), `BACKEND_DOWN` (Server unreachable while the LAN is up), `EMPTY_DATA` (Nothing recorded yet), `LARGE_DATA` (Large data volume), `OFFLINE` (No internet), `CONCURRENT_EDIT` (Two people change the same thing)

- [ ] `BACKEND_DOWN` P1 · Make staff_requests_page fail, then Retry **Expect:** Error state with Retry `OP.OBS_REQUESTS.04`
- [ ] **Request list** `EMPTY_DATA` P2 · With nothing pending **Expect:** "Nothing awaiting a decision" / "New requests from your team appear here."; on other filters "No requests" `OP.OBS_REQUESTS.LIST.03`
- [ ] **Request list** `LARGE_DATA` P2 · Seed 10 pending requests **Expect:** Three rows, then View more; a "N of M" count shows only when the server list is cut short `OP.OBS_REQUESTS.LIST.04`
- [ ] **Request list** `OFFLINE` P2 · Open the page offline **Expect:** Last loaded list stays or the error with Retry shows; the 60 s poll resumes on reconnect `OP.OBS_REQUESTS.LIST.06`

- [ ] **Approve or decline** `CONCURRENT_EDIT` P2 · Decide a request the requester withdrew a moment earlier on their phone **Expect:** The server refusal shows in the dialog; after cancel the list refreshes with Withdrawn `OP.OBS_REQUESTS.DECIDE.06`

### OP.SAFE: Safe (main cash)

The branch's main cash (0343): the balance, an always-open form to Pay a cost (from the safe or by bank), Move cash (drawer boxes, bank, owner) or Count the safe, the month's costs by category and every movement with the balance after it. All writes are direct appRpc (online only) with an idempotency key. /safe?show=payments opens as Bills & suppliers.

**Route:** `/safe` · **Roles:** manager, owner

**Source:** `apps/operator/src/features/safe/SafePage.tsx`, `apps/operator/src/features/safe/safeLogic.ts`, `apps/operator/src/features/safe/api.ts`

**Components:** Balance · Pay a cost · Move cash · Count the safe · Where the money went · Every movement

#### OP.SAFE.T01 · P1 · Pay a cost: main flow

- [ ] Press Pay with no amount, then with no category **Expect:** Button disabled with "Type the amount first." then "Choose what it was for." `OP.SAFE.PAY.03`
- [ ] P2 · Type a payee over 80 characters or a note over 300 **Expect:** Input stops at the limit (maxLength); the server rule matches `OP.SAFE.PAY.04`
- [ ] Type an amount above 1,000,000,000 IQD **Expect:** The amount is capped; the button stays disabled with the amount reason `OP.SAFE.PAY.05`
- [ ] P2 · Choose Supplier after paying the same supplier before **Expect:** The payee field suggests earlier names for that category, each once `OP.SAFE.PAY.07`
- [ ] Make the server refuse a payment **Expect:** The refusal shows beside the form (ErrorText); the draft stays `OP.SAFE.PAY.10`

- [ ] **Balance** Start from a counted 1,000,000 IQD, hand in 250,000 from the café cashier, pay 100,000 rent from the safe **Expect:** "In the safe" 1,150,000 IQD; "Today: 250,000 IQD in, 100,000 IQD out" `OP.SAFE.BALANCE.01`
- [ ] **Balance** Pay more than the safe holds **Expect:** The balance goes negative and the warning "Below zero: something was paid that never came in. Count the safe to set it right." shows `OP.SAFE.BALANCE.03`
- [ ] **Balance** P1 · Count after a short **Expect:** The last count line reads "Counted {when} by {name}, {amount} short" `OP.SAFE.BALANCE.04`
- [ ] **Pay a cost** Type 250000, choose Supplier, type a payee, keep Safe and press the button **Expect:** The button reads "Pay 250,000 IQD from the safe"; toast "Paid 250,000 IQD from the safe."; the balance drops by 250,000; the form clears keeping Safe and the cursor returns to the amount `OP.SAFE.PAY.01`
- [ ] **Pay a cost** Choose Bank transfer and pay 500,000 Bills **Expect:** Hint "Listed with the costs. The safe does not change."; button "Log 500,000 IQD paid by bank"; the cost appears in Where the money went with "500,000 IQD by bank" and the balance does not change `OP.SAFE.PAY.02`
- [ ] **Pay a cost** Pay 300,000 from the safe when it shows 200,000 **Expect:** Warning "The safe shows 200,000 IQD. This payment takes it below zero. Log it anyway if the money left." and the payment is still allowed `OP.SAFE.PAY.06`
- [ ] **Pay a cost** Look for wages and advances on the Pay form **Expect:** Not in the categories; "Wages, advances and coach pay are paid from their own pages, so each is counted once." with Wages (owner only) and Coach pay links `OP.SAFE.PAY.08`
- [ ] **Move cash** Into the safe from Court desk, 180,000 **Expect:** Button "Move 180,000 IQD into the safe"; toast "Moved 180,000 IQD."; ledger row "In from the court desk"; balance up by 180,000 `OP.SAFE.MOVE.01`
- [ ] **Move cash** Out of the safe to the café cashier as a float, 50,000 **Expect:** Ledger "Float out to the café cashier"; balance down by 50,000 `OP.SAFE.MOVE.02`
- [ ] **Move cash** Move in from Bank and out to Owner **Expect:** Rows "Taken from the bank" and "The owner took cash out" with matching balance changes `OP.SAFE.MOVE.03`
- [ ] **Move cash** Hand in the café cashier at Day close, then try to hand in the same box for that day here **Expect:** MAIN_CASH_HANDED_IN: "This drawer was already handed in to the safe for that day. Take that entry back on the Safe page to redo it." `OP.SAFE.MOVE.06`
- [ ] **Move cash** P1 · Check the Day close hand-in row in the ledger **Expect:** It reads "In from the {box}" with "at day close" and can be taken back here `OP.SAFE.MOVE.07`

### OP.ATTENDANCE: Late and early (attendance)

Manager or owner (0270/0271): the branch rule (X grace minutes, Y IQD penalty, 0 = off), recording a day's late and early minutes for a person within the last 60 days with a live verdict, and the month per person with what each day costs and the wage it comes off. All writes direct appRpc (set_cafe_settings, record_attendance, clear_attendance), online only.

**Route:** `/attendance` · **Roles:** manager, owner

**Source:** `apps/operator/src/features/attendance/AttendancePage.tsx`, `apps/operator/src/features/attendance/attendanceLogic.ts`, `apps/operator/src/features/attendance/api.ts`

**Components:** The rule · Record a day · The month

#### OP.ATTENDANCE.T01 · P1 · The rule: main flow

- [ ] Set penalty 0 **Expect:** The sentence says the rule is off `OP.ATTENDANCE.RULE.02`
- [ ] Type a penalty above 2,000,000 IQD **Expect:** Field error with the maximum; Save refused `OP.ATTENDANCE.RULE.03`
- [ ] P2 · Look at Save without changes **Expect:** Save appears only when the rule is changed `OP.ATTENDANCE.RULE.05`

#### OP.ATTENDANCE.T02 · P1 · Record a day: main flow

- [ ] P2 · Type minutes above 720 **Expect:** Minutes range error `OP.ATTENDANCE.RECORD.05`
- [ ] Record a day for a person who already has that date recorded **Expect:** An info line says the new entry replaces the day already recorded for that name and date `OP.ATTENDANCE.RECORD.06`

#### OP.ATTENDANCE.T03 · P0 · Late and early (attendance): money and totals

- [ ] **The rule** Set grace 15 and penalty 10,000 and press Save **Expect:** The sentence reads the rule with 10,000 IQD and 15 minutes; toast saved; both keys sent in one write `OP.ATTENDANCE.RULE.01`
- [ ] **The rule** Change the rule after days are recorded **Expect:** Already recorded days keep the rule in force when they were recorded; their cost does not change `OP.ATTENDANCE.RULE.04`
- [ ] **Record a day** With rule 15 min / 10,000 IQD, record 10 late + 10 early for a waiter today **Expect:** Verdict "over" naming 10,000 IQD before saving; saved toast; the day shows Penalty 10,000 IQD and the month total rises by 10,000 `OP.ATTENDANCE.RECORD.01`
- [ ] **Record a day** Record 5 late + 5 early **Expect:** Verdict "within"; the day costs 0 `OP.ATTENDANCE.RECORD.02`
- [ ] **Record a day** Record a day whose month's wage is already paid **Expect:** The day comes off a later wage, and the row names that wage month `OP.ATTENDANCE.RECORD.07`
- [ ] **The month** Read the month after recording three days for two people **Expect:** Totals equal the sum of the rows; each person's panel shows their penalty total in IQD; days list date, late, early, penalty and note `OP.ATTENDANCE.MONTH.01`

- [ ] **The month** View a day whose wage is paid **Expect:** A "locked" badge replaces Edit and Clear `OP.ATTENDANCE.MONTH.04`
- [ ] **The month** Compare a person's penalties here with the owner's Wages page for that month **Expect:** Same IQD `OP.ATTENDANCE.MONTH.08`

### OP.ANALYTICS: Analytics (layout, filters, shared cards)

Owner-only analytics workspace with Courts, Cafe and People tabs sharing one sticky filter bar (period, compare basis, court, settings) and branch scope. The URL search params carry the period across tabs.

**Route:** `/analytics` · **Roles:** owner

**Source:** `apps/operator/src/routes/analytics.tsx`, `apps/operator/src/routes/analytics/_children.ts`, `apps/operator/src/features/analytics/search.ts`, `apps/operator/src/features/analytics/AnalyticsFrame.tsx`

**Components:** Branch scope (one / All branches / closed branch) · Sticky filter bar (period, compare, court, jump-nav) · Courts | Cafe | People tabs · Settings disclosure (business-day start hour, excluded items) · Notices list · Export (pulse workbook, table twins, CSV-labelled downloads) · Figure tiles, figure lines and drill-through · AI findings card (Ask for findings / Check they still hold / Hide) · Assistant-fed cards and pinned components · Card shell states

### OP.ANALYTICS_COURTS: Analytics › Courts

Owner reads how the courts did: bookings, occupancy, padel revenue (courts plus Touch Shop), losses, when it is busy, per court, booking shape, guests, shop and cafe attach.

**Route:** `/analytics/courts` · **Roles:** owner

**Source:** `apps/operator/src/features/analytics/courts/CourtsTab.tsx`, `apps/operator/src/features/analytics/courts/useCourtsData.ts`, `apps/operator/src/features/analytics/courts/api.ts`, `apps/operator/src/features/analytics/courts/derive.ts`, `apps/operator/src/features/analytics/courts/shape.ts`, `apps/operator/src/features/analytics/useVenueRevenue.ts`

**Components:** Summary (lead tiles, time and beyond groups, mix ring) · What stands out (court patterns card) · When courts are busy (heatmap) · Courts compared (court table and per-court charts) · Cancellations and no-shows · How people book · Guests (returning, regulars, frequency, weekly) · Touch Shop on the Courts tab · Court players at the cafe

### OP.ANALYTICS_CAFE: Analytics › Cafe

Owner reads cafe sales, menu performance (margins, conversion from QR views), promos and time patterns; guest-menu engagement comes from PostHog when configured.

**Route:** `/analytics/cafe` · **Roles:** owner

### OP.ANALYTICS_PEOPLE: Analytics › People

Owner sees who the customers are (0369): gender, age band, level, derived interests, biggest groups with spend, when each group plays, and whether recorded levels are accurate. Exact counts are owner-only.

**Route:** `/analytics/people` · **Roles:** owner

**Source:** `apps/operator/src/features/analytics/people/PeopleTab.tsx`, `apps/operator/src/features/analytics/people/peopleLogic.ts`, `apps/operator/src/features/analytics/people/zones.ts`

**Components:** Who they are (crowd, coverage, genders, ages, levels) · What they are into · Biggest groups table · When each group plays · Are the levels right / new vs returning

#### OP.ANALYTICS_PEOPLE.T01 · P1 · Analytics › People: main checks

- [ ] Open People as the owner **Expect:** One call app.analytics_customers with the 60 s deadline; five zones: who, interests, groups, when, judged `OP.ANALYTICS_PEOPLE.01`
- [ ] P2 · Check the filter bar on People **Expect:** Period and compare only; no court filter and no Settings disclosure `OP.ANALYTICS_PEOPLE.02`
- [ ] P2 · Change the compare basis **Expect:** Only the period line changes; People figures are not compared (record that no deltas exist) `OP.ANALYTICS_PEOPLE.03`

#### OP.ANALYTICS_PEOPLE.T02 · P1 · Who they are (crowd, coverage, genders, ages, levels): main flow

- [ ] Compare Guests with distinct customers who played in the period **Expect:** Equal `OP.ANALYTICS_PEOPLE.WHO.01`
- [ ] P2 · Coverage meter **Expect:** Percent of guests with an age/level; with level shows how many were judged by a coach `OP.ANALYTICS_PEOPLE.WHO.02`
- [ ] P2 · Buckets order **Expect:** Gender female, male, unknown; ages u18 to 55+ then unknown; levels new to advanced then unknown `OP.ANALYTICS_PEOPLE.WHO.03`
- [ ] P2 · Sign up a guest with no age **Expect:** Counted in unknown `OP.ANALYTICS_PEOPLE.WHO.04`
- [ ] P2 · Download each chart twin **Expect:** people-<chart>_<from>_<to>.xlsx `OP.ANALYTICS_PEOPLE.WHO.05`
- [ ] Check no name or phone appears anywhere **Expect:** Counts only `OP.ANALYTICS_PEOPLE.WHO.07`

#### OP.ANALYTICS_PEOPLE.T03 · P1 · Analytics › People: money and totals

- [ ] **Biggest groups table** Sum Spend across segments **Expect:** Record against the venue revenue for identified customers; must not exceed venue revenue `OP.ANALYTICS_PEOPLE.GROUPS.02`

#### OP.ANALYTICS_PEOPLE.T04 · P2 · Analytics › People: other parts

- [ ] **What they are into** Read interest bars **Expect:** One bar per tag the server returned, in server order, chart height grows with tags `OP.ANALYTICS_PEOPLE.INTERESTS.01`
- [ ] **Biggest groups table** Read the table **Expect:** Rows with Who, Band, Level, Guests, Plays, Spend (IQD); long cells truncate with full text on hover `OP.ANALYTICS_PEOPLE.GROUPS.01`
- [ ] **When each group plays** Read peaks **Expect:** Each bucket lists its busiest slots like "Thursday 19:00" `OP.ANALYTICS_PEOPLE.WHEN.01`

#### OP.ANALYTICS_PEOPLE.T05 · P2 · Analytics › People: With no data yet

*Setup:* `EMPTY_DATA` (Nothing recorded yet)

- [ ] Branch with no customer records **Expect:** Empty sentence in every card `OP.ANALYTICS_PEOPLE.05`
- [ ] **What they are into** No interests **Expect:** Empty sentence `OP.ANALYTICS_PEOPLE.INTERESTS.02`
- [ ] **When each group plays** No peaks **Expect:** Empty sentence `OP.ANALYTICS_PEOPLE.WHEN.02`

#### OP.ANALYTICS_PEOPLE.T06 · P0 · Analytics › People: ge

*Setup:* `WRONG_ROLE` (Signed in with a role that may not use this), `SLOW_NETWORK` (Slow network), `BACKEND_DOWN` (Server unreachable while the LAN is up), `PARTIAL_FAILURE` (One analytics RPC fails, the others succeed), `SECOND_BRANCH` (Two branches), `STATEMENT_TIMEOUT` (Server statement timeout or 60 s client deadline on a heavy analytics RPC), `ARABIC_RTL` (Arabic, right to left), `LARGE_DATA` (Large data volume), `TIMEZONE_EDGE` (Midnight / business-day boundary (Asia/Baghdad)), `THIN_SAMPLE` (Fewer than 20 bookings or orders in both windows)

### OP.REPORTS: Reports layout: branch scope, period, filters, tables, drill, export

The shared frame of every report: the owner-only branch scope above the page, the period picker counted from the business day, the labelled filters, the report tables, the drill-through window and the spreadsheet export. Manager and owner only.

**Route:** `/reports` · **Roles:** manager, owner

**Source:** `apps/operator/src/routes/reports.tsx`, `apps/operator/src/routes/reports/_children.ts`, `apps/operator/src/lib/workspaces.ts`, `apps/operator/src/features/reports/ReportParts.tsx`

**Components:** Branch scope control (owner) · Period picker (DateRangeControl) and business day · Labelled filters (Court, Category, Staff member, Paid by, Group by, Compare with) · Report table, View more cap and column notes · Drill-through window (DrillDialog) · Export button (spreadsheet) · Loading, error, timeout and offline states

#### OP.REPORTS.T01 · P1 · Reports layout: branch scope, period, filters, tables, drill, export: main checks

- [ ] Sign in as owner and open /reports (type it in the address or follow a link) **Expect:** The app redirects (replace, no extra history entry) to /reports/courts and the Courts report loads `OP.REPORTS.01`
- [ ] As owner open the Financial section, click the Reports row in the rail **Expect:** It opens /reports/revenue; the family tabs read Revenue, Court sales, Cafe sales (REPORT_TABS) `OP.REPORTS.02`
- [ ] As owner open Stock > On hand family and click its Stock value tab; then Team > What they did **Expect:** Stock value opens /reports/stock under the Stock rail (not Financial); What they did opens /reports/staff beside Who is on (/observation/activity) `OP.REPORTS.04`

#### OP.REPORTS.T02 · P1 · Period picker (DateRangeControl) and business day: main flow

- [ ] Open any report fresh **Expect:** The period defaults to This month: the 1st of the business month to today; the page subtitle reads the period (e.g. "1 Oct 2026 – 30 Oct 2026") `OP.REPORTS.PERIOD.01`
- [ ] Click each preset in turn and Apply **Expect:** Each sets the right dates, the subtitle and the request p_from/p_to change accordingly; Last week is Sunday to Saturday of the previous week `OP.REPORTS.PERIOD.02`
- [ ] Pick a custom range by clicking the later day first, then the earlier day, and Apply **Expect:** The range is put in order (from <= to) and the report reads it `OP.REPORTS.PERIOD.03`
- [ ] P2 · Open the picker, change the dates, then press Escape (or click outside) **Expect:** The panel closes and the field goes back to the applied range; no new request is sent `OP.REPORTS.PERIOD.04`
- [ ] P2 · Use Clear in the panel, then Apply without picking **Expect:** Nothing changes until a new range is applied; no request with empty dates is sent `OP.REPORTS.PERIOD.05`

#### OP.REPORTS.T03 · P1 · Labelled filters (Court, Category, Staff member, Paid by, Group by, Compare with): main flow

- [ ] Open each report and list its filters **Expect:** Revenue: Period, Paid by, Staff member, Compare with (+ Group by beside the breakdown). Courts: Period, Court, Compare with. Cafe: Period, Category, Compare with. Stock: Period only. Staff activity: Period, Staff member. Each control has its label above it `OP.REPORTS.FILTERS.01`
- [ ] Open the Staff member list **Expect:** People are listed alphabetically by display name; removed (inactive) staff are still listed so their past work can be read `OP.REPORTS.FILTERS.02`
- [ ] P2 · Open the Court filter at a venue with a retired court **Expect:** Only active courts are listed (fetchActiveCourts); a retired court still appears in the By court table with a "Retired" badge `OP.REPORTS.FILTERS.03`
- [ ] Set Compare with to "Previous period" and then "Same period last year" **Expect:** The subtitle reads "<period>, compared with <earlier period>" and headline figures show their change; the request goes to report_compare with p_report and p_compare `OP.REPORTS.FILTERS.04`

#### OP.REPORTS.T04 · P1 · Report table, View more cap and column notes: main flow

- [ ] Sort a money column by clicking its header, then click again **Expect:** First click sorts biggest first (numbers default to descending), second click flips; the three rows shown are the top of the chosen order `OP.REPORTS.TABLE.02`
- [ ] Find a figure the server did not send (e.g. a missing cost) **Expect:** The cell shows "—", never "0"; zero figures are drawn muted `OP.REPORTS.TABLE.04`
- [ ] P2 · Read a percentage cell (occupancy, margin, cancelled %) **Expect:** Always one decimal place followed by % (e.g. "45.0%") `OP.REPORTS.TABLE.06`
- [ ] P2 · Check the "Reading the table" notes under each breakdown **Expect:** Notes appear only for the breakdown on screen and match its columns (e.g. Occupancy and Per open hour notes under By court) `OP.REPORTS.TABLE.07`

#### OP.REPORTS.T05 · P1 · Drill-through window (DrillDialog): main flow

- [ ] In a drill with several kinds, click a kind tab, then a kind tag in a row, then a location, then type in the search **Expect:** Rows narrow each time; the shown/total count updates; the Total card and footer total follow the filtered rows; removing the place chip restores rows `OP.REPORTS.DRILL.03`
- [ ] Open a Given away drill (several figures) and switch between Discounts, Voids and Refunds **Expect:** Each switch loads that figure's list, and kind/place filters reset `OP.REPORTS.DRILL.04`
- [ ] P2 · Open one drill, close it and immediately open another figure **Expect:** The second window stays open (a fresh Modal per request); it does not close itself from the first one's fade-out `OP.REPORTS.DRILL.09`
- [ ] P2 · Open a drill where every row was taken by one person **Expect:** The By column is folded away and the Total card says "All taken by <name>" `OP.REPORTS.DRILL.11`

#### OP.REPORTS.T06 · P1 · Export button (spreadsheet): main flow

- [ ] Click Export on Revenue for 1–30 Sep with Group by Week, Paid by Cash and a staff member **Expect:** A file named like revenue_2026-09-01_2026-09-30_group-week_pay-cash_staff-1a2b3c4d.xlsx downloads (staff id cut to 8 characters); there is no CSV or Print option on any report `OP.REPORTS.EXPORT.01`
- [ ] Open the downloaded file in Excel / Numbers / LibreOffice **Expect:** One sheet with a bold filled header row frozen at the top, readable column widths, money as numbers formatted #,##0 with negatives in red, dates as real dates `OP.REPORTS.EXPORT.02`
- [ ] Export a table with percentage or decimal columns (Courts by court, Cafe Cost & profit, Stock quantities) and inspect those columns **Expect:** Report it if a percentage (occupancy, margin) or a decimal quantity (2.5) displays as a rounded whole number without % - tableCsv formats every numeric column as money (#,##0) because no column sets csvType `OP.REPORTS.EXPORT.05`
- [ ] P2 · Export with a filter value containing non-Latin text (e.g. a view key) and check the file name **Expect:** Only a-z, 0-9 and "-" appear in filter parts; the file name has no spaces, slashes or Arabic letters `OP.REPORTS.EXPORT.09`

#### OP.REPORTS.T07 · P0 · Reports layout: branch scope, period, filters, tables, drill, export: money and totals

- [ ] **Drill-through window (DrillDialog)** Click a figure (e.g. Revenue > Cash) and sum the Amount column by hand **Expect:** The window title is the figure, the subtitle the period; the Total card, the footer "Total (n)" and the hand sum all equal the headline figure to the dinar `OP.REPORTS.DRILL.01`
- [ ] **Export button (spreadsheet)** Sum a money column in the exported file and compare with the on-screen headline figure **Expect:** The sums equal the screen totals exactly (whole IQD, nothing rounded or lost) `OP.REPORTS.EXPORT.03`
