### OP.REPORTS_REVENUE: Revenue report

Owner-only: how much was earned (padel, cafe, lessons), how it came in (cash, card), what went back out (discounts, voids, refunds) and tax, with a by day/week/month breakdown and drill-through. Reads app.report_revenue (or report_compare).

**Route:** `/reports/revenue` · **Roles:** owner

**Source:** `apps/operator/src/features/reports/RevenueReport.tsx`, `apps/operator/src/features/reports/reportPayloads.ts`, `apps/operator/src/components/BreakdownCards.tsx`

**Components:** Totals cards (Earned, Money taken, Given away, Tax) · Paid by and Staff member filters · Breakdown table (Earned / Money taken / Given away / Tax, by Day / Week / Month) · Revenue export

#### OP.REPORTS_REVENUE.T01 · P1 · Breakdown table (Earned / Money taken / Given away / Tax, by Day / Week / Month): main flow

- [ ] Switch Show between Earned, Money taken, Given away and Tax **Expect:** Columns change: Earned = Day, Padel, Cafe, (Lessons), Revenue, Bookings, Orders; Money taken = Cash, Card; Given away = Discounts, Voids, Refunds; Tax = Cafe sales, Tax; the lead sentence and notes change too `OP.REPORTS_REVENUE.BREAKDOWN.01`
- [ ] Switch Group by to Week for a period starting mid-week (e.g. Wed 1 Oct – Fri 31 Oct) **Expect:** The first column is "Week starting"; the first row's drill opens only 1 Oct onwards (clipped to the period), the last week is clipped at 31 Oct `OP.REPORTS_REVENUE.BREAKDOWN.03`
- [ ] Click a day row in Given away **Expect:** The drill opens titled "Given away" with the row's date as subtitle and a switch Discounts / Voids / Refunds `OP.REPORTS_REVENUE.BREAKDOWN.05`
- [ ] P2 · Click a row on the Tax view **Expect:** Nothing opens (no drill hint is shown on Tax) `OP.REPORTS_REVENUE.BREAKDOWN.06`

#### OP.REPORTS_REVENUE.T02 · P0 · Revenue report: money and totals

- [ ] **Totals cards (Earned, Money taken, Given away, Tax)** Seed a known day: 2 bookings of 40,000 IQD, cafe tabs paid 25,000 IQD (cafe net), one 5,000 IQD discount, one refund 3,000 IQD; open that day **Expect:** Earned: Padel 80,000 IQD (Bookings: 2), Cafe = cafe net after refunds, Revenue = Padel + Cafe; Given away: Discounts 5,000, Refunds 3,000; every figure matches the seed exactly `OP.REPORTS_REVENUE.FIGURES.01`
- [ ] **Totals cards (Earned, Money taken, Given away, Tax)** Compare Money taken (Cash + Card) with Earned for a period where a booking was prepaid last month and played this month **Expect:** They differ, and that is expected: padel counts on the play day, money taken on the day the money moved (the card hints say so) `OP.REPORTS_REVENUE.FIGURES.02`
- [ ] **Totals cards (Earned, Money taken, Given away, Tax)** Check Cash and Card against the day-close drawer counts for the same business day **Expect:** Cash taken equals the sum of cash payments less cash refunds recorded at the tills for that business day `OP.REPORTS_REVENUE.FIGURES.03`
- [ ] **Totals cards (Earned, Money taken, Given away, Tax)** Check the Tax card against paid cafe tabs **Expect:** Tax equals the tax on paid cafe tabs only (no tax on padel), whole IQD `OP.REPORTS_REVENUE.FIGURES.04`
- [ ] **Totals cards (Earned, Money taken, Given away, Tax)** On a server with coaching (0288), read Lessons and Owed to coaches **Expect:** Lessons shows the lesson revenue (inside Revenue, outside Padel); Owed to coaches shows the coaches' share; neither opens a drill `OP.REPORTS_REVENUE.FIGURES.05`
- [ ] **Paid by and Staff member filters** Set Paid by to Cash **Expect:** An info note "Only cash …" (scopeMethod) shows; Money taken Card drops to 0 or "—"; request p_filters.paymentMethod = "cash" `OP.REPORTS_REVENUE.FILTERS.01`
- [ ] **Paid by and Staff member filters** Pick a Staff member **Expect:** A note "Only what <name> recorded: bookings they made, orders they placed, payments they took, and the discounts, voids and refunds they gave." shows; figures drop to that person's; drills are scoped to staff:<id> `OP.REPORTS_REVENUE.FILTERS.03`
- [ ] **Paid by and Staff member filters** Combine Staff and Paid by and sum the breakdown rows **Expect:** Row sums equal the filtered headline figures `OP.REPORTS_REVENUE.FILTERS.05`
- [ ] **Breakdown table (Earned / Money taken / Given away / Tax, by Day / Week / Month)** In Earned by Day, add up the Revenue column across all rows **Expect:** The sum equals the Revenue headline exactly `OP.REPORTS_REVENUE.BREAKDOWN.02`
- [ ] **Breakdown table (Earned / Money taken / Given away / Tax, by Day / Week / Month)** Switch Group by to Month over a 3-month period **Expect:** Rows are labelled "Month Year" (e.g. "Sep 2026"); row totals add up to the headline `OP.REPORTS_REVENUE.BREAKDOWN.04`
- [ ] **Revenue export** Sum Revenue, Cash, Card and Refunds in the file **Expect:** Each equals the on-screen headline to the dinar `OP.REPORTS_REVENUE.EXPORT.03`

#### OP.REPORTS_REVENUE.T03 · P1 · Revenue report: other parts

- [ ] **Whole page** As owner open /reports/revenue with seeded data for this month **Expect:** Header "Revenue" with eyebrow "Reports", subtitle the period; Totals cards Earned, Money taken, Given away, Tax; then the Show switch on Earned grouped by Day `OP.REPORTS_REVENUE.04`
- [ ] **Totals cards (Earned, Money taken, Given away, Tax)** Click Revenue, Padel, Cafe, Cash, Card, Discounts, Voids and Refunds in turn **Expect:** Each opens the drill window named for the figure over the whole period; Lessons, Owed to coaches and Tax do not open anything `OP.REPORTS_REVENUE.FIGURES.07`
- [ ] **Totals cards (Earned, Money taken, Given away, Tax)** Turn Compare with "Previous period" on and read each figure's change **Expect:** Changes show for figures the server compares; a rise in Discounts, Voids or Refunds is shown as bad news (inverted tone), a rise in Revenue as good `OP.REPORTS_REVENUE.FIGURES.08`
- [ ] **Paid by and Staff member filters** With Paid by Cash set, open any figure's drill **Expect:** The window carries the note "This list includes every payment method." (report_drill cannot filter by method) `OP.REPORTS_REVENUE.FILTERS.02`
- [ ] **Paid by and Staff member filters** Pick a removed (former) staff member **Expect:** Their past figures load (not an empty or refused page) `OP.REPORTS_REVENUE.FILTERS.04`
- [ ] **Revenue export** Export from the Tax view **Expect:** The file still carries every figure column: period, Padel, Cafe, (Lessons, Owed to coaches), Revenue, Cafe sales, Cash, Card, Discounts, Voids, Refunds, Tax, Bookings, Orders `OP.REPORTS_REVENUE.EXPORT.01`
- [ ] **Revenue export** P2 · In the file, check the period column for Group by Day / Week / Month **Expect:** It holds ISO dates (the week's start, the month's 1st) as real spreadsheet dates `OP.REPORTS_REVENUE.EXPORT.02`

#### OP.REPORTS_REVENUE.T04 · P0 · Revenue report: Who can and cannot use it

*Setup:* `WRONG_ROLE` (Signed in with a role that may not use this)

- [ ] As manager type /reports/revenue **Expect:** The refusal card shows ("Viewing revenue" needs owner) and no report_revenue call is made (check the network tab) `OP.REPORTS_REVENUE.01`
- [ ] As manager call app.report_revenue directly (devtools / REST) with valid dates **Expect:** The server refuses (FORBIDDEN or equivalent); no figures return `OP.REPORTS_REVENUE.02`
- [ ] As a manager who also holds a second job (is_staff) other than owner, open /reports/revenue **Expect:** Still refused: viewFinancials is owner only `OP.REPORTS_REVENUE.03`

#### OP.REPORTS_REVENUE.T05 · P1 · Revenue report: ge

*Setup:* `ARABIC_RTL` (Arabic, right to left), `SERVER_MISSING_FEATURE` (Server without a newer RPC or payload block), `LARGE_DATA` (Large data volume), `EMPTY_DATA` (Nothing recorded yet)

- [ ] `ARABIC_RTL` Open Revenue in Arabic **Expect:** Cards, switch, table and notes in Arabic; money as "15,000 د.ع." with Latin digits; period column dates in Arabic month names `OP.REPORTS_REVENUE.05`
- [ ] **Breakdown table (Earned / Money taken / Given away / Tax, by Day / Week / Month)** `ARABIC_RTL` P2 · Read the Day column in Arabic **Expect:** Dates read in Arabic month names with Latin digits, isolated so they do not reorder with neighbouring numbers `OP.REPORTS_REVENUE.BREAKDOWN.08`
- [ ] **Totals cards (Earned, Money taken, Given away, Tax)** `SERVER_MISSING_FEATURE` On a server without the lesson keys, read Lessons and Owed to coaches **Expect:** Both read "—" (never 0) and the Earned table has no Lessons column `OP.REPORTS_REVENUE.FIGURES.06`
- [ ] **Totals cards (Earned, Money taken, Given away, Tax)** `LARGE_DATA` P2 · Look at Revenue for a period with a very large total (e.g. 1,234,567,890 IQD) **Expect:** The figure prints in full with separators ("1,234,567,890 IQD") and fits its card without overlap `OP.REPORTS_REVENUE.FIGURES.09`
- [ ] **Breakdown table (Earned / Money taken / Given away / Tax, by Day / Week / Month)** `LARGE_DATA` P2 · Load 12 months by Day (365 rows) **Expect:** Three rows show with View more (362); the page stays responsive; sorting by Revenue works `OP.REPORTS_REVENUE.BREAKDOWN.09`
- [ ] **Breakdown table (Earned / Money taken / Given away / Tax, by Day / Week / Month)** `EMPTY_DATA` P2 · Check a day with no sales, bookings or payments **Expect:** That day is not listed (the lead says so); no zero row `OP.REPORTS_REVENUE.BREAKDOWN.07`

### OP.REPORTS_COURTS: Courts report

How the courts did: bookings kept, hours booked, occupancy, court revenue, cancellations, no-shows, tournament hours; breakdowns by court, cancellations, peak, start time, day, plus Open matches and Lessons when the server sends them. Reads app.report_courts, report_matches, report_lessons.

**Route:** `/reports/courts` · **Roles:** manager, owner

**Source:** `apps/operator/src/features/reports/CourtsReport.tsx`, `apps/operator/src/features/reports/reportPayloads.ts`

**Components:** Figure band · By court, Cancellations and Peak times tables · By start time bars and By day table · Open matches view · Lessons view · Courts export

#### OP.REPORTS_COURTS.T01 · P1 · Figure band: main flow

- [ ] Check Occupancy against hours: booked hours / open court hours **Expect:** Occupancy % = booked minutes / available minutes, one decimal; the hint reads "Of <N> open court hours" `OP.REPORTS_COURTS.BAND.02`
- [ ] P2 · On a server with lessons (0288), read the Occupancy hint **Expect:** It reads "… Lesson time counts as booked." `OP.REPORTS_COURTS.BAND.03`
- [ ] Pick a period in which a tournament blocked a court **Expect:** A "Tournament hours" figure appears last in the band with its hint; a period without one shows no tournament figure at all `OP.REPORTS_COURTS.BAND.04`
- [ ] P2 · Turn Compare with on **Expect:** Bookings, Hours, Court revenue, Cancellations and No-shows show changes (cancellations and no-shows inverted); Occupancy shows none `OP.REPORTS_COURTS.BAND.05`

#### OP.REPORTS_COURTS.T02 · P1 · By court, Cancellations and Peak times tables: main flow

- [ ] On By court, sort by Per open hour ascending **Expect:** The court earning least per open hour is first; every court is listed (no View more cap: fixed axis) `OP.REPORTS_COURTS.BY_COURT.01`
- [ ] Click a court row on By court **Expect:** The drill opens titled with the court name, listing its bookings for the period (report_drill bookings with p_key court:<id>) `OP.REPORTS_COURTS.BY_COURT.03`
- [ ] Click a court row on Cancellations **Expect:** The drill opens with a switch between Cancelled and No-shows `OP.REPORTS_COURTS.BY_COURT.04`
- [ ] P2 · On Peak times, check a booking priced by hand **Expect:** It counts as Off-peak (the note explains peak = highest price rule for that length) `OP.REPORTS_COURTS.BY_COURT.06`
- [ ] Pick a court in the Court filter **Expect:** The band and tables narrow to that court; the request carries p_filters.courtId `OP.REPORTS_COURTS.BY_COURT.07`
- [ ] P2 · With a court that has been retired **Expect:** Its row shows a "Retired" badge and its past figures `OP.REPORTS_COURTS.BY_COURT.08`

#### OP.REPORTS_COURTS.T03 · P1 · Open matches view: main flow

- [ ] On a server with 0265, open the Show switch **Expect:** An "Open matches" option is listed; on an older server it is not `OP.REPORTS_COURTS.MATCHES.01`
- [ ] Open Open matches **Expect:** The Court filter is replaced by Category (All / Open / Women / Men) and Joining (Any / Open / Approve) filters; Compare with is disabled and a note says comparison is not available here `OP.REPORTS_COURTS.MATCHES.02`
- [ ] P2 · Change Category to Women **Expect:** report_matches is re-read with p_filters.category women; counts and By day change; the band from report_courts does not `OP.REPORTS_COURTS.MATCHES.04`

#### OP.REPORTS_COURTS.T04 · P1 · Lessons view: main flow

- [ ] Check the By coach table **Expect:** One row per coach with Lessons, Enrolments, Collected, Coach share; capped at three rows with View more `OP.REPORTS_COURTS.LESSONS.02`
- [ ] Click "Export By coach" (and the By lesson type / By day export buttons) **Expect:** Each downloads its own .xlsx file named courts_<from>_<to>_view-lessons_table-byCoach (etc.) `OP.REPORTS_COURTS.LESSONS.03`
- [ ] Click the header Export while on Lessons **Expect:** One workbook with three sheets named By coach / By lesson type / By day (in the UI language) `OP.REPORTS_COURTS.LESSONS.04`

#### OP.REPORTS_COURTS.T05 · P1 · Courts export: main flow

- [ ] Export from By court and open the file **Expect:** Columns: Court, Bookings, Hours booked, (Lesson hours), Occupancy, Revenue, Per open hour, Cancelled, Cancelled %, No-shows, No-show %, Peak, Off-peak, Available hours, (Event minutes) `OP.REPORTS_COURTS.EXPORT.01`

- [ ] **Figure band** Seed 3 bookings of 90 minutes at 30,000 IQD on one day, one cancelled and one no-show; open that day **Expect:** Bookings kept 1 (not counting cancellations and no-shows), Hours booked "1.5 h", Court revenue matches the kept/charged bookings, Cancellations 1 (amber), No-shows 1 (red) `OP.REPORTS_COURTS.BAND.01`

- [ ] **Open matches view** Check Booked IQD, Paid at the desk and Written off against the seeded matches **Expect:** Each equals the seed exactly; Written off is amber when not zero `OP.REPORTS_COURTS.MATCHES.03`
- [ ] **Open matches view** Seed a sandbox match and open the view **Expect:** The note ws.matches.reports.sandboxExcluded shows and sandbox money is not counted `OP.REPORTS_COURTS.MATCHES.07`
- [ ] **Lessons view** Open Lessons and compare Collected = Court share + Coach share (+ Venue share) for the seeded month **Expect:** The money list adds up as the server sends it; Owed to coaches in the band equals the Coach's share total on /reports/coaches for the same month `OP.REPORTS_COURTS.LESSONS.01`
- [ ] **Lessons view** Compare Collected here with Lessons on Revenue for the same period (owner) **Expect:** They agree or differ only as the notes explain (refunds) `OP.REPORTS_COURTS.LESSONS.08`
- [ ] **Courts export** Sum Revenue in the By court export **Expect:** Equals Court revenue on screen `OP.REPORTS_COURTS.EXPORT.05`

- [ ] **By start time bars and By day table** Open By start time **Expect:** One bar per hour labelled "07:00" etc. (always LTR), bar length relative to the busiest hour, the count at the end `OP.REPORTS_COURTS.TIME_VIEWS.01`
- [ ] **By start time bars and By day table** Open By day and click a day **Expect:** The drill opens that one day's bookings (narrowed to the court filter if one is set) `OP.REPORTS_COURTS.TIME_VIEWS.04`

Try a longer period." and a Last 30 days button - not a table of courts at zero `OP.REPORTS_COURTS.02`

### OP.REPORTS_CAFE: Cafe report

What sold, what it earned and what it cost: revenue, orders, average order, items sold, gross profit (on costed items only), prep time; breakdowns Best sellers, Cost & profit, By category, Waste. Reads app.report_cafe.

**Route:** `/reports/cafe` · **Roles:** manager, owner

**Source:** `apps/operator/src/features/reports/CafeReport.tsx`, `apps/operator/src/features/reports/reportPayloads.ts`

**Components:** Figure band · Best sellers and Cost & profit · By category and Waste · Cafe export

#### OP.REPORTS_CAFE.T01 · P0 · Cafe report: money and totals

- [ ] **Figure band** Seed 4 paid orders totalling 100,000 IQD after a 10,000 discount and a 5,000 refund; open the day **Expect:** Cafe revenue is after discounts and refunds; Orders 4; Average order = revenue / orders as the server rounds it (whole IQD); Items sold = units `OP.REPORTS_CAFE.BAND.01`
- [ ] **Figure band** With 3 of 5 sold items having a recipe cost, read Gross profit **Expect:** The hint reads "Margin X%, on the 3 of 5 items with a cost"; profit counts only costed items `OP.REPORTS_CAFE.BAND.02`
- [ ] **Figure band** Compare Cafe revenue here with Cafe on Revenue (owner) for the same period **Expect:** They match (both after discounts and refunds; court fees on tabs count as padel) `OP.REPORTS_CAFE.BAND.05`
- [ ] **Best sellers and Cost & profit** P1 · Open Cost & profit for an item without a recipe **Expect:** Cost, Gross profit and Margin read "—" `OP.REPORTS_CAFE.ITEMS.02`
- [ ] **Best sellers and Cost & profit** Check one item: Revenue - Cost = Gross profit, Margin = profit / revenue **Expect:** The server figures satisfy the relation to the dinar and one decimal `OP.REPORTS_CAFE.ITEMS.03`
- [ ] **Best sellers and Cost & profit** Add up Revenue across all items (View more open) **Expect:** Equals Cafe revenue `OP.REPORTS_CAFE.ITEMS.05`
- [ ] **By category and Waste** P1 · Click "See each write-off" **Expect:** The drill lists every write-off in the period with ingredient, quantity and unit, reason `OP.REPORTS_CAFE.CATEGORIES_WASTE.03`
- [ ] **Cafe export** Sum Revenue in the items export **Expect:** Equals Cafe revenue on screen `OP.REPORTS_CAFE.EXPORT.03`

#### OP.REPORTS_CAFE.T02 · P1 · Cafe report: other parts

- [ ] **Whole page** As manager open /reports/cafe **Expect:** The report loads with its band and Best sellers `OP.REPORTS_CAFE.01`
- [ ] **Figure band** P2 · With no timed KDS tickets, read Average prep time **Expect:** It shows "—", not "0 s"; with tickets, "45 s" under a minute or "5.5 min", and the hint "9 in 10 ready within …" `OP.REPORTS_CAFE.BAND.04`
- [ ] **Figure band** Pick a Category **Expect:** The band and tables narrow to that category; request p_filters.categoryId `OP.REPORTS_CAFE.BAND.06`
- [ ] **Best sellers and Cost & profit** Open Best sellers **Expect:** Item, Category (muted), Sold, Orders, Revenue; three rows then View more; drill hint above `OP.REPORTS_CAFE.ITEMS.01`
- [ ] **Best sellers and Cost & profit** Click an item row **Expect:** The drill opens titled with the item name listing each sold line with quantity ("<item> × 2") and table `OP.REPORTS_CAFE.ITEMS.04`
- [ ] **By category and Waste** Open By category **Expect:** Every category is listed (no cap) with Items, Sold, Revenue, Cost, Gross profit, Margin `OP.REPORTS_CAFE.CATEGORIES_WASTE.01`
- [ ] **By category and Waste** P2 · Open Waste **Expect:** Rows per reason in words (e.g. "Spill", "Wrong item"), never codes like waste_spill; Times recorded and Cost `OP.REPORTS_CAFE.CATEGORIES_WASTE.02`
- [ ] **Cafe export** Export from Best sellers **Expect:** File columns: Item, Category, Sold, Orders, Revenue, Cost, Gross profit, Margin; file name cafe_<from>_<to>_view-items(_cat-xxxxxxxx) `OP.REPORTS_CAFE.EXPORT.01`
- [ ] **Cafe export** P2 · Export Waste **Expect:** Reason column holds the words the screen shows, not codes `OP.REPORTS_CAFE.EXPORT.02`

#### OP.REPORTS_CAFE.T03 · P1 · Cafe report: With no data yet

*Setup:* `EMPTY_DATA` (Nothing recorded yet)

- [ ] P2 · Pick a period with no orders and no waste **Expect:** Empty state "Nothing was sold in this period" / "Try a longer period, or another category." `OP.REPORTS_CAFE.02`
- [ ] **Figure band** With no costed items, read Gross profit **Expect:** It shows "—" with no hint (not 0 and not 100%) `OP.REPORTS_CAFE.BAND.03`
- [ ] **By category and Waste** P2 · Open Waste for a period with none **Expect:** "Nothing was written off in this period." and no See button `OP.REPORTS_CAFE.CATEGORIES_WASTE.04`

*Setup:* `ARABIC_RTL` (Arabic, right to left), `OFFLINE_THEN_RECONNECT` (Offline, then back online)

- [ ] **By category and Waste** `ARABIC_RTL` P2 · Read waste reasons in Arabic **Expect:** Known reasons translated; a typed custom reason shown as typed `OP.REPORTS_CAFE.CATEGORIES_WASTE.06`

### OP.REPORTS_STOCK: Stock value report

What is on the shelves worth and what needs attention: out of stock, running low, below par, expiring, expired (stock as it is now) plus Used and Count differences (follow the period). Reads app.report_stock.

**Route:** `/reports/stock` · **Roles:** manager, owner

**Source:** `apps/operator/src/features/reports/StockReport.tsx`, `apps/operator/src/features/reports/reportPayloads.ts`

**Components:** Figure band · Out of stock, Running low, Below par, Expiring soon, Expired · Used and Count differences · Stock export

#### OP.REPORTS_STOCK.T01 · P1 · Out of stock, Running low, Below par, Expiring soon, Expired: main flow

- [ ] Open each of the five lists **Expect:** A hint "Right now. The period above does not change this list." shows above each `OP.REPORTS_STOCK.NOW_LISTS.01`
- [ ] Click "Open in inventory" on Out of stock, Running low, Below par **Expect:** It navigates to /stock?filter=out, low, belowPar respectively `OP.REPORTS_STOCK.NOW_LISTS.02`
- [ ] Click "Open expiry list" on Expiring soon and Expired **Expect:** It opens /stock/expiry `OP.REPORTS_STOCK.NOW_LISTS.03`
- [ ] P2 · Check an expiring batch row **Expect:** Ingredient, Store (Cafe / Bakery, or "—" for a pre-stores batch), Quantity with unit, Use by date, Days left, Value `OP.REPORTS_STOCK.NOW_LISTS.04`
- [ ] P2 · Check a quantity with decimals (e.g. 2.5 kg stored in g) **Expect:** It reads "2,500 g" with separators and the unit `OP.REPORTS_STOCK.NOW_LISTS.07`

#### OP.REPORTS_STOCK.T02 · P1 · Used and Count differences: main flow

- [ ] Open Count differences **Expect:** "Only counts that differ" is ticked by default; rows show Counted (date and time), Ingredient, Store, Expected, Found, Difference, Product test, Moved (+/−) `OP.REPORTS_STOCK.PERIOD_LISTS.02`
- [ ] Untick "Only counts that differ" **Expect:** Matching counts appear too `OP.REPORTS_STOCK.PERIOD_LISTS.03`
- [ ] Check a negative Difference **Expect:** It reads with a minus and the note "Below zero means less was found." `OP.REPORTS_STOCK.PERIOD_LISTS.05`
- [ ] P2 · Check Moved for a store that received a transfer **Expect:** Shows "+2,000 g" (in) or "−500 ml" (out), always signed `OP.REPORTS_STOCK.PERIOD_LISTS.06`
- [ ] Click "Open stock counts" **Expect:** Navigates to /stock/counts `OP.REPORTS_STOCK.PERIOD_LISTS.07`

#### OP.REPORTS_STOCK.T03 · P0 · Stock value report: money and totals

- [ ] **Figure band** Compare "On the shelves" with the sum of on-hand x unit cost from the inventory screen **Expect:** Equal to the dinar (server value) `OP.REPORTS_STOCK.BAND.01`
- [ ] **Out of stock, Running low, Below par, Expiring soon, Expired** P1 · Check Value on the Expired list **Expect:** Each batch's value at cost in IQD; together they are the money about to be written off `OP.REPORTS_STOCK.NOW_LISTS.05`
- [ ] **Used and Count differences** P1 · Open Used for last month **Expect:** One row per ingredient: Used quantity and Cost; cost is at stock cost `OP.REPORTS_STOCK.PERIOD_LISTS.01`
- [ ] **Stock export** P1 · Export Expired and sum Value **Expect:** Equals the sum of Value on screen `OP.REPORTS_STOCK.EXPORT.03`

#### OP.REPORTS_STOCK.T04 · P1 · Stock value report: other parts

- [ ] **Whole page** As manager open /reports/stock from Stock > On hand > Stock value **Expect:** The report loads; the page is never "empty": the stock value always shows `OP.REPORTS_STOCK.01`
- [ ] **Whole page** P2 · Note the filters **Expect:** Only the Period; no Category or Compare (report_stock ignores them) `OP.REPORTS_STOCK.03`
- [ ] **Figure band** Count the rows of each list and compare with the band **Expect:** Each count equals the length of its list; non-zero counts show in red (out, low, expired) or amber (below par, expiring) `OP.REPORTS_STOCK.BAND.02`
- [ ] **Figure band** Change the period **Expect:** Stock value and the five "now" counts do not change; only Used and Count differences change `OP.REPORTS_STOCK.BAND.03`
- [ ] **Stock export** Export Count differences **Expect:** Columns include Counted (a date), a separate "Counted at" clock column, the quantities as bare numbers and a Unit column `OP.REPORTS_STOCK.EXPORT.01`
- [ ] **Stock export** P2 · Export Running low and check quantities with decimals **Expect:** Report it if decimal quantities show rounded to whole numbers (numeric columns default to the money format) `OP.REPORTS_STOCK.EXPORT.02`

#### OP.REPORTS_STOCK.T05 · P1 · Stock value report: ge

*Setup:* `ARABIC_RTL` (Arabic, right to left), `EMPTY_DATA` (Nothing recorded yet)

- [ ] `ARABIC_RTL` Open Stock in Arabic **Expect:** Ingredient names Arabic, units translated (g, ml, pc), store names (cafe / bakery) in Arabic `OP.REPORTS_STOCK.02`
- [ ] **Out of stock, Running low, Below par, Expiring soon, Expired** `EMPTY_DATA` P2 · With nothing out of stock **Expect:** The good-news empty line ws.reports.stock.empty.out shows `OP.REPORTS_STOCK.NOW_LISTS.06`
- [ ] **Used and Count differences** `EMPTY_DATA` P2 · A period where every count matched **Expect:** "Every count in this period matched." shows while the box is ticked `OP.REPORTS_STOCK.PERIOD_LISTS.04`

### OP.REPORTS_COACHES: Coach pay (monthly coach statements)

Each coach's monthly statement per branch from app.report_coach_statements: this month so far, the month's figures, statements to approve, pay (from the safe or bank, PIN-gated) or void. Manager and owner.

**Route:** `/reports/coaches?month=YYYY-MM-01` · **Roles:** manager, owner

**Source:** `apps/operator/src/features/reports/coaches/CoachStatements.tsx`, `apps/operator/src/features/reports/coaches/statementKeys.ts`, `apps/operator/src/features/reports/coaches/statementsLogic.ts`, `apps/operator/src/routes/reports/_children.ts`, `apps/operator/src/features/reports/coaches/CoachesThisMonth.tsx`, `apps/operator/src/features/reports/coaches/StatementDialog.tsx`, `apps/operator/src/features/reports/coaches/MarkPaidDialog.tsx`, `apps/operator/src/features/reports/coaches/VoidStatementDialog.tsx`

**Components:** Coaches this month so far (CoachesThisMonth) · Month stepper and totals band · Statements table, other branches and Not drafted list · Statement dialog (detail, Recount, Approve, Redraft) · Mark paid dialog (PIN-gated, paid from safe or bank) · Void statement dialog · Coach pay (page) · Statements and figures · Coaches this month so far · Statement dialog · Mark paid and Void

#### OP.REPORTS_COACHES.T01 · P1 · Coach pay (monthly coach statements): main checks

- [ ] Open /reports/coaches with no month **Expect:** Header "Coach pay" with the lead; the month shown is the month before the current month (statements are drafted on the 1st); the › next button (coachPay.month.next) is disabled `OP.REPORTS_COACHES.01`
- [ ] Open /reports/coaches?month=2026-08-01 **Expect:** August 2026 is shown and requested with p_month 2026-08-01; a "Latest month" button returns to the default and drops ?month `OP.REPORTS_COACHES.02`
- [ ] P2 · Open /reports/coaches?month=2030-01-01 (future) and ?month=banana **Expect:** Both show the default month (future is clamped, invalid is ignored) `OP.REPORTS_COACHES.03`
- [ ] P2 · Open /reports/coaches?month=2026-13-01 **Expect:** Record what happens: the route accepts it (regex only checks the shape); expect a clean error notice, not a crash `OP.REPORTS_COACHES.04`

### OP.MARKETING: Marketing (owner)

The owner's marketing desk: posts waiting for approval, the month content plan summary, campaigns and what they returned, staff requests to marketing, and audiences.

**Route:** `/marketing` · **Roles:** owner

**Source:** `apps/operator/src/routes/marketing.tsx`, `apps/operator/src/features/marketing/MarketingPanel.tsx`, `apps/operator/src/features/marketing/marketingTypes.ts`, `apps/operator/src/features/marketing/marketingStaffLogic.ts`

**Components:** Content for approval (owner list) · Post decision sheet (owner) · Content plan summary · Campaign table and status moves · Campaign wizard and edit form · Requests to marketing · Audiences

#### OP.MARKETING.T01 · P1 · Content for approval (owner list): main flow

- [ ] Open /marketing with 3 posts waiting **Expect:** Panel data-testid content.approval opens on the Waiting filter, oldest first, with the "N waiting" badge; each row (content.item.<id>) shows cover thumbnail, title, channel, "for <day>", "by <author>", version N when above 1, sent time and an amber Waiting pill `OP.MARKETING.CONTENT_APPROVAL.01`
- [ ] P2 · Switch the filter to Changes asked, Approved, Closed and All in turn **Expect:** Each shows only its statuses (Closed = declined and withdrawn); the list goes back to page 1 on each switch `OP.MARKETING.CONTENT_APPROVAL.02`
- [ ] P2 · Open the page as owner with a cover image whose signed URL fails (delete the storage object) **Expect:** The row shows the plain frame icon instead of a broken image `OP.MARKETING.CONTENT_APPROVAL.07`

- [ ] Open a waiting post and press "Approve version N" (content.decide.approve) **Expect:** decide_content is sent with the version shown; toast "approved" naming the author; sheet closes; the row leaves Waiting and the badge drops by one `OP.MARKETING.CONTENT_SHEET.01`
- [ ] P1 · Press Ask for changes (content.decide.changes), type a reason in content.decide.note and press the confirm (content.decide.confirm) **Expect:** Status becomes Changes asked; marketing sees the note under that version on /posts `OP.MARKETING.CONTENT_SHEET.02`
- [ ] P1 · Press Decline, leave the note empty and confirm **Expect:** The decline goes through without a reason (0361: the owner never has to say why); status Declined (red) `OP.MARKETING.CONTENT_SHEET.03`
- [ ] P2 · In the reason box paste 1,001 characters **Expect:** The textarea stops at 1,000 (maxLength); if forced past via paste, confirm shows the TEXT_TOO_LONG message and nothing is sent `OP.MARKETING.CONTENT_SHEET.04`
- [ ] P2 · Press Back from the reason step **Expect:** The sheet returns to reading mode with the note kept but no decision sent `OP.MARKETING.CONTENT_SHEET.05`
- [ ] P2 · Open a post with 3 versions **Expect:** Version 3 is open with its caption, images (signed, up to 10), Drive link with Copy and note; versions 2 and 1 are folded rows showing their decision badge and time, each expanding to its text and the owner reason `OP.MARKETING.CONTENT_SHEET.06`
- [ ] P2 · Press Copy (content.copy.N) beside the link **Expect:** Toast "copied"; the link is never opened inside the till; if clipboard is denied a toast says copy failed `OP.MARKETING.CONTENT_SHEET.07`

#### OP.MARKETING.T04 · P1 · Campaign table and status moves: main flow

- [ ] Look at the Sent column for a campaign never sent **Expect:** It says Not sent, not 0; a campaign with failed sends shows the failed line in red `OP.MARKETING.CAMPAIGN_TABLE.04`

### OP.PLAN: Content plan

Marketing writes the month's content ideas on a calendar and sends the plan; the owner approves it (leaving some ideas out) or asks for changes; approved ideas then get results sent as posts.

**Route:** `/plan` · **Roles:** marketing, owner

**Source:** `apps/operator/src/routes/plan.tsx`, `apps/operator/src/features/plan/PlanPage.tsx`, `apps/operator/src/features/plan/PlanCalendar.tsx`, `apps/operator/src/features/plan/IdeaParts.tsx`, `apps/operator/src/features/plan/PlanSummary.tsx`, `apps/operator/src/features/plan/planLogic.ts`, `apps/operator/src/features/plan/search.ts`, `apps/operator/src/features/plan/api.ts`

**Components:** Plan status bar (send / take back) · Month calendar · Day panel · Idea form · Idea row and its actions · Owner's decision panel · List view, stage counts and legend · Send result for an idea · Plan badges (planToDo / planWaiting)

#### OP.PLAN.T01 · P1 · Content plan: main checks

- [ ] Sign in as marketing **Expect:** The app opens on /plan (marketing home) in Calendar view on the current business month `OP.PLAN.01`
- [ ] Sign in as owner and open Content plan from the Marketing tabs with no month in the URL while September is waiting **Expect:** The page jumps (replace) to ?month=2026-09 and opens in List view with the decision panel `OP.PLAN.02`
- [ ] P2 · Open /plan?month=2026-13, ?day=2026-02-30, ?view=grid **Expect:** Bad values are dropped and the plain page opens (current month, calendar for marketing) `OP.PLAN.06`
- [ ] P2 · Open /plan?month=2026-11&day=2026-12-05 **Expect:** The day is dropped because it is outside the month shown `OP.PLAN.07`
- [ ] P2 · Open /plan?day=2026-12-05 with no month while it is October **Expect:** Expected: the day is ignored or the December month opens. Note: the validator keeps the day when month is absent, so the October calendar shows with a December 5 day panel and Add idea there writes into December; record the result `OP.PLAN.08`
- [ ] P2 · Use the month stepper prev/next (plan.month.prev, plan.month.next) and This month **Expect:** The month label (plan.month) changes, URL ?month=YYYY-MM updates, This month only shows when away from the current month `OP.PLAN.09`

### OP.FINANCIAL: Financial home

Owner landing of Management's Financial section: refunds needing attention, this month's revenue and takings, the safe and last closed days, and what is coming due (wages, coach pay).

**Route:** `/financial` · **Roles:** owner

**Source:** `apps/operator/src/routes/financial.tsx`, `apps/operator/src/features/financial/FinancialHome.tsx`

**Components:** Needs you (online deposit refunds) · This month so far · The cash · Coming due

#### OP.FINANCIAL.T01 · P0 · Financial home: money and totals

- [ ] **Needs you (online deposit refunds)** Create a deposit refund that failed (see deposits slice) and open /financial. **Expect:** The panel appears first, above This month so far, listing the refund with Retry and Settled another way. `OP.FINANCIAL.DEPOSIT_ATTENTION.02`
- [ ] **This month so far** Open /financial and /panel side by side for the same month. **Expect:** Revenue, Cash and Card figures here equal the /panel headline figures exactly (both read panel_headline). `OP.FINANCIAL.MONTH_SO_FAR.01`
- [ ] **The cash** Compare the In safe figure (data-testid financial.safe.status) with the balance on /safe. **Expect:** They are identical (same SK.overview(null) key). `OP.FINANCIAL.THE_CASH.01`
- [ ] **The cash** Mark a wage paid from the Safe on /wages, then come back to /financial. **Expect:** In safe has dropped by exactly the amount paid (MarkPaidDialog invalidates ['main-cash']). `OP.FINANCIAL.THE_CASH.02`
- [ ] **The cash** Check a closed day with counted less than expected by 15,000 IQD. **Expect:** Row shows expected and counted amounts and the short variance in red words naming 15,000 IQD; an exact day reads green; an over day amber; a day without a count reads Not counted. `OP.FINANCIAL.THE_CASH.06`
- [ ] **Coming due** P1 · With coach settlement on, view the coach pay line. **Expect:** Shows 'to approve N · to pay M' (data-testid financial.coachPay.status) matching /reports/coaches; its Open link goes there. `OP.FINANCIAL.COMING_DUE.03`

#### OP.FINANCIAL.T02 · P1 · Financial home: other parts

- [ ] **Whole page** Sign in as owner and open /financial (from a Financial link or by typing the route). **Expect:** Page header 'Financial' style title shows with the sections This month so far, The cash, and Coming due; no console errors. `OP.FINANCIAL.01`
- [ ] **Whole page** P2 · Look for /financial in the rail as owner. **Expect:** The Overview item for /financial is hidden in the rail (hidden: true) but the page still opens from links; the rail highlights the Financial section. `OP.FINANCIAL.04`
- [ ] **This month so far** Check the labels under Earned and Taken. **Expect:** Earned shows Revenue (large); Taken shows Cash and Card, each with the hint text explaining earned vs taken. `OP.FINANCIAL.MONTH_SO_FAR.02`
- [ ] **This month so far** P2 · Press Open panel. **Expect:** Navigates to /panel. `OP.FINANCIAL.MONTH_SO_FAR.07`
- [ ] **The cash** P2 · Press Open safe and the day-close link. **Expect:** Open safe goes to /safe; the panel action goes to /admin/day-close. `OP.FINANCIAL.THE_CASH.08`
- [ ] **Coming due** As owner with 2 wages due, view Coming due. **Expect:** Wages due line shows 2, equal to the Pay rail badge and the Due now list on /wages; Open Wages goes to /wages. `OP.FINANCIAL.COMING_DUE.01`

#### OP.FINANCIAL.T03 · P1 · Financial home: Flaky or slow network, backend down

*Setup:* `SLOW_NETWORK` (Slow network), `BACKEND_DOWN` (Server unreachable while the LAN is up)

- [ ] **This month so far** `SLOW_NETWORK` P2 · Throttle the network so panel_headline takes 20 s. **Expect:** Skeleton lines show while waiting; the call is allowed 60 s (report_ / panel_ prefix) and then renders the figures, not a timeout. `OP.FINANCIAL.MONTH_SO_FAR.04`
- [ ] **The cash** `BACKEND_DOWN` Make the safe read fail (block main_cash_overview). **Expect:** In safe shows an em dash, not 0 IQD; the rest of the panel still renders. `OP.FINANCIAL.THE_CASH.03`

*Setup:* `EMPTY_DATA` (Nothing recorded yet)

- [ ] **Coming due** P2 · With no wages due, view. **Expect:** Wages line shows 0 (zero is said as zero), not hidden. `OP.FINANCIAL.COMING_DUE.02`

- [ ] `DARK_MODE` P2 · Switch to dark mode, then blue mode, and view the page. **Expect:** All text, borders and variance colours (exact green, short red, over amber) stay readable with enough contrast in both modes. `OP.FINANCIAL.08`

- [ ] **Needs you (online deposit refunds)** `FEATURE_FLAG_OFF` P2 · With online deposits off and no refund waiting, open /financial. **Expect:** No Needs you panel is rendered at the top. `OP.FINANCIAL.DEPOSIT_ATTENTION.01`
- [ ] **Coming due** `FEATURE_FLAG_OFF` P2 · With coach settlement capability off, view. **Expect:** No coach pay line is shown; wages line remains. `OP.FINANCIAL.COMING_DUE.04`
- [ ] **This month so far** `OFFLINE_THEN_RECONNECT` P1 · Block the panel_headline call (offline) and view. **Expect:** Error state with Retry inside the panel; pressing Retry after reconnecting loads the figures. `OP.FINANCIAL.MONTH_SO_FAR.05`

### OP.WAGES: Wages

Owner-only payroll: each person's salary and pay day, deductions, lateness, reward bonuses, advances, net and pay status per business month, with Mark paid, Undo, Give advance, Set salary and Deduct.

**Route:** `/wages` · **Roles:** owner

**Source:** `apps/operator/src/routes/wages.tsx`, `apps/operator/src/features/wages/WagesPage.tsx`, `apps/operator/src/features/wages/wagesLogic.ts`, `apps/operator/src/features/wages/api.ts`, `apps/operator/src/lib/workspaces.ts`, `apps/operator/src/lib/navBadges.ts`

**Components:** Due now strip · Wages due card (management panel) · Reminder days setting · Deductions to approve · No salary yet · Month totals · People table · Person details · Set salary dialog · Mark paid dialog · Undo payment dialog · Give advance wizard · Take back advance dialog · Pay rail badge wagesDue

#### OP.WAGES.T01 · P0 · Wages: main checks

- [ ] Sign in as owner and open /wages from the rail (Financial > Pay > Wages). **Expect:** Title Wages with lead text, header buttons Late and early (wages.link.attendance) and All deductions (wages.link.deductions), month heading for the current business month, totals and the people table. `OP.WAGES.01`
- [ ] P1 · Check the Wages tab badge in the Pay rail as owner with 3 wages due. **Expect:** Badge reads 3 and equals the number of rows in Due now and the Wages due card on the panel (QK.wagesDue shared). `OP.WAGES.05`
- [ ] P1 · Press the previous-month arrow (wages.month.prev) twice, then This month. **Expect:** Heading steps back two months showing that month's figures; a This month button appears and returns to the current business month. `OP.WAGES.06`
- [ ] P1 · From the current month press next (wages.month.next) repeatedly. **Expect:** Steps to next month only once, then the next button is disabled (canStepWageForward: at most one month ahead). `OP.WAGES.07`
- [ ] P2 · Reload the page and watch it load. **Expect:** Month heading shows Loading, table shows a skeleton, then data; no flash of empty state. `OP.WAGES.08`

- [ ] Press Save. **Expect:** Toast 'Reminder saved.'; Save disappears; Due now and the badge refetch and now include wages due within 7 days. `OP.WAGES.REMIND_CONTROL.02`
- [ ] P2 · Try to set the counter above 14 or below 0. **Expect:** Counter stops at 14 and 0 (CountInput min 0 max 14). `OP.WAGES.REMIND_CONTROL.03`

- [ ] Press Set salary from the panel and save 600,000 IQD on day 25. **Expect:** Person leaves the panel; row shows 600,000 IQD, Day 25. `OP.WAGES.UNSET_PANEL.02`
- [ ] P2 · Have someone who left the branch with no salary. **Expect:** They are not listed in No salary yet (member false is excluded). `OP.WAGES.UNSET_PANEL.03`

- [ ] Set a person's salary to 0 and view their row. **Expect:** Status 'Not paid here'; no Mark paid unless a reward bonus is carried. `OP.WAGES.MONTH_TABLE.05`

- [ ] P2 · Press Details (wages.row.details.<id>) then Hide details. **Expect:** Details panel opens under the table for that person (row highlighted, aria-expanded true); pressing again closes it. `OP.WAGES.MONTH_TABLE.13`

### OP.DEDUCTIONS: Pay deductions

Managers propose pay deductions; only the owner approves, declines or cancels them (never their own proposal). Tabs Waiting, Month and All.

**Route:** `/deductions` · **Roles:** manager, owner

**Source:** `apps/operator/src/routes/deductions.tsx`, `apps/operator/src/features/deductions/DeductionsPage.tsx`, `apps/operator/src/features/deductions/deductionsLogic.ts`, `apps/operator/src/features/deductions/api.ts`, `apps/operator/src/features/deductions/peopleRecordCounts.ts`

**Components:** Propose / deduct form · Waiting tab · Approve / decline dialog · Withdraw proposal confirm · All tab · Month tab · Cancel deduction dialog · Deductions to decide row (/ops, Observe)

#### OP.DEDUCTIONS.T01 · P0 · Pay deductions: main checks

- [ ] P1 · Open /deductions as owner. **Expect:** Title 'Pay deductions', lead text, button 'Deduct from a wage' (deductions.propose), tabs Waiting, Month, All; Waiting selected. `OP.DEDUCTIONS.01`
- [ ] Open /deductions as manager. **Expect:** Same page; button reads 'Propose a deduction'; Waiting rows show no Approve/Decline. `OP.DEDUCTIONS.02`
- [ ] P1 · As owner with 2 waiting proposals, check the Pay > Deductions rail badge and tab label. **Expect:** Badge reads 2 and the tab reads 'Waiting (2)'. `OP.DEDUCTIONS.06`
- [ ] Check that a deduction against the viewer never shows. **Expect:** A manager with a deduction against themselves does not see it in Waiting, Month or All (server excludes rows against the caller). `OP.DEDUCTIONS.08`

#### OP.DEDUCTIONS.T02 · P0 · Propose / deduct form: main flow

- [ ] P1 · As manager press Propose a deduction and submit empty. **Expect:** Errors: person 'Fill this in.', amount 'Enter an amount from 1 IQD to 2,000,000 IQD.', reason 'Fill this in.'; date defaults to today. `OP.DEDUCTIONS.PROPOSE_FORM.01`
- [ ] Open the person list. **Expect:** Lists active non-owner staff at the branch except the proposer, 'Name · Role'; the owner is never listed. `OP.DEDUCTIONS.PROPOSE_FORM.02`
- [ ] P1 · Type 2,000,001 in Amount. **Expect:** Keystroke refused; amount stays 200,000 or last accepted value. `OP.DEDUCTIONS.PROPOSE_FORM.04`
- [ ] P1 · Pick a date 61 days ago or tomorrow. **Expect:** Date picker bounds stop it; if forced, 'Pick a day within the last 60 days.' `OP.DEDUCTIONS.PROPOSE_FORM.05`
- [ ] P2 · Paste a 501-character reason. **Expect:** Textarea stops at 500. `OP.DEDUCTIONS.PROPOSE_FORM.07`
- [ ] P1 · Submit a valid manager proposal of 25,000 IQD. **Expect:** Toast 'Sent to the owner for approval.'; form closes; it shows in Waiting with 'You proposed this. The owner decides it.' and Withdraw. `OP.DEDUCTIONS.PROPOSE_FORM.08`

#### OP.DEDUCTIONS.T03 · P1 · Approve / decline dialog: main flow

- [ ] Press Approve on 25,000 for Ali. **Expect:** Title 'Approve this deduction?', body '25,000 IQD off Ali's pay. It comes off their next unpaid wage, and Ali is told.', the reason quoted, optional Note. `OP.DEDUCTIONS.DECIDE_DIALOG.01`
- [ ] Decline with no reason. **Expect:** Allowed; toast 'Deduction declined.'; the person is never told; wage unchanged. `OP.DEDUCTIONS.DECIDE_DIALOG.03`
- [ ] P2 · Paste 1,001 characters in Note. **Expect:** Stops at 1,000. `OP.DEDUCTIONS.DECIDE_DIALOG.04`

#### OP.DEDUCTIONS.T04 · P2 · Month tab: main flow

- [ ] Press next arrow (deductions.month.next) in the current month. **Expect:** Disabled: the stepper never passes the current month. `OP.DEDUCTIONS.MONTH_VIEW.02`
- [ ] Step back with deductions.month.prev and press This month. **Expect:** Previous month figures shown, no waiting line; This month returns. `OP.DEDUCTIONS.MONTH_VIEW.03`
- [ ] A person who left the team has deductions this month. **Expect:** Row shows 'Left the team' badge. `OP.DEDUCTIONS.MONTH_VIEW.09`

#### OP.DEDUCTIONS.T05 · P0 · Pay deductions: money and totals

- [ ] **Propose / deduct form** As owner submit 'Deduct from wage' for 25,000. **Expect:** Toast 'Deduction recorded.'; recorded approved at once; /wages for that person shows Deductions +25,000 and Net -25,000 in the first unpaid month. `OP.DEDUCTIONS.PROPOSE_FORM.09`
- [ ] **Approve / decline dialog** Confirm Approve deduction. **Expect:** Toast 'Deduction approved.'; Waiting list and /wages refresh (refreshAfterWrite); badge drops by 1. `OP.DEDUCTIONS.DECIDE_DIALOG.02`
- [ ] **Month tab** Open Month. **Expect:** Heading current business month; 'Approved (n)' total equals the sum of approved amounts in the rows; 'Waiting for the owner (n)' shown in amber in the current month only. `OP.DEDUCTIONS.MONTH_VIEW.01`
- [ ] **Month tab** Expand a person row (deductions.person.<id>). **Expect:** Items show amount, date, 'Happened in <month>' when earlier, reason, 'Proposed by', 'Approved by <name>, <time>', status badge; cancelled items struck through and excluded from totals. `OP.DEDUCTIONS.MONTH_VIEW.04`
- [ ] **Cancel deduction dialog** Cancel a 25,000 approved deduction with a reason. **Expect:** Toast 'Deduction cancelled.'; it stays listed as cancelled, leaves every total; /wages net for that person rises by 25,000. `OP.DEDUCTIONS.CANCEL_DIALOG.02`

#### OP.DEDUCTIONS.T06 · P1 · Pay deductions: other parts

- [ ] **Waiting tab** As owner view a manager's waiting proposal. **Expect:** Row: person and role, amount, date with 'Counts in <month>', reason, proposer and time, Approve (deductions.approve.<id>) and Decline (deductions.decline.<id>). `OP.DEDUCTIONS.WAITING_LIST.01`
- [ ] **Waiting tab** As a manager, view a proposal you sent yourself. **Expect:** 'You proposed this. The owner decides it.' and Withdraw (deductions.withdraw.<id>). `OP.DEDUCTIONS.WAITING_LIST.03`
- [ ] **Withdraw proposal confirm** Press Withdraw and confirm 'Withdraw proposal'. **Expect:** Toast 'Proposal withdrawn.'; row leaves Waiting; in All it shows status withdrawn (neutral). `OP.DEDUCTIONS.WITHDRAW_CONFIRM.01`
- [ ] **Withdraw proposal confirm** P2 · Press Keep it after a failed withdraw. **Expect:** Dialog closes and the error is cleared (withdraw.reset). `OP.DEDUCTIONS.WITHDRAW_CONFIRM.03`
- [ ] **All tab** Open All. **Expect:** Extra Status column: badge plus '<decider>, <time>', 'Note: ...', 'Cancelled by ...', 'Reason: ...' as applicable. `OP.DEDUCTIONS.ALL_LIST.01`
- [ ] **All tab** As owner find an approved deduction whose month is unpaid. **Expect:** Cancel deduction (deductions.cancel.<id>) shown. `OP.DEDUCTIONS.ALL_LIST.02`
- [ ] **Cancel deduction dialog** Press Cancel deduction and confirm with empty reason. **Expect:** REASON_REQUIRED error; nothing sent. `OP.DEDUCTIONS.CANCEL_DIALOG.01`
- [ ] **Deductions to decide row (/ops, Observe)** As owner with 2 decidable proposals, open Today (/ops). **Expect:** A 'Deductions to decide' row shows 2, equal to the rail badge; its action opens /deductions. `OP.DEDUCTIONS.PEOPLE_RECORD_COUNTS.01`

#### OP.DEDUCTIONS.T07 · P0 · Pay deductions: Who can and cannot use it

*Setup:* `WRONG_ROLE` (Signed in with a role that may not use this), `SECOND_JOB` (Person holds a second job (0345)), `STAFF_ACCESS_BLOCKED` (Owner blocked a page for this person (0345))

- [ ] `WRONG_ROLE` P1 · As a manager with their own proposal waiting, check the badge. **Expect:** No deductionsWaiting badge for the manager (decideDeductions is owner only); the Waiting tab shows no count for what they cannot decide. `OP.DEDUCTIONS.07`
- [ ] **Waiting tab** `WRONG_ROLE` As manager view another head's waiting proposal. **Expect:** Muted 'Waiting for the owner' (deductions.awaiting.<id>), no buttons. `OP.DEDUCTIONS.WAITING_LIST.02`
- [ ] **Approve / decline dialog** `WRONG_ROLE` As owner, look for Approve on any row the owner proposed or that is against the owner, then call decide_deduction on such a row directly (devtools). **Expect:** Owner never sees Approve on a row they proposed (can_decide false); a direct call returns CANNOT_DECIDE_OWN. `OP.DEDUCTIONS.DECIDE_DIALOG.06`
- [ ] **All tab** `WRONG_ROLE` As manager view All. **Expect:** No Cancel buttons anywhere. `OP.DEDUCTIONS.ALL_LIST.04`
- [ ] **Deductions to decide row (/ops, Observe)** `WRONG_ROLE` P2 · As manager open Today. **Expect:** No deductions count (decideDeductions false), even if another screen cached the key. `OP.DEDUCTIONS.PEOPLE_RECORD_COUNTS.02`

#### OP.DEDUCTIONS.T08 · P1 · Pay deductions: With no internet

- [ ] **Propose / deduct form** Go offline and submit. **Expect:** Connection error under the form; values kept; nothing created. `OP.DEDUCTIONS.PROPOSE_FORM.13`
- [ ] **Approve / decline dialog** Go offline and confirm. **Expect:** Connection error in dialog; still waiting after reconnect. `OP.DEDUCTIONS.DECIDE_DIALOG.07`
- [ ] **Cancel deduction dialog** Go offline and confirm. **Expect:** Connection error; deduction still approved after reconnect. `OP.DEDUCTIONS.CANCEL_DIALOG.04`

*Setup:* `MONTH_PAID` (Pay month already marked paid (frozen))

- [ ] **All tab** As owner find an approved deduction whose month is paid. **Expect:** No Cancel button. `OP.DEDUCTIONS.ALL_LIST.03`

- [ ] **Waiting tab** With nothing waiting, view the tab. **Expect:** Empty 'Nothing waiting' with the explanatory body. `OP.DEDUCTIONS.WAITING_LIST.05`
- [ ] **All tab** Empty branch. **Expect:** 'No deductions yet' empty state. `OP.DEDUCTIONS.ALL_LIST.05`

#### OP.DEDUCTIONS.T11 · P0 · Pay deductions: Two people at once

*Setup:* `CONCURRENT_EDIT` (Two people change the same thing)

- [ ] **Propose / deduct form** P2 · Deactivate the chosen person on another PC and submit. **Expect:** FORBIDDEN hint staff_id: person field shows 'You cannot propose a deduction for this person. Choose someone from the list.' `OP.DEDUCTIONS.PROPOSE_FORM.14`
- [ ] **Approve / decline dialog** Manager withdraws while owner has the dialog open; owner confirms. **Expect:** SUBMISSION_DECIDED message stays in the dialog; list refreshes and the row is gone; no wage change. `OP.DEDUCTIONS.DECIDE_DIALOG.05`
- [ ] **Withdraw proposal confirm** Owner approves while the manager's withdraw confirm is open; manager confirms. **Expect:** Error (SUBMISSION_DECIDED or INVALID_TRANSITION) shown inside the confirm; list refreshes to show it approved. `OP.DEDUCTIONS.WITHDRAW_CONFIRM.02`
- [ ] **Cancel deduction dialog** Mark the wage paid on another PC, then confirm the cancel. **Expect:** WAGE_ALREADY_PAID message stays; list refreshes and the Cancel button disappears. `OP.DEDUCTIONS.CANCEL_DIALOG.03`

#### OP.DEDUCTIONS.T12 · P1 · Pay deductions: Around midnight and the business-day boundary

*Setup:* `TIMEZONE_EDGE` (Midnight / business-day boundary (Asia/Baghdad))

- [ ] **Propose / deduct form** At 02:00 Baghdad with business-day start 06:00, open the form. **Expect:** Date defaults to yesterday's date (the business day), and today's calendar date is not selectable as 'today'. `OP.DEDUCTIONS.PROPOSE_FORM.06`
- [ ] **Waiting tab** P2 · View a deduction dated in a previous month. **Expect:** Amber clock line 'Happened earlier, counts in <month>'. `OP.DEDUCTIONS.WAITING_LIST.04`
- [ ] **Month tab** At 00:30 on the 1st (before the business-day start hour) open Month. **Expect:** Heading still names the previous month (server's business month). `OP.DEDUCTIONS.MONTH_VIEW.07`

#### OP.DEDUCTIONS.T13 · P0 · Pay deductions: ge

*Setup:* `SECOND_BRANCH` (Two branches), `ARABIC_RTL` (Arabic, right to left), `DARK_MODE` (Dark / blue display mode), `LOST_RESPONSE` (Write committed but its answer was lost), `LARGE_DATA` (Large data volume), `BACKEND_DOWN` (Server unreachable while the LAN is up)

- [ ] `SECOND_BRANCH` P1 · Switch branch on the rail. **Expect:** Lists and month totals change to the new branch; open propose form is discarded. `OP.DEDUCTIONS.09`
- [ ] `ARABIC_RTL` P1 · Switch to Arabic. **Expect:** All text Arabic, tabs mirror, Arabic reasons readable (dir auto), amounts 'n د.ع.'. `OP.DEDUCTIONS.10`
- [ ] `DARK_MODE` P2 · View in dark and blue mode. **Expect:** Status badges (waiting amber, approved green, declined red) and the amber 'earlier month' line are legible. `OP.DEDUCTIONS.12`
- [ ] **Propose / deduct form** `LOST_RESPONSE` Throttle so submit times out after the server saved it; press submit again without editing. **Expect:** Same idempotency key is reused: only one deduction is created. `OP.DEDUCTIONS.PROPOSE_FORM.11`
- [ ] **Propose / deduct form** `LOST_RESPONSE` P1 · After a timeout, change the amount and submit again. **Expect:** A new key is minted on edit: a second, separate proposal with the new amount is created; verify the first one too and withdraw/cancel the unwanted one. `OP.DEDUCTIONS.PROPOSE_FORM.12`
- [ ] **Waiting tab** `LARGE_DATA` P2 · Seed 120 waiting proposals. **Expect:** First page shows 50 rows with Pagination (3 pages); page 2 loads its own 50; badge still counts decidable ones from page 1 (may overstate per comment). `OP.DEDUCTIONS.WAITING_LIST.06`
- [ ] **Waiting tab** `BACKEND_DOWN` P2 · Block deductions_page and reload. **Expect:** Error state with Retry. `OP.DEDUCTIONS.WAITING_LIST.07`
- [ ] **Month tab** `BACKEND_DOWN` P2 · Block deductions_month. **Expect:** Alert with error text and Retry button; skeleton while loading. `OP.DEDUCTIONS.MONTH_VIEW.08`

### OP.REWARDS: Rewards

Owner sets standing rewards per waiter, cashier or manager: reach N orders placed in a business month to earn a bonus (added to next month's wage) and/or a prize.

**Route:** `/rewards` · **Roles:** owner

**Source:** `apps/operator/src/routes/rewards.tsx`, `apps/operator/src/features/rewards/RewardsPage.tsx`, `apps/operator/src/features/rewards/rewardsLogic.ts`, `apps/operator/src/features/rewards/api.ts`, `packages/db/supabase/migrations/20261010000333_reward_wages.sql`

**Components:** Rewards board · Add reward form · Remove reward · Unlock push and wage bonus

#### OP.REWARDS.T01 · P1 · Rewards board: main flow

- [ ] View a person with rewards at 200 and 100. **Expect:** Listed At 100 then At 200; each with bonus amount and/or prize and '<n> orders to go' or a green Reached badge. `OP.REWARDS.BOARD.02`
- [ ] P2 · Check board order. **Expect:** Rows ordered by name (never by count): no ranking. `OP.REWARDS.BOARD.03`
- [ ] Check who is listed. **Expect:** Only waiters, cashiers and managers active at the branch; never the owner, chefs or baristas. `OP.REWARDS.BOARD.04`

#### OP.REWARDS.T02 · P1 · Add reward form: main flow

- [ ] Press Add reward (rewards.row.add.<id>) and save empty. **Expect:** Target error 'Enter a number of orders from 1 to 100,000.' and 'Enter a bonus, a prize, or both.' `OP.REWARDS.ADD_FORM.01`
- [ ] P2 · Type 999999 into Orders in a month. **Expect:** Box keeps 6 digits; save shows the target error (over 100,000). `OP.REWARDS.ADD_FORM.02`
- [ ] P2 · Type a bonus above 10,000,000. **Expect:** Keystroke refused by MoneyInput. `OP.REWARDS.ADD_FORM.04`
- [ ] Save target 300, bonus empty, prize 'Dinner for two'. **Expect:** Saved as prize-only; row shows the prize with no amount. `OP.REWARDS.ADD_FORM.06`
- [ ] P2 · Save bonus 0 and empty prize. **Expect:** 'Enter a bonus, a prize, or both.' `OP.REWARDS.ADD_FORM.07`
- [ ] Add a second reward at an existing target. **Expect:** REWARD_TARGET_TAKEN: 'This person already has a reward at that target.'; board refreshes. `OP.REWARDS.ADD_FORM.08`
- [ ] P2 · Give a person 5 rewards. **Expect:** Add reward is replaced by 'Up to 5 rewards each: remove one to add another.'; a 6th via another PC returns REWARD_LIMIT. `OP.REWARDS.ADD_FORM.09`

#### OP.REWARDS.T03 · P0 · Rewards: money and totals

- [ ] **Rewards board** Have a waiter place 12 orders this month (1 voided) and view the board. **Expect:** This month shows '11 orders' (voided excluded); Last month shows last month's count. `OP.REWARDS.BOARD.01`
- [ ] **Add reward form** P1 · Save target 200, bonus 50,000. **Expect:** Toast 'Reward saved.'; form closes; the reward shows on the row. `OP.REWARDS.ADD_FORM.05`
- [ ] **Remove reward** P1 · Press Remove (rewards.reward.remove.<id>). **Expect:** Confirm 'Remove this reward?' explaining '... This month still counts: if they reach it by the end of the month, it is still earned.' `OP.REWARDS.REMOVE.01`
- [ ] **Unlock push and wage bonus** P1 · Void an order after the month closed. **Expect:** Earned bonus is unchanged (frozen once written). `OP.REWARDS.WAGE_LINK_AND_PUSH.04`

#### OP.REWARDS.T04 · P1 · Rewards: other parts

- [ ] **Whole page** Open /rewards as owner. **Expect:** Title 'Rewards', lead, Wages link (rewards.link.wages), current business month heading with 'N days left' (rewards.daysLeft), and the board. `OP.REWARDS.01`
- [ ] **Remove reward** Confirm Remove reward. **Expect:** Toast 'Reward removed.'; row loses it; Add reward available again if at limit. `OP.REWARDS.REMOVE.02`
- [ ] **Unlock push and wage bonus** Have a waiter cross a 10-order target. **Expect:** Within about 5 minutes the waiter's phone gets one reward_unlocked push (route staff-rewards) with no amount, prize or name; nobody else is notified. `OP.REWARDS.WAGE_LINK_AND_PUSH.01`
- [ ] **Unlock push and wage bonus** P2 · Cross the same target again later in the month, or remove and re-add it. **Expect:** No second push for that person, target and month. `OP.REWARDS.WAGE_LINK_AND_PUSH.02`

#### OP.REWARDS.T05 · P2 · Rewards: Two people at once

*Setup:* `CONCURRENT_EDIT` (Two people change the same thing)

- [ ] **Rewards board** Place an order on another station while the board is open. **Expect:** Count updates within about 60 s (refetchInterval). `OP.REWARDS.BOARD.07`
- [ ] **Add reward form** Open the form, deactivate the person elsewhere, save. **Expect:** REWARD_STAFF_INVALID message; board refreshes without them. `OP.REWARDS.ADD_FORM.10`
- [ ] **Remove reward** Remove the same reward from two PCs. **Expect:** Second gets REF_NOT_FOUND shown above the table; board refreshes. `OP.REWARDS.REMOVE.03`

#### OP.REWARDS.T06 · P0 · Rewards: Around midnight and the business-day boundary

*Setup:* `TIMEZONE_EDGE` (Midnight / business-day boundary (Asia/Baghdad))

- [ ] P2 · On the last day of the business month view the heading. **Expect:** Reads 'last day' (count 0 or 1). `OP.REWARDS.03`
- [ ] **Remove reward** Remove a reward already reached this month, then let the month end. **Expect:** The bonus is still earned and lands in the next wage month. `OP.REWARDS.REMOVE.04`
- [ ] **Unlock push and wage bonus** Let the business month end and the new month's first business day pass. **Expect:** The bonus appears in /wages Bonuses for the next unpaid month and in the Mark paid dialog; net includes it. `OP.REWARDS.WAGE_LINK_AND_PUSH.03`

#### OP.REWARDS.T07 · P0 · Rewards: ge

*Setup:* `WRONG_ROLE` (Signed in with a role that may not use this), `SECOND_BRANCH` (Two branches), `ARABIC_RTL` (Arabic, right to left), `OFFLINE` (No internet), `DARK_MODE` (Dark / blue display mode), `EMPTY_DATA` (Nothing recorded yet), `LARGE_DATA` (Large data volume), `LOST_RESPONSE` (Write committed but its answer was lost), `PUSH_DENIED` (Notifications denied on the staff phone)

- [ ] `WRONG_ROLE` Open /rewards as manager and as waiter. **Expect:** Refusal card naming owner; no counts or bonuses visible. `OP.REWARDS.02`
- [ ] `SECOND_BRANCH` P1 · Switch branch in the rail. **Expect:** Board shows the new branch's waiters, cashiers and managers; a reward added now is created at that branch (p_venue_id = currentBranchId). `OP.REWARDS.04`
- [ ] `ARABIC_RTL` P2 · Arabic UI. **Expect:** Order counts read 'N طلب' style plurals correctly, names in bdi, amounts 'د.ع.'. `OP.REWARDS.05`
- [ ] **Add reward form** `ARABIC_RTL` P1 · Type the target with an Arabic keyboard (١٠٠). **Expect:** Expected: 100. Per code the target box strips non-ASCII digits (replace(/\D/g,'')) instead of using digitsOnly, so it stays empty: report if so. `OP.REWARDS.ADD_FORM.03`
- [ ] `OFFLINE` P2 · Reopen offline. **Expect:** Error state with Retry; heading shows 'Rewards' title instead of Loading. `OP.REWARDS.06`
- [ ] **Add reward form** `OFFLINE` P2 · Go offline and save. **Expect:** Connection error in the form; nothing saved. `OP.REWARDS.ADD_FORM.12`
- [ ] `DARK_MODE` P2 · Dark and blue mode. **Expect:** Reached badge green and muted text legible. `OP.REWARDS.07`
- [ ] **Rewards board** `EMPTY_DATA` P2 · Branch with no eligible staff. **Expect:** Empty 'Nobody to reward at this branch'. `OP.REWARDS.BOARD.05`
- [ ] **Rewards board** `LARGE_DATA` P2 · With 40 eligible staff. **Expect:** 3 rows then View more. `OP.REWARDS.BOARD.06`
- [ ] **Add reward form** `LOST_RESPONSE` P1 · Time out the save after the server recorded it and press save again. **Expect:** No idempotency key on set_staff_reward: the retry gets REWARD_TARGET_TAKEN and no duplicate is created; refreshing shows one reward. `OP.REWARDS.ADD_FORM.11`
- [ ] **Unlock push and wage bonus** `PUSH_DENIED` P2 · Deny notifications on the waiter's phone. **Expect:** No push arrives, but the reward and bonus still record. `OP.REWARDS.WAGE_LINK_AND_PUSH.05`

### OP.FILES: Files

Owner and managers keep documents per branch; every file is compressed in the browser (gzip or WebP) before upload, its text is extracted for the owner assistant; owner can mark files owner-only.

**Route:** `/files` · **Roles:** manager, owner

**Source:** `apps/operator/src/routes/files.tsx`, `apps/operator/src/features/files/FilesPage.tsx`, `apps/operator/src/features/files/api.ts`, `apps/operator/src/features/files/filesLogic.ts`, `apps/operator/src/features/files/compress.ts`, `apps/operator/src/features/files/extract.ts`, `apps/operator/src/features/files/zip.ts`, `packages/db/supabase/migrations/20261020000354_venue_files.sql`

**Components:** Add files (drop area) · Text extraction for the assistant · Saved files list · Download · Edit in place · Remove file

#### OP.FILES.T01 · P0 · Add files (drop area): main flow

- [ ] P1 · Drop a 2 MB PDF on the drop area (files.drop). **Expect:** Line shows Packing…, Sending…, Saving…, then 'Saved as <size>, <n>% smaller. The assistant can read it.' and the file appears in the list. `OP.FILES.ADD_FILES.01`
- [ ] P1 · Press Choose files (files.pick) and pick 3 files. **Expect:** Three lines processed one after another; each ends done or failed independently. `OP.FILES.ADD_FILES.02`
- [ ] P2 · Focus the drop area with Tab and press Enter. **Expect:** File picker opens. `OP.FILES.ADD_FILES.03`
- [ ] P2 · Pick an empty (0 byte) file. **Expect:** Line fails with 'This file is empty.'; nothing sent. `OP.FILES.ADD_FILES.04`
- [ ] P2 · Upload a 4000 px JPEG photo. **Expect:** Stored as WebP at most 2560 px on the long side; list shows the smaller stored size; download is a .webp. `OP.FILES.ADD_FILES.07`
- [ ] P2 · Upload an animated GIF and a PNG that WebP would not shrink. **Expect:** Both stored gzip (GIF never redrawn); download returns the original bytes. `OP.FILES.ADD_FILES.08`
- [ ] As owner tick Only me (files.ownerOnly) and upload. **Expect:** File shows the lock badge 'Only the owner'; a manager never sees it; checkbox disabled while an upload runs. `OP.FILES.ADD_FILES.10`
- [ ] P2 · Drop a file before the list has loaded. **Expect:** Drop area is disabled (not-allowed cursor, dimmed); nothing starts. `OP.FILES.ADD_FILES.11`

#### OP.FILES.T02 · P1 · Text extraction for the assistant: main flow

- [ ] Upload a .docx, a .xlsx with two sheets and a .pptx. **Expect:** Each ends 'The assistant can read it.'; Assistant column 'Can read it'. `OP.FILES.TEXT_EXTRACTION.01`
- [ ] P2 · Upload a scanned PDF (images only) and a photo. **Expect:** Done line says 'The assistant sees its name only.'; Assistant column 'Name only'. `OP.FILES.TEXT_EXTRACTION.02`
- [ ] P2 · Upload a password-protected .docx or ZIP64 file. **Expect:** File stored without text (no error). `OP.FILES.TEXT_EXTRACTION.04`
- [ ] P2 · Look for an in-app PDF viewer. **Expect:** There is none: pdf.js is used only to extract text; PDFs are opened by Download. Note this if a viewer was expected. `OP.FILES.TEXT_EXTRACTION.06`

#### OP.FILES.T03 · P2 · Saved files list: main flow

- [ ] View the list with several files. **Expect:** Newest first; each row shows kind icon, name, note, added date and who, original size and 'stored <size>, <n>% smaller' or 'stored <size>'. `OP.FILES.FILE_TABLE.01`
- [ ] Search 'supplier price' and an uploader's name. **Expect:** Only files whose name, note or uploader contain every word show; case-insensitive. `OP.FILES.FILE_TABLE.02`
- [ ] Check the usage line. **Expect:** '<used> of 2 GB used' with a bar; bar turns red above 90%. `OP.FILES.FILE_TABLE.05`

#### OP.FILES.T04 · P1 · Edit in place: main flow

- [ ] P2 · Press Edit (files.edit.<id>), change name and note, Save (files.field.save). **Expect:** Toast 'File updated'; row shows the new name and note. `OP.FILES.EDIT_ROW.01`
- [ ] P2 · Clear the name. **Expect:** Save is disabled. `OP.FILES.EDIT_ROW.02`
- [ ] P2 · Type 201 characters in name and 501 in note. **Expect:** Inputs stop at 200 and 500. `OP.FILES.EDIT_ROW.03`
- [ ] As owner untick 'Only me' on an owner-only file. **Expect:** File becomes visible to managers after their list refreshes. `OP.FILES.EDIT_ROW.04`

#### OP.FILES.T05 · P0 · Files: other parts

- [ ] **Whole page** P1 · Open /files as owner and as manager. **Expect:** Title 'Files', lead, Add files panel with drop area, Saved files list with usage and search. `OP.FILES.01`
- [ ] **Download** Download a gzip-stored PDF (files.download.<id>) and compare its checksum to the original. **Expect:** Saved under the original name; bytes identical to the uploaded file. `OP.FILES.DOWNLOAD.01`
- [ ] **Download** P2 · Download a photo stored as WebP. **Expect:** Saved as '<name>.webp'. `OP.FILES.DOWNLOAD.02`
- [ ] **Remove file** P1 · As owner press the trash button (files.remove.<id>) and confirm Remove. **Expect:** Toast '<name> removed'; row gone; download no longer possible. `OP.FILES.REMOVE.01`
- [ ] **Remove file** P2 · As manager remove your own file. **Expect:** Removed. `OP.FILES.REMOVE.03`

#### OP.FILES.T06 · P0 · Files: Who can and cannot use it

*Setup:* `WRONG_ROLE` (Signed in with a role that may not use this), `STAFF_ACCESS_BLOCKED` (Owner blocked a page for this person (0345)), `SESSION_EXPIRED` (Staff session expired)

- [ ] `WRONG_ROLE` Open /files as marketing, waiter and cashier. **Expect:** Refusal card naming manager; venue_files_list returns FORBIDDEN. `OP.FILES.02`
- [ ] `WRONG_ROLE` As manager, look for owner-only files. **Expect:** Files the owner marked 'Only me' are absent from the list, search and usage-visible rows; the Only me checkbox is not shown to managers. `OP.FILES.03`
- [ ] `STAFF_ACCESS_BLOCKED` P1 · Block /files for a manager in Staff Access. **Expect:** Blocked message instead of the page. `OP.FILES.04`
- [ ] **Add files (drop area)** `SESSION_EXPIRED` P1 · Let the session expire, then drop a file. **Expect:** Begin is refused; the line shows the error; nothing stored. `OP.FILES.ADD_FILES.14`
- [ ] **Download** `WRONG_ROLE` As manager try to download an owner-only file by path (storage API). **Expect:** Refused by the storage read rule. `OP.FILES.DOWNLOAD.04`
- [ ] **Edit in place** `WRONG_ROLE` P1 · As manager edit a file. **Expect:** No Only me checkbox in the edit form. `OP.FILES.EDIT_ROW.05`
- [ ] **Remove file** `WRONG_ROLE` P1 · As manager hover the trash on a file another person added. **Expect:** Button disabled with reason 'Only the owner or the person who added this file can remove it.' `OP.FILES.REMOVE.02`

#### OP.FILES.T07 · P1 · Files: With no internet

*Setup:* `OFFLINE` (No internet)

- [ ] P2 · Reopen offline. **Expect:** List shows error with Retry; drop area disabled (not ready). `OP.FILES.07`
- [ ] **Add files (drop area)** Go offline mid-upload (during Sending). **Expect:** Line fails with an error; the unfinished row is ignored by the list; reconnecting and dropping again succeeds. `OP.FILES.ADD_FILES.12`
- [ ] **Download** P2 · Go offline and press Download. **Expect:** Error toast; button returns from busy. `OP.FILES.DOWNLOAD.03`
- [ ] **Remove file** P2 · Go offline and confirm Remove. **Expect:** Error toast; file still listed and downloadable. `OP.FILES.REMOVE.05`

#### OP.FILES.T08 · P1 · Files: With a lot of data

*Setup:* `LARGE_DATA` (Large data volume)

#### OP.FILES.T09 · P1 · Files: ge

*Setup:* `SECOND_BRANCH` (Two branches), `CONCURRENT_EDIT` (Two people change the same thing), `ARABIC_RTL` (Arabic, right to left), `DARK_MODE` (Dark / blue display mode), `APP_KILLED_MIDFLOW` (Station app closed or power cut mid-flow), `EMPTY_DATA` (Nothing recorded yet), `BACKEND_DOWN` (Server unreachable while the LAN is up)

- [ ] `CONCURRENT_EDIT` P2 · Upload a file on PC A; look at the list on PC B without reloading. **Expect:** List has no polling: B shows the file only after reload or refocus refetch. Note if this is acceptable. `OP.FILES.06`
- [ ] **Edit in place** `CONCURRENT_EDIT` P2 · Remove the file on another PC, then Save the edit. **Expect:** FILE_NOT_FOUND line in the form. `OP.FILES.EDIT_ROW.06`
- [ ] `ARABIC_RTL` Arabic UI. **Expect:** Labels Arabic, sizes '1.2 MB' formatted, file names in bdi, search works with Arabic letter forms (أ/إ/آ = ا, ى = ي, ة = ه). `OP.FILES.08`
- [ ] **Text extraction for the assistant** `ARABIC_RTL` P2 · Upload an Arabic Word document and ask the assistant about it (owner). **Expect:** Assistant can quote the Arabic text correctly. `OP.FILES.TEXT_EXTRACTION.05`
- [ ] `DARK_MODE` P2 · Dark and blue mode. **Expect:** Drop area dashed border, usage bar (red above 90%) and badges legible. `OP.FILES.09`
- [ ] **Add files (drop area)** `APP_KILLED_MIDFLOW` P2 · Quit the app during Sending and reopen. **Expect:** No half file in the list (uploading rows ignored, cleared at the next begin by the same person). `OP.FILES.ADD_FILES.13`
- [ ] **Saved files list** `EMPTY_DATA` P2 · Search a word with no match. **Expect:** Filtered empty state with Clear filters, which resets the search. `OP.FILES.FILE_TABLE.03`
- [ ] **Saved files list** `EMPTY_DATA` P2 · Branch with no files. **Expect:** 'No files yet' empty state. `OP.FILES.FILE_TABLE.04`
- [ ] **Remove file** `BACKEND_DOWN` P2 · Make venue_file_delete fail after storage removal (block the RPC). **Expect:** Error toast; the row remains but its download fails; removing it again finishes the job. `OP.FILES.REMOVE.04`

### OP.STOCK: Stock section (layout and rail)

The guarded layout for every /stock child and the Stock section of the management rail: On hand, Stock movement, Stock counting and Stock costs, each with its tab family. Managers and the owner run the cafe and bakery stores from here.

**Route:** `/stock` · **Roles:** manager, owner

**Source:** `apps/operator/src/routes/stock.tsx`, `apps/operator/src/routes/stock/_children.ts`, `apps/operator/src/lib/workspaces.ts`, `apps/operator/src/lib/navBadges.ts`, `apps/operator/src/lib/auth.tsx`

#### OP.STOCK.T01 · P1 · Stock section (layout and rail): main checks

- [ ] Sign in as manager and open the Stock section from the management rail **Expect:** Rail shows four rows: On hand, Stock movement, Stock counting, Stock costs; /stock opens On hand with tabs On hand, Alerts, Expiry, Stock value `OP.STOCK.01`
- [ ] Click each rail row and each tab under the page title in turn **Expect:** Stock movement shows Goods in, Move stock, Waste and production; Stock counting shows Stock count, Count differences; Stock costs shows Ingredients, Recipes, Margins; the active row and tab are highlighted `OP.STOCK.02`
- [ ] Sign in as owner and open /stock **Expect:** Same rail and pages as the manager; nothing hidden `OP.STOCK.03`
- [ ] P2 · Open /stock/does-not-exist **Expect:** A not-found state shows and the Stock rail section stays lit (On hand activePrefix claims /stock) `OP.STOCK.11`
- [ ] P2 · Click the Stock value tab under On hand **Expect:** Opens /reports/stock with the Stock rail still active `OP.STOCK.18`

#### OP.STOCK.T02 · P0 · Stock section (layout and rail): Who can and cannot use it

*Setup:* `WRONG_ROLE` (Signed in with a role that may not use this), `STAFF_ACCESS_BLOCKED` (Owner blocked a page for this person (0345))

- [ ] `WRONG_ROLE` Sign in as cashier and type /stock in the address bar (or deep link) **Expect:** RequireRole refuses: no stock data loads and the no-access screen shows instead of On hand `OP.STOCK.04`
- [ ] `WRONG_ROLE` Sign in as shop_staff and open /stock/receive, /stock/counts and /stock/waste by URL **Expect:** Each is refused (route roles manager+owner); the shop assistant keeps only /shop pages `OP.STOCK.05`
- [ ] `WRONG_ROLE` P1 · Sign in as head_barista and open /stock/ingredients by URL **Expect:** Refused; no ingredient costs are shown `OP.STOCK.06`
- [ ] `STAFF_ACCESS_BLOCKED` As owner, block the Stock area for a manager on the Staff Access list, then sign in as that manager and open /stock **Expect:** Stock rail section is gone and /stock is refused even though the role allows it `OP.STOCK.07`

#### OP.STOCK.T03 · P1 · Stock section (layout and rail): A phone count waits for a manager

*Setup:* `PHONE_COUNT_WAITING` (A phone count waits for a manager)

- [ ] Have a kitchen phone submit a bakery count, then look at the Stock counting rail row and the Stock count tab **Expect:** Both carry a badge with the number of phone counts waiting (stockCountsWaiting), refreshed within 60 s `OP.STOCK.08`
- [ ] P2 · Apply or discard the waiting phone count on /stock/counts **Expect:** The badge drops to 0 (or disappears) within 60 s without reloading `OP.STOCK.09`
- [ ] P2 · Have a phone count of the shop store waiting, then compare the Stock count badge with the list on /stock/counts **Expect:** Badge number matches the counts listed on the page (note: the badge counts every phone count, the cafe page lists only cafe and bakery stores; log a bug if they differ) `OP.STOCK.10`

#### OP.STOCK.T04 · P0 · Stock section (layout and rail): ge

*Setup:* `SLOW_NETWORK` (Slow network), `OFFLINE` (No internet), `SECOND_BRANCH` (Two branches), `ARABIC_RTL` (Arabic, right to left), `DARK_MODE` (Dark / blue display mode)

- [ ] `SLOW_NETWORK` P2 · Throttle the network and click a stock tab for the first time **Expect:** RoutePending skeleton shows while the lazy chunk loads, then the page renders `OP.STOCK.12`

### OP.STOCK_ONHAND: On hand

Stock landing page: what needs attention (out, low, expired, count needed, below par, expiring, phone counts, staff additions without cost, alerts) and the searchable on-hand table with each item history. The shop desk reuses it for shop stock.

**Route:** `/stock (also /shop/stock in shop scope)` · **Roles:** manager, owner, shop_staff (via /shop/stock)

**Source:** `apps/operator/src/features/stock/OnHand.tsx`, `apps/operator/src/features/stock/stockLogic.ts`, `apps/operator/src/features/stock/storeLogic.ts`, `apps/operator/src/features/stock/stockUi.tsx`, `apps/operator/src/features/stock/stockKeys.ts`, `apps/operator/src/features/shop/ShopStockPages.tsx`

**Components:** Needs attention list · On hand table · Store choice and split line · Header and subtitle · History drawer (LedgerDrawer)

#### OP.STOCK_ONHAND.T01 · P1 · Needs attention list: main flow

- [ ] Make one ingredient 0 on hand, one at or under its reorder point, one under par only **Expect:** Rows "Out of stock" 1, "Running low" 1, "Below par" 1: each ingredient counted once on its highest rung (stockLevel), never in two rows `OP.STOCK_ONHAND.ATTENTION.01`
- [ ] Click "Show which" on Out of stock **Expect:** Filter switches to Out, search and store reset, page scrolls to the table which lists only the empty shelves `OP.STOCK_ONHAND.ATTENTION.02`
- [ ] Sell an item past its recorded batches so on_hand differs from theoretical **Expect:** "Count needed" row appears with a count; Show which lists those rows `OP.STOCK_ONHAND.ATTENTION.03`
- [ ] Have an expired batch and one expiring within the venue window **Expect:** "Expired" and "Expiring soon" rows show counts from report_stock; their button opens /stock/expiry `OP.STOCK_ONHAND.ATTENTION.04`
- [ ] P2 · Have unread manager alerts **Expect:** "Alerts" row shows the unacknowledged count; button opens /stock/alerts `OP.STOCK_ONHAND.ATTENTION.06`

#### OP.STOCK_ONHAND.T02 · P1 · On hand table: main flow

- [ ] Look at a healthy row, an out row, a low row and a count-needed row **Expect:** Healthy row says a quiet "OK"; others carry one badge (Out, Low, Below par, Count needed); an out or low row that is also off its records shows "Records say X" beside the badge `OP.STOCK_ONHAND.TABLE.01`
- [ ] P2 · Check an ingredient with fractional stock, e.g. 2.4 kg as 2400.5 g **Expect:** On hand shows the decimal part aligned in its own slot, unit in the Unit column (g, ml, pc translated) `OP.STOCK_ONHAND.TABLE.02`
- [ ] P2 · Type part of an English name, then part of the Arabic name in the search box **Expect:** Both match case-insensitively; clearing search restores all rows `OP.STOCK_ONHAND.TABLE.03`
- [ ] P2 · Pick the Count needed filter then type a name that matches nothing **Expect:** Filtered empty state with "Clear filters"; clicking it resets filter, search and store `OP.STOCK_ONHAND.TABLE.04`
- [ ] P2 · Deactivate an ingredient on /stock/ingredients and reload On hand **Expect:** Inactive ingredient no longer listed; ResultCount total drops by one `OP.STOCK_ONHAND.TABLE.06`
- [ ] On a venue with shop products, open /stock **Expect:** Retail (shop) rows never appear on the cafe On hand; they appear only on /shop/stock `OP.STOCK_ONHAND.TABLE.07`

- [ ] Open History for an ingredient with deliveries, sales, waste and a count **Expect:** Rows read in words (Delivery, Sold, Waste spill, Count correction), signed change (+40 g / −40 g) in green/red, store, cost per unit like "2.5 IQD", who and note `OP.STOCK_ONHAND.LEDGER.01`
- [ ] P2 · Look at a sale that drew past the recorded batches **Expect:** Row shows the "beyond stock" note in warn colour `OP.STOCK_ONHAND.LEDGER.03`

- [ ] **Header and subtitle** Record a delivery of 10 pc at 1,500 IQD, return to On hand within 60 s **Expect:** Worth rises by 15,000 IQD `OP.STOCK_ONHAND.HEADER.02`
- [ ] **History drawer (LedgerDrawer)** Open History for an item with fractional per-gram costs (e.g. 2.3333 IQD) **Expect:** Cost column shows the fraction as a number plus IQD; the drawer does not crash `OP.STOCK_ONHAND.LEDGER.02`

#### OP.STOCK_ONHAND.T05 · P1 · On hand: other parts

- [ ] **Whole page** P2 · Open /stock?filter=low and /stock?filter=belowPar (the links from Today) **Expect:** Table opens already narrowed to that filter; an unknown filter value opens All `OP.STOCK_ONHAND.06`
