- [ ] **Needs attention list** `BACKEND_DOWN` P2 · Make report_stock fail (block the RPC) while v_ingredient_on_hand works **Expect:** Expired/Expiring rows read 0 and the worth is left out of the subtitle; table still works `OP.STOCK_ONHAND.ATTENTION.08`

### OP.STOCK_RECEIVE: Goods in

Book deliveries into stock: an invoice-shaped typed delivery (app.receive_delivery), the driver purchases (app.receive_purchase), scanned supplier receipts (app.confirm_receipt) and costing what staff logged on the phone (app.price_logged_stock). Online-only.

**Route:** `/stock/receive (?purchase=<uuid>, ?receipt=<uuid>; also /shop/receive in shop scope)` · **Roles:** manager, owner, shop_staff (via /shop/receive)

**Source:** `apps/operator/src/features/stock/ReceiveDelivery.tsx`, `apps/operator/src/features/stock/stockLogic.ts`, `apps/operator/src/features/stock/decimalInput.ts`, `apps/operator/src/features/stock/SupplierField.tsx`, `apps/operator/src/features/stock/StaffLogs.tsx`, `apps/operator/src/features/stock/DriverPurchases.tsx`, `apps/operator/src/features/stock/driverPurchasesLogic.ts`, `apps/operator/src/features/stock/receipts/ReceiptsPanel.tsx`, `apps/operator/src/features/stock/receipts/ReceiptReview.tsx`, `apps/operator/src/features/stock/receipts/receiptLogic.ts`, `apps/operator/src/routes/stock/_children.ts`

**Components:** Delivery table lines · Line totals and delivery total · Supplier, store and notes · Store being counted hold · Record delivery · Goods in vs Main cash (safe) · Waiting work chips · Added by staff (set cost) · Bought by the driver list · Receive one driver purchase · Scan receipt button · Scanned receipts list · Receipt review (?receipt=)

#### OP.STOCK_RECEIVE.T01 · P1 · Goods in: main checks

- [ ] Open /stock/receive **Expect:** Header "Goods in" with Scan receipt button; a row of waiting chips (if any); the delivery table with one empty line; total "—"; Record disabled `OP.STOCK_RECEIVE.01`
- [ ] P2 · Open /stock/receive?purchase=not-a-uuid and ?receipt=garbage **Expect:** Search params are dropped and the ordinary Goods in form shows `OP.STOCK_RECEIVE.02`
- [ ] P2 · Open /stock/receive?purchase=<valid id>&receipt=<valid id> **Expect:** The purchase wins: driver purchase screen opens `OP.STOCK_RECEIVE.03`

#### OP.STOCK_RECEIVE.T02 · P1 · Delivery table lines: main flow

- [ ] Pick "Milk" (pack 1000 ml at 2,500 IQD) on line 1 **Expect:** Cost box prefills 2.5 with "/ ml"; hint shows pack price "1,000 ml 2,500 IQD"; expiry hint says what blank does (shelf life N days or no expiry) `OP.STOCK_RECEIVE.DELIVERY_LINES.01`
- [ ] P2 · Type a cost first, then pick the ingredient **Expect:** Typed cost is kept (prefill only fills an empty box) `OP.STOCK_RECEIVE.DELIVERY_LINES.02`
- [ ] Fill only the item on a line **Expect:** Red "enter received" under Received; Record disabled `OP.STOCK_RECEIVE.DELIVERY_LINES.03`
- [ ] Type received 0 **Expect:** Received error shown; Record disabled `OP.STOCK_RECEIVE.DELIVERY_LINES.04`
- [ ] Type ordered 10 and received 8 **Expect:** Row tinted, "2 short" hint under Ordered; foot shows "1 short" badge with the short lead `OP.STOCK_RECEIVE.DELIVERY_LINES.05`
- [ ] Type letters, a second decimal point and 12 digits into Received **Expect:** Box keeps only digits and one point; stops at 10 digits `OP.STOCK_RECEIVE.DELIVERY_LINES.06`
- [ ] Type an expiry date of yesterday (keyboard into the date box) **Expect:** Expiry error shown and Record held; the picker greys out past days `OP.STOCK_RECEIVE.DELIVERY_LINES.08`
- [ ] P2 · Add 3 lines, remove line 2 with its X button **Expect:** Line removed; numbers renumber; the X is disabled when only one line remains `OP.STOCK_RECEIVE.DELIVERY_LINES.10`
- [ ] P2 · Leave a fully blank extra line and record **Expect:** Blank line is skipped (not an error); delivery books the filled lines only `OP.STOCK_RECEIVE.DELIVERY_LINES.11`
- [ ] Open the item list on the cafe Goods in **Expect:** Only active purchased ingredients; prepared items and shop products are not listed `OP.STOCK_RECEIVE.DELIVERY_LINES.12`

#### OP.STOCK_RECEIVE.T03 · P1 · Supplier, store and notes: main flow

- [ ] P2 · Pick an ingredient whose record has a supplier, with the supplier box empty **Expect:** Supplier fills itself from the first ingredient (linked supplier, else its supplier name) `OP.STOCK_RECEIVE.HEAD.01`
- [ ] P2 · Type "al rafidain" for an existing "Al-Rafidain" and tab out **Expect:** Expected: links to the existing supplier on blur only when spelling matches ignoring case and spaces; "al rafidain" vs "Al-Rafidain" (hyphen) stays a typed name, server dedups suppliers on spelling `OP.STOCK_RECEIVE.HEAD.02`
- [ ] P2 · Type a brand-new supplier name **Expect:** List shows the "will be saved as a new name" line; Record books with p_supplier_name `OP.STOCK_RECEIVE.HEAD.03`
- [ ] P2 · Use arrow keys and Enter in the supplier list, then Escape **Expect:** Arrow keys move the highlight, Enter picks, Escape closes; screen reader hears combobox/listbox roles `OP.STOCK_RECEIVE.HEAD.04`
- [ ] P2 · Scroll the page while the supplier list is open **Expect:** List closes rather than floating detached `OP.STOCK_RECEIVE.HEAD.05`
- [ ] Choose Bakery store and record **Expect:** Batches land in the bakery store: On hand split shows the bakery figure rise `OP.STOCK_RECEIVE.HEAD.06`
- [ ] P2 · Type a 250-character note **Expect:** Server refuses with TEXT_TOO_LONG message or the note is accepted within its limit; no crash `OP.STOCK_RECEIVE.HEAD.07`

#### OP.STOCK_RECEIVE.T04 · P1 · Waiting work chips: main flow

- [ ] Have 2 receipts to check, 1 driver purchase and 3 staff lines needing a cost **Expect:** Chips show counts 2, 1, 3 with coloured dots; data-testid goods-in-waiting-receipts / -driver / -staff `OP.STOCK_RECEIVE.WAITING.01`
- [ ] P2 · Click a chip, then another **Expect:** Only one panel open at a time; aria-expanded toggles; clicking the open chip closes it `OP.STOCK_RECEIVE.WAITING.02`
- [ ] P2 · Have only staff logs that are all costed **Expect:** Staff chip still shows (no count) so a cost can be corrected `OP.STOCK_RECEIVE.WAITING.05`

#### OP.STOCK_RECEIVE.T05 · P1 · Added by staff (set cost): main flow

- [ ] Open the staff chip with lines booked at no cost **Expect:** Panel lists logs needing a cost first, each line with "Needs a cost" badge and a Set cost button (data-testid set-cost-<id>) `OP.STOCK_RECEIVE.STAFF_LOGS.01`
- [ ] Type 1000000000 as cost **Expect:** Save disabled with "not a valid cost" (1e9 or more refused) `OP.STOCK_RECEIVE.STAFF_LOGS.04`
- [ ] P2 · Press Enter in the cost box with a valid value, Escape with another **Expect:** Enter saves; Escape cancels editing `OP.STOCK_RECEIVE.STAFF_LOGS.05`

#### OP.STOCK_RECEIVE.T06 · P0 · Receive one driver purchase: main flow

- [ ] P1 · Open a purchase with 2 stock lines **Expect:** Details panel (bought by, where, when, Paid IQD, delivery status, Receipt button if photo); each line shows "Bought 2,000 g · 6,000 IQD = 3 IQD per g"; Received prefilled with the bought qty `OP.STOCK_RECEIVE.DRIVER_RECEIVE.01`
- [ ] P1 · Change Received to less than bought **Expect:** Warn hint "N short"; to more than bought: "more than bought" warning; both still receivable `OP.STOCK_RECEIVE.DRIVER_RECEIVE.03`
- [ ] P1 · Clear Received or type "." only **Expect:** Field error; Receive disabled with reason "fix invalid" `OP.STOCK_RECEIVE.DRIVER_RECEIVE.04`
- [ ] Press Receive into stock **Expect:** Toast received; purchase leaves the list (back to Goods in if no other lines); On hand rises; ONE delivery booked for all stock lines `OP.STOCK_RECEIVE.DRIVER_RECEIVE.05`
- [ ] P1 · Open a purchase with a line already switched off **Expect:** Line shows inside Into stock with "switched off"; Receive disabled with reason until it is marked checked (confirm dialog first) `OP.STOCK_RECEIVE.DRIVER_RECEIVE.08`
- [ ] P2 · Mark checked a non-stock line (cleaning supplies) **Expect:** Toast acknowledged; line moves to Done with status badge; failure shows under that line only `OP.STOCK_RECEIVE.DRIVER_RECEIVE.09`
- [ ] P2 · Press Receipt **Expect:** Photo viewer opens the driver receipt photo; close returns `OP.STOCK_RECEIVE.DRIVER_RECEIVE.12`
- [ ] P2 · Open ?purchase=<id> that was already received **Expect:** Empty state "already received" with Back `OP.STOCK_RECEIVE.DRIVER_RECEIVE.13`
- [ ] P2 · Leave supplier blank on a purchase with a shop name **Expect:** Hint says the shop name will be used; receive books the supplier name `OP.STOCK_RECEIVE.DRIVER_RECEIVE.15`

#### OP.STOCK_RECEIVE.T07 · P1 · Scan receipt button: main flow

- [ ] Press Scan receipt (data-testid receipts.scan) and pick a JPEG **Expect:** Button shows Uploading; toast saved; review page /stock/receive?receipt=<id> opens and shows "reading" while the model reads `OP.STOCK_RECEIVE.SCAN.01`
- [ ] P2 · Pick a PDF or a GIF **Expect:** Inline alert "wrong type"; nothing filed `OP.STOCK_RECEIVE.SCAN.02`
- [ ] P2 · Pick a 15 MB photo **Expect:** Photo is compressed (max 2560 px / 2.5 MB) or refused with "too big"; never a hang `OP.STOCK_RECEIVE.SCAN.03`

#### OP.STOCK_RECEIVE.T08 · P0 · Receipt review (?receipt=): main flow

- [ ] P1 · Open a line printed as "3 box" for an item with pack size 12 pc **Expect:** Received prefilled 36 with the warn note "assumed 12 pc per pack" (data-testid receipt.pack-assumed) `OP.STOCK_RECEIVE.RECEIPT_REVIEW.02`
- [ ] P1 · Open a line with an unknown unit ("dozen") **Expect:** Received left blank for the manager to type (never guessed) `OP.STOCK_RECEIVE.RECEIPT_REVIEW.03`
- [ ] P1 · Look at lines with flags (ARITHMETIC, NO_PRICE, TOTAL_MISMATCH, UNCLEAR, SMALL_AMOUNT, TRUNCATED) **Expect:** Each flag shows as a warn bullet in words `OP.STOCK_RECEIVE.RECEIPT_REVIEW.05`
- [ ] P1 · Change the matched ingredient on a read line **Expect:** Quantity and cost recalculated from the receipt in the new ingredient unit; badge says manual match `OP.STOCK_RECEIVE.RECEIPT_REVIEW.06`
- [ ] P2 · Remove a delivery-fee line and add a manual line **Expect:** Fee line gone; added line blank; Put into stock books only the remaining lines `OP.STOCK_RECEIVE.RECEIPT_REVIEW.07`
- [ ] Press Put into stock (data-testid receipt.confirm) **Expect:** Toast confirmed; back to Goods in; receipt leaves the list; On hand rises; one delivery booked `OP.STOCK_RECEIVE.RECEIPT_REVIEW.08`
- [ ] Double-click Put into stock **Expect:** Only one request (in-flight guard) `OP.STOCK_RECEIVE.RECEIPT_REVIEW.10`
- [ ] P2 · Remove every line **Expect:** Put into stock disabled with "no lines" `OP.STOCK_RECEIVE.RECEIPT_REVIEW.11`
- [ ] P2 · Press Set aside (data-testid receipt.reject) and confirm **Expect:** Red confirm first; then toast rejected, back to Goods in, receipt gone from list, no stock booked `OP.STOCK_RECEIVE.RECEIPT_REVIEW.20`
- [ ] P2 · Open ?receipt=<id> of a confirmed or deleted receipt **Expect:** Empty state "already done or gone" with Back; RECEIPT_NOT_FOUND shows the same `OP.STOCK_RECEIVE.RECEIPT_REVIEW.21`

#### OP.STOCK_RECEIVE.T09 · P0 · Goods in: money and totals (1 of 2)

- [ ] **Line totals and delivery total** Line 1500 g at 2.3333 IQD/g **Expect:** Line total shows 3,500 (Math.round of 3,499.95), integer IQD with thousands separator `OP.STOCK_RECEIVE.TOTALS.01`
- [ ] **Line totals and delivery total** Lines: 3 pc at 3333.3333, 2 pc at 1,250.5, 10 kg flour as 10000 g at 1.2 **Expect:** Line totals 10,000 / 2,501 / 12,000; delivery total 24,501 IQD `OP.STOCK_RECEIVE.TOTALS.02`
- [ ] **Line totals and delivery total** P1 · Enter only received (no cost) on a line **Expect:** Line total "—" and total excludes it; total is "—" until any line has both `OP.STOCK_RECEIVE.TOTALS.03`
- [ ] **Line totals and delivery total** Record the delivery and reopen the ingredient history **Expect:** Delivery row cost per unit equals the typed cost (to 4 places); On hand worth rises by about the delivery total `OP.STOCK_RECEIVE.TOTALS.04`
- [ ] **Goods in vs Main cash (safe)** Note the Safe balance, record a 150,000 IQD delivery on Goods in, reopen the Safe **Expect:** Safe balance and the month costs list are unchanged; Goods in has no paid-from field `OP.STOCK_RECEIVE.SAFE_INTERPLAY.01`
- [ ] **Goods in vs Main cash (safe)** Pay the same supplier on Safe > Pay: category Supplier, 150,000, paid from Safe **Expect:** Safe balance drops by exactly 150,000; cost listed under Supplier; stock value not changed by the payment `OP.STOCK_RECEIVE.SAFE_INTERPLAY.02`
- [ ] **Goods in vs Main cash (safe)** Pay a supplier from Bank instead **Expect:** Safe balance unchanged; cost listed with the bank figure `OP.STOCK_RECEIVE.SAFE_INTERPLAY.03`
- [ ] **Goods in vs Main cash (safe)** Receive a driver purchase and a scanned receipt, then check the Safe **Expect:** Neither moves the safe balance; the driver purchase total is only shown as "Paid" on the purchase `OP.STOCK_RECEIVE.SAFE_INTERPLAY.04`
- [ ] **Goods in vs Main cash (safe)** P1 · Compare the Goods in delivery total with the Safe payment entered for that invoice at month end **Expect:** Totals reconcile to the IQD; any difference is a missed entry to chase `OP.STOCK_RECEIVE.SAFE_INTERPLAY.06`
- [ ] **Added by staff (set cost)** Set cost per unit 2.5 on a 1000 g line and press Save (save-cost-<id>) **Expect:** Toast saved; line shows "2.5 IQD per g" with source; Needs a cost count on On hand drops `OP.STOCK_RECEIVE.STAFF_LOGS.02`
- [ ] **Added by staff (set cost)** Switch Per to pack (pack 3 pc) and type 10,000 **Expect:** Saved cost per base unit is 3333.3333 (rounded to 4 places) `OP.STOCK_RECEIVE.STAFF_LOGS.03`
- [ ] **Added by staff (set cost)** P1 · Change the cost of a line partly used already **Expect:** Only what is still on the shelf is revalued; the explained note "revalues what is left" shows `OP.STOCK_RECEIVE.STAFF_LOGS.06`

#### OP.STOCK_RECEIVE.T10 · P0 · Goods in: money and totals (2 of 2)

#### OP.STOCK_RECEIVE.T11 · P0 · Goods in: other parts

- [ ] **Line totals and delivery total** P1 · Type a large invoice: 9,999,999,999 g at 1 **Expect:** Box stops at 10 digits; server refuses anything at 1e9 or more with INVALID_QTY shown under the foot `OP.STOCK_RECEIVE.TOTALS.05`

#### OP.STOCK_RECEIVE.T12 · P0 · Goods in: With no internet

*Setup:* `OFFLINE` (No internet)

- [ ] Go offline and press Record delivery with a valid line **Expect:** Connection error under the foot; nothing queued; lines kept; when back online the same Record books once (same idempotency key) `OP.STOCK_RECEIVE.04`
- [ ] **Added by staff (set cost)** P1 · Go offline and Save a cost **Expect:** Connection error under the line; editor stays open `OP.STOCK_RECEIVE.STAFF_LOGS.09`
- [ ] **Receive one driver purchase** P1 · Open ?purchase=<id> while offline after restart **Expect:** Read-failed panel (data-testid driver-purchase-read-failed) with Retry and Back, never "already received" `OP.STOCK_RECEIVE.DRIVER_RECEIVE.14`
- [ ] **Scan receipt button** P1 · Go offline and press Scan **Expect:** Error under the button; nothing filed; button usable again `OP.STOCK_RECEIVE.SCAN.04`
- [ ] **Receipt review (?receipt=)** P1 · Open ?receipt=<id> offline after restart **Expect:** Error with Retry (not "gone") `OP.STOCK_RECEIVE.RECEIPT_REVIEW.22`

#### OP.STOCK_RECEIVE.T13 · P0 · Goods in: Flaky or slow network, backend down

*Setup:* `FLAKY_NETWORK` (Network drops on and off), `BACKEND_DOWN` (Server unreachable while the LAN is up), `SLOW_NETWORK` (Slow network)

- [ ] `FLAKY_NETWORK` Make the network drop the reply after Record (DevTools offline right after click), go online, press Record again **Expect:** Delivery booked once (p_idempotency_key kept across retries); On hand rises once `OP.STOCK_RECEIVE.05`
- [ ] **Delivery table lines** `BACKEND_DOWN` P2 · Make the ingredient read fail **Expect:** Error with Retry above the table explaining the empty Choose list `OP.STOCK_RECEIVE.DELIVERY_LINES.14`
- [ ] **Record delivery** `SLOW_NETWORK` Record with throttling until the 15 s deadline passes **Expect:** Connection error shown; pressing Record again with the same lines books at most once `OP.STOCK_RECEIVE.RECORD.05`
- [ ] **Waiting work chips** `BACKEND_DOWN` P2 · Block purchases_to_receive **Expect:** Driver chip still shows (no count) so its panel can show the error and Retry `OP.STOCK_RECEIVE.WAITING.04`
- [ ] **Bought by the driver list** `BACKEND_DOWN` P2 · Make purchases_to_receive fail **Expect:** Panel shows the error and Retry `OP.STOCK_RECEIVE.DRIVER_LIST.04`
- [ ] **Receive one driver purchase** `FLAKY_NETWORK` Press Receive twice quickly, or retry after a lost reply **Expect:** One delivery (idempotency key kept until success) `OP.STOCK_RECEIVE.DRIVER_RECEIVE.16`

#### OP.STOCK_RECEIVE.T14 · P0 · Goods in: Shared stock screen opened on the shop desk

*Setup:* `SHOP_SCOPE` (Shared stock screen opened on the shop desk)

- [ ] P1 · Open /shop/receive as shop_staff **Expect:** No Scan button, no waiting chips, no store picker; cost column reads "Cost each"; no Expiry column; only shop products listed; delivery goes into the shop store `OP.STOCK_RECEIVE.07`
- [ ] **Goods in vs Main cash (safe)** Receive goods on /shop/receive, then check the shop drawer on /shop/drawer **Expect:** Shop drawer expected cash unchanged `OP.STOCK_RECEIVE.SAFE_INTERPLAY.05`
- [ ] **Receive one driver purchase** P1 · Open a purchase containing a shop (retail) product and pick Bakery **Expect:** Bakery disabled with "shop stock goes to the cafe only"; expected per 0245 shop stock lives in the shop store only: receiving into Cafe should be refused with INVALID_ARGUMENT (kind); log a bug that there is no way to receive a driver-bought shop product `OP.STOCK_RECEIVE.DRIVER_RECEIVE.11`
- [ ] **Receipt review (?receipt=)** P1 · Pick a shop (retail) product on a line and put into Cafe store **Expect:** Expected per 0245: refused with INVALID_ARGUMENT (kind) shown as an error; the review offers retail items and only cafe/bakery stores; log a bug that shop products on a receipt cannot be booked `OP.STOCK_RECEIVE.RECEIPT_REVIEW.12`
- [ ] **Receipt review (?receipt=)** P2 · Choose Bakery with a retail line on the form **Expect:** Bakery disabled with "shop stock cafe only" `OP.STOCK_RECEIVE.RECEIPT_REVIEW.13`

#### OP.STOCK_RECEIVE.T15 · P0 · Goods in: A manager count is open at the store

*Setup:* `STORE_BEING_COUNTED` (A manager count is open at the store)

- [ ] **Receipt review (?receipt=)** Start a cafe count then try Put into stock into Cafe store **Expect:** Notice and disabled reason "held"; server STORE_BEING_COUNTED refetches counts if it slipped through `OP.STOCK_RECEIVE.RECEIPT_REVIEW.23`

#### OP.STOCK_RECEIVE.T16 · P1 · Goods in: Third-party service down

*Setup:* `VENDOR_DOWN` (Third-party service down)

- [ ] **Receipt review (?receipt=)** Hit the monthly LLM cap and read again **Expect:** Receipt shows the LLM_MONTHLY_CAP reason; manager types lines manually `OP.STOCK_RECEIVE.RECEIPT_REVIEW.19`

#### OP.STOCK_RECEIVE.T17 · P1 · Goods in: Scanned receipt still being read

#### OP.STOCK_RECEIVE.T20 · P0 · Goods in: Two people at once

*Setup:* `CONCURRENT_EDIT` (Two people change the same thing)

- [ ] **Receive one driver purchase** P1 · Switch an ingredient off on another station, then press Receive **Expect:** Refused INGREDIENT_NOT_FOUND hint lines: notice "an ingredient was switched off" and the line moves to the mark-checked list after refetch `OP.STOCK_RECEIVE.DRIVER_RECEIVE.07`
- [ ] **Receipt review (?receipt=)** Confirm the same receipt on two stations **Expect:** Second gets RECEIPT_ALREADY_DONE, review re-reads and shows "already done"; stock booked once `OP.STOCK_RECEIVE.RECEIPT_REVIEW.09`
- [ ] **Receipt review (?receipt=)** P1 · Edit lines, then let a new reading land **Expect:** Notice "a new reading arrived" with Use new reading / Keep mine (data-testid receipt.new-reading); Keep mine keeps edits `OP.STOCK_RECEIVE.RECEIPT_REVIEW.17`

#### OP.STOCK_RECEIVE.T21 · P2 · Goods in: Around midnight and the business-day boundary

### OP.PRICE_WATCH: Supplier price watch

On the registered shop desk PC, read each shop size supplier page link about hourly through the shell, parse one IQD price, report it (app.record_shop_supplier_price); the server pushes the owner and shop staff on a change; Products lists sizes whose supplier price differs with Apply new price.

**Route:** `background in the signed-in shell (routes/__root.tsx) + panel on /shop/products` · **Roles:** shop_staff, manager, owner

**Source:** `apps/operator/src/features/shop/priceWatch/PriceWatchCrawler.tsx`, `apps/operator/src/features/shop/priceWatch/crawlPass.ts`, `apps/operator/src/features/shop/priceWatch/priceWatchLogic.ts`, `apps/operator/src/features/shop/priceWatch/parseSupplierPrice.ts`, `apps/operator/src/features/shop/priceWatch/PriceWatchUi.tsx`, `apps/operator/src/features/shop/priceWatch/priceWatchData.ts`, `apps/operator/src/ipc/bridge.ts`, `apps/operator/src/routes/__root.tsx`

**Components:** Hourly crawler · Supplier page price parser · Supplier price changes panel

#### OP.PRICE_WATCH.T01 · P1 · Hourly crawler: main flow

- [ ] Change the supplier page price from 30,000 to 32,000 IQD and wait for a pass **Expect:** Server stores 32,000 with price_changed_at; owner and other shop staff get a push; the signed-in shop desk shows an info toast "1 new supplier price" `OP.PRICE_WATCH.CRAWLER.01`
- [ ] P2 · Have the supplier page price equal the shop price **Expect:** Reported; no toast and no push for that size `OP.PRICE_WATCH.CRAWLER.02`
- [ ] P2 · Remount the shell quickly (navigate around) while a pass runs **Expect:** Only one pass at a time (single-flight) `OP.PRICE_WATCH.CRAWLER.08`

- [ ] P2 · Watch a homepage with no price data **Expect:** last_error no_price; row shows "Supplier link not read" badge with the reason as tooltip `OP.PRICE_WATCH.PARSER.07`
- [ ] P2 · Watch a page showing "from 40,000" range **Expect:** ambiguous `OP.PRICE_WATCH.PARSER.08`

### OP.ASSISTANT: Owner assistant (paid)

The owner asks about the business in plain words; Claude reads the figures through the same tools the screens use, every answer names what it read and what it cost.

**Route:** `/assistant, /assistant/$id` · **Roles:** owner

**Source:** `apps/operator/src/routes/assistant.tsx`, `apps/operator/src/routes/assistant/_children.ts`, `apps/operator/src/features/assistant/AssistantPage.tsx`, `apps/operator/src/features/assistant/Thread.tsx`

**Components:** Start screen and ready questions · Reads (scope picker) · Model switch · Composer · Answer streaming and error sentences · Answer bubble, sources and page links · Re-check · Pin to Analytics · Ask next buttons · Job estimate card (estimate then job) · Job progress · Cost toolbar and monthly cap bar · Chats drawer (history) · Owner on the free AI · Tools, web search, files and stored days (server side)

#### OP.ASSISTANT.T01 · P0 · Owner assistant (paid): main checks

- [ ] P1 · Sign in as the owner and open Assistant from the rail **Expect:** The page opens on the start screen with the heading What do you want to know?, a slim strip with Chats and New chat, and a locked composer reading Pick what this chat reads to type a question `OP.ASSISTANT.01`
- [ ] As the owner open /assistant/<id of a chat that does not exist or belongs to another owner> **Expect:** The thread shows This chat is not in your list. and no messages `OP.ASSISTANT.04`
- [ ] P1 · Ask a first question in a new chat and watch the address bar **Expect:** The URL moves to /assistant/<new id> without the stream stopping or the answer flickering away `OP.ASSISTANT.05`
- [ ] P1 · Reload the page while on /assistant/<id> **Expect:** The same chat opens again with every stored question and answer in order `OP.ASSISTANT.06`

- [ ] P2 · Press Where do I change the booking deposit? on the How do I… card **Expect:** The answer explains the page and shows a Go to button for the deposit settings page that opens it `OP.ASSISTANT.START.06`

### OP.PROTOCOLS: Protocols

Management starts a new item, a tournament, a hiring or a price or promo change and decides the steps waiting on them; the owner also edits How it works and the daily checklists.

**Route:** `/protocols` · **Roles:** manager, owner

**Source:** `apps/operator/src/routes/protocols.tsx`, `apps/operator/src/features/protocols/ProtocolsPage.tsx`, `apps/operator/src/features/protocols/search.ts`, `apps/operator/src/features/protocols/api.ts`

**Components:** Protocol cards and Start · Runs list · Run sheet · Step panel and step form · Step photos · Decide dialog · Run edits (owner) · How it works (owner template editor) · Hiring candidates · Protocol pushes, reminders and protocol watch · Recipe changes card

#### OP.PROTOCOLS.T01 · P1 · Protocols: main checks

- [ ] Open Protocols as a manager **Expect:** Four protocol cards (New item, Tournament, Hiring, Price or promo change) with n running and n waiting on you and Start, then Daily checklists and Recipe changes, then the runs list with Waiting on you, In progress and Finished `OP.PROTOCOLS.01`
- [ ] Open Protocols as the owner **Expect:** Each protocol card also shows How it works; the checklists card offers Edit the lists and Write a list `OP.PROTOCOLS.02`
- [ ] Open /protocols?run=<id>&step=<id> from a push or a link **Expect:** The run sheet opens on that step; Back closes it and returns to the list `OP.PROTOCOLS.04`
- [ ] P2 · Open /protocols?run=<id of a run that does not exist> **Expect:** The sheet shows That protocol could not be found. `OP.PROTOCOLS.05`

#### OP.PROTOCOLS.T02 · P1 · Protocol cards and Start: main flow

- [ ] P2 · Read the New item card **Expect:** It says A new menu item, from the idea and the test to the price and the launch., n running, n waiting on you, n finished in the last 30 days, and ideas waiting from the team `OP.PROTOCOLS.CARDS.01`
- [ ] Press Start: Tournament and pick Tournament type **Expect:** Type 1, 2 and 3 each explain who decides (owner approves feasibility / a manager decides every step / sponsor details go in the plan) `OP.PROTOCOLS.CARDS.02`

- [ ] P2 · As a manager start with one title language **Expect:** Accepted: One language is enough. `OP.PROTOCOLS.CARDS.04`
- [ ] P2 · As the owner start a protocol whose first step he decides **Expect:** Toast Started. Your first step passed at once. `OP.PROTOCOLS.CARDS.05`
- [ ] As a manager start a protocol **Expect:** Toast Started. and the first step goes for a decision (Starting sends this first step for a decision.) `OP.PROTOCOLS.CARDS.06`
- [ ] Start a type 3 tournament without sponsor details **Expect:** Refused with Add the sponsor or client details before starting this tournament. `OP.PROTOCOLS.CARDS.07`

- [ ] P2 · Filter Kind to Hiring **Expect:** Only hiring runs show `OP.PROTOCOLS.LISTS.02`
- [ ] Have a staff member send a step, then refresh Waiting on you **Expect:** The run appears with Where it is naming the step `OP.PROTOCOLS.LISTS.03`

- [ ] P1 · Fill and send a step a manager decides **Expect:** Toast Sent. and the step shows Sent. A manager decides. `OP.PROTOCOLS.STEP.02`
- [ ] P2 · Send a step you decide yourself **Expect:** Toast Sent and passed: you decide this step. `OP.PROTOCOLS.STEP.03`

#### OP.PROTOCOLS.T07 · P1 · Decide dialog: main flow

- [ ] Approve a waiting step **Expect:** Toast Approved.; the next steps open and the sender gets an Approved push `OP.PROTOCOLS.DECISION.01`
- [ ] Send back with a reason to an earlier step **Expect:** Sent back.; the target step reopens and the reason shows to the sender `OP.PROTOCOLS.DECISION.02`
- [ ] P2 · Send back without a reason **Expect:** Refused: Reason required `OP.PROTOCOLS.DECISION.03`
- [ ] Approve a new item proposal without a menu category **Expect:** The category field is marked; nothing is sent `OP.PROTOCOLS.DECISION.04`

#### OP.PROTOCOLS.T08 · P2 · Run edits (owner): main flow

- [ ] As the owner press Add a step to this protocol, pick After, name it in both languages, choose who and Needs my OK **Expect:** The step is added.; it shows Added by the owner; How it works is unchanged `OP.PROTOCOLS.RUN_EDITS.01`
- [ ] Try to add a step after a step whose next step has started **Expect:** Not offered: Only where nothing after it has started yet. `OP.PROTOCOLS.RUN_EDITS.02`
- [ ] Edit a step checklist and save **Expect:** The checklist is saved. `OP.PROTOCOLS.RUN_EDITS.03`

- [ ] P2 · Open How it works: New item **Expect:** Steps with Built in / Your step, Always first / Always last, Done by, Needs my OK; Last saved by <name>, <date> (version n) `OP.PROTOCOLS.HOW.01`
- [ ] P1 · Add a step of your own and save **Expect:** Save how it works? Running protocols keep their steps. New ones use this.; Saved. New protocols use it. `OP.PROTOCOLS.HOW.02`
- [ ] P2 · Leave a step name in English only **Expect:** Fill in both English and Arabic. `OP.PROTOCOLS.HOW.03`
- [ ] Try to remove a built-in step or drop the owner OK on a price step **Expect:** Built-in steps cannot be removed… the price steps always need the owner’s OK. `OP.PROTOCOLS.HOW.04`
- [ ] P2 · Order a step before one it depends on **Expect:** That order is not possible… `OP.PROTOCOLS.HOW.05`
- [ ] P2 · Navigate away with changes **Expect:** Leave without saving? Your changes to how it works are not saved yet. `OP.PROTOCOLS.HOW.07`

- [ ] P2 · Send the interview step with no candidate picked **Expect:** Pick the candidate you want to hire first. `OP.PROTOCOLS.CANDIDATES.02`
- [ ] Read the privacy line **Expect:** Names and phone numbers stay here and are deleted 90 days after the decision. The step itself keeps no name. `OP.PROTOCOLS.CANDIDATES.03`
- [ ] Open a run decided more than 90 days ago **Expect:** The candidates were deleted 90 days after the decision. `OP.PROTOCOLS.CANDIDATES.04`
- [ ] Finish the hire step: Add the staff member **Expect:** The Staff form opens prefilled; a role mismatch is refused with The new account’s role does not match the position.; a non-owner sees Only the owner adds staff. `OP.PROTOCOLS.CANDIDATES.05`

- [ ] P1 · Send a step needing the owner OK **Expect:** The reminders go to the owners only `OP.PROTOCOLS.PUSHES.02`

#### OP.PROTOCOLS.T17 · P0 · Protocols: ge (1 of 2)

*Setup:* `ARABIC_RTL` (Arabic, right to left), `SECOND_BRANCH` (Two branches), `EMPTY_DATA` (Nothing recorded yet), `LARGE_DATA` (Large data volume), `TIMEZONE_EDGE` (Midnight / business-day boundary (Asia/Baghdad)), `PRICE_TARGET_CHANGED` (The priced item, size, add-on, promotion, rate, lesson type or coach price changed after approval), `RATE_LIMITED` (AI vendor rate limit (429) or free AI per-minute / club limit), `FLAKY_NETWORK` (Network drops on and off), `ALREADY_DECIDED` (Another decider already decided or the sender withdrew (SUBMISSION_DECIDED))

- [ ] `SECOND_BRANCH` P1 · Switch the rail branch as the owner **Expect:** The page remounts and shows that branch runs and deciders only `OP.PROTOCOLS.08`
- [ ] **Protocol pushes, reminders and protocol watch** `SECOND_BRANCH` P2 · Close a branch and leave a step waiting there **Expect:** No reminders for the closed branch `OP.PROTOCOLS.PUSHES.11`
- [ ] **Runs list** `EMPTY_DATA` P2 · Open Waiting on you with nothing waiting **Expect:** Nothing is waiting on you / A step you do or decide shows here the moment it opens. `OP.PROTOCOLS.LISTS.01`
- [ ] **Runs list** `LARGE_DATA` P2 · Seed 100 runs **Expect:** The list caps and offers View more; scrolling stays smooth `OP.PROTOCOLS.LISTS.05`
- [ ] **Step panel and step form** `TIMEZONE_EDGE` P1 · Launch on a date (When = On a date) **Expect:** Run shows Goes ahead on <date>; at that time the item goes on sale; if not ready then, a Launch postponed push is sent `OP.PROTOCOLS.STEP.14`
- [ ] **Step panel and step form** `PRICE_TARGET_CHANGED` Apply a price change after the item changed **Expect:** Refused with This change no longer matches what was approved… Start a new change. `OP.PROTOCOLS.STEP.15`
- [ ] **Step panel and step form** `PRICE_TARGET_CHANGED` Apply a lesson price change after the lesson type or coach price changed **Expect:** The lesson-specific PRICE_TARGET_CHANGED line shows `OP.PROTOCOLS.STEP.16`
- [ ] **Step photos** `RATE_LIMITED` P2 · Upload many photos fast **Expect:** Too many photos in a short time. Try again in a few minutes. `OP.PROTOCOLS.PHOTOS.04`
- [ ] **Step photos** `FLAKY_NETWORK` P2 · Upload while the connection drops **Expect:** A photo did not upload properly. Take or choose it again. `OP.PROTOCOLS.PHOTOS.05`
- [ ] **Decide dialog** `ALREADY_DECIDED` Approve on station A, then press Approve on station B for the same step **Expect:** B is refused with This was already decided or withdrawn. Refresh to see the latest.; only one decision is stored `OP.PROTOCOLS.DECISION.08`

- [ ] **Protocol pushes, reminders and protocol watch** `OFF_HOURS` P2 · Send a step at 21:00 Baghdad time **Expect:** The reminder due at 00:00 waits until 09:00 the next morning `OP.PROTOCOLS.PUSHES.03`
- [ ] **Protocol pushes, reminders and protocol watch** `PUSH_DENIED` P2 · Deny notification permission on the phone and send a step **Expect:** The step still waits in Waiting on you on the operator; nothing is lost `OP.PROTOCOLS.PUSHES.09`

### OP.CHECKLISTS: Daily checklists (card and sheet on Protocols)

Scheduled, assigned checklists: the owner writes lists for a role or named people with weekday or monthday repeats and a due rule; staff tick on the phone; management sees today state here.

**Route:** `/protocols (Checklists card)` · **Roles:** manager, owner

**Source:** `apps/operator/src/features/checklists/ChecklistsCard.tsx`, `apps/operator/src/features/checklists/ChecklistsSheet.tsx`, `apps/operator/src/features/checklists/ChecklistEditor.tsx`, `apps/operator/src/features/checklists/checklistLogic.ts`, `apps/operator/src/features/checklists/StaffPhoto.tsx`, `packages/db/supabase/migrations/20261008000323_checklist_schedules.sql`

**Components:** Today tab · List editor (owner) · Checklist reminders (remind + flag)

#### OP.CHECKLISTS.T01 · P1 · Today tab: main flow

- [ ] Have a barista tick two lines on the phone, then open See today **Expect:** Each ticked line shows <name> · <time>; progress updates `OP.CHECKLISTS.TODAY.01`
- [ ] Open a list whose due time has passed unfinished **Expect:** It is marked Overdue `OP.CHECKLISTS.TODAY.02`
- [ ] P2 · Open a photo line ticked on the phone **Expect:** See the photo: <line> opens the photo; a broken one says This photo could not be opened. `OP.CHECKLISTS.TODAY.03`
- [ ] P2 · Look at a role list set to everyone their own copy **Expect:** Each person copy shows separately `OP.CHECKLISTS.TODAY.05`

#### OP.CHECKLISTS.T02 · P1 · List editor (owner): main flow (1 of 2)

- [ ] Write a list for the Barista role, Every day, Before opening, three lines, Save the list **Expect:** List saved.; baristas see it on the phone the next opening `OP.CHECKLISTS.EDITOR.01`
- [ ] Pick Named people and choose two people **Expect:** Chosen: 2; only they get the list `OP.CHECKLISTS.EDITOR.02`
- [ ] P2 · Pick Named people and choose none **Expect:** Choose at least one person. `OP.CHECKLISTS.EDITOR.03`
- [ ] P2 · Choose more than 50 people **Expect:** At most 50 people. `OP.CHECKLISTS.EDITOR.04`
- [ ] P2 · Pick A role with no role chosen **Expect:** Choose a role. `OP.CHECKLISTS.EDITOR.05`
- [ ] P2 · Pick Chosen weekdays with no day **Expect:** Choose at least one day. `OP.CHECKLISTS.EDITOR.06`
- [ ] P2 · Pick Twice a month with the same date twice **Expect:** Choose two different dates. `OP.CHECKLISTS.EDITOR.07`
- [ ] P2 · Pick By a set time with no time **Expect:** Enter a time. `OP.CHECKLISTS.EDITOR.09`
- [ ] P2 · Write a line in English only **Expect:** Write it in both English and Arabic. `OP.CHECKLISTS.EDITOR.10`
- [ ] P2 · Write a line over 200 characters, or a name over 120 **Expect:** At most n characters. `OP.CHECKLISTS.EDITOR.11`
- [ ] P2 · Add a 31st line **Expect:** A list holds at most 30 lines. `OP.CHECKLISTS.EDITOR.12`
- [ ] P2 · Save a list with no lines **Expect:** Allowed with the note No lines yet. A list with no lines is not shown to anyone. `OP.CHECKLISTS.EDITOR.13`

#### OP.CHECKLISTS.T03 · P1 · List editor (owner): main flow (2 of 2)

- [ ] Switch on Needs a photo for a line **Expect:** Staff can tick it only with a photo on the phone; the line shows Needs a photo `OP.CHECKLISTS.EDITOR.14`
- [ ] P2 · Edit a list that already has a copy open today **Expect:** This list already has a copy open, so that copy keeps its old lines. Your change shows from the next one. `OP.CHECKLISTS.EDITOR.15`
- [ ] P2 · Archive the list **Expect:** Archive “<name>”? It goes off every phone at once, copies open today included. It cannot be brought back here; toast List archived. `OP.CHECKLISTS.EDITOR.18`

### OP.INCIDENTS: Incidents

The desk and the café cashier report accidents, injuries, fights and damage; managers and the owner review each with a note the reporter reads; the owner can redact.

**Route:** `/incidents` · **Roles:** court_desk, cashier, manager, owner

**Source:** `apps/operator/src/routes/incidents.tsx`, `apps/operator/src/features/incidents/IncidentsPage.tsx`, `apps/operator/src/features/incidents/incidentsLogic.ts`, `apps/operator/src/features/incidents/api.ts`

**Components:** Report an incident (stepper) · My reports · Review list and incident sheet

#### OP.INCIDENTS.T01 · P0 · Report an incident (stepper): main flow

- [ ] Report an injury on Court 2, 10 min ago, with a description and a photo, Send report **Expect:** Report sent. A manager will review it.; it shows in My reports as Waiting for a manager; managers get an Incident report push `OP.INCIDENTS.REPORT.01`
- [ ] P2 · Try to go on with no kind **Expect:** Please select the type of incident. `OP.INCIDENTS.REPORT.02`

- [ ] P2 · Pick a time 8 days ago or in the future **Expect:** Pick a time in the last 7 days. `OP.INCIDENTS.REPORT.04`

- [ ] P2 · Add a 7th photo **Expect:** Up to 6 photos. `OP.INCIDENTS.REPORT.06`
- [ ] P1 · Press Send report twice **Expect:** One report only (idempotency key follows what is sent) `OP.INCIDENTS.REPORT.07`
- [ ] P2 · Read the privacy hint on What happened **Expect:** Write only what is needed. Do not add phone numbers. `OP.INCIDENTS.REPORT.10`

- [ ] P2 · Mark reviewed with no note **Expect:** Write a note for the reporter. `OP.INCIDENTS.REVIEW.02`

- [ ] **Assign money to players** P1 · Assign on an over-paid bill **Expect:** …A manager refunds the difference at the café cashier. `OP.MATCH.ASSIGN.07`
- [ ] **Assign money to players** P1 · Read Price changed after booking: <delta> **Expect:** Shown as on the bill, not on a player `OP.MATCH.ASSIGN.08`
- [ ] **Call off the match** Call off with every player marked and one missing **Expect:** Call off this match? Came: … Didn’t come: …; Match called off.; nobody pays the court `OP.MATCH.CALL_OFF.01`
- [ ] **Call off the match** Call off after money was taken **Expect:** <amount> was already taken at the desk for this match. After calling off, a manager refunds it at the café cashier.; note there is no refund in this dialog `OP.MATCH.CALL_OFF.04`

#### OP.MATCH.T09 · P1 · Open match screen: other parts

- [ ] **Write off a share** Try with a 3 digit PIN **Expect:** Confirm disabled until at least 4 characters `OP.MATCH.WRITE_OFF.02`
- [ ] **Assign money to players** P2 · Assign nothing **Expect:** Enter an amount for at least one player. `OP.MATCH.ASSIGN.04`
- [ ] **Call off the match** Try before marking everyone **Expect:** Mark every player first (n not marked) `OP.MATCH.CALL_OFF.02`
- [ ] **Call off the match** P2 · Try when nobody came **Expect:** Nobody came. Mark everyone as no-show instead. `OP.MATCH.CALL_OFF.03`

#### OP.MATCH.T10 · P0 · Open match screen: Who can and cannot use it

*Setup:* `WRONG_ROLE` (Signed in with a role that may not use this)

- [ ] **Take share / Take several / group** P1 · As a cashier take a share from the booking **Expect:** Allowed (takeSeatPayment includes cashier); shop_staff never sees it `OP.MATCH.TAKE_SHARE.07`
- [ ] **Write off a share** As the court desk write off with a manager PIN **Expect:** Allowed only with the manager PIN `OP.MATCH.WRITE_OFF.04`
- [ ] **Remove a player and add in a seat** P1 · As the court desk remove a booked seat for Staff error **Expect:** After booking, only a manager removes a seat for a staff error or a duplicate. `OP.MATCH.REMOVE.04`

#### OP.MATCH.T11 · P0 · Open match screen: ge (1 of 2)

*Setup:* `SECOND_BRANCH` (Two branches), `OFFLINE` (No internet), `ARABIC_RTL` (Arabic, right to left), `CONCURRENT_EDIT` (Two people change the same thing), `EMPTY_DATA` (Nothing recorded yet), `SEAT_RACE` (An app player takes the seat while the desk is adding one), `DAY_CLOSED` (Business day just closed), `TIMEZONE_EDGE` (Midnight / business-day boundary (Asia/Baghdad)), `OWED_CHANGED` (What a student / seat / entry owes changed while the payment pane was open), `SHIFT_NOT_OPEN` (Till shift state edge)

- [ ] `SECOND_BRANCH` P1 · Open a match id from another branch **Expect:** That open match isn’t at this branch. with Back to Today `OP.MATCH.02`
- [ ] `OFFLINE` P1 · Go offline with the match open **Expect:** Last updated <time>; every write disabled with the connection reason; Copy invite link still works `OP.MATCH.05`
- [ ] `ARABIC_RTL` P2 · Open in Arabic **Expect:** Seat rows, money lines and history Arabic and mirrored `OP.MATCH.06`
- [ ] **Header actions, invite link and history** `CONCURRENT_EDIT` P1 · Cancel a match that booked meanwhile **Expect:** This match isn’t filling any more. A booked match is changed from its booking. with Open booking `OP.MATCH.HEADER.04`
- [ ] **Seat rows and attendance** `CONCURRENT_EDIT` P2 · Mark a no-show where someone took the seat since **Expect:** Someone has taken this seat since, so the no-show stays. `OP.MATCH.ATTENDANCE.05`
- [ ] **Requests (ask to join)** `EMPTY_DATA` P2 · Open with no requests **Expect:** No requests waiting. `OP.MATCH.REQUESTS.03`
- [ ] **Requests (ask to join)** `SEAT_RACE` P1 · Accept a request after the match filled **Expect:** Refused with No seat is free in this match. `OP.MATCH.REQUESTS.05`
- [ ] **Add a player** `SEAT_RACE` Add while an app user takes the last seat **Expect:** No seat is free in this match. `OP.MATCH.ADD_PLAYER.03`
- [ ] **Seat rows and attendance** `DAY_CLOSED` P1 · Mark a no-show on a closed day **Expect:** The day of this game is closed… `OP.MATCH.ATTENDANCE.04`
- [ ] **Seat rows and attendance** `TIMEZONE_EDGE` P2 · Leave players unmarked after the booking ends **Expect:** They count as arrived when the booking completes or three hours after it ends `OP.MATCH.ATTENDANCE.07`
- [ ] **Take share / Take several / group** `OWED_CHANGED` Change what a seat owes on another station, then record **Expect:** What this player owes changed to <amount>. Check before taking it. `OP.MATCH.TAKE_SHARE.05`
- [ ] **Take share / Take several / group** `SHIFT_NOT_OPEN` Take a share with no shift open **Expect:** The shift gate asks to start a shift first `OP.MATCH.TAKE_SHARE.08`

#### OP.MATCH.T12 · P0 · Open match screen: ge (2 of 2)

*Setup:* `PIN_WRONG` (Wrong or locked manager PIN), `MATCHES_OFF` (Open matches not running (online payments not live and pay at desk off, or the branch switch off)), `FLAKY_NETWORK` (Network drops on and off)

- [ ] **Write off a share** `PIN_WRONG` Enter a wrong PIN **Expect:** Incorrect PIN.; lock after repeated tries `OP.MATCH.WRITE_OFF.03`
- [ ] **Add a player** `MATCHES_OFF` P2 · Add after matches are switched off **Expect:** MATCHES_OFF line `OP.MATCH.ADD_PLAYER.08`
- [ ] **Assign money to players** `FLAKY_NETWORK` P1 · Assign two payments when the second fails **Expect:** The first stays saved, the error shows for the second `OP.MATCH.ASSIGN.06`

### OP.INSTALL: Install (Windows and macOS)

Getting the operator desktop app onto the till, desk, kitchen screen and shop PCs: the PowerShell route, the browser download, the per-user NSIS installer and the gated macOS build.

**Route:** `/download (guest site) and install-operator.ps1`

**Source:** `docs/install-runbook.md`, `apps/web/public/install-operator.ps1`, `apps/operator-shell/electron-builder.config.cjs`, `apps/operator-shell/assets/installer.nsh`, `apps/operator-shell/src/main/index.ts`

**Components:** PowerShell install command · Browser download and SmartScreen · NSIS per-user installer · macOS build · Launch on boot · Startup failure handling

#### OP.INSTALL.T01 · P0 · PowerShell install command: main flow

- [ ] On a clean Windows 10 or 11 PC, open Windows PowerShell and paste the install command **Expect:** It prints "Checking the latest version...", "Downloading Touch Padel Operator X.Y.Z (N MB)...", "Checking the download...", "Download verified.", "Installing...", then "Done. Touch Padel Operator X.Y.Z is installed. Opening it now..." and the app opens `OP.INSTALL.PS_SCRIPT.01`
- [ ] P1 · Watch for an administrator prompt during the PowerShell install **Expect:** No UAC prompt appears; the app lands under %LOCALAPPDATA%\Programs\Touch Padel Operator `OP.INSTALL.PS_SCRIPT.02`
- [ ] Set TP_INSTALL_DRY_RUN=1 and TP_INSTALL_TAMPER_TEST=1, then run the command **Expect:** It prints "TAMPER TEST: appending one byte to the download.", then "The download does not match the release feed (sha512 mismatch), so it was deleted and nothing was installed." and stops; the temp file is gone and nothing is installed `OP.INSTALL.PS_SCRIPT.04`
- [ ] P2 · Run with TP_INSTALL_DRY_RUN=1 only **Expect:** It prints "DRY RUN: would run: ... /S /currentuser" and "DRY RUN OK: Touch Padel Operator X.Y.Z downloaded and verified." and installs nothing `OP.INSTALL.PS_SCRIPT.05`
- [ ] P2 · Set "Choose where to get apps" to Recommendations (warn me), then run the command **Expect:** A yellow heads-up "Windows may ask once about installing an app from outside the Store. Click "Install anyway"." and the install continues `OP.INSTALL.PS_SCRIPT.08`
- [ ] P1 · Run the command a second time on an installed and configured station **Expect:** The installer replaces the app in place; the app opens to sign-in as the same station (no setup screen), queue.db intact `OP.INSTALL.PS_SCRIPT.13`

#### OP.INSTALL.T02 · P1 · Browser download and SmartScreen: main flow

- [ ] Click the Windows download button on /download **Expect:** Touch-Padel-Operator-Setup.exe downloads from github.com/KaguSoftware/touchpadel-releases/releases/latest/download and is the newest published version `OP.INSTALL.BROWSER_DOWNLOAD.01`
- [ ] After the first signed release, run Get-AuthenticodeSignature on the downloaded Setup.exe **Expect:** Status is Valid and SignerCertificate names the publisher; only then flip SHOW_SMARTSCREEN_NOTE to false, and only once a fresh browser download shows no warning `OP.INSTALL.BROWSER_DOWNLOAD.04`
- [ ] Install from the same Setup.exe on a 32-bit Windows 10 **Expect:** The installer picks the ia32 build by itself and the app starts `OP.INSTALL.BROWSER_DOWNLOAD.05`
- [ ] P2 · Install on Windows 10 on ARM **Expect:** The 32-bit build installs and runs `OP.INSTALL.BROWSER_DOWNLOAD.06`

#### OP.INSTALL.T03 · P0 · NSIS per-user installer: main flow

- [ ] P1 · Double-click Setup.exe **Expect:** No "just me / everyone" page and no administrator prompt; the folder page allows a change; the last page starts the app `OP.INSTALL.NSIS_INSTALLER.01`
- [ ] P2 · Look for shortcuts after install **Expect:** A desktop shortcut and a Start menu entry named Touch Padel Operator exist `OP.INSTALL.NSIS_INSTALLER.02`
- [ ] P1 · Run Setup.exe from an administrator account **Expect:** It still installs for the current user only (HKCU InstallLocation, not HKLM) `OP.INSTALL.NSIS_INSTALLER.03`
- [ ] Uninstall from Settings > Apps **Expect:** The app is removed; %APPDATA%/touch-padel-operator/queue.db and station.json remain on disk `OP.INSTALL.NSIS_INSTALLER.04`
- [ ] Reinstall after the uninstall **Expect:** The app opens straight to sign-in as the same station; Day close still lists any rows that were waiting `OP.INSTALL.NSIS_INSTALLER.05`
- [ ] P1 · On the till, finish setup and watch for the Windows Firewall prompt **Expect:** Windows asks once to allow the app on private networks (port 47810); allowing it lets the kitchen screen connect `OP.INSTALL.NSIS_INSTALLER.06`

#### OP.INSTALL.T04 · P1 · macOS build: main flow

- [ ] P2 · Check the release assets of the newest operator release **Expect:** If the macOS job ran: Touch-Padel-Operator-arm64.dmg, -x64.dmg, both zips, their blockmaps and latest-mac.yml are present `OP.INSTALL.MACOS.01`
- [ ] Open the arm64 dmg on an Apple silicon Mac and launch the app **Expect:** It opens without an unidentified-developer block (signed and notarized) `OP.INSTALL.MACOS.02`
- [ ] P2 · Open the x64 dmg on an Intel Mac **Expect:** The app launches and better-sqlite3 loads (no startup error dialog) `OP.INSTALL.MACOS.03`

#### OP.INSTALL.T05 · P1 · Startup failure handling: main flow

- [ ] Force a boot failure (for example a better-sqlite3 built for the wrong ABI on a test machine) and launch **Expect:** A dialog titled "Touch Padel Operator could not start" shows the error and "Saved to <userData>/startup-error.log"; the app exits `OP.INSTALL.STARTUP_FAILURE.01`
- [ ] P2 · After that failure, click the shortcut again **Expect:** A new instance starts (the single-instance lock was released by the exit) `OP.INSTALL.STARTUP_FAILURE.02`
- [ ] Build locally without VITE_SUPABASE_URL and VITE_SUPABASE_ANON_KEY and launch **Expect:** The renderer refuses to start instead of silently pointing at localhost `OP.INSTALL.STARTUP_FAILURE.03`
- [ ] Check the sidebar version line on every venue machine **Expect:** It shows a tagged X.Y.Z, never a dev build pointed at a localhost guest site `OP.INSTALL.STARTUP_FAILURE.04`

#### OP.INSTALL.T06 · P0 · Install (Windows and macOS): other parts

- [ ] **Whole page** P1 · Open https://<guest-site>/download on a laptop **Expect:** The page shows the PowerShell command with a copy button and the Windows download button as the fallback `OP.INSTALL.01`
- [ ] **Whole page** P1 · Install on each of the three venue machines (till, desk, kitchen screen) and the shop PC, then record station id and the sidebar version line in the venue sheet **Expect:** Every machine shows the same "Version X.Y.Z" line and a distinct station id `OP.INSTALL.02`
- [ ] **Launch on boot** Restart a configured packaged station **Expect:** The app starts by itself at Windows login, kiosked, with no Task Scheduler entry `OP.INSTALL.LOGIN_ITEM.01`
- [ ] **Launch on boot** P2 · Run an unpackaged dev build **Expect:** No login item is registered `OP.INSTALL.LOGIN_ITEM.03`

#### OP.INSTALL.T07 · P1 · Install (Windows and macOS): Unsigned build on Windows

*Setup:* `SMARTSCREEN` (Unsigned build on Windows)

- [ ] **PowerShell install command** P2 · Watch for a SmartScreen prompt on the PowerShell route with an unsigned release **Expect:** No SmartScreen prompt: a PowerShell download carries no Mark of the Web `OP.INSTALL.PS_SCRIPT.03`
- [ ] **Browser download and SmartScreen** Run the downloaded installer while releases are unsigned **Expect:** "Windows protected your PC" appears; More info then Run anyway installs the app `OP.INSTALL.BROWSER_DOWNLOAD.02`
- [ ] **Browser download and SmartScreen** P2 · Download the installer in Edge while unsigned **Expect:** Edge warns the file is not commonly downloaded; ... then Keep then Keep anyway keeps it and it runs `OP.INSTALL.BROWSER_DOWNLOAD.03`

#### OP.INSTALL.T08 · P0 · Install (Windows and macOS): ge

*Setup:* `STORE_ONLY` (Windows set to Microsoft Store apps only), `ALL_USERS_INSTALL` (Old all-users install present), `APP_KILLED_MIDFLOW` (Station app closed or power cut mid-flow), `OFFLINE` (No internet), `S_MODE` (Windows in S mode), `OLD_APP_VERSION` (Station build older than the server), `LAN_PEER_DOWN` (Café cashier (LAN peer) unreachable), `ROLLBACK` (Older version installed over a newer one), `FEATURE_FLAG_OFF` (A feature switched off)

- [ ] **PowerShell install command** `STORE_ONLY` P1 · Set Windows "Choose where to get apps" to Microsoft Store only, then run the command **Expect:** Red text "Windows is set to install apps from the Microsoft Store only, which blocks this installer." with the Windows 10 and Windows 11 settings paths; nothing is installed `OP.INSTALL.PS_SCRIPT.06`
- [ ] **PowerShell install command** `STORE_ONLY` P2 · With the SmartScreen policy ConfigureAppInstallControl set to StoreOnly by IT policy, run the command **Expect:** Red text "This PC only allows apps from the Microsoft Store, and an administrator or IT policy sets that." and nothing is installed `OP.INSTALL.PS_SCRIPT.07`
- [ ] **PowerShell install command** `ALL_USERS_INSTALL` P1 · On a PC with an existing all-users install, run the command **Expect:** Red text "An all-users copy of Touch Padel Operator is already installed on this PC." plus the uninstall steps and "Your till data is kept (queue.db and station.json in %APPDATA%)."; nothing is installed `OP.INSTALL.PS_SCRIPT.09`
- [ ] **PowerShell install command** `APP_KILLED_MIDFLOW` Run the command while the operator app is open with queued rows (WAN unplugged on the till first, then reconnect only the laptop doing the download) **Expect:** Yellow "The operator app is running: it will close and reopen during the install."; after the install the app reopens on the new version and the queued count is unchanged `OP.INSTALL.PS_SCRIPT.10`
- [ ] **Launch on boot** `APP_KILLED_MIDFLOW` Cut power to the till mid-service, restore it **Expect:** Windows boots, the app auto-launches, and the queued count matches what it was before the cut `OP.INSTALL.LOGIN_ITEM.02`
- [ ] **PowerShell install command** `OFFLINE` P2 · Run the command on a PC with no internet **Expect:** The script stops with an error message in red; nothing is installed and no half-installed app remains `OP.INSTALL.PS_SCRIPT.11`
- [ ] **PowerShell install command** `S_MODE` P2 · Run the command on Windows in S mode **Expect:** PowerShell is blocked by Windows; the runbook path (Switch out of S mode) is the only fix `OP.INSTALL.PS_SCRIPT.12`
- [ ] **Browser download and SmartScreen** `OLD_APP_VERSION` P2 · On 32-bit Windows, run an installer older than operator-v0.2.21 **Expect:** "This app can't run on your PC"; downloading again from the stable link fixes it `OP.INSTALL.BROWSER_DOWNLOAD.07`
- [ ] **NSIS per-user installer** `LAN_PEER_DOWN` P1 · Deny the firewall prompt on the till, then pull the WAN **Expect:** The kitchen screen cannot reach the till; its LAN board stays on "Offline - waiting for tickets from the cafe cashier over the local network." `OP.INSTALL.NSIS_INSTALLER.07`
- [ ] **NSIS per-user installer** `ROLLBACK` P1 · Run an older Setup.exe over a newer installed version **Expect:** It replaces the app in place; station.json and queue.db are kept `OP.INSTALL.NSIS_INSTALLER.08`
- [ ] **macOS build** `FEATURE_FLAG_OFF` P2 · With the Apple secrets absent, push a tag **Expect:** The macos job is skipped, publish still runs, and no mac assets are attached `OP.INSTALL.MACOS.04`

### OP.RELEASE: Operator release tag flow and code signing

Cutting an operator release: the CI gate, version stamping, Windows signing (Azure, eSigner or PFX), the gated macOS build and publishing to KaguSoftware/touchpadel-releases, which is also the auto-update feed.

**Route:** `.github/workflows/operator-release.yml (tag operator-vX.Y.Z)`

**Source:** `.github/workflows/operator-release.yml`, `apps/operator-shell/electron-builder.config.cjs`, `apps/operator-shell/scripts/sign-win.cjs`, `apps/operator-shell/scripts/notarize-mac.cjs`, `docs/install-runbook.md`

**Components:** CI gate on the tagged commit · Prepare: version, credentials, draft · Windows build, signing and proof · macOS build and notarization · Publish to the public releases repo · Version visible on stations

#### OP.RELEASE.T01 · P1 · Prepare: version, credentials, draft: main flow

- [ ] Push the tag operator-v0.3 (not semver) **Expect:** prepare fails "operator-v0.3 is not operator-v<semver> (e.g. operator-v0.2.0)" `OP.RELEASE.PREPARE.01`
- [ ] P2 · Push a prerelease tag operator-vX.Y.Z-beta.1 **Expect:** It is accepted and published as an ordinary release; a station on it still takes X.Y.Z at its next start `OP.RELEASE.PREPARE.02`
- [ ] Read the prepare log **Expect:** A notice "windows signing: <azure|esigner|pfx|unsigned> - macOS build: <true|false>" names the route taken `OP.RELEASE.PREPARE.05`
- [ ] P2 · Re-run the workflow for a version whose draft already exists **Expect:** The log says "release vX.Y.Z already exists - reusing it" `OP.RELEASE.PREPARE.07`

#### OP.RELEASE.T02 · P0 · Windows build, signing and proof: main flow

- [ ] P2 · After a release, check main for changes to apps/operator-shell/package.json **Expect:** No commit: the version is stamped only inside the job `OP.RELEASE.WIN_BUILD_SIGN.01`
- [ ] P1 · Read the "Rebuild better-sqlite3 for Electron (and prove it loads)" step **Expect:** It passes; a wrong ABI fails the job before anything is published `OP.RELEASE.WIN_BUILD_SIGN.02`
- [ ] On a signed release, read "Prove the Windows build is signed" **Expect:** Touch-Padel-Operator-Setup.exe, win-unpacked and win-ia32-unpacked Touch Padel Operator.exe each print Valid by <subject>; any NotSigned or HashMismatch fails the job `OP.RELEASE.WIN_BUILD_SIGN.03`
- [ ] On a signed release with WIN_SIGN_PUBLISHER_NAME, open win-unpacked/resources/app-update.yml from the artifact **Expect:** It contains publisherName `OP.RELEASE.WIN_BUILD_SIGN.04`
- [ ] P1 · Take the eSigner route with a CodeSignTool zip whose sha256 does not match **Expect:** The step fails "CodeSignTool zip sha256 mismatch" `OP.RELEASE.WIN_BUILD_SIGN.05`
- [ ] P2 · Open the run's artifacts **Expect:** operator-windows-X.Y.Z holds the exe, the yml files and the blockmap, kept 14 days `OP.RELEASE.WIN_BUILD_SIGN.07`

#### OP.RELEASE.T03 · P0 · Publish to the public releases repo: main flow

- [ ] Read the publish job of a successful run **Expect:** It lists the assets and finds Touch-Padel-Operator-Setup.exe, its .blockmap and latest.yml (and the mac set when built) `OP.RELEASE.PUBLISH.01`
- [ ] P1 · Delete one asset from the draft and re-run publish **Expect:** It fails "<file> is missing from release vX.Y.Z - not publishing" and the release stays draft `OP.RELEASE.PUBLISH.02`
- [ ] P1 · After publish, open the stable link releases/latest/download/Touch-Padel-Operator-Setup.exe **Expect:** It downloads the new version `OP.RELEASE.PUBLISH.03`
- [ ] Download latest.yml and the exe; compare sha512 **Expect:** The base64 sha512 in latest.yml matches the exe (the PowerShell script checks exactly this) `OP.RELEASE.PUBLISH.04`

#### OP.RELEASE.T04 · P1 · Operator release tag flow and code signing: other parts

- [ ] **Whole page** Push tag operator-vX.Y.Z on a commit that is on main **Expect:** The operator-release run starts with jobs gate, prepare, windows, macos (or skipped) and publish `OP.RELEASE.01`
- [ ] **CI gate on the tagged commit** Tag a commit whose ci.yml run is green **Expect:** The gate logs "CI is green on <sha8>." and prepare starts `OP.RELEASE.TAG_GATE.01`
- [ ] **CI gate on the tagged commit** P2 · Tag a commit while its CI is still running **Expect:** The gate polls every 30 s (up to 90 times) and continues once CI goes green, or fails "gave up waiting for CI" `OP.RELEASE.TAG_GATE.03`
- [ ] **macOS build and notarization** With all four Apple secrets set, push a tag **Expect:** The macos job imports the identity ("security find-identity" lists it), builds, notarizes and publishes dmg and zip per arch `OP.RELEASE.MAC_BUILD.01`
- [ ] **Version visible on stations** After an update, read the sidebar version line **Expect:** It reads "Version X.Y.Z" matching the tag `OP.RELEASE.VERSION_STAMP.01`
- [ ] **Version visible on stations** Open Settings > Devices as the owner after the update **Expect:** The station's Version column shows X.Y.Z within one heartbeat (10 s) `OP.RELEASE.VERSION_STAMP.02`

#### OP.RELEASE.T05 · P0 · Operator release tag flow and code signing: ge

*Setup:* `CI_RED` (Tagged commit has no green CI), `SECRET_MISSING` (Release secrets missing), `UNSIGNED_BUILD` (No Windows signing credentials), `MAC_SECRETS_MISSING` (Apple signing secrets missing), `ROLLBACK` (Older version installed over a newer one), `OFFLINE` (No internet)

- [ ] **CI gate on the tagged commit** `CI_RED` Tag a commit whose ci.yml run failed **Expect:** The gate fails with "No green CI ... Tag a commit CI passed." and nothing is built or published `OP.RELEASE.TAG_GATE.02`
- [ ] **Prepare: version, credentials, draft** `SECRET_MISSING` Remove OPERATOR_SUPABASE_URL (in a fork or test repo) and push a tag **Expect:** prepare fails "OPERATOR_SUPABASE_URL / OPERATOR_SUPABASE_ANON_KEY are missing"; nothing is published `OP.RELEASE.PREPARE.03`
- [ ] **Prepare: version, credentials, draft** `SECRET_MISSING` P1 · Push a tag with RELEASES_GH_TOKEN missing **Expect:** prepare fails "RELEASES_GH_TOKEN is missing" `OP.RELEASE.PREPARE.04`
- [ ] **Prepare: version, credentials, draft** `UNSIGNED_BUILD` Set WIN_SIGN_PUBLISHER_NAME with no signing credentials, push a tag **Expect:** prepare fails: "An unsigned release would be refused by every installed station's updater." `OP.RELEASE.PREPARE.06`
- [ ] **Windows build, signing and proof** `UNSIGNED_BUILD` P1 · Take the unsigned route (no credentials, no publisher name) **Expect:** The installer is published without the proof step and SmartScreen warns on browser downloads `OP.RELEASE.WIN_BUILD_SIGN.06`
- [ ] **macOS build and notarization** `MAC_SECRETS_MISSING` P2 · With one Apple secret missing, push a tag **Expect:** macos is skipped and publish still flips the release to latest `OP.RELEASE.MAC_BUILD.02`
- [ ] **Publish to the public releases repo** `ROLLBACK` P1 · Try to re-publish an already used version number from a different commit **Expect:** Do not: a station that ran that version will never install it at a start; publish a higher version instead `OP.RELEASE.PUBLISH.05`
- [ ] **Version visible on stations** `OFFLINE` P2 · Boot a station right after an update while offline **Expect:** It does not paint data restored from the previous version's cache shape (PERSIST_BUSTER changes with the version); screens load from ref_cache or show their loading state `OP.RELEASE.VERSION_STAMP.03`

### OP.FIRST_RUN: First run station setup

Turns a fresh install into a till, desk, kitchen screen or shop desk: writes station.json once, mints the till pairing code, finds the till on the LAN for a kitchen screen, then relaunches kiosked.

**Route:** `Station setup screen (shown when station.json is missing)`

**Source:** `apps/operator/src/features/setup/StationSetupScreen.tsx`, `apps/operator/src/features/setup/StationSetupContainer.tsx`, `apps/operator/src/features/setup/stationSetup.ts`, `apps/operator-shell/src/main/first-run.ts`, `apps/operator-shell/src/main/pairing-code.ts`, `apps/operator-shell/src/main/lan-discover.ts`, `apps/operator-shell/src/main/station.ts`

**Components:** Mode choice · Station name field · Till, desk and shop save and relaunch · Kitchen screen pairing code and till discovery · Scripted and manual station identity

#### OP.FIRST_RUN.T01 · P2 · Mode choice: main flow

- [ ] Read the four mode cards **Expect:** Cafe cashier, Desk, Kitchen screen and Touch Shop desk each show their lead line `OP.FIRST_RUN.MODE_PICK.01`
- [ ] Pick Cafe cashier **Expect:** The details step suggests station name TILL-01 `OP.FIRST_RUN.MODE_PICK.02`
- [ ] Pick Desk, Kitchen screen and Touch Shop desk in turn **Expect:** They suggest DESK-01, KDS-01 and SHOP-01 `OP.FIRST_RUN.MODE_PICK.03`
- [ ] From the details step press Back **Expect:** It returns to the mode choice `OP.FIRST_RUN.MODE_PICK.04`

#### OP.FIRST_RUN.T02 · P1 · Station name field: main flow

- [ ] Type "till 02" in Station name **Expect:** It becomes "TILL-02" as you type `OP.FIRST_RUN.STATION_NAME.01`
- [ ] Type "2TILL" **Expect:** The field shows "Use capitals, digits and dashes, starting with a letter." and Finish setup does nothing `OP.FIRST_RUN.STATION_NAME.02`
- [ ] P2 · Type a name longer than 32 characters **Expect:** It is cut to 32 characters `OP.FIRST_RUN.STATION_NAME.03`

#### OP.FIRST_RUN.T03 · P0 · Till, desk and shop save and relaunch: main flow

- [ ] Pick Cafe cashier, keep TILL-01, press Finish setup **Expect:** "Saving and restarting..." shows, the app relaunches kiosked to sign-in, and station.json holds station_id TILL-01, mode till and a 10-character lan_psk `OP.FIRST_RUN.TILL_SAVE.01`
- [ ] P1 · Pick Desk and finish **Expect:** station.json has mode desk and no lan_psk; the app relaunches kiosked `OP.FIRST_RUN.TILL_SAVE.02`
- [ ] P1 · Pick Touch Shop desk and finish **Expect:** station.json has mode shop; after sign-in the supplier price crawler may run here only `OP.FIRST_RUN.TILL_SAVE.03`
- [ ] P2 · Make %APPDATA%/touch-padel-operator read-only, then press Finish setup **Expect:** The failed step shows "The station could not be saved." with Try again and Back `OP.FIRST_RUN.TILL_SAVE.04`
- [ ] P1 · Create station.json by hand while the setup screen is open, then press Finish setup **Expect:** "This station is already set up. Restart the app." and Try again does nothing `OP.FIRST_RUN.TILL_SAVE.05`

#### OP.FIRST_RUN.T04 · P0 · Kitchen screen pairing code and till discovery: main flow

- [ ] P1 · Type the code with lowercase letters, a dash, an O and an I **Expect:** It is normalised to uppercase, the dash dropped, O becomes 0 and I or L become 1, cut at 10 characters `OP.FIRST_RUN.KDS_PAIRING.02`
