### OP.PIN: PIN sign-in, idle lock and offline PIN cache

How staff PINs authorise on a station: online verification inside the RPCs, the scrypt offline cache in main fed only by online successes, the idle lock, and what a queued PIN-gated write carries.

**Route:** `Idle lock overlay, PIN prompts on the till, pin-cache in main` · **Roles:** cashier, court_desk, manager, owner

**Source:** `apps/operator-shell/src/main/pin-cache.ts`, `apps/operator-shell/src/main/secret-store.ts`, `apps/operator-shell/src/main/queue.ts`, `apps/operator/src/routes/__root.tsx`, `apps/operator/src/features/till/ManagerActions.tsx`, `apps/operator/src/features/till/TabDetailPanel.tsx`, `packages/db/supabase/functions/_shared/redact.ts`

**Components:** Offline PIN cache (main process) · PIN-gated writes queued offline · PIN redaction and encryption at rest · Idle lock (SessionLockScreen)

#### OP.PIN.T01 · P1 · Idle lock (SessionLockScreen): main flow

- [ ] Leave the till untouched past the idle timeout **Expect:** The lock card appears over the screen; the basket and selected tab are kept underneath `OP.PIN.IDLE_LOCK.01`
- [ ] Unlock with your own PIN **Expect:** The card closes and you continue where you were `OP.PIN.IDLE_LOCK.02`
- [ ] P2 · Press Unlock with an empty field **Expect:** The field says to type the PIN first and focus returns to it `OP.PIN.IDLE_LOCK.03`
- [ ] Unlock with someone else's PIN **Expect:** "Incorrect PIN." and the field clears `OP.PIN.IDLE_LOCK.04`
- [ ] P2 · Unlock as an account with no PIN **Expect:** The card switches to the password field and explains why `OP.PIN.IDLE_LOCK.05`
- [ ] Press Escape or click outside the lock card **Expect:** Nothing happens; the lock stays `OP.PIN.IDLE_LOCK.06`
- [ ] P2 · As a manager or owner, unlock with your own PIN online **Expect:** The PIN is cached tagged as yours, so offline you cannot use it to let yourself out of the station `OP.PIN.IDLE_LOCK.08`

#### OP.PIN.T02 · P0 · PIN sign-in, idle lock and offline PIN cache: other parts

- [ ] **Whole page** Sign in on the till while online, then perform one PIN-gated action online today (drill setup) **Expect:** The action succeeds and the PIN is now in the station cache (later offline checks accept it) `OP.PIN.01`
- [ ] **Offline PIN cache (main process)** Open queue.db in a SQLite viewer (copy of a test till) and read pin_cache and meta **Expect:** pin_cache holds only hex hashes; meta holds pin_salt_enc (ciphertext) and no plaintext pin_salt `OP.PIN.OFFLINE_CACHE.01`
- [ ] **Offline PIN cache (main process)** Copy queue.db to another Windows account or PC and try the same PINs there **Expect:** No cached PIN works (the salt does not decrypt; the cache is reset) `OP.PIN.OFFLINE_CACHE.02`
- [ ] **PIN redaction and encryption at rest** P1 · Check the updater.log, startup-error.log and console for PIN digits after a PIN-heavy session **Expect:** No PIN appears in any log `OP.PIN.PIN_REDACTION.04`

#### OP.PIN.T03 · P0 · PIN sign-in, idle lock and offline PIN cache: With no internet

*Setup:* `OFFLINE` (No internet)

- [ ] Reboot the till with the WAN unplugged **Expect:** The app opens still signed in (supabase-js restores the session from local storage) and the till trades `OP.PIN.02`
- [ ] Sign out on the till with the WAN unplugged, then try to sign in **Expect:** Sign-in fails because it needs the server; record that a signed-out till cannot be used until the connection is back `OP.PIN.03`
- [ ] **Offline PIN cache (main process)** Type a wrong PIN online in a PIN-gated dialog, then go offline and type it again where main checks the cache (Quit to desktop) **Expect:** It is refused offline too: wrong PINs are never cached (verify_manager_pin returns null and is refused before the cache learns it) `OP.PIN.OFFLINE_CACHE.04`
- [ ] **PIN-gated writes queued offline** P2 · Online, apply a discount with a valid PIN, then go offline and use Quit to desktop with that same PIN while signed in as someone else **Expect:** Refused as "Incorrect PIN.": a PIN cached from a till write has no owner on file, and a signed-in exit needs a known, different owner `OP.PIN.PIN_GATED_OFFLINE.05`
- [ ] **PIN redaction and encryption at rest** Queue a PIN refund offline, then open a copy of queue.db **Expect:** The mutation_queue row has payload_enc = 1 and the payload column is ciphertext; the PIN is not readable `OP.PIN.PIN_REDACTION.01`
- [ ] **Idle lock (SessionLockScreen)** Unplug the WAN, let the lock trip, then type your own correct PIN **Expect:** Expected: the till unlocks. Note the code calls verify_own_pin and the password path over the network with no offline branch, so record whether the cashier is stuck behind the lock until the connection returns `OP.PIN.IDLE_LOCK.07`

#### OP.PIN.T04 · P0 · PIN sign-in, idle lock and offline PIN cache: Coming back online

*Setup:* `OFFLINE_THEN_RECONNECT` (Offline, then back online)

- [ ] **PIN-gated writes queued offline** WAN unplugged: apply a PIN discount on a server tab with a valid manager PIN **Expect:** The discount is accepted as queued; after reconnect it lands once with its authoriser and reason in the audit log `OP.PIN.PIN_GATED_OFFLINE.01`
- [ ] **PIN-gated writes queued offline** WAN unplugged: apply a PIN discount with a WRONG PIN **Expect:** Note: the renderer does not check the offline cache for these writes (touch.unlockPin is never called), so it is queued; after reconnect the row fails with PIN_INVALID, a toast "Discount did not sync - Incorrect PIN." appears and Day close lists it as failed `OP.PIN.PIN_GATED_OFFLINE.02`
- [ ] **PIN-gated writes queued offline** After that wrong-PIN replay, check the tab total on the server **Expect:** No discount was applied `OP.PIN.PIN_GATED_OFFLINE.03`
- [ ] **PIN-gated writes queued offline** P1 · Queue several wrong-PIN discounts offline, reconnect **Expect:** Each fails PIN_INVALID; once the station lockout trips the rest fail PIN_LOCKED ("Too many wrong PINs - locked for a few minutes.") and stay failed (not retried) `OP.PIN.PIN_GATED_OFFLINE.04`
- [ ] **PIN redaction and encryption at rest** Reconnect, then read the sync_replays row for that key (SQL editor) **Expect:** conflict_detail or the echo shows pin as "[redacted]" `OP.PIN.PIN_REDACTION.02`
- [ ] **PIN redaction and encryption at rest** P1 · Make a wrong-PIN refund replay fail, then read the Day close row and the toast **Expect:** Neither shows the PIN; the row shows the write word, state and the code `OP.PIN.PIN_REDACTION.03`

#### OP.PIN.T05 · P1 · PIN sign-in, idle lock and offline PIN cache: ge

*Setup:* `PIN_CACHE_STALE` (Cached PIN older than 14 days), `QUEUE_ENCRYPTION_UNAVAILABLE` (OS encryption (safeStorage) unavailable), `SHIFT_NOT_OPEN` (Till shift state edge)

- [ ] **Offline PIN cache (main process)** `PIN_CACHE_STALE` Use a manager PIN offline whose last online success was more than 14 days ago (move the PC clock or wait) **Expect:** It is refused offline (stale) until it is used online again `OP.PIN.OFFLINE_CACHE.03`
- [ ] **Offline PIN cache (main process)** `QUEUE_ENCRYPTION_UNAVAILABLE` On a Linux or broken-keyring test box where safeStorage is unavailable, perform a PIN action online then try offline **Expect:** Nothing is cached; offline PIN checks fail closed and staff must authorise online `OP.PIN.OFFLINE_CACHE.05`
- [ ] **Idle lock (SessionLockScreen)** `SHIFT_NOT_OPEN` Switch user from the lock with your own till shift open on this station **Expect:** It asks first inside the card before signing you out `OP.PIN.IDLE_LOCK.09`

### OP.QUEUE: Durable offline queue

The SQLite write queue every registered mutation goes through in Electron, online or offline: fsynced before the renderer is told, encrypted at rest, ordered by seq, never deleted.

**Route:** `main process queue.db (%APPDATA%/touch-padel-operator)`

**Source:** `apps/operator-shell/src/main/queue.ts`, `apps/operator-shell/src/main/ipc-validate.ts`, `apps/operator-shell/src/main/index.ts`, `apps/operator/src/lib/mutate.ts`, `apps/operator/src/lib/idem.ts`

**Components:** Enqueue · Row states · queue.db schema upgrades · Unreadable queued payload · Crash and power-cut recovery

#### OP.QUEUE.T01 · P1 · Enqueue: main flow

- [ ] Inspect PRAGMA journal_mode and synchronous on queue.db **Expect:** WAL and FULL (2) `OP.QUEUE.ENQUEUE.02`
- [ ] Check the idempotency_key and local_id of a new row **Expect:** key is {STATION}:{mutation_type}:{26-char Crockford ULID}; local_id is {STATION}-{ULID} `OP.QUEUE.ENQUEUE.03`
- [ ] Send a mutation from dev tools with a key whose station differs from deviceId **Expect:** The bridge returns {error: "invalid IPC payload: idempotencyKey and deviceId disagree on the station"} and nothing is stored `OP.QUEUE.ENQUEUE.06`
- [ ] P2 · Send a mutation with a payload larger than 256 KB **Expect:** Refused "invalid IPC payload: payload is too large" `OP.QUEUE.ENQUEUE.07`
- [ ] Send a mutation of an unknown type (for example "merge.tabs") **Expect:** Refused "unknown mutationType" `OP.QUEUE.ENQUEUE.08`

#### OP.QUEUE.T02 · P1 · Durable offline queue: other parts

- [ ] **Whole page** Do one sale online on a packaged till and open a copy of queue.db **Expect:** The order and settle rows exist in mutation_queue with state acked and a server_result `OP.QUEUE.01`
- [ ] **Row states** Try to resolve a pending row (dev tools resolveQueueRow on a pending key) **Expect:** Refused "not-resolvable"; only conflict and failed rows can be dismissed `OP.QUEUE.ROW_STATES.04`

#### OP.QUEUE.T03 · P0 · Durable offline queue: Station app closed or power cut mid-flow

*Setup:* `APP_KILLED_MIDFLOW` (Station app closed or power cut mid-flow)

- [ ] **Enqueue** Send an order offline and immediately cut power **Expect:** After reboot the order is in the queue (it was fsynced before the till showed it as sent) `OP.QUEUE.ENQUEUE.01`
- [ ] **Crash and power-cut recovery** Online with a slow link, press Send then pull power while the row is Sending **Expect:** After reboot the row is re-sent first and the order exists exactly once on the server `OP.QUEUE.KILL_RECOVERY.01`
- [ ] **Crash and power-cut recovery** Kill the app from Task Manager with 10 rows queued offline, relaunch **Expect:** All 10 rows are still pending in the same order `OP.QUEUE.KILL_RECOVERY.02`
- [ ] **Crash and power-cut recovery** Drill step 10-11: fill a basket, press Send, yank power, power on with no WAN **Expect:** Offline tabs are back on the floor plan; the queued count matches before the cut; nothing confirmed is missing and nothing unconfirmed appears `OP.QUEUE.KILL_RECOVERY.03`
- [ ] **Crash and power-cut recovery** P1 · Close the app with Quit to desktop while a POST is in flight **Expect:** The POST is cut and the row goes back to pending for the next start `OP.QUEUE.KILL_RECOVERY.04`

#### OP.QUEUE.T04 · P0 · Durable offline queue: ge

*Setup:* `QUEUE_ENCRYPTION_UNAVAILABLE` (OS encryption (safeStorage) unavailable), `NOT_SIGNED_IN` (No session), `OFFLINE` (No internet), `OFFLINE_THEN_RECONNECT` (Offline, then back online), `REPLAY_TERMINAL` (Replay answered a deterministic 4xx), `OLD_APP_VERSION` (Station build older than the server), `ROLLBACK` (Older version installed over a newer one), `PAYLOAD_UNREADABLE` (Queued payload cannot be decrypted)

- [ ] **Enqueue** `QUEUE_ENCRYPTION_UNAVAILABLE` On a box where safeStorage encryption is unavailable, try to send an order **Expect:** The write is refused with an error ("offline queue unavailable: this machine cannot encrypt at rest") and no row is written `OP.QUEUE.ENQUEUE.04`
- [ ] **Enqueue** `NOT_SIGNED_IN` P1 · With the till signed out (no staff), try to send an order through a stale screen **Expect:** mutate refuses with AUTH_REQUIRED; nothing is queued `OP.QUEUE.ENQUEUE.05`
- [ ] **Row states** `OFFLINE` P1 · Queue 5 writes offline and read queue state counts (Day close, step 2) **Expect:** All 5 are "Waiting to send" (pending); none inflight once the worker has backed off `OP.QUEUE.ROW_STATES.01`
- [ ] **Row states** `OFFLINE_THEN_RECONNECT` Reconnect and watch the rows **Expect:** Each passes "Sending" then leaves the list as acked, strictly oldest first `OP.QUEUE.ROW_STATES.02`
- [ ] **Row states** `REPLAY_TERMINAL` P1 · Dismiss a failed row from Day close, then read it in queue.db **Expect:** The row is still there with state resolved, resolved_by the manager's staff id and resolved_at `OP.QUEUE.ROW_STATES.03`
- [ ] **queue.db schema upgrades** `OLD_APP_VERSION` Update a station that has queued rows from an older version (offline, then install the new build, then reconnect) **Expect:** The rows replay after the upgrade; user_version reads 6 `OP.QUEUE.SCHEMA_MIGRATION.01`
- [ ] **queue.db schema upgrades** `OLD_APP_VERSION` P1 · Open a pre-v4 queue that has plaintext payloads **Expect:** Those rows (payload_enc 0) still replay; new rows are encrypted `OP.QUEUE.SCHEMA_MIGRATION.02`
- [ ] **queue.db schema upgrades** `ROLLBACK` P1 · Roll back to an older version with a v6 queue.db **Expect:** The older app opens the queue without crashing and keeps replaying (columns are additive) `OP.QUEUE.SCHEMA_MIGRATION.03`
- [ ] **Unreadable queued payload** `PAYLOAD_UNREADABLE` Queue writes offline, then move queue.db to another Windows account and start the app there **Expect:** Those rows show in Day close as failed with "queued payload cannot be decrypted (<key>)"; later rows still replay `OP.QUEUE.UNREADABLE_PAYLOAD.01`
- [ ] **Unreadable queued payload** `PAYLOAD_UNREADABLE` Try to close the day with such a row **Expect:** Close is blocked until a manager dismisses the row with a PIN `OP.QUEUE.UNREADABLE_PAYLOAD.02`

### OP.SYNC: Sync worker and replay

Drains the queue strictly by seq, one row at a time, as the staff session the renderer pushed; maps every answer to ack, conflict, failed, retry or pause.

**Route:** `main process sync-worker.ts -> POST /functions/v1/replay`

**Source:** `apps/operator-shell/src/main/sync-worker.ts`, `apps/operator-shell/src/main/auth-state.ts`, `apps/operator-shell/src/main/queue.ts`, `packages/db/supabase/functions/replay/index.ts`

**Components:** Strict order and exactly-once · Answer map: retryable vs terminal · Replay authentication · Branch scope on replay

#### OP.SYNC.T01 · P1 · Sync worker and replay: other parts

- [ ] With the till online, send an order and time it **Expect:** It is acked in under a second and the screen shows the server result (no queued state) `OP.SYNC.01`

#### OP.SYNC.T02 · P0 · Sync worker and replay: Coming back online

*Setup:* `OFFLINE_THEN_RECONNECT` (Offline, then back online)

- [ ] **Strict order and exactly-once** Offline: open a tab, add items, settle it; reconnect **Expect:** The tab, its order and its payment appear on the server exactly once, in that order (open before order before settle) `OP.SYNC.ORDERING.01`
- [ ] **Strict order and exactly-once** Drill step 13: reconnect with 20+ queued rows **Expect:** The banner clears within about 45 s, the waiting count drains to 0, and each sale appears once in /till or the database `OP.SYNC.ORDERING.03`
- [ ] **Strict order and exactly-once** Check stock after replaying offline sales (drill step 14) **Expect:** One deduction per item sold `OP.SYNC.ORDERING.04`
- [ ] **Answer map: retryable vs terminal** P1 · Keep the till offline for an hour with rows queued, then reconnect **Expect:** Replay starts within the next 30 s backoff window or at once on the first successful beat; no row is marked failed by the outage itself `OP.SYNC.OUTCOMES.08`
- [ ] **Replay authentication** P1 · Queue rows as cashier A offline, sign out A, sign in B, reconnect **Expect:** Rows replay with B's session but stay attributed to A (staff_id A) in the audit `OP.SYNC.AUTH_PAUSE.04`

#### OP.SYNC.T03 · P0 · Sync worker and replay: Flaky or slow network, backend down

*Setup:* `FLAKY_NETWORK` (Network drops on and off), `BACKEND_DOWN` (Server unreachable while the LAN is up), `SLOW_NETWORK` (Slow network)

- [ ] **Strict order and exactly-once** `FLAKY_NETWORK` Force a re-send of an already applied row (lose the 200 by cutting the WAN right after it is sent) **Expect:** The replay answers duplicate with the stored result and the row is acked; no second order or payment exists `OP.SYNC.ORDERING.02`
- [ ] **Answer map: retryable vs terminal** `BACKEND_DOWN` Make the replay endpoint return 503 RETRY_LATER (or block it at the firewall) for a while **Expect:** Rows stay "Waiting to send" with backoff 1 s doubling to 30 s, then send once it answers; nothing is marked failed or conflict `OP.SYNC.OUTCOMES.04`
- [ ] **Answer map: retryable vs terminal** `SLOW_NETWORK` P1 · Hold a replay request open longer than 20 s (slow proxy) **Expect:** The POST is cut at 20 s, the row returns to pending and is sent again `OP.SYNC.OUTCOMES.06`

#### OP.SYNC.T04 · P0 · Sync worker and replay: ge

*Setup:* `REPLAY_CONFLICT` (Replay answered 409 (slot taken) or a duplicate of a refusal), `REPLAY_TERMINAL` (Replay answered a deterministic 4xx), `STAFF_DEACTIVATED` (Staff access removed), `OLD_APP_VERSION` (Station build older than the server), `SESSION_EXPIRED` (Staff session expired), `AUTH_TOKEN_REJECTED` (Replay answers 401 to the pushed token), `SIGNED_OUT_QUEUE` (Rows queued but nobody signed in), `SECOND_BRANCH` (Two branches)

- [ ] **Answer map: retryable vs terminal** `REPLAY_CONFLICT` Queue a desk booking offline for a slot a guest then books online; reconnect **Expect:** The row becomes a conflict (409 SLOT_TAKEN), a toast "Booking did not sync - <reason>" appears, a manager alert replay_conflict is filed, and later rows keep replaying `OP.SYNC.OUTCOMES.01`
- [ ] **Answer map: retryable vs terminal** `REPLAY_TERMINAL` Queue an order offline for an item an admin then marks unavailable; reconnect **Expect:** The row fails (4xx ITEM_UNAVAILABLE), shows "Failed - will not retry" in Day close, and later rows still replay `OP.SYNC.OUTCOMES.02`
- [ ] **Answer map: retryable vs terminal** `REPLAY_TERMINAL` Make one key's first attempt end in a deterministic refusal, then re-send it **Expect:** The re-send answers duplicate with prior_result conflict and the row is marked conflict, never acked `OP.SYNC.OUTCOMES.07`
- [ ] **Answer map: retryable vs terminal** `STAFF_DEACTIVATED` P1 · Deactivate the staff member who queued rows, then reconnect **Expect:** Those rows fail with 403 "staff_id is not active staff" and are listed in Day close `OP.SYNC.OUTCOMES.03`
- [ ] **Answer map: retryable vs terminal** `OLD_APP_VERSION` P1 · Update a till ahead of its migration so replay answers 501 RPC_NOT_DEPLOYED **Expect:** The row waits and retries; it replays once the migration lands `OP.SYNC.OUTCOMES.05`
- [ ] **Replay authentication** `SESSION_EXPIRED` Leave the till offline long enough for the access token to expire, then reconnect **Expect:** supabase-js refreshes the token, the new token is pushed, and replay drains without anyone signing in again `OP.SYNC.AUTH_PAUSE.01`
- [ ] **Replay authentication** `AUTH_TOKEN_REJECTED` P1 · Revoke the till session server-side so replay answers 401 **Expect:** The strip turns red "This station can reach the server but cannot send its changes..." and no request is sent with the refused token again `OP.SYNC.AUTH_PAUSE.02`
- [ ] **Replay authentication** `AUTH_TOKEN_REJECTED` P1 · Sign in again after that 401 **Expect:** Replay resumes at once and the strip clears `OP.SYNC.AUTH_PAUSE.03`
- [ ] **Replay authentication** `SIGNED_OUT_QUEUE` P1 · Queue rows, sign out, leave the till signed out and online **Expect:** Nothing replays while nobody is signed in; the rows send on the next sign-in `OP.SYNC.AUTH_PAUSE.05`
- [ ] **Branch scope on replay** `SECOND_BRANCH` P1 · On the owner's unregistered PC with the rail on branch B, queue a write offline, switch the rail to branch A, reconnect **Expect:** The write lands at branch B (the branch shown when it was queued) `OP.SYNC.VENUE_SCOPE.01`
- [ ] **Branch scope on replay** `SECOND_BRANCH` P1 · On a registered station, queue a write offline and reconnect **Expect:** It lands at the station's own branch `OP.SYNC.VENUE_SCOPE.02`

### OP.RESULTS: Renderer write results and offline tabs

How a screen learns what happened to its write: an 8 s wait for the server echo, the queued state after that, toasts for later refusals, per-row pending marks, and tabs that exist only on this till.

**Route:** `mutate() / queueResults / offlineTabs / QueueFailureToasts` · **Roles:** cashier, court_desk, manager, owner, shop_staff

**Source:** `apps/operator/src/lib/mutate.ts`, `apps/operator/src/lib/queueResults.ts`, `apps/operator/src/lib/offlineTabs.ts`, `apps/operator/src/lib/pendingResults.ts`, `apps/operator/src/components/QueueFailureToasts.tsx`, `apps/operator/src/features/till/OfflineTabPanel.tsx`, `apps/operator/src/features/till/NewTabDialog.tsx`

**Components:** 8-second wait then queued · Did-not-sync toasts · Offline tabs on the floor plan · Per-row pending marks

#### OP.RESULTS.T01 · P0 · Renderer write results and offline tabs: money and totals

- [ ] **8-second wait then queued** Online, settle a cash tab **Expect:** The change shown is the server's change_iqd and the tab leaves the rail at once `OP.RESULTS.MUTATE_AWAIT.01`

#### OP.RESULTS.T02 · P1 · Renderer write results and offline tabs: other parts

- [ ] Online, trigger a refusal (settle a tab whose total changed, or void with a wrong PIN) **Expect:** The error shows beside the pressed control, not as a toast `OP.RESULTS.MUTATE_AWAIT.03`

*Setup:* `OFFLINE` (No internet)

- [ ] **Offline tabs on the floor plan** P1 · Open the offline tab **Expect:** It shows the lines, an "Estimated total", and only Cash and Card buttons (no discount, void or split here) `OP.RESULTS.OFFLINE_TABS.02`
- [ ] **Offline tabs on the floor plan** Pay the offline tab by cash with a tender below the estimate **Expect:** Record payment stays disabled with "The tendered amount does not cover what is due." `OP.RESULTS.OFFLINE_TABS.03`
- [ ] **Offline tabs on the floor plan** Pay the offline tab cash with enough tender **Expect:** Change is computed from the estimate; the tab stays on the plan marked "Settled - waiting to reach the server" and Cash/Card are not offered again `OP.RESULTS.OFFLINE_TABS.04`
- [ ] **Per-row pending marks** P1 · Offline, void a sent line **Expect:** The line shows "Void waiting to sync" until replay `OP.RESULTS.PENDING_ROWS.01`
- [ ] **Per-row pending marks** P1 · Offline, remove a tab from Open tabs **Expect:** The row shows "Removal waiting to sync"; after reconnect it leaves the board or shows its refusal `OP.RESULTS.PENDING_ROWS.02`
- [ ] **Per-row pending marks** Offline, refund a payment **Expect:** "Refund saved on this station. It will be recorded when the connection is back; the payments list updates then." `OP.RESULTS.PENDING_ROWS.03`
- [ ] **Per-row pending marks** Offline, take a payment on a server tab **Expect:** "Payment saved on this station. It will be recorded when the connection is back; the amount due updates then." and paying again is blocked while it is pending `OP.RESULTS.PENDING_ROWS.04`

#### OP.RESULTS.T04 · P0 · Renderer write results and offline tabs: Coming back online

*Setup:* `OFFLINE_THEN_RECONNECT` (Offline, then back online)

- [ ] **8-second wait then queued** P1 · Offline, trigger the same refusal and reconnect later **Expect:** A toast appears instead: "<write> did not sync - <reason>" (or "<write> did not sync. See the Day close screen." when there is no code) `OP.RESULTS.MUTATE_AWAIT.04`
- [ ] **Offline tabs on the floor plan** Reconnect after that settle **Expect:** The open and the settle ack, the local tab retires, and the server tab is settled for the server's full due (tax included) exactly once `OP.RESULTS.OFFLINE_TABS.05`
- [ ] **Offline tabs on the floor plan** On a tax-exclusive venue, tender exactly the offline estimate and reconnect **Expect:** Check the outcome: the estimate excludes tax and promotions, so if the server due is higher the settle may be refused; record the result and the cash in hand `OP.RESULTS.OFFLINE_TABS.06`
- [ ] **Offline tabs on the floor plan** P2 · Select an offline tab, reconnect so it acks **Expect:** The selection clears and the server tab appears on the plan through the normal refresh `OP.RESULTS.OFFLINE_TABS.11`

*Setup:* `REPLAY_TERMINAL` (Replay answered a deterministic 4xx)

- [ ] **Offline tabs on the floor plan** P1 · Press Remove from this cafe cashier on that failed tab **Expect:** The tab leaves the plan; the queue row still blocks Day close until a manager dismisses it `OP.RESULTS.OFFLINE_TABS.08`

#### OP.RESULTS.T06 · P0 · Renderer write results and offline tabs: ge

- [ ] **Did-not-sync toasts** `ARABIC_RTL` P2 · See the toasts in Arabic **Expect:** The template and write word are Arabic and read right-to-left `OP.RESULTS.FAILURE_TOASTS.04`
- [ ] **Offline tabs on the floor plan** `APP_KILLED_MIDFLOW` Reboot the till with an offline tab open **Expect:** The offline tab is back on the plan with its lines `OP.RESULTS.OFFLINE_TABS.09`
- [ ] **Offline tabs on the floor plan** `APP_KILLED_MIDFLOW` P2 · Clear site data (DevTools Local Storage key touch-operator-offline-tabs) on a test rig with queued tab rows **Expect:** The plan loses the offline tabs, but the queue still replays them and the server tabs appear after reconnect `OP.RESULTS.OFFLINE_TABS.10`

### OP.CONNECTIVITY: Connectivity indicator and heartbeat

One line that answers whether this station can reach the server and whether the venue is in offline mode; fed by the renderer heartbeat every 10 s and the worker's upload state.

**Route:** `Status strip above every screen (VenueStatusBanner)` · **Roles:** cashier, court_desk, manager, owner, prep, barista, chef, shop_staff

**Source:** `apps/operator/src/components/VenueStatusBanner.tsx`, `apps/operator/src/lib/heartbeat.ts`, `apps/operator/src/lib/stationReach.tsx`, `apps/operator/src/lib/realtime.ts`, `apps/operator-shell/src/main/queue.ts`, `apps/operator-shell/src/main/heartbeat.ts`

- [ ] Run the Vite dev server or an unpackaged shell against hosted **Expect:** Its beat files as DEV-<id> with is_till false, so it never makes the venue degraded `OP.CONNECTIVITY.HEARTBEAT.04`
- [ ] P1 · Set up a desk PC (mode desk) and unplug only the till **Expect:** Only tills count toward offline mode (p_is_till true for mode till only) `OP.CONNECTIVITY.HEARTBEAT.05`

#### OP.CONNECTIVITY.T02 · P1 · Connectivity indicator and heartbeat: other parts

- [ ] **Status strip** P2 · Sign in and watch the strip before the first beat **Expect:** An empty strip of the same height (data-connectivity unknown), no claim of connected `OP.CONNECTIVITY.STRIP.01`
- [ ] **Status strip** Online, healthy **Expect:** Green strip "Connected." `OP.CONNECTIVITY.STRIP.02`
- [ ] **Station reach for online-only controls** P2 · Right after sign-in, before the first beat, open a match **Expect:** Controls are enabled (fails open); a write that then fails shows its own error `OP.CONNECTIVITY.STATION_REACH.02`

*Setup:* `OFFLINE` (No internet)

- [ ] **Status strip** Drill step 2: pull the WAN cable, leave the LAN on **Expect:** Within one failed beat (about 10-25 s) the strip turns red with the no-wifi icon: "Not connected - changes are saved here and will sync once the connection is back." `OP.CONNECTIVITY.STRIP.03`
- [ ] **Status strip** With offline mode on, unplug every till so the venue goes degraded; look at the desk PC that is still online **Expect:** Amber strip "Venue offline mode: guests cannot book the coming days or order online. Take bookings and orders at the desk." `OP.CONNECTIVITY.STRIP.06`
- [ ] **Status strip** P2 · Read the strip with queued rows while offline **Expect:** No queued count is shown on the strip (counts live on Day close) `OP.CONNECTIVITY.STRIP.09`
- [ ] **Station reach for online-only controls** P1 · Offline, open a booking with an open match on the desk **Expect:** Match controls are disabled with the reason on them `OP.CONNECTIVITY.STATION_REACH.01`
- [ ] **Station reach for online-only controls** Offline, take a payment on a till that requires an open shift **Expect:** The shift gate fails open: payment is not held up by a shift the screen cannot see `OP.CONNECTIVITY.STATION_REACH.03`

#### OP.CONNECTIVITY.T04 · P1 · Connectivity indicator and heartbeat: Flaky or slow network, backend down

*Setup:* `BACKEND_DOWN` (Server unreachable while the LAN is up), `FLAKY_NETWORK` (Network drops on and off)

- [ ] **Status strip** `BACKEND_DOWN` Block only the replay function (beats succeed) **Expect:** Red hourglass strip "This station can reach the server but cannot send its changes. Keep serving: nothing is lost, and everything syncs when sending works again." `OP.CONNECTIVITY.STRIP.05`
- [ ] **Renderer heartbeat** `FLAKY_NETWORK` Queue 3 rows offline on the till, reconnect only briefly (one beat) then pull it again **Expect:** Devices shows Waiting to sync 3 for that till `OP.CONNECTIVITY.HEARTBEAT.02`

*Setup:* `OFFLINE_THEN_RECONNECT` (Offline, then back online), `SMALL_SCREEN` (Small station screen), `ARABIC_RTL` (Arabic, right to left), `NOT_SIGNED_IN` (No session), `SECOND_BRANCH` (Two branches)

- [ ] **Status strip** `OFFLINE_THEN_RECONNECT` P1 · Reconnect the WAN **Expect:** The strip returns to green on the first successful beat `OP.CONNECTIVITY.STRIP.04`
- [ ] **Realtime reconnection** `OFFLINE_THEN_RECONNECT` Pull the WAN on the kitchen screen for 30 s and reconnect **Expect:** The board's Connection indicator goes Disconnected then Live, and tickets made meanwhile appear (recovered refetch) `OP.CONNECTIVITY.REALTIME.01`
- [ ] **Status strip** `SMALL_SCREEN` P2 · Make a long message and a narrow window **Expect:** The strip stays one line, truncated with an ellipsis; the full text is in the tooltip `OP.CONNECTIVITY.STRIP.07`
- [ ] **Status strip** `ARABIC_RTL` P2 · Read the strip in Arabic and in blue mode / dark rail **Expect:** Arabic text, right-to-left icon order; colours from tokens stay readable `OP.CONNECTIVITY.STRIP.08`
- [ ] **Renderer heartbeat** `NOT_SIGNED_IN` P1 · Sit on the sign-in screen **Expect:** No heartbeat is sent (beats need a staff session); the till goes Silent after the stale window `OP.CONNECTIVITY.HEARTBEAT.03`
- [ ] **Realtime reconnection** `SECOND_BRANCH` P2 · Switch branch on the owner PC **Expect:** Realtime topics move to the new branch's topic (branchTopic), no events from the old branch `OP.CONNECTIVITY.REALTIME.03`

### OP.LAN_KDS: LAN kitchen screen link

Keeps tickets reaching the kitchen when the cloud path is down: the till serves kitchen-bound orders over the LAN behind the pairing code, and kitchen bumps ride back onto the till's own queue.

**Route:** `ws://<till LAN IP>:47810 (till server, kitchen screen client, /kds LAN board)` · **Roles:** prep, head_barista, barista, assistant_barista, head_chef, chef, manager, owner

**Source:** `apps/operator-shell/src/main/lan-kds-server.ts`, `apps/operator-shell/src/main/lan-kds-client.ts`, `apps/operator-shell/src/main/lan-frames.ts`, `apps/operator-shell/src/main/lan-net.ts`, `apps/operator/src/features/kds/KdsBoard.tsx`, `apps/operator/src/features/kds/LanBoard.tsx`

**Components:** Till LAN server · Ticket ring buffer · Kitchen screen LAN client · LAN board fallback · Kitchen bumps over the LAN

#### OP.LAN_KDS.T01 · P0 · Till LAN server: main flow

- [ ] On the till, check which address port 47810 listens on (netstat -an) **Expect:** A private LAN address (192.168.x, 10.x or 172.16-31.x), never 0.0.0.0 or a public address `OP.LAN_KDS.SERVER.01`
- [ ] P1 · Connect with the right code **Expect:** The first frame is ticket.snapshot with the ring buffer `OP.LAN_KDS.SERVER.03`
- [ ] P1 · Send a malformed frame on an authenticated socket **Expect:** The till answers {type: error, reason: malformed frame} and enqueues nothing `OP.LAN_KDS.SERVER.04`
- [ ] P2 · On a till with two network cards, check the bind **Expect:** It binds the first private IPv4; lan_bind in station.json (or --lan-bind) pins the right one `OP.LAN_KDS.SERVER.05`
- [ ] P2 · Send a Touch Shop sale on the shop desk **Expect:** No ticket is broadcast for it (shop sales are never kitchen work) `OP.LAN_KDS.SERVER.08`

#### OP.LAN_KDS.T02 · P2 · LAN kitchen screen link: other parts

- [ ] Two kitchen screens on the same till: bump on one **Expect:** Both screens show the new status (echo broadcast) `OP.LAN_KDS.BUMP_PATH.05`
- [ ] Bump the same ticket twice quickly over the LAN **Expect:** Two ticket.status rows queue; set_ticket_status is transition-idempotent so the server ends in one state `OP.LAN_KDS.BUMP_PATH.06`

*Setup:* `OFFLINE` (No internet)

- [ ] Day-one check 3: on the kitchen screen, confirm a test ticket appears, then unplug the WAN briefly **Expect:** The board switches to LAN tickets with the line "Offline - tickets arriving from the cafe cashier over the local network." `OP.LAN_KDS.01`
- [ ] **Ticket ring buffer** Trade online for an hour (tickets completed on the cloud board), then pull the WAN on the kitchen screen **Expect:** The LAN board must not show tickets already completed on the cloud board as new; note that the ring receives every order enqueued online too and only LAN bumps update its status, so record any resurrected tickets `OP.LAN_KDS.RING.01`
- [ ] **Ticket ring buffer** P1 · Read a LAN ticket's label **Expect:** It shows "#" plus the last 6 characters of the offline tab key, or of the ticket ref when there is no tab key (no table name over the LAN) `OP.LAN_KDS.RING.04`
- [ ] **LAN board fallback** Drill step 6: with the WAN pulled, send an order from the till **Expect:** The ticket appears on the kitchen screen over the LAN within a second, item names in the board language `OP.LAN_KDS.LAN_BOARD.01`
- [ ] **LAN board fallback** P2 · Pull the WAN with no tickets **Expect:** "Offline - waiting for tickets from the cafe cashier over the local network." `OP.LAN_KDS.LAN_BOARD.02`

*Setup:* `LAN_PEER_DOWN` (Café cashier (LAN peer) unreachable)

Record that the bump is lost and must be redone `OP.LAN_KDS.BUMP_PATH.04`

#### OP.LAN_KDS.T05 · P0 · LAN kitchen screen link: ge

*Setup:* `BAD_PSK` (Wrong LAN pairing code), `LAN_NO_PRIVATE_IP` (Till has no private IPv4), `STATION_KIND_MISMATCH` (Wrong kind of station for the action), `APP_KILLED_MIDFLOW` (Station app closed or power cut mid-flow), `LARGE_DATA` (Large data volume), `BROKEN_STATION_JSON` (station.json unreadable or missing its pairing key), `EMPTY_DATA` (Nothing recorded yet), `CLOCK_SKEW` (Station clock wrong), `OFFLINE_THEN_RECONNECT` (Offline, then back online), `ARABIC_RTL` (Arabic, right to left), `NOT_SIGNED_IN` (No session)

- [ ] **Till LAN server** `BAD_PSK` Connect to ws://<till>:47810 with a wrong bearer code (wscat) **Expect:** The socket is closed with code 4401 "bad psk" and no frame is sent `OP.LAN_KDS.SERVER.02`
- [ ] **Till LAN server** `LAN_NO_PRIVATE_IP` P2 · On a till with no private IPv4, start the app **Expect:** It binds 127.0.0.1 and logs that the KDS is unreachable; kitchen screens cannot connect `OP.LAN_KDS.SERVER.06`
- [ ] **Till LAN server** `STATION_KIND_MISMATCH` P2 · Start a desk or shop station **Expect:** No LAN server is started (only the till owns the queue and the server) `OP.LAN_KDS.SERVER.07`
- [ ] **Ticket ring buffer** `APP_KILLED_MIDFLOW` P1 · Restart the till during an outage, then reconnect the kitchen screen over LAN **Expect:** The snapshot holds only orders enqueued since the till restarted (the ring is memory only); earlier offline tickets are gone from the LAN board `OP.LAN_KDS.RING.02`
- [ ] **Ticket ring buffer** `LARGE_DATA` P2 · Send more than 500 kitchen orders in one session **Expect:** Only the newest 500 are kept in the snapshot `OP.LAN_KDS.RING.03`
- [ ] **Kitchen screen LAN client** `BROKEN_STATION_JSON` P2 · Start a kitchen screen whose station.json lacks till_host or lan_psk **Expect:** No LAN client runs; the LAN board stays empty when the cloud fails `OP.LAN_KDS.CLIENT.03`
- [ ] **LAN board fallback** `EMPTY_DATA` P1 · Use a kitchen screen that never loaded the menu online, then go offline **Expect:** LAN items show the first 8 characters of the variant id instead of a name `OP.LAN_KDS.LAN_BOARD.03`
- [ ] **LAN board fallback** `CLOCK_SKEW` P2 · Read ticket ages on the LAN board with the till and kitchen clocks 3 minutes apart **Expect:** Ages are computed from the till's createdAt against the kitchen's clock, so they are off by the skew; stale alarms may fire early or late `OP.LAN_KDS.LAN_BOARD.05`
- [ ] **LAN board fallback** `OFFLINE_THEN_RECONNECT` P1 · Reconnect the WAN on the kitchen screen **Expect:** The board switches back to cloud tickets once the tickets query succeeds `OP.LAN_KDS.LAN_BOARD.06`
- [ ] **Kitchen bumps over the LAN** `OFFLINE_THEN_RECONNECT` P1 · Reconnect and check the ticket on the server **Expect:** The ticket has the bumped status, written once, attributed to the till's signed-in staff with a TILL key `OP.LAN_KDS.BUMP_PATH.02`
- [ ] **LAN board fallback** `ARABIC_RTL` P2 · View the LAN board in Arabic **Expect:** Item names in Arabic from the cached menu, the offline line in Arabic `OP.LAN_KDS.LAN_BOARD.07`
- [ ] **Kitchen bumps over the LAN** `NOT_SIGNED_IN` P1 · Bump a LAN ticket while the till is signed out **Expect:** The till answers error "till has no staff session" and nothing is queued; the kitchen board does not change `OP.LAN_KDS.BUMP_PATH.03`

### OP.PRINT: Receipt printing

Renders the receipt HTML in an offscreen 576 px window, thresholds it to 1-bit, sends ESC/POS raster bands to a network printer on port 9100, and falls back to the browser print dialog.

**Route:** `Bill view Print bill, shop receipt auto-print, main print/*` · **Roles:** cashier, manager, owner, shop_staff, court_desk

**Source:** `apps/operator-shell/src/main/print/print-receipt.ts`, `apps/operator-shell/src/main/print/escpos.ts`, `apps/operator-shell/src/main/print/raster.ts`, `apps/operator-shell/src/main/print/transport.ts`, `apps/operator-shell/src/main/index.ts`, `apps/operator/src/features/till/BillView.tsx`

**Components:** Receipt pipeline · Network printer transport · Browser print fallback · Cash drawer

#### OP.PRINT.T01 · P0 · Receipt printing: money and totals

- [ ] **Receipt pipeline** Check totals on the printed bill against the screen **Expect:** Every line, discount, tax, court fee and total in IQD match the screen exactly `OP.PRINT.RECEIPT.03`
- [ ] **Cash drawer** P1 · Settle a cash tab with a printer that has a drawer attached **Expect:** The drawer does not open by itself (no kick, cut from phase 1); staff open it by key or button on the hardware `OP.PRINT.DRAWER.01`
- [ ] **Cash drawer** Press Open drawer on the till, pick a reason, confirm online **Expect:** "Drawer opening recorded." and the drawer log lists it with time, reason and staff `OP.PRINT.DRAWER.02`

#### OP.PRINT.T02 · P0 · Receipt printing: other parts

- [ ] **Whole page** Physical print at the venue on the real printer (owed on-site proof) **Expect:** A full bill prints cleanly, cut, with Arabic shaped correctly `OP.PRINT.01`
- [ ] **Receipt pipeline** P2 · Print grey or light text **Expect:** Light grey text may drop out (luminance threshold 160); confirm all bill text is dark enough `OP.PRINT.RECEIPT.04`
- [ ] **Receipt pipeline** Put ESC p bytes into an order note and print **Expect:** Nothing opens the cash drawer; the note prints as glyphs (the job is pixels only) `OP.PRINT.RECEIPT.05`
- [ ] **Network printer transport** P1 · Print with the printer on **Expect:** Printed within a couple of seconds `OP.PRINT.TRANSPORT.01`
- [ ] **Network printer transport** P2 · Leave the printer idle for an hour, then print **Expect:** It prints (the one retry covers a dropped first connection) `OP.PRINT.TRANSPORT.03`
- [ ] **Browser print fallback** P1 · Open a bill with auto print on the shop desk and let a query refresh **Expect:** The receipt prints once, not again on re-render `OP.PRINT.FALLBACK.03`

#### OP.PRINT.T03 · P0 · Receipt printing: No printer

*Setup:* `PRINTER_MISSING` (No printer)

- [ ] **Network printer transport** Unplug the printer and press Print bill **Expect:** After about 10 s (5 s timeout, one retry) the browser print dialog opens instead; the sale itself is unaffected `OP.PRINT.TRANSPORT.02`
- [ ] **Network printer transport** P1 · Print on a till with no printer in station.json **Expect:** The browser print dialog opens (no-printer fallback) `OP.PRINT.TRANSPORT.05`
- [ ] **Browser print fallback** P2 · Look for a message when the thermal print failed **Expect:** No toast says the thermal printer failed; only the dialog appears (failures go to telemetry). Record this so staff know the dialog means the printer is off `OP.PRINT.FALLBACK.02`

#### OP.PRINT.T04 · P0 · Receipt printing: ge

*Setup:* `ARABIC_RTL` (Arabic, right to left), `LARGE_DATA` (Large data volume), `OFFLINE` (No internet), `BROKEN_STATION_JSON` (station.json unreadable or missing its pairing key), `KIOSK_LOCKED` (Locked kiosk station)

- [ ] **Receipt pipeline** `ARABIC_RTL` Print a bill with Arabic item names **Expect:** Arabic is shaped and right-to-left on paper (it is printed as an image, never printer fonts) `OP.PRINT.RECEIPT.01`
- [ ] **Receipt pipeline** `LARGE_DATA` P1 · Print a bill with 40 lines **Expect:** It prints whole, in bands, with no garbled lines between bands, then feeds and cuts `OP.PRINT.RECEIPT.02`
- [ ] **Network printer transport** `OFFLINE` Print with the WAN unplugged (printer on the LAN) **Expect:** The receipt prints: printing needs no internet `OP.PRINT.TRANSPORT.04`
- [ ] **Cash drawer** `OFFLINE` Press Open drawer with the WAN unplugged **Expect:** It is refused at once with a connection error beside the control and nothing is recorded (record_drawer_open is online-only); if the line reads "Something went wrong" rather than naming the connection, log it `OP.PRINT.DRAWER.03`
- [ ] **Network printer transport** `BROKEN_STATION_JSON` P2 · Press Print bill on a broken-install station **Expect:** No thermal print (no-printer); only the browser dialog `OP.PRINT.TRANSPORT.06`
- [ ] **Browser print fallback** `KIOSK_LOCKED` P1 · Trigger the fallback on a kiosked Windows till **Expect:** The Windows print dialog opens over the kiosk and can be printed or cancelled, and the app is still kiosked afterwards `OP.PRINT.FALLBACK.01`

### OP.UPDATE: Auto-update and Quit reopens

Every packaged station checks the public releases feed at start, 30 s later and every 6 h, downloads silently, and installs only at a start, from Update ready, or on Quit to desktop, then reopens.

**Route:** `Rail "Update ready" row, kitchen pill, Quit to desktop, start-time install (updater.ts)`

**Source:** `apps/operator-shell/src/main/updater.ts`, `apps/operator-shell/src/main/index.ts`, `apps/operator/src/components/UpdateReady.tsx`, `apps/operator/src/lib/updates.ts`, `apps/operator/src/routes/__root.tsx`, `docs/install-runbook.md`

**Components:** Check and silent download · Update ready control · Quit to desktop installs · Install at the next start · Rollback

#### OP.UPDATE.T01 · P2 · Auto-update and Quit reopens: other parts

- [ ] **Whole page** Read %APPDATA%/touch-padel-operator/updater.log after a day of running **Expect:** Lines like checking, update available X.Y.Z, update downloaded, up to date; no PIN or token `OP.UPDATE.01`
- [ ] **Check and silent download** Run a dev build (unpackaged) **Expect:** The updater is disabled `OP.UPDATE.CHECK_DOWNLOAD.04`
- [ ] **Quit to desktop installs** Quit with nothing waiting **Expect:** The app just exits `OP.UPDATE.QUIT_INSTALLS.03`
- [ ] **Quit to desktop installs** Make the install quit stall **Expect:** Within 5 s the app exits anyway (fallback), and the next start installs `OP.UPDATE.QUIT_INSTALLS.04`

#### OP.UPDATE.T02 · P1 · Auto-update and Quit reopens: With no internet

*Setup:* `OFFLINE` (No internet)

- [ ] **Check and silent download** Start a station with the WAN unplugged **Expect:** The window opens without waiting (nothing downloaded yet); the updater logs a failed check and never throws `OP.UPDATE.CHECK_DOWNLOAD.02`
- [ ] **Update ready control** Tap Update ready with the WAN unplugged after the download finished **Expect:** It installs from the cached download and reopens `OP.UPDATE.UPDATE_READY.05`
- [ ] **Install at the next start** With an update downloaded, start the station with no network **Expect:** The window opens after the 15 s wait and the update waits for later `OP.UPDATE.START_INSTALL.03`

#### OP.UPDATE.T03 · P0 · Auto-update and Quit reopens: A newer operator build is downloaded

*Setup:* `UPDATE_READY` (A newer operator build is downloaded)

- [ ] **Check and silent download** P1 · Publish a new release and wait 30 s after a station starts **Expect:** The station downloads it silently and shows Update ready; nothing installs while the app is open `OP.UPDATE.CHECK_DOWNLOAD.01`
- [ ] **Update ready control** P1 · With an update downloaded, look at the till rail **Expect:** An "Update ready X.Y.Z" row appears, titled "Restart to update to X.Y.Z" `OP.UPDATE.UPDATE_READY.01`
- [ ] **Update ready control** P2 · Look at the kitchen screen with an update downloaded **Expect:** A pill in the corner shows Update ready `OP.UPDATE.UPDATE_READY.02`
- [ ] **Update ready control** Tap Update ready with rows queued offline **Expect:** The app closes, installs, reopens on the new version; the queued count is unchanged and replay resumes `OP.UPDATE.UPDATE_READY.03`
- [ ] **Update ready control** P2 · A newer release replaces the downloaded one **Expect:** The row updates to the newer version (the old offer is withdrawn) `OP.UPDATE.UPDATE_READY.06`
- [ ] **Quit to desktop installs** P1 · With an update ready, open Quit to desktop **Expect:** The dialog adds "An update is ready. Quitting installs it, then the app opens again by itself." `OP.UPDATE.QUIT_INSTALLS.01`
- [ ] **Quit to desktop installs** P1 · Confirm Quit with a valid manager PIN **Expect:** The app installs and reopens on the new version `OP.UPDATE.QUIT_INSTALLS.02`
- [ ] **Install at the next start** P1 · With an update downloaded, restart Windows **Expect:** At login nothing shows for a few seconds (up to 15 s), then the installer runs silently and the app opens on the new version about a minute later `OP.UPDATE.START_INSTALL.01`
- [ ] **Install at the next start** P2 · Shut Windows down with an update downloaded **Expect:** Nothing installs on the way down; it installs at the next start `OP.UPDATE.START_INSTALL.02`
- [ ] **Install at the next start** P1 · Make the start install fail (kill the installer) so the station comes back on the old version **Expect:** Later starts leave that version alone; Update ready stays in the sidebar for someone to tap; updater-startup.json records tried `OP.UPDATE.START_INSTALL.04`
- [ ] **Install at the next start** P2 · On macOS, restart with an update downloaded **Expect:** The start waits up to 30 s, installs via Squirrel.Mac and reopens `OP.UPDATE.START_INSTALL.07`

#### OP.UPDATE.T04 · P0 · Auto-update and Quit reopens: Older version installed over a newer one

*Setup:* `ROLLBACK` (Older version installed over a newer one)

- [ ] **Rollback** P1 · Run an older Setup.exe over the installed app, then restart twice **Expect:** The station stays on the older version at each start (a start never installs a version this station already ran) `OP.UPDATE.ROLLBACK.01`
- [ ] **Rollback** P1 · After the rollback, look at the rail **Expect:** Update ready comes back for the newer release; tapping it or quitting reinstalls it `OP.UPDATE.ROLLBACK.02`
- [ ] **Rollback** After update and rollback, check queue.db and station.json **Expect:** Both unchanged `OP.UPDATE.ROLLBACK.03`

#### OP.UPDATE.T05 · P1 · Auto-update and Quit reopens: ge

*Setup:* `OFFLINE_THEN_RECONNECT` (Offline, then back online), `KIOSK_LOCKED` (Locked kiosk station), `APP_KILLED_MIDFLOW` (Station app closed or power cut mid-flow), `ALL_USERS_INSTALL` (Old all-users install present)

- [ ] **Check and silent download** `OFFLINE_THEN_RECONNECT` P2 · Keep a station offline when a release is published, reconnect hours later **Expect:** The next 6-hourly check downloads it; Update ready appears then `OP.UPDATE.CHECK_DOWNLOAD.03`
- [ ] **Update ready control** `KIOSK_LOCKED` Tap Update ready on a kiosked Windows till **Expect:** The install proceeds (windows are made closable only once the install quit is announced) and the app reopens kiosked `OP.UPDATE.UPDATE_READY.04`
- [ ] **Install at the next start** `APP_KILLED_MIDFLOW` P2 · Click the shortcut during the minute the start install runs **Expect:** Do not: runbook says not to switch off or click the shortcut then; record what happens `OP.UPDATE.START_INSTALL.05`
- [ ] **Install at the next start** `ALL_USERS_INSTALL` P2 · On a machine with an old all-users install, restart with an update downloaded **Expect:** The start does not install (it would need an administrator); Update ready still offers it and asks for UAC when tapped `OP.UPDATE.START_INSTALL.06`

### OP.EXIT: Quit to desktop and Exit forced full screen

The only ways out of a kiosked station: a manager PIN that is not the signed-in person's own, re-checked in main against the offline cache; the owner and marketing leave without a PIN once the server confirms the role.

**Route:** `Rail rows and the sign-in corner (QuitToDesktop, ExitFullscreen), main quitApp / exitFullscreen` · **Roles:** cashier, court_desk, manager, owner, marketing, prep, barista, chef, shop_staff

**Source:** `apps/operator/src/routes/__root.tsx`, `apps/operator-shell/src/main/index.ts`, `apps/operator-shell/src/main/pin-cache.ts`, `apps/operator-shell/src/main/owner-exit.ts`

**Components:** Quit to desktop · Exit forced full screen · Owner and marketing exit without PIN

#### OP.EXIT.T01 · P1 · Quit to desktop and Exit forced full screen: other parts

- [ ] **Whole page** P2 · Use Quit and Exit forced full screen in browser mode (vite dev) **Expect:** Neither control renders `OP.EXIT.01`
- [ ] **Exit forced full screen** P2 · After releasing, let the token refresh (same person) **Expect:** The window stays released `OP.EXIT.EXIT_FULLSCREEN.03`
- [ ] **Owner and marketing exit without PIN** Try to pass the owner's staff id with a manager's token (dev tools) **Expect:** Refused before any request (token sub does not match the staff id) `OP.EXIT.OWNER_EXIT.06`

#### OP.EXIT.T02 · P0 · Quit to desktop and Exit forced full screen: With no internet

*Setup:* `OFFLINE` (No internet)

- [ ] **Quit to desktop** P1 · Offline, enter another manager's PIN that was verified online on this station in the last 14 days **Expect:** The app quits (main's cache knows its owner) `OP.EXIT.QUIT.05`
- [ ] **Quit to desktop** Quit with rows still queued **Expect:** The app quits; rows stay in queue.db and replay on the next start `OP.EXIT.QUIT.08`
- [ ] **Owner and marketing exit without PIN** P1 · Sign in as the owner online, then pull the WAN and press Quit **Expect:** Still no PIN: the verdict learnt online is kept for this session `OP.EXIT.OWNER_EXIT.02`
- [ ] **Owner and marketing exit without PIN** P2 · Boot the station offline with the owner's restored session and press Quit **Expect:** The dialog says "Couldn't confirm your account right now, so a manager's PIN is needed." and asks for a manager PIN `OP.EXIT.OWNER_EXIT.03`

#### OP.EXIT.T03 · P0 · Quit to desktop and Exit forced full screen: Locked kiosk station

*Setup:* `KIOSK_LOCKED` (Locked kiosk station)

- [ ] **Quit to desktop** As a cashier, open Quit to desktop **Expect:** The dialog says "This ends service on this station. Orders stop and the venue sees it go offline." and asks for a Manager PIN with the hint "A manager other than you has to enter their PIN." `OP.EXIT.QUIT.01`
- [ ] **Quit to desktop** P1 · Enter another manager's valid PIN **Expect:** The app quits to the desktop `OP.EXIT.QUIT.02`
- [ ] **Quit to desktop** P1 · Enter a wrong PIN **Expect:** "Incorrect PIN." and the app stays `OP.EXIT.QUIT.04`
- [ ] **Exit forced full screen** P1 · Press Exit forced full screen, enter another manager's PIN **Expect:** The window shrinks to about 90 percent, centred, with the desktop reachable; the queue keeps replaying `OP.EXIT.EXIT_FULLSCREEN.01`
- [ ] **Exit forced full screen** After releasing, sign out and sign in as someone else **Expect:** The window goes back into kiosk `OP.EXIT.EXIT_FULLSCREEN.02`

#### OP.EXIT.T04 · P0 · Quit to desktop and Exit forced full screen: ge

*Setup:* `OWN_PIN` (Signed-in person types their own manager PIN to leave), `PIN_CACHE_EMPTY` (PIN never verified online on this station), `NOT_SIGNED_IN` (No session), `UNCONFIGURED_STATION` (Machine has no station.json), `OWNER_SESSION` (Owner signed in), `MARKETING_SESSION` (Marketing signed in), `STAFF_DEACTIVATED` (Staff access removed)

- [ ] **Quit to desktop** `OWN_PIN` As a manager, enter your own PIN **Expect:** "That is your own PIN. Another manager has to enter theirs." `OP.EXIT.QUIT.03`
- [ ] **Exit forced full screen** `OWN_PIN` P1 · Enter your own PIN **Expect:** "That is your own PIN. Another manager has to enter theirs." `OP.EXIT.EXIT_FULLSCREEN.04`
- [ ] **Quit to desktop** `PIN_CACHE_EMPTY` P1 · Offline, enter a manager PIN this station never verified online **Expect:** "Incorrect PIN." (not recognised offline) `OP.EXIT.QUIT.06`
- [ ] **Quit to desktop** `NOT_SIGNED_IN` P1 · At the sign-in screen, use the Quit control in the corner **Expect:** Any manager PIN on the offline cache lets the app quit (no "own" to exclude) `OP.EXIT.QUIT.07`
- [ ] **Quit to desktop** `UNCONFIGURED_STATION` P2 · On a dev or first-run window, press Quit **Expect:** A plain confirmation, no PIN `OP.EXIT.QUIT.09`
- [ ] **Owner and marketing exit without PIN** `OWNER_SESSION` P1 · Sign in as the owner online and press Quit to desktop **Expect:** A plain confirmation without a PIN; confirming quits `OP.EXIT.OWNER_EXIT.01`
- [ ] **Owner and marketing exit without PIN** `MARKETING_SESSION` P2 · Sign in as marketing on a kiosked station **Expect:** Once the server confirms the role the window is released (not kiosk) with no PIN asked `OP.EXIT.OWNER_EXIT.04`
- [ ] **Owner and marketing exit without PIN** `STAFF_DEACTIVATED` P2 · Deactivate the owner account, then press Quit as that session **Expect:** Not confirmed as owner; a manager PIN is required `OP.EXIT.OWNER_EXIT.05`

### OP.DEVICES: Devices and offline mode settings

The owner and managers see every station that has reported in (last report, waiting to sync, version), retire stale tills, and set offline mode, the silence limit and the protected booking window.

**Components:** Device list · Retire a device · Offline mode settings

#### OP.DEVICES.T01 · P0 · Devices and offline mode settings: other parts

- [ ] **Device list** P1 · With till, desk and kitchen screen signed in, open Devices **Expect:** Three rows; the till is Cafe cashier, the others Screen; all Reporting; versions shown `OP.DEVICES.LIST.01`
- [ ] **Offline mode settings** Turn offline mode on and save **Expect:** Toast "Offline mode is on." and the hint explains online booking pauses when every cafe cashier goes quiet during an open day `OP.DEVICES.OFFLINE_MODE.01`
- [ ] **Offline mode settings** P1 · Set the silence limit to 9999 or a letter **Expect:** "Enter a whole number." or "Enter a number from <min> to <max>." and nothing saves `OP.DEVICES.OFFLINE_MODE.05`

*Setup:* `STATION_RETIRED` (Station retired)

- [ ] **Retire a device** P1 · Retire a silent old till (renamed or replaced) **Expect:** Confirm "Retire this device?" then toast "<device> retired."; the venue stops counting it `OP.DEVICES.RETIRE.01`
- [ ] **Retire a device** P1 · Retire one silent till while another till is also silent **Expect:** Toast "<device> retired. The venue is still offline: another cafe cashier is silent." `OP.DEVICES.RETIRE.02`
- [ ] **Retire a device** Retire a till while it is offline with queued rows, then reconnect it **Expect:** Its heartbeat brings it back to the list ("If it reports in again it comes back on its own") and its queued rows replay `OP.DEVICES.RETIRE.03`
- [ ] **Retire a device** P2 · Register a station that was retired on the Stations page **Expect:** Refused "This station was retired. Register it again in Settings > Venue details > Stations." until it is re-registered on purpose `OP.DEVICES.RETIRE.04`

#### OP.DEVICES.T03 · P0 · Devices and offline mode settings: ge

*Setup:* `WRONG_ROLE` (Signed in with a role that may not use this), `EMPTY_DATA` (Nothing recorded yet), `OFFLINE` (No internet), `OFFLINE_THEN_RECONNECT` (Offline, then back online), `OLD_APP_VERSION` (Station build older than the server), `FEATURE_FLAG_OFF` (A feature switched off), `DAY_CLOSED` (Business day just closed)

- [ ] `WRONG_ROLE` P1 · Open the Devices page as a cashier **Expect:** Refused with the role notice `OP.DEVICES.01`
- [ ] `EMPTY_DATA` P2 · Open Devices before any station has reported **Expect:** "No device has reported in yet." `OP.DEVICES.02`
- [ ] **Device list** `OFFLINE` P1 · Unplug the till WAN and wait past the silence limit **Expect:** The till turns Silent with its last report time `OP.DEVICES.LIST.02`
- [ ] **Offline mode settings** `OFFLINE` With offline mode on and the day open, pull the WAN on every till **Expect:** After the silence limit the venue is degraded: guests are refused tonight's bookings with the venue phone shown (drill step 3) but can book beyond the protected window (step 4); web ordering is blocked (step 5) `OP.DEVICES.OFFLINE_MODE.02`
- [ ] **Device list** `OFFLINE_THEN_RECONNECT` P1 · Queue rows on the till, reconnect **Expect:** Waiting to sync shows the blocking count and drops to 0 as rows ack `OP.DEVICES.LIST.03`
- [ ] **Offline mode settings** `OFFLINE_THEN_RECONNECT` P1 · Reconnect one till during degraded mode **Expect:** Guests can book again on the first successful beat; the degraded period is logged with start, end and duration `OP.DEVICES.OFFLINE_MODE.06`
- [ ] **Device list** `OLD_APP_VERSION` P1 · After an update, check Version per station **Expect:** Each station shows its running version; one left behind is visible `OP.DEVICES.LIST.04`
- [ ] **Offline mode settings** `FEATURE_FLAG_OFF` With offline mode off, repeat **Expect:** The venue always counts as online; a desk booking taken offline that a guest also books online shows as a conflict when the till reconnects `OP.DEVICES.OFFLINE_MODE.03`
- [ ] **Offline mode settings** `DAY_CLOSED` P1 · Pull the WAN on every till with the day closed **Expect:** The venue is not degraded (only during an open day) `OP.DEVICES.OFFLINE_MODE.04`

### OP.SUPPLIER: Supplier price crawler

On the Touch Shop desk only, an hourly pass fetches each watched supplier product page through main (https only, no private addresses, 15 s, 3 MB), records the price, and toasts when a new price can be applied.

**Route:** `Shop desk background pass (PriceWatchCrawler) + main fetchSupplierPage` · **Roles:** shop_staff, manager, owner

**Source:** `apps/operator-shell/src/main/supplier-fetch.ts`, `apps/operator-shell/src/main/index.ts`, `apps/operator/src/features/shop/priceWatch/PriceWatchCrawler.tsx`

**Components:** URL and address rules · Fetch limits and outcomes

#### OP.SUPPLIER.T01 · P1 · Supplier price crawler: other parts

- [ ] **Whole page** Sign in as shop_staff on the shop desk and wait for the first pass **Expect:** Watched pages are fetched and Products shows their last read; a toast says how many prices changed `OP.SUPPLIER.01`
- [ ] **Fetch limits and outcomes** P2 · Point a watch at a PDF or JSON URL **Expect:** not_html `OP.SUPPLIER.FETCH_LIMITS.03`
- [ ] **Fetch limits and outcomes** P2 · Check the User-Agent the supplier sees **Expect:** TouchPadelShop/<version> (supplier price check) `OP.SUPPLIER.FETCH_LIMITS.07`

- [ ] **URL and address rules** Add a watch with https://192.168.1.1/ or https://router.local/ **Expect:** blocked_url `OP.SUPPLIER.URL_RULES.02`

#### OP.SUPPLIER.T03 · P2 · Supplier price crawler: Third-party service down

*Setup:* `VENDOR_DOWN` (Third-party service down)

### OP.SECURITY: Window security and IPC

Pins the window to the bundled renderer, sends links to the system browser, blocks webviews, recovers from crashes, and validates every IPC message before it touches the queue, cache, printer or LAN.

**Route:** `Main window webContents guards, preload window.touch bridge, ipc-validate.ts`

**Source:** `apps/operator-shell/src/main/window-security.ts`, `apps/operator-shell/src/main/index.ts`, `apps/operator-shell/src/main/ipc-validate.ts`, `apps/operator-shell/src/preload/index.ts`, `apps/operator-shell/src/ipc-channels.ts`

**Components:** Navigation lock · External links and webviews · Renderer crash recovery · IPC validation · Preload bridge surface

#### OP.SECURITY.T01 · P0 · External links and webviews: main flow

- [ ] P1 · Click a help link (for example the Telegram setup doc) on a station **Expect:** It opens in the system browser, not a second app window `OP.SECURITY.EXTERNAL_LINKS.01`
- [ ] From DevTools call window.open("file:///C:/Windows/System32/calc.exe") **Expect:** Refused; nothing opens `OP.SECURITY.EXTERNAL_LINKS.02`
- [ ] P1 · Insert a <webview> tag via DevTools **Expect:** Attach is blocked `OP.SECURITY.EXTERNAL_LINKS.03`

#### OP.SECURITY.T02 · P0 · IPC validation: main flow

- [ ] P2 · From DevTools call window.touch.unlockPin("12ab") **Expect:** Refused "pin must be 4-12 digits" `OP.SECURITY.IPC_VALIDATION.01`
- [ ] P1 · Call window.touch.pushAuthState with a non-uuid staffId **Expect:** Refused "staffId must be a uuid"; replay auth unchanged `OP.SECURITY.IPC_VALIDATION.02`
- [ ] P2 · Call window.touch.print with html over 512 KB **Expect:** Refused "data.html exceeds" the limit `OP.SECURITY.IPC_VALIDATION.03`
- [ ] Call window.touch.saveStation on a configured station **Expect:** Answers already-configured; station.json unchanged `OP.SECURITY.IPC_VALIDATION.04`
- [ ] P1 · Call window.touch.discoverTill with host 8.8.8.8 **Expect:** Refused "host must be a private (LAN) address" `OP.SECURITY.IPC_VALIDATION.05`
- [ ] P1 · Check that the six copies of the mutation type list agree (pnpm --filter @touch/operator-shell test, operator test) **Expect:** Tests pass: ipc-validate MUTATION_TYPES, core, DIRECT_RPC, replay MUTATION_RPCS, queueResults and QUEUE_WRITE_KEY in the same order `OP.SECURITY.IPC_VALIDATION.06`

#### OP.SECURITY.T03 · P0 · Preload bridge surface: main flow

- [ ] In DevTools check typeof require and typeof process **Expect:** Both undefined in the renderer `OP.SECURITY.PRELOAD_SURFACE.01`
- [ ] P1 · List Object.keys(window.touch) **Expect:** Only the documented calls (enqueue, getCachedRef, print, unlockPin, quitApp, ...), no raw ipcRenderer `OP.SECURITY.PRELOAD_SURFACE.02`
- [ ] P1 · Read a pairing code without a PIN (window.touch.getPairingInfo("0000")) **Expect:** Refused "pin not recognised" unless 0000 is a cached manager PIN `OP.SECURITY.PRELOAD_SURFACE.03`

#### OP.SECURITY.T04 · P0 · Window security and IPC: other parts

- [ ] **Navigation lock** From DevTools on a packaged station run location.href = "https://example.com" **Expect:** Navigation is blocked and the app stays on the renderer `OP.SECURITY.NAVIGATION.01`
- [ ] **Navigation lock** P1 · Reload on a deep route (Ctrl+R) in a packaged build **Expect:** The app returns to the renderer (did-fail-load recovery), not a white window `OP.SECURITY.NAVIGATION.02`
- [ ] **Renderer crash recovery** P2 · Trigger a render error on a screen (test build) **Expect:** The crash screen shows instead of a blank window `OP.SECURITY.CRASH_RECOVERY.02`

#### OP.SECURITY.T05 · P0 · Window security and IPC: ge

*Setup:* `OFFLINE` (No internet), `APP_KILLED_MIDFLOW` (Station app closed or power cut mid-flow), `KIOSK_LOCKED` (Locked kiosk station)

- [ ] **Navigation lock** `OFFLINE` Confirm the renderer loads from disk **Expect:** It loads resources/renderer/index.html with zero network `OP.SECURITY.NAVIGATION.03`
- [ ] **Renderer crash recovery** `APP_KILLED_MIDFLOW` P1 · Kill the renderer process (Task Manager, the GPU/renderer child) **Expect:** The window reloads by itself; queued rows untouched; still signed in `OP.SECURITY.CRASH_RECOVERY.01`
- [ ] **Preload bridge surface** `KIOSK_LOCKED` P1 · Check that DevTools are reachable on a packaged kiosk **Expect:** Record whether staff can open DevTools (keyboard shortcut) on a production station `OP.SECURITY.PRELOAD_SURFACE.04`

### OP.OFFLINE_MATRIX: Offline matrix

One place that says, per operator feature area, whether it works offline, how it is queued and keyed, that it replays exactly once on reconnect, how a conflict on reconnect is surfaced, and what an online-only action says when refused. Run it with the till, desk and kitchen screen signed in online first, day open, and one PIN action done online today.

**Route:** `Every station feature with the WAN pulled and the LAN left on` · **Roles:** cashier, court_desk, manager, owner, prep, barista, chef, shop_staff

**Source:** `apps/operator/src/lib/mutate.ts`, `apps/operator/src/lib/queueResults.ts`, `apps/operator/src/features/admin/dayCloseLogic.ts`, `apps/operator-shell/src/main/ipc-validate.ts`, `apps/operator-shell/src/main/sync-worker.ts`, `packages/db/supabase/functions/replay/index.ts`, `packages/db/supabase/functions/_shared/mutation-types.json`, `HANDOFF.md`, `docs/drill-runbook.md`

**Components:** Desk booking create (reservation.create) · Desk booking move, extend, cancel, mark (reservation.update) · Desk court bill (tab.open, tab.settle, tab.cancel, tab.settle_zero) · Till new tab (tab.open) · Send to kitchen (order.create / order.add_items) · Payment (tab.settle, payment.record) · Discount (adjustment.apply) · Price override (adjustment.apply price_override) · Refund (payment.refund) · Void after send (order_item.void) · Waste (stock.waste) · Tab removal (tab.cancel) · Close at zero (tab.settle_zero) · Merge tabs and Charge to booking (merge_tabs, online-only) · Open drawer (record_drawer_open, online-only) · Open day (open_day, online-only) · Close day (close_day, online-only) · Till shift start and end (online-only) · Kitchen ticket status (ticket.status) · Kitchen item ready ticks (set_order_item_ready, online-only) · Waiter calls (waiter_call.action) · Printing · Stock counts, deliveries, expiry write-off, alerts (online-only) · Staff sign-in and PIN prompts · Breaks and cover (start_break, end_break, cover_station, online-only) · Open matches (online-only, DF-11) · Coaching desk (online-only, CD-6) · Loyalty redeem and member attach (online-only) · Touch Shop sale (queued tab.open, order.add_items, tab.settle with shop) · Menu, settings and other admin editors (online-only) · App killed mid-queue · Two stations offline at once · Clock skew · Retryable vs terminal replay errors · PIN redaction in the queue · Station retired while offline · Update available while offline · Printer unplugged · LAN kitchen peer down · Cash drawer during an outage

#### OP.OFFLINE_MATRIX.T01 · P0 · Offline matrix: other parts

- [ ] **Whole page** Before the matrix, sign in on till, desk and kitchen screen while online, open the day, and do one PIN-gated action online **Expect:** All three stations show the green "Connected." strip and Devices lists them Reporting `OP.OFFLINE_MATRIX.01`
- [ ] **Whole page** Confirm the 15 queued types against the scope ledger **Expect:** Queued: order.create, order.add_items, ticket.status, payment.record, reservation.create, reservation.update, waiter_call.action, stock.waste, tab.open, tab.settle, adjustment.apply, tab.cancel, tab.settle_zero, payment.refund, order_item.void. Online-only by decision: merge_tabs, record_drawer_open, open_day, close_day, open_till_shift, close_till_shift, close_till_shift_for, every open-match and coaching write `OP.OFFLINE_MATRIX.03`
- [ ] **Printer unplugged** P2 · Plug it back in and print again **Expect:** Prints normally `OP.OFFLINE_MATRIX.PRINTER_UNPLUGGED.02`

#### OP.OFFLINE_MATRIX.T02 · P0 · Offline matrix: With no internet (1 of 5)

*Setup:* `OFFLINE` (No internet)

- [ ] Pull the WAN cable on the venue router (LAN switch stays on) **Expect:** Every station turns red within one failed beat; the kitchen board moves to LAN tickets `OP.OFFLINE_MATRIX.02`
- [ ] **Desk booking create (reservation.create)** Offline on the desk, create a booking for a free slot **Expect:** Works offline: a toast "Saved on this station only. It is not confirmed until the connection is back, so do not promise the slot yet." `OP.OFFLINE_MATRIX.DESK_BOOKING.01`
- [ ] **Desk booking create (reservation.create)** P1 · Read the queued row in Day close **Expect:** A Booking row, Waiting to send, key DESK-01:reservation.create:<ULID> `OP.OFFLINE_MATRIX.DESK_BOOKING.02`
- [ ] **Desk booking move, extend, cancel, mark (reservation.update)** P1 · Offline, mark a booking arrived **Expect:** Works offline: toast "Saved on this station only...", the board shows the change as pending `OP.OFFLINE_MATRIX.DESK_BOOKING_CHANGE.01`
- [ ] **Desk court bill (tab.open, tab.settle, tab.cancel, tab.settle_zero)** Offline, open the bill of a booking that has no tab yet **Expect:** "The bill could not be opened while offline. Try again when the connection is back." and no payment can be taken here `OP.OFFLINE_MATRIX.DESK_BILL.01`
- [ ] **Desk court bill (tab.open, tab.settle, tab.cancel, tab.settle_zero)** Offline, take cash on a booking whose bill tab already exists **Expect:** Works offline: "Payment saved. It will reach the server when the connection is back." `OP.OFFLINE_MATRIX.DESK_BILL.02`
- [ ] **Desk court bill (tab.open, tab.settle, tab.cancel, tab.settle_zero)** P1 · Offline, close a bill at zero **Expect:** "Bill close saved. It will be recorded when the connection is back." and the close control shows "The close is waiting to sync..." `OP.OFFLINE_MATRIX.DESK_BILL.04`
- [ ] **Till new tab (tab.open)** Offline, open a new tab for a table **Expect:** Works offline: the tab is on the plan marked "Not yet on the server - syncs automatically" under a local: id `OP.OFFLINE_MATRIX.TAB_OPEN.01`
- [ ] **Send to kitchen (order.create / order.add_items)** Offline, add items to an offline tab and press Send to kitchen **Expect:** Works offline: "Order sent.", lines appear priced from the cached menu, and the ticket reaches the kitchen screen over the LAN `OP.OFFLINE_MATRIX.ORDER_SEND.01`
- [ ] **Send to kitchen (order.create / order.add_items)** Offline, add items to a server tab (opened before the outage) **Expect:** Queued with the tab id; ticket on the LAN board `OP.OFFLINE_MATRIX.ORDER_SEND.02`
- [ ] **Payment (tab.settle, payment.record)** Offline, settle a server tab in cash **Expect:** Works offline: change shown, "Payment saved on this station. It will be recorded when the connection is back; the amount due updates then." and paying again is blocked `OP.OFFLINE_MATRIX.PAYMENT.01`
- [ ] **Payment (tab.settle, payment.record)** Offline, settle by card **Expect:** Same queued state; record the card terminal slip separately (terminal is outside the app) `OP.OFFLINE_MATRIX.PAYMENT.02`

## Mobile app (iOS + Android)

The Expo app players use to sign in, book courts, pay deposits, join open matches, follow ranks and loyalty, and order from the café. The same app carries staff, coach and owner modes behind role checks.

111 pages, 430 test points, 2164 steps (152 P0 points).

### MOB.APP: App shell and boot

The root layout: boot preferences, fonts, splash and BootOverlay, the provider tree, the offline bar, the crash and config-error screens, and the first-launch Welcome redirect. Every guest passes through it on every launch.

**Route:** `/_layout`

**Source:** `apps/mobile/app/_layout.tsx`, `apps/mobile/src/features/boot/BootOverlay.tsx`, `apps/mobile/src/features/boot/splash.ts`, `apps/mobile/src/lib/bootPrefs.ts`, `apps/mobile/src/components/states.tsx`

**Components:** Offline bar · Crash and config error screens · Boot preferences

#### MOB.APP.T01 · P1 · App shell and boot: main checks

- [ ] Cold start the release build on a phone with a good connection **Expect:** The native splash (brand blue) cross-fades into BootOverlay with the Touch logo serve, then fades into the Book tab; no white frame, no half-built 3D court, no language or theme flash `MOB.APP.01`
- [ ] Fresh install, signed out: launch for the first time **Expect:** Welcome replaces the tabs as the first screen (router.replace('/welcome')); a second launch goes straight to the Book tab `MOB.APP.02`
- [ ] Signed-in guest: kill and relaunch **Expect:** No Welcome screen; the tabs open straight away with the restored session `MOB.APP.03`
- [ ] Use the app on a network where Google is blocked or behind a VPN, but Supabase is reachable **Expect:** The offline bar does NOT show (NetInfo reachability probing is disabled; only isConnected counts) and everything works `MOB.APP.08`
- [ ] Force a render crash on a dev build (or trigger any screen that throws) and look at the result **Expect:** The crash screen (testID app.crash) shows 'This screen ran into a problem' with a Retry button, in the guest's language and theme; Retry re-renders `MOB.APP.09`

#### MOB.APP.T02 · P1 · Crash and config error screens: main flow

- [ ] Trigger the error boundary in a release build **Expect:** No developer stack trace text is shown (the dev detail line is __DEV__ only) `MOB.APP.CRASH_AND_CONFIG.02`
- [ ] P2 · Tap Retry on the crash screen after the cause is gone **Expect:** The screen renders normally again `MOB.APP.CRASH_AND_CONFIG.03`
- [ ] Check the splash is hidden on the crash and config screens **Expect:** The native splash is hidden (useRevealSplash) so the message is visible `MOB.APP.CRASH_AND_CONFIG.04`

#### MOB.APP.T03 · P2 · App shell and boot: other parts

- [ ] Corrupt or clear app storage (Android: clear storage) and relaunch **Expect:** Boot falls back to light + English (or device locale) and the app opens; no crash `MOB.APP.THEME_LANGUAGE_BOOT.03`

*Setup:* `OFFLINE` (No internet)

- [ ] Cold start with airplane mode on, signed in, after having used the app online before **Expect:** The app opens (no endless splash); the Book tab and My reservations show the persisted cache; the red offline bar 'You are offline. Some things will not work until you reconnect.' shows `MOB.APP.05`
- [ ] Cold start with airplane mode on, on a fresh install **Expect:** The app still leaves the splash (auth and boot prefs do not wait on the network); screens show their loading or error states with Retry rather than a frozen splash `MOB.APP.06`
- [ ] **Offline bar** Turn airplane mode on while on the Book tab **Expect:** The offline bar slides in with errors.offline text, below the status bar, not covering the native back button `MOB.APP.OFFLINE_BANNER.01`

*Setup:* `OFFLINE_THEN_RECONNECT` (Offline, then back online), `FEATURE_FLAG_OFF` (A feature switched off), `REDUCE_MOTION` (OS asks for reduced motion), `SCREEN_READER` (Screen reader on), `DARK_MODE` (Dark / blue display mode), `SLOW_NETWORK` (Slow network), `FLAKY_NETWORK` (Network drops on and off), `STAFF_SESSION` (Staff account signed in on the phone)

- [ ] `OFFLINE_THEN_RECONNECT` P1 · While on any screen, turn airplane mode on, then off **Expect:** The offline bar appears within a second or two and disappears when the connection returns; paused queries refetch on reconnect `MOB.APP.07`
- [ ] `FEATURE_FLAG_OFF` Build with EXPO_PUBLIC_SUPABASE_URL or EXPO_PUBLIC_SUPABASE_ANON_KEY missing (e.g. the staging profile as committed, which still has REPLACE placeholders) and launch **Expect:** The config-error screen (testID app.config-error) shows instead of a white splash; production builds must never reach this screen `MOB.APP.10`

- [ ] `DARK_MODE` P2 · Check the status bar on every tab in light and dark **Expect:** Status bar icons are dark on light pages and light on dark pages (ThemedChrome); the Android navigation bar background matches the page colour `MOB.APP.12`
- [ ] **Boot preferences** `DARK_MODE` P2 · Choose Dark in Settings, kill the app, relaunch **Expect:** The app comes back dark from the very first frame `MOB.APP.THEME_LANGUAGE_BOOT.01`
- [ ] `SLOW_NETWORK` P2 · On a slow phone (older Android), cold start and time to the first usable Book tab **Expect:** Under about 4 seconds to a usable screen; the BootOverlay hold ends even if fonts or auth are slow (it has its own time limits) `MOB.APP.13`
- [ ] **Offline bar** `FLAKY_NETWORK` P2 · Turn Wi-Fi on but connect to a router with no internet **Expect:** isConnected is still true, so the bar does not show; requests time out and screens show their own error or Retry `MOB.APP.OFFLINE_BANNER.02`
- [ ] `STAFF_SESSION` P1 · Sign in with a staff account and cold start **Expect:** StaffStatusProvider routes to the staff Today screen, not the guest tabs; the screenshot guard and activity ping mount only for staff `MOB.APP.14`

### MOB.TABS: Tab bar

The guest tab bar: Bookings, Play, Book, Club, Coaches. iOS uses the native tab bar; Android draws its own bar. GuestTabsGate sends staff sessions to Today. The avatar (AccountButton) on each tab's title row opens the account page.

**Route:** `/(tabs)`

**Source:** `apps/mobile/app/(tabs)/_layout.tsx`, `apps/mobile/src/features/staff/GuestTabsGate.tsx`, `apps/mobile/src/navigation/TabsLayout.ios.tsx`, `apps/mobile/src/navigation/TabsLayout.android.tsx`, `apps/mobile/src/components/AccountButton.tsx`, `apps/mobile/src/features/tournaments/shipped.ts`

#### MOB.TABS.T01 · P1 · Tab bar: other parts

- [ ] Tap each tab in turn **Expect:** Bookings, Play, Book, Club and Coaches each open their screen; the selected tab is highlighted; the Book tab is the default on launch `MOB.TABS.01`
- [ ] Tap the avatar (AccountButton) on each tab's title row **Expect:** Profile opens as a pushed screen with a native back button; signed out it shows the sign-in pitch `MOB.TABS.07`

#### MOB.TABS.T02 · P1 · Tab bar: iPhone vs Android, back gesture

*Setup:* `PLATFORM_IOS` (iOS-specific behaviour), `PLATFORM_ANDROID` (Android-specific behaviour)
