- [ ] `SESSION_EXPIRED` Revoke the user's sessions on the server (or delete the refresh token), then foreground the app **Expect:** The refresh fails, the app treats the guest as signed out, gated screens show Welcome; no endless spinner `MOB.SESSION.03`
- [ ] `SLOW_NETWORK` P2 · Open a gated screen while auth is still initialising on cold start **Expect:** A spinner shows; there is no flash of the signed-out redirect `MOB.SESSION.04`

### MOB.NETWORK: Query layer, retries and offline rules

The TanStack Query client: offlineFirst pausing, retry rules, request deadlines, persisted cache with exclusions, idempotency keys.

**Roles:** guest

**Source:** `apps/mobile/src/lib/queryClient.ts`, `apps/mobile/src/lib/network.ts`, `apps/mobile/src/lib/requestTimeout.ts`, `apps/mobile/src/lib/idempotency.ts`, `apps/mobile/src/features/booking/errors.ts`

#### MOB.NETWORK.T01 · P1 · Query layer, retries and offline rules: other parts

- [ ] Make a new booking attempt after a refusal **Expect:** A new intent gets a new key; it is not refused as a duplicate of the old one `MOB.NETWORK.09`
- [ ] P2 · Bring the app to the foreground after a while **Expect:** Visible queries refetch on focus (focusManager tied to AppState); there is no 60 s poll running in the background `MOB.NETWORK.10`

#### MOB.NETWORK.T02 · P0 · Query layer, retries and offline rules: With no internet

*Setup:* `OFFLINE` (No internet)

- [ ] Tap Cancel booking with airplane mode on **Expect:** The cancel fails now with the network line (cancel_reservation is never retried automatically) and the booking stays as it was `MOB.NETWORK.04`
- [ ] P1 · Join a match / book a lesson / register for a tournament offline **Expect:** These run now or fail now: an error shows immediately; nothing is queued to fire later `MOB.NETWORK.05`
- [ ] P1 · Use the app online, then cold start offline and open Play, a match, My lessons, a tournament and Ranks **Expect:** Match, coaching, tournament and ranks data are NOT restored from disk (never persisted): they show loading or error; Bookings and the Book grid do restore `MOB.NETWORK.07`

#### MOB.NETWORK.T03 · P0 · Query layer, retries and offline rules: ge

*Setup:* `SLOT_TAKEN` (Slot or seat taken by someone else first), `OFFLINE_THEN_RECONNECT` (Offline, then back online), `SLOW_NETWORK` (Slow network), `FLAKY_NETWORK` (Network drops on and off), `OLD_APP_VERSION` (Station build older than the server)

- [ ] `SLOT_TAKEN` P1 · Trigger a business refusal (e.g. tap a slot someone else just took: SLOT_TAKEN) **Expect:** The refusal shows at once (no retry delay) and never reads as 'No connection' `MOB.NETWORK.01`
- [ ] `OFFLINE_THEN_RECONNECT` P1 · Kill connectivity mid-request on a read (e.g. pull to refresh Bookings) **Expect:** The query pauses and resumes on reconnect; it does not fail with an error screen if cached data exists `MOB.NETWORK.02`
- [ ] `OFFLINE_THEN_RECONNECT` Tap Reserve court on Review with airplane mode on, then turn it off within the hold **Expect:** The confirm (keyed, confirm_booking) waits and goes through once on reconnect; exactly one booking is created `MOB.NETWORK.03`
- [ ] `SLOW_NETWORK` P1 · Leave a request hanging (server slow) for more than the request deadline **Expect:** The request times out (TimeoutError) and is treated as a transport failure: the network line and a retry, not a frozen spinner; edge functions get 30 s `MOB.NETWORK.06`
- [ ] `FLAKY_NETWORK` Retry a failed hold after a transport error **Expect:** The retry carries the same idempotency key ({station}:{mutation}:{ulid}); the server creates one hold, not two `MOB.NETWORK.08`
- [ ] `OLD_APP_VERSION` P1 · Deploy a backend change that removes an RPC the app calls (PGRST202) on a test project **Expect:** The screen shows a generic error, not 'No connection'; the deposit quote and match chips fail fast (one try) and Review falls back to plain Confirm `MOB.NETWORK.11`

*Setup:* `OFFLINE` (No internet), `FLAKY_NETWORK` (Network drops on and off), `ARABIC_RTL` (Arabic, right to left), `DARK_MODE` (Dark / blue display mode), `LIGHT_MODE` (Light appearance), `SMALL_SCREEN` (Small station screen), `LARGE_TEXT` (Largest OS text size), `SCREEN_READER` (Screen reader on), `BACK_GESTURE` (Back gesture or button), `STAFF_SESSION` (Staff account signed in on the phone)

- [ ] `DARK_MODE` P2 · Set Appearance to Dark and open Welcome **Expect:** Background, cards, text and icons use the dark palette; no white flashes, no black text on navy, native bar chevron and title visible `MOB.WELCOME.04`
- [ ] `LIGHT_MODE` P2 · Set Appearance to Light (and then Automatic with the phone in light mode) and open Welcome **Expect:** Light palette throughout; status bar icons dark on light; Automatic follows the phone setting live `MOB.WELCOME.05`
- [ ] `SMALL_SCREEN` P2 · Open Welcome on a small phone (iPhone SE 3rd gen / 5-inch Android) with the keyboard open where there are fields **Expect:** Nothing is clipped or overlapped; the primary action (Sign in) is reachable by scrolling and is not hidden behind the keyboard or the tab bar `MOB.WELCOME.06`
- [ ] `LARGE_TEXT` P2 · Set the OS text size to the largest (iOS Larger Text / Android Font size max) and open Welcome **Expect:** Text grows without overlapping or being cut off mid-word; buttons still fit their labels; the screen still scrolls to every control `MOB.WELCOME.07`
- [ ] `SCREEN_READER` P2 · Turn on VoiceOver (iOS) / TalkBack (Android) and swipe through Welcome **Expect:** Every control is reached in reading order and announced with a meaningful label and role; the primary action is announced as 'Sign in' button `MOB.WELCOME.08`
- [ ] `BACK_GESTURE` On iOS, swipe back from the left edge (right edge in Arabic) on Welcome; on Android, press the system back button / back gesture **Expect:** Back from Welcome (pushed by a slot tap) returns to where the guest was; Keep browsing does the same and clears the pending intent `MOB.WELCOME.10`
- [ ] `STAFF_SESSION` Sign in with a staff account and try to reach Welcome **Expect:** RequireNoSession sends a signed-in session (staff or guest) away from Welcome `MOB.WELCOME.11`

### MOB.SIGN_IN: Sign in

Sign in with the account's phone number (a code, no password; default segment) or email + password, or with Apple / Google.

**Route:** `/sign-in`

**Source:** `apps/mobile/app/sign-in.tsx`, `apps/mobile/src/features/auth/api.ts`, `apps/mobile/src/features/auth/phoneOtp.ts`, `apps/mobile/src/features/auth/useFinishSignIn.ts`, `apps/mobile/src/features/booking/usePostAuthContinue.ts`

**Components:** Continue with Apple / Google · Phone segment · Email segment

#### MOB.SIGN_IN.T01 · P0 · Phone segment: main flow

- [ ] Enter a registered Iraqi number and tap Send code **Expect:** A code is sent (WhatsApp first, SMS if the number has no WhatsApp) and Verify code opens in signin mode `MOB.SIGN_IN.PHONE.01`
- [ ] P1 · Tap Send code with the field empty **Expect:** auth.phoneRequired shows on the field; no code is requested `MOB.SIGN_IN.PHONE.02`
- [ ] P1 · Enter a too-short or invalid number **Expect:** auth.phoneOtpInvalid shows on the field before any paid code is requested `MOB.SIGN_IN.PHONE.03`
- [ ] P2 · Pick another country in the picker (e.g. Turkey) and send **Expect:** The E.164 is built with that country code; numbers worldwide are accepted `MOB.SIGN_IN.PHONE.05`

#### MOB.SIGN_IN.T02 · P0 · Email segment: main flow

- [ ] Switch to Email, enter valid credentials and tap Sign in **Expect:** The welcome-back toast shows and the guest lands on the pending action or the tabs; an account without a phone goes to Complete your profile first `MOB.SIGN_IN.EMAIL.01`
- [ ] P2 · Tap Sign in with an empty email **Expect:** auth.emailRequired on the email field `MOB.SIGN_IN.EMAIL.02`
- [ ] P2 · Enter a malformed email **Expect:** auth.emailInvalid on the email field `MOB.SIGN_IN.EMAIL.03`
- [ ] P2 · Enter a correct email and no password **Expect:** auth.passwordRequired on the password field `MOB.SIGN_IN.EMAIL.04`
- [ ] P1 · Enter a wrong password **Expect:** auth.invalidEmailCredentials on the password field; no hint whether the email exists beyond that `MOB.SIGN_IN.EMAIL.05`
- [ ] P1 · Sign in with an email account whose verification link was never opened **Expect:** Verify email opens with that address and a Resend link `MOB.SIGN_IN.EMAIL.06`
- [ ] P2 · Switch segments after an error **Expect:** Errors clear; the method does not flip by itself when arriving from sign-up's footer `MOB.SIGN_IN.EMAIL.07`
- [ ] P2 · Tap Forgot password **Expect:** Forgot password opens on the email segment; the link is hidden on the phone segment `MOB.SIGN_IN.EMAIL.09`
- [ ] P2 · Tap Create account in the footer **Expect:** Sign up opens on the same segment `MOB.SIGN_IN.EMAIL.10`

#### MOB.SIGN_IN.T03 · P1 · Sign in: other parts

- [ ] **Whole page** P2 · Inspect Sign in with the Maestro / Appium inspector **Expect:** Interactive elements carry the agreed testIDs, including sign-in.submit, sign-in.social, sign-in.method, sign-in.phone, sign-in.email, sign-in.password, sign-in.forgot-password, sign-in.create-account `MOB.SIGN_IN.09`
- [ ] **Continue with Apple / Google** P2 · Double-tap Continue with Apple quickly **Expect:** Only one sheet opens; the other button and the form are disabled while busy `MOB.SIGN_IN.SOCIAL.09`
- [ ] **Continue with Apple / Google** Social sign-in with a pending slot (tapped a slot signed out first) **Expect:** After sign-in (and Complete your profile if needed) the slot is held and Review opens `MOB.SIGN_IN.SOCIAL.10`

#### MOB.SIGN_IN.T04 · P0 · Sign in: iPhone vs Android, back gesture

*Setup:* `BACK_GESTURE` (Back gesture or button), `PLATFORM_IOS` (iOS-specific behaviour), `PLATFORM_ANDROID` (Android-specific behaviour)

- [ ] `BACK_GESTURE` P1 · On iOS, swipe back from the left edge (right edge in Arabic) on Sign in; on Android, press the system back button / back gesture **Expect:** The screen pops to the one beneath it with the native animation; if it was opened from a link with nothing beneath, it lands on the tabs instead of doing nothing `MOB.SIGN_IN.10`
- [ ] **Continue with Apple / Google** `PLATFORM_IOS` On an iPhone, tap Continue with Apple and complete Face ID **Expect:** Signed in; first-time Apple sign-ups get their name from Apple's first authorization; a new account without a phone goes to Complete your profile; otherwise the welcome-back toast and the pending action or the tabs `MOB.SIGN_IN.SOCIAL.01`
- [ ] **Continue with Apple / Google** `PLATFORM_IOS` P1 · On an iPhone, start Apple sign-in and cancel the sheet **Expect:** Nothing happens: no error text, buttons usable again `MOB.SIGN_IN.SOCIAL.02`
- [ ] **Continue with Apple / Google** `PLATFORM_ANDROID` P1 · On an Android phone, look at the social block **Expect:** Only Continue with Google shows (Apple is iOS-only); with no Google configured the divider is hidden too `MOB.SIGN_IN.SOCIAL.03`
- [ ] **Continue with Apple / Google** `PLATFORM_IOS` P1 · Tap Continue with Google on iOS **Expect:** The Google sheet opens, sign-in completes with the id-token grant, same landing as Apple `MOB.SIGN_IN.SOCIAL.04`
- [ ] **Continue with Apple / Google** `PLATFORM_ANDROID` P1 · Tap Continue with Google on Android and close the account chooser **Expect:** The 'Use Google in the browser' offer appears (testID sign-in.social.google-browser); tapping it signs in through the browser and returns via auth-callback `MOB.SIGN_IN.SOCIAL.05`
- [ ] **Continue with Apple / Google** `PLATFORM_ANDROID` P1 · On a Huawei or phone without Play Services, tap Continue with Google **Expect:** It goes straight to the browser flow (googleStartsInBrowser) or shows auth.googlePlayServices; never a silent failure `MOB.SIGN_IN.SOCIAL.06`
- [ ] **Phone segment** `PLATFORM_IOS` P2 · On iOS open the country picker; on Android open it **Expect:** iOS uses the native wheel/picker sheet; Android its own list; both searchable and readable in Arabic `MOB.SIGN_IN.PHONE.06`

- [ ] P1 · Submit with last name empty **Expect:** auth.lastNameRequired on Last name `MOB.SIGN_UP.FORM.03`
- [ ] P1 · Submit with no gender picked **Expect:** guestGender.required on the gender picker (gender is a must for every account, 0353) `MOB.SIGN_UP.FORM.04`
- [ ] P1 · Submit with no age band picked **Expect:** auth.ageRequired on the age picker (0368) `MOB.SIGN_UP.FORM.05`

- [ ] P1 · Submit with a password under the minimum **Expect:** auth.passwordTooShort on Password (also when the server says weak-password) `MOB.SIGN_UP.FORM.09`
- [ ] P2 · Type a name longer than the maximum **Expect:** The field caps at NAME_PART_MAX characters `MOB.SIGN_UP.FORM.11`

- [ ] Email segment: sign up with an email that already has an account **Expect:** auth.emailTaken on the field and the same dialog with the email prefilled `MOB.SIGN_UP.FORM.13`
- [ ] P1 · Email segment: complete the form and submit **Expect:** Verify email opens (replace) waiting for the link; the language switches first `MOB.SIGN_UP.FORM.14`

- [ ] P2 · Tap a ticked row **Expect:** It unticks without opening the reader `MOB.SIGN_UP.TERMS_ROW.04`
- [ ] P1 · Tap the Terms or Privacy link inside the row text (sign-up.terms-link.*) **Expect:** The reader opens at that document `MOB.SIGN_UP.TERMS_ROW.05`

### MOB.BOOK: Book tab

**Source:** `apps/mobile/app/(tabs)/index.tsx`, `apps/mobile/src/components/BookingSheet.tsx`, `apps/mobile/src/components/booking.tsx`, `apps/mobile/src/features/availability/useAvailabilityBooking.ts`, `apps/mobile/src/features/availability/assemble.ts`, `apps/mobile/src/features/availability/courtsChannel.ts`, `apps/mobile/src/features/availability/BranchPicker.tsx`, `apps/mobile/src/features/courtTransition/useCourtTransition.ts`

**Components:** 3D court and transition · Branch picker · Day chips and duration · Slot grid · Tap a free slot (hold) · Open-match chips

- [ ] P1 · Tap a slot in a closed date / outside hours / in the past (e.g. leave the grid open past the hour) **Expect:** booking.closedDate / outsideHours / slotInPast; the grid refetches `MOB.BOOK.HOLD.06`

### MOB.REVIEW: Review and confirm

Navy hold card with live countdown, summary, pay-at-desk card, cancellation policy, and Reserve court (native confirm alert) or Pay now by Qi Card depending on the venue deposit mode. Terminal states for hold expired and slot taken.

**Route:** `/review` · **Roles:** guest

**Source:** `apps/mobile/app/review.tsx`, `apps/mobile/src/features/booking/hooks.ts`, `apps/mobile/src/features/deposit/hooks.ts`, `apps/mobile/src/features/deposit/logic.ts`, `apps/mobile/src/features/profile/consent.ts`

**Components:** Hold card and countdown · Summary and policy · Reserve court · Pay now by Qi Card · Hold expired / slot taken

#### MOB.REVIEW.T01 · P1 · Hold card and countdown: main flow

- [ ] Open Review after a hold **Expect:** booking.heldForYou with a m:ss countdown that ticks every second and a shrinking bar; booking.holdExplainer text `MOB.REVIEW.HOLD_CARD.01`
- [ ] Re-tap a slot you already hold (duplicate replay) **Expect:** Review opens with no countdown (no deadline) rather than an instant expired screen `MOB.REVIEW.HOLD_CARD.03`
- [ ] P2 · Background the app for 3 minutes and return **Expect:** The countdown reflects real elapsed time `MOB.REVIEW.HOLD_CARD.04`

- [ ] **Summary and policy** Check each summary row against the slot tapped **Expect:** Court, date, time (Baghdad), duration (booking.durationMinutes) and price in IQD all match the slot and the grid price `MOB.REVIEW.SUMMARY.01`
- [ ] **Summary and policy** P1 · Read the policy line **Expect:** 'Free cancellation until {hours} hours before your slot...' with the branch's real cancellation_window_hours `MOB.REVIEW.SUMMARY.03`
- [ ] **Summary and policy** P1 · Venue deposit off: read the pay-at-desk card **Expect:** booking.payAtDeskTitle / payAtDeskBody: court reserved now, pay at reception `MOB.REVIEW.SUMMARY.04`
- [ ] **Summary and policy** Venue deposit optional: read the pay-at-desk card **Expect:** deposit.deskOptionalBody explains paying now is optional and the rest is paid at the desk, with the deposit amount in IQD `MOB.REVIEW.SUMMARY.05`

- [ ] **Reserve court** P1 · Deposit became required while on Review (DEPOSIT_REQUIRED) **Expect:** The quote refetches; Reserve is replaced by Pay now; the error line explains `MOB.REVIEW.RESERVE.09`
- [ ] **Reserve court** Double-tap Reserve in the alert **Expect:** One booking only (confirm_booking answers a repeat with duplicate) `MOB.REVIEW.RESERVE.10`
- [ ] **Pay now by Qi Card** Deposit optional: look at the footer **Expect:** 'Pay {amount} now' (deposit amount in IQD) first and 'Reserve court' (confirm, pay at the desk) second `MOB.REVIEW.PAY_NOW.01`
- [ ] **Pay now by Qi Card** Deposit required: look at the footer **Expect:** Only 'Pay {amount} now' `MOB.REVIEW.PAY_NOW.02`

- [ ] **Pay now by Qi Card** App Review account (payment_sandbox) taps Pay now **Expect:** The sandbox pill shows on the payment screen; Qi sandbox is used; no real money `MOB.REVIEW.PAY_NOW.11`

- [ ] `FLAKY_NETWORK` P1 · Open Success on a throttled connection (Network Link Conditioner / Android emulator 'Edge', or 3G with packet loss) and use its main action **Expect:** Loading shows a spinner or skeleton, requests time out with a clear error rather than hanging, and a retry succeeds once the connection improves; nothing is recorded twice `MOB.SUCCESS.02`
- [ ] `ARABIC_RTL` P1 · Switch the app to Arabic (Settings > Language) and open Success **Expect:** Every string is Arabic (no English keys or English fallbacks), the layout mirrors (leading edge on the right), back chevrons and arrows point the Arabic way, numbers and phone numbers are not scrambled by bidi `MOB.SUCCESS.03`
- [ ] `DARK_MODE` P2 · Set Appearance to Dark and open Success **Expect:** Background, cards, text and icons use the dark palette; no white flashes, no black text on navy, native bar chevron and title visible `MOB.SUCCESS.04`
- [ ] `LIGHT_MODE` P2 · Set Appearance to Light (and then Automatic with the phone in light mode) and open Success **Expect:** Light palette throughout; status bar icons dark on light; Automatic follows the phone setting live `MOB.SUCCESS.05`
- [ ] `SMALL_SCREEN` P2 · Open Success on a small phone (iPhone SE 3rd gen / 5-inch Android) with the keyboard open where there are fields **Expect:** Nothing is clipped or overlapped; the primary action (Done) is reachable by scrolling and is not hidden behind the keyboard or the tab bar `MOB.SUCCESS.06`
- [ ] `LARGE_TEXT` P2 · Set the OS text size to the largest (iOS Larger Text / Android Font size max) and open Success **Expect:** Text grows without overlapping or being cut off mid-word; buttons still fit their labels; the screen still scrolls to every control `MOB.SUCCESS.07`
- [ ] `SCREEN_READER` P2 · Turn on VoiceOver (iOS) / TalkBack (Android) and swipe through Success **Expect:** Every control is reached in reading order and announced with a meaningful label and role; the primary action is announced as 'Done' button `MOB.SUCCESS.08`
- [ ] `BACK_GESTURE` P1 · On iOS, swipe back from the left edge (right edge in Arabic) on Success; on Android, press the system back button / back gesture **Expect:** Success has no header; back/swipe goes to the tabs, never back into Review `MOB.SUCCESS.10`
- [ ] `SESSION_EXPIRED` P1 · Let the session expire (revoke the refresh token in Supabase or sign the account out on the server) and return to Success **Expect:** The failed token refresh signs the app out; RequireSession replaces the screen with Welcome (or an action shows the auth.sessionExpired line for AUTH_REQUIRED); no private data from the old session stays on screen `MOB.SUCCESS.11`
- [ ] `NOT_SIGNED_IN` Signed out, open Success directly (link or adb/xcrun openurl) **Expect:** RequireSession shows a spinner while auth initialises, then replaces the screen with Welcome (Sign in / Create account / Keep browsing); the private screen never renders its data `MOB.SUCCESS.12`

One reservation: court, date, time, duration, reference, payment state (pay at desk, paid online, payment in progress), weekly series notice, Cancel booking (the only place a guest cancels) and Call venue.

**Route:** `/booking/[id]` · **Roles:** guest

**Source:** `apps/mobile/app/booking/[id].tsx`, `apps/mobile/src/features/booking/logic.ts`, `apps/mobile/src/features/booking/hooks.ts`

**Components:** Booking info · Cancel booking · Call venue

#### MOB.BOOKING_DETAIL.T01 · P1 · Booking info: main flow

- [ ] Open an upcoming booking **Expect:** Court (by language), date, time, duration, reference (booking.bookingRef), status and pay-at-desk or paid-online line `MOB.BOOKING_DETAIL.INFO.01`
- [ ] P2 · Open a weekly series booking **Expect:** 'Weekly series' notice (booking.seriesNotice) explains series changes go through the desk `MOB.BOOKING_DETAIL.INFO.04`
- [ ] P2 · Open a booking the desk cancelled or marked no-show **Expect:** The ended notice names who ended it (0088) and no Cancel button `MOB.BOOKING_DETAIL.INFO.05`

- [ ] Cancel inside the cancellation window **Expect:** booking.windowClosedTitle / windowClosedBody with the hours; Call venue is offered; no cancel happens `MOB.BOOKING_DETAIL.CANCEL.02`

- [ ] P2 · Tap Cancel twice quickly **Expect:** One cancel call; the button shows busy `MOB.BOOKING_DETAIL.CANCEL.06`

- [ ] **Cancel booking** Cancel a booking that had a paid deposit **Expect:** deposit.cancelRefundLine says the deposit is refunded to the card; the payment screen later shows refund pending then refunded `MOB.BOOKING_DETAIL.CANCEL.04`

### MOB.PAY_RETURN: Payment return link

touchpadel://pay/return?ref=...: where Qi's return page sends the browser. It closes the payment sheet and hands the ref to the payment screen; it decides nothing.

**Route:** `/pay/return` · **Roles:** guest

**Source:** `apps/mobile/app/pay/return.tsx`, `apps/mobile/src/features/deposit/browser.ts`

#### MOB.PAY_RETURN.T01 · P0 · Payment return link: ge

*Setup:* `PAYMENT_RETURNED` (Returned from Qi Card's page), `DEEP_LINK_COLD_START` (Opened from a link or push while the app was killed), `NOT_SIGNED_IN` (No session), `LINK_EXPIRED` (Expired, used or malformed link), `PLATFORM_ANDROID` (Android-specific behaviour), `FEATURE_FLAG_OFF` (A feature switched off), `SCREEN_READER` (Screen reader on)

- [ ] `PAYMENT_RETURNED` Pay on Qi's page and let it redirect back **Expect:** The sheet closes (iOS) and the payment screen shows the ref; never 'paid' from the link alone `MOB.PAY_RETURN.01`
- [ ] `PAYMENT_RETURNED` P1 · Return link while the payment screen is already open beneath **Expect:** dismissTo pops to that screen; no second payment screen is stacked `MOB.PAY_RETURN.02`
- [ ] `DEEP_LINK_COLD_START` Open the return link with the app killed **Expect:** The app cold starts onto the payment screen for that ref `MOB.PAY_RETURN.03`
- [ ] `NOT_SIGNED_IN` P1 · Open the return link while signed out **Expect:** The ref is remembered; after sign-in the payment screen opens `MOB.PAY_RETURN.04`
- [ ] `LINK_EXPIRED` P2 · Open touchpadel://pay/return with no ref **Expect:** The payment screen shows its 'nothing to show here' (notFound) state `MOB.PAY_RETURN.05`
- [ ] `PLATFORM_ANDROID` P1 · On Android, return from the Custom Tab **Expect:** The app comes to the front with the payment screen; no attempt to close the tab programmatically crashes `MOB.PAY_RETURN.06`
- [ ] `FEATURE_FLAG_OFF` P2 · Build with EXPO_PUBLIC_ONLINE_PAYMENTS off and open the link **Expect:** The online payments gate keeps the screen from rendering a payment flow `MOB.PAY_RETURN.07`
- [ ] `SCREEN_READER` P2 · Screen reader on the return spinner **Expect:** Announced as progress with deposit.checkingTitle `MOB.PAY_RETURN.08`

### MOB.PAY_STATUS: Payment status

THE payment screen for deposits, ticket purchases and lesson payments: renders only what deposit-status says, polls every 2 s then 5 s, offers Open payment page again, Try again, Pay at the desk instead, Choose another time, Leave.

**Route:** `/pay/status` · **Roles:** guest

**Source:** `apps/mobile/app/pay/status.tsx`, `apps/mobile/src/features/deposit/logic.ts`, `apps/mobile/src/features/deposit/hooks.ts`, `apps/mobile/src/features/deposit/pendingPayment.ts`, `apps/mobile/src/features/deposit/PayStateLayout.tsx`

**Components:** Checking / still checking · Paid / confirmed · Failed · Expired, refunds, slot lost · Not found and error

#### MOB.PAY_STATUS.T01 · P0 · Payment status: money and totals

- [ ] **Checking / still checking** Start a deposit and look at the screen while Qi's page is open **Expect:** deposit.checkingTitle with deposit.timeLeft countdown and summary (court, date, time, amount in IQD) `MOB.PAY_STATUS.CHECKING.01`
- [ ] **Checking / still checking** App Review sandbox account **Expect:** deposit.sandbox pill shows 'test' payment `MOB.PAY_STATUS.CHECKING.06`
- [ ] **Paid / confirmed** Deposit succeeds **Expect:** deposit.paidTitle / paidBody (or booking.successTitle when confirmed) with the amount in IQD and View booking `MOB.PAY_STATUS.SUCCESS.01`
- [ ] **Paid / confirmed** Ticket purchase succeeds **Expect:** matches.pay.ticketsBoughtTitle with the count; View tickets; a purchase made for a join continues into that join once `MOB.PAY_STATUS.SUCCESS.02`
- [ ] **Paid / confirmed** Lesson payment succeeds **Expect:** coaching.guest.pay.lessonBooked with View the lesson `MOB.PAY_STATUS.SUCCESS.03`
- [ ] **Paid / confirmed** Compare the amount on screen with Qi's receipt and the operator **Expect:** All three are the same IQD amount, no rounding difference `MOB.PAY_STATUS.SUCCESS.04`
- [ ] **Paid / confirmed** P1 · Succeeded but the booking is not yet visible **Expect:** stillChecking rather than claiming either outcome `MOB.PAY_STATUS.SUCCESS.05`
- [ ] **Expired, refunds, slot lost** Refund pending **Expect:** deposit.refundPendingTitle / body `MOB.PAY_STATUS.REFUNDS.03`
- [ ] **Expired, refunds, slot lost** P1 · Refunded **Expect:** deposit.refundedTitle with the date (or refundedBodyNoDate) `MOB.PAY_STATUS.REFUNDS.04`
- [ ] **Expired, refunds, slot lost** Refund failed **Expect:** deposit.refundFailedTitle / body with Call venue `MOB.PAY_STATUS.REFUNDS.05`
- [ ] **Expired, refunds, slot lost** P1 · Lesson payment that landed after the place was released **Expect:** coaching.guest.pay.refundPending (never 'slot lost') `MOB.PAY_STATUS.REFUNDS.06`

#### MOB.PAY_STATUS.T02 · P2 · Payment status: other parts

- [ ] **Whole page** Inspect the payment screen with the Maestro / Appium inspector **Expect:** Interactive elements carry the agreed testIDs, including pay-status.state.<kind>, pay-status.open-again, pay-status.leave, pay-status.check-again, pay-status.try-again, pay-status.pay-at-desk, pay-status.choose-another-time, pay-status.view-booking, pay-status.bookings, pay-status.view-tickets, pay-status.view-lesson, pay-status.book-again, pay-status.call-venue, pay-status.back, pay-status.error `MOB.PAY_STATUS.09`
- [ ] **Checking / still checking** Check the poll rate **Expect:** About every 2 s for the first minute, then every 5 s, and again on foreground `MOB.PAY_STATUS.CHECKING.05`

#### MOB.PAY_STATUS.T03 · P0 · Payment status: Who can and cannot use it

*Setup:* `SESSION_EXPIRED` (Staff session expired), `NOT_SIGNED_IN` (No session), `WRONG_ROLE` (Signed in with a role that may not use this)

- [ ] `SESSION_EXPIRED` P1 · Let the session expire (revoke the refresh token in Supabase or sign the account out on the server) and return to the payment screen **Expect:** The failed token refresh signs the app out; RequireSession replaces the screen with Welcome (or an action shows the auth.sessionExpired line for AUTH_REQUIRED); no private data from the old session stays on screen `MOB.PAY_STATUS.11`
- [ ] `NOT_SIGNED_IN` Signed out, open the payment screen directly (link or adb/xcrun openurl) **Expect:** RequireSession shows a spinner while auth initialises, then replaces the screen with Welcome (Sign in / Create account / Keep browsing); the private screen never renders its data `MOB.PAY_STATUS.12`
- [ ] **Not found and error** `WRONG_ROLE` Another account's ref **Expect:** PAYMENT_NOT_FOUND line; no data from the other account `MOB.PAY_STATUS.ERRORS.03`

#### MOB.PAY_STATUS.T04 · P1 · Payment status: Flaky or slow network, backend down

*Setup:* `FLAKY_NETWORK` (Network drops on and off), `SLOW_NETWORK` (Slow network), `BACKEND_DOWN` (Server unreachable while the LAN is up)

- [ ] `FLAKY_NETWORK` Open the payment screen on a throttled connection (Network Link Conditioner / Android emulator 'Edge', or 3G with packet loss) and use its main action **Expect:** Polling keeps going; a failed poll does not change the state; once a poll succeeds the true state shows `MOB.PAY_STATUS.02`
- [ ] **Checking / still checking** `SLOW_NETWORK` Let the payment window pass with Qi still pending **Expect:** deposit.stillCheckingTitle; polling continues a minute past the deadline, then the rest is left to push `MOB.PAY_STATUS.CHECKING.04`
- [ ] **Not found and error** `BACKEND_DOWN` Server returns a non-transport error **Expect:** pay-status.error with Retry (Check again) `MOB.PAY_STATUS.ERRORS.02`

#### MOB.PAY_STATUS.T05 · P0 · Payment status: Left Qi Card's page without paying

*Setup:* `PAYMENT_CANCELLED` (Left Qi Card's page without paying)

- [ ] **Checking / still checking** Close Qi's page without paying **Expect:** The screen keeps asking the server (a closed sheet means nothing); 'Open payment page again' reopens the same attempt `MOB.PAY_STATUS.CHECKING.02`
- [ ] **Failed** P1 · Cancel on Qi's page **Expect:** deposit.failedCancelled `MOB.PAY_STATUS.FAILED.04`
- [ ] **Expired, refunds, slot lost** P1 · Let the window expire without paying **Expect:** deposit.expiredTitle / expiredBody; Book again / Choose another time `MOB.PAY_STATUS.REFUNDS.01`

#### MOB.PAY_STATUS.T06 · P0 · Payment status: Online payment failed

*Setup:* `PAYMENT_FAILED` (Online payment failed)

- [ ] **Failed** Use a card that the bank declines **Expect:** deposit.failedTitle with deposit.failedDeclined; Try again if attempts are left `MOB.PAY_STATUS.FAILED.01`
- [ ] **Failed** P1 · Fail 3-D Secure **Expect:** deposit.failedAuth `MOB.PAY_STATUS.FAILED.02`
- [ ] **Failed** P1 · Bank error **Expect:** deposit.failedBank `MOB.PAY_STATUS.FAILED.03`
- [ ] **Failed** Tap Try again **Expect:** A new attempt starts and Qi's page opens; the pending pointer now points at the new ref `MOB.PAY_STATUS.FAILED.05`
- [ ] **Failed** Optional mode: tap Pay at the desk instead **Expect:** The booking is confirmed without a deposit (confirm_booking) and Success shows pay-at-desk `MOB.PAY_STATUS.FAILED.06`
- [ ] **Failed** P1 · Ticket purchase fails **Expect:** matches.pay.failedNoAttempts when out of attempts; no pay-at-desk option `MOB.PAY_STATUS.FAILED.10`

#### MOB.PAY_STATUS.T07 · P0 · Payment status: ge (1 of 2)

*Setup:* `OFFLINE` (No internet), `ARABIC_RTL` (Arabic, right to left), `DARK_MODE` (Dark / blue display mode), `LIGHT_MODE` (Light appearance), `SMALL_SCREEN` (Small station screen), `LARGE_TEXT` (Largest OS text size), `SCREEN_READER` (Screen reader on), `BACK_GESTURE` (Back gesture or button), `DEEP_LINK_COLD_START` (Opened from a link or push while the app was killed), `APP_KILLED_MIDFLOW` (Station app closed or power cut mid-flow), `PAYMENT_RETURNED` (Returned from Qi Card's page), `RATE_LIMITED` (AI vendor rate limit (429) or free AI per-minute / club limit)

- [ ] `OFFLINE` P1 · Open the payment screen with Wi-Fi and mobile data off (airplane mode) **Expect:** The screen keeps the last server answer (or the spinner) and never shows 'failed' from a failed request; the offline bar shows; deposit.offlineHint shows when the phone is online but the server does not answer `MOB.PAY_STATUS.01`
- [ ] `ARABIC_RTL` P1 · Switch the app to Arabic (Settings > Language) and open the payment screen **Expect:** Every string is Arabic (no English keys or English fallbacks), the layout mirrors (leading edge on the right), back chevrons and arrows point the Arabic way, numbers and phone numbers are not scrambled by bidi `MOB.PAY_STATUS.03`
- [ ] `DARK_MODE` P2 · Set Appearance to Dark and open the payment screen **Expect:** Background, cards, text and icons use the dark palette; no white flashes, no black text on navy, native bar chevron and title visible `MOB.PAY_STATUS.04`
- [ ] `LIGHT_MODE` P2 · Set Appearance to Light (and then Automatic with the phone in light mode) and open the payment screen **Expect:** Light palette throughout; status bar icons dark on light; Automatic follows the phone setting live `MOB.PAY_STATUS.05`
- [ ] `SMALL_SCREEN` P2 · Open the payment screen on a small phone (iPhone SE 3rd gen / 5-inch Android) with the keyboard open where there are fields **Expect:** Nothing is clipped or overlapped; the primary action (the state's primary action) is reachable by scrolling and is not hidden behind the keyboard or the tab bar `MOB.PAY_STATUS.06`
- [ ] `LARGE_TEXT` P2 · Set the OS text size to the largest (iOS Larger Text / Android Font size max) and open the payment screen **Expect:** Text grows without overlapping or being cut off mid-word; buttons still fit their labels; the screen still scrolls to every control `MOB.PAY_STATUS.07`
- [ ] `SCREEN_READER` P2 · Turn on VoiceOver (iOS) / TalkBack (Android) and swipe through the payment screen **Expect:** Every control is reached in reading order and announced with a meaningful label and role; the primary action is announced as 'the state's primary action' button `MOB.PAY_STATUS.08`
- [ ] `BACK_GESTURE` P1 · On iOS, swipe back from the left edge (right edge in Arabic) on the payment screen; on Android, press the system back button / back gesture **Expect:** While checking, Android back or swipe asks 'Leave this screen?' (deposit.leaveTitle) with Stay / Leave; Leave goes to My reservations, never back to Review; the iOS back item always leaves `MOB.PAY_STATUS.10`
- [ ] `DEEP_LINK_COLD_START` P1 · Kill the app, then open the payment screen from its link or push **Expect:** A payment push or the return link cold-starts here `MOB.PAY_STATUS.13`
- [ ] `APP_KILLED_MIDFLOW` Kill the app (swipe it away) in the middle of the payment screen and reopen it **Expect:** Killing the app on Qi's 3-D Secure page and reopening it brings the guest back to this screen for that payment (pending pointer tp.pendingPayment.<uid>) within the window plus ten minutes `MOB.PAY_STATUS.14`
- [ ] **Checking / still checking** `PAYMENT_RETURNED` Approve on Qi's page and close it one second later **Expect:** The screen shows paid as soon as the server says so `MOB.PAY_STATUS.CHECKING.03`
- [ ] **Failed** `RATE_LIMITED` P1 · Out of attempts (TOO_MANY_ATTEMPTS) **Expect:** deposit.failedNoAttempts / tooManyAttempts with Choose another time `MOB.PAY_STATUS.FAILED.07`

#### MOB.PAY_STATUS.T08 · P0 · Payment status: ge (2 of 2)

*Setup:* `HOLD_EXPIRED` (Hold timed out), `SLOT_TAKEN` (Slot or seat taken by someone else first), `LINK_EXPIRED` (Expired, used or malformed link)

- [ ] **Failed** `HOLD_EXPIRED` P1 · Fail after the hold expired **Expect:** deposit.failedHoldGone with Choose another time / Book again `MOB.PAY_STATUS.FAILED.08`
- [ ] **Failed** `HOLD_EXPIRED` P1 · Try again when the hold just expired (HOLD_EXPIRED) or deposits went off (DEPOSITS_OFF) **Expect:** The right state and line; no new charge attempt `MOB.PAY_STATUS.FAILED.09`
- [ ] **Expired, refunds, slot lost** `SLOT_TAKEN` Pay after the slot was already lost (late success) **Expect:** deposit.slotLostTitle / slotLostBody; refund pending `MOB.PAY_STATUS.REFUNDS.02`
- [ ] **Not found and error** `LINK_EXPIRED` P2 · Open /pay/status?ref=unknown **Expect:** deposit.notFoundTitle / notFoundBody with My reservations `MOB.PAY_STATUS.ERRORS.01`

### MOB.MATCH_DETAIL: Open match

One open match: everything the guest may do comes from the server (me.can / me.refusal). Join, Ask to join, Buy tickets and join, Leave, Withdraw request, seat menu, organiser's requests and Cancel, Share invite, Message, Report, Block, Call branch. Polled every 20 s while filling.

**Route:** `/match/[id]` · **Roles:** guest

**Source:** `apps/mobile/app/(matches)/match/[id].tsx`, `apps/mobile/src/features/matches/state.ts`, `apps/mobile/src/features/matches/errors.ts`, `apps/mobile/src/features/matches/hooks.ts`, `apps/mobile/src/features/matches/continuation.ts`

**Components:** Join / Ask / Buy and join · Share and payment lines · Leave / Withdraw · Organiser tools · Share, report and block · Match states

#### MOB.MATCH_DETAIL.T01 · P0 · Join / Ask / Buy and join: main flow

- [ ] Join an open public match with tickets in the wallet **Expect:** match_join runs; matches.detail.joined; the guest's seat shows on the seats card; one ticket is in use `MOB.MATCH_DETAIL.JOIN.01`
- [ ] P1 · Ask to join an approval match **Expect:** matches.detail.requestSent; the card shows 'asked' with Withdraw; a ticket is held `MOB.MATCH_DETAIL.JOIN.02`
- [ ] P1 · Join too late (MATCH_TOO_LATE) **Expect:** matches.errors.tooLateAt with the minutes of notice `MOB.MATCH_DETAIL.JOIN.05`
- [ ] P1 · Join with the wrong gender for the category (MATCH_GENDER_MISMATCH) **Expect:** matches.errors.genderMismatch `MOB.MATCH_DETAIL.JOIN.06`
- [ ] P1 · Join with no gender set (GENDER_REQUIRED) **Expect:** The inline gender ask (match-detail.gender); after answering, Join again `MOB.MATCH_DETAIL.JOIN.07`
- [ ] P2 · Already in (MATCH_ALREADY_IN) **Expect:** matches.errors.alreadyIn and the card shows you in `MOB.MATCH_DETAIL.JOIN.12`
- [ ] P2 · Seat limit (MATCH_SEAT_LIMIT) **Expect:** matches.errors.seatLimit `MOB.MATCH_DETAIL.JOIN.13`
- [ ] P1 · Join with friends (seats wanted, friends gender row) **Expect:** Seats for friends use your tickets; the friends gender is asked for mixed/category matches `MOB.MATCH_DETAIL.JOIN.14`

#### MOB.MATCH_DETAIL.T02 · P1 · Leave / Withdraw: main flow

- [ ] Leave a match early enough **Expect:** matches.detail.leaveTitle with the outcome (ticket returned); Leave confirms; matches.detail.left `MOB.MATCH_DETAIL.LEAVE.01`
- [ ] Organiser leaves **Expect:** matches.detail.leaveOrganiser warns what happens to the match `MOB.MATCH_DETAIL.LEAVE.03`
- [ ] P2 · Withdraw a pending request **Expect:** matches.detail.withdrawn; the held ticket returns `MOB.MATCH_DETAIL.LEAVE.04`
- [ ] P2 · Tap Keep it in the dialog **Expect:** Nothing changes `MOB.MATCH_DETAIL.LEAVE.05`

#### MOB.MATCH_DETAIL.T03 · P1 · Organiser tools: main flow

- [ ] As organiser, approve a request **Expect:** The requester gets a seat; the request row disappears `MOB.MATCH_DETAIL.ORGANISER.01`
- [ ] Remove a player from the seat menu **Expect:** matches.detail.removeTitle confirm; matches.detail.removed; late removal warns `MOB.MATCH_DETAIL.ORGANISER.03`
- [ ] Cancel the match **Expect:** matches.detail.cancelTitle with a reason (cancelWhy); cancelled; players notified by push `MOB.MATCH_DETAIL.ORGANISER.04`
- [ ] P2 · Send a preset message **Expect:** matches.messages.sent; the button rests for a few seconds after a send `MOB.MATCH_DETAIL.ORGANISER.05`

#### MOB.MATCH_DETAIL.T04 · P1 · Share, report and block: main flow

- [ ] Tap Share (or the header share) **Expect:** The native share sheet opens with matches.link.shareMessage and an https://www.touch-padel.com/m/<token> link (with the branch line) `MOB.MATCH_DETAIL.SHARE_REPORT.01`
- [ ] Tap Report on a player **Expect:** Match report opens for that player `MOB.MATCH_DETAIL.SHARE_REPORT.03`
- [ ] Block a player **Expect:** matches.detail.blockTitle confirm; matches.detail.blocked; that player's matches are hidden from each other `MOB.MATCH_DETAIL.SHARE_REPORT.04`

### MOB.MATCH_NEW: Start an open match

Start a match at a chosen court and time: who can play (category, gender hours), who can see (public / link only), approval policy, seats for you and friends, the quote (price per player in IQD), buy-and-start with tickets. match_start carries an idempotency key kept across the refusals the guest fixes.

**Route:** `/match-new` · **Roles:** guest

**Source:** `apps/mobile/app/(matches)/match-new.tsx`, `apps/mobile/src/features/matches/hooks.ts`, `apps/mobile/src/features/matches/errors.ts`, `apps/mobile/src/lib/idempotency.ts`

- [ ] `FLAKY_NETWORK` P1 · Open Report a player on a throttled connection (Network Link Conditioner / Android emulator 'Edge', or 3G with packet loss) and use its main action **Expect:** Loading shows a spinner or skeleton, requests time out with a clear error rather than hanging, and a retry succeeds once the connection improves; nothing is recorded twice `MOB.MATCH_REPORT.02`

- [ ] `DARK_MODE` P2 · Set Appearance to Dark and open Report a player **Expect:** Background, cards, text and icons use the dark palette; no white flashes, no black text on navy, native bar chevron and title visible `MOB.MATCH_REPORT.04`
- [ ] `LIGHT_MODE` P2 · Set Appearance to Light (and then Automatic with the phone in light mode) and open Report a player **Expect:** Light palette throughout; status bar icons dark on light; Automatic follows the phone setting live `MOB.MATCH_REPORT.05`
- [ ] `SMALL_SCREEN` P2 · Open Report a player on a small phone (iPhone SE 3rd gen / 5-inch Android) with the keyboard open where there are fields **Expect:** Nothing is clipped or overlapped; the primary action (Send report) is reachable by scrolling and is not hidden behind the keyboard or the tab bar `MOB.MATCH_REPORT.06`
- [ ] `LARGE_TEXT` P2 · Set the OS text size to the largest (iOS Larger Text / Android Font size max) and open Report a player **Expect:** Text grows without overlapping or being cut off mid-word; buttons still fit their labels; the screen still scrolls to every control `MOB.MATCH_REPORT.07`
- [ ] `SCREEN_READER` P2 · Turn on VoiceOver (iOS) / TalkBack (Android) and swipe through Report a player **Expect:** Every control is reached in reading order and announced with a meaningful label and role; the primary action is announced as 'Send report' button `MOB.MATCH_REPORT.08`

- [ ] `SESSION_EXPIRED` P1 · Let the session expire (revoke the refresh token in Supabase or sign the account out on the server) and return to Report a player **Expect:** The failed token refresh signs the app out; RequireSession replaces the screen with Welcome (or an action shows the auth.sessionExpired line for AUTH_REQUIRED); no private data from the old session stays on screen `MOB.MATCH_REPORT.11`

### MOB.TOURNAMENT_DETAIL: Tournament

One tournament: what, when, places, fee (paid at the desk), Register / Join the waitlist / Withdraw, the seating board, schedule and standings (refreshed every 30 s while live). Public; register runs the open-match eligibility.

**Route:** `/tournament/[id]`

**Source:** `apps/mobile/app/(tournaments)/tournament/[id].tsx`, `apps/mobile/src/features/tournaments/hooks.ts`, `apps/mobile/src/features/tournaments/errors.ts`, `apps/mobile/src/features/tournaments/seating.ts`, `apps/mobile/src/components/tournament.tsx`, `apps/mobile/src/features/tournaments/shipped.ts`

**Components:** Register and withdraw · Seating board · Schedule and standings

#### MOB.TOURNAMENT_DETAIL.T01 · P1 · Register and withdraw: main flow

- [ ] Tap an open chair **Expect:** Runs Register (same refusals); you get the next place `MOB.TOURNAMENT_DETAIL.SEATING.02`
- [ ] P2 · After round 1 is drawn **Expect:** Round 1 courts and your court / sit-out show `MOB.TOURNAMENT_DETAIL.SEATING.05`

#### MOB.TOURNAMENT_DETAIL.T03 · P2 · Schedule and standings: main flow

- [ ] Leave the screen **Expect:** Refresh stops (only while focused) `MOB.TOURNAMENT_DETAIL.LIVE.02`
- [ ] Americano and Mexicano formats **Expect:** Points target and diff columns render correctly `MOB.TOURNAMENT_DETAIL.LIVE.03`

#### MOB.TOURNAMENT_DETAIL.T04 · P0 · Tournament: money and totals

- [ ] `OFFLINE` Open the tournament screen with Wi-Fi and mobile data off (airplane mode) **Expect:** Loading or error with Retry (never persisted); Register / Withdraw fail at once; nothing queues `MOB.TOURNAMENT_DETAIL.01`
- [ ] `FLAKY_NETWORK` Open the tournament screen on a throttled connection (Network Link Conditioner / Android emulator 'Edge', or 3G with packet loss) and use its main action **Expect:** Loading shows a spinner or skeleton, requests time out with a clear error rather than hanging, and a retry succeeds once the connection improves; nothing is recorded twice `MOB.TOURNAMENT_DETAIL.02`

- [ ] **Register and withdraw** `SLOT_TAKEN` Register when full **Expect:** Joins the waitlist: 'Number N on the waitlist' `MOB.TOURNAMENT_DETAIL.REGISTER.02`
- [ ] **Register and withdraw** `TERMS_REQUIRED` Register without terms **Expect:** Accept terms `MOB.TOURNAMENT_DETAIL.REGISTER.05`
- [ ] **Register and withdraw** `PHONE_REQUIRED` Register with no phone **Expect:** Profile step (phone); the booking gate itself does not apply (no court booked) `MOB.TOURNAMENT_DETAIL.REGISTER.06`
- [ ] **Seating board** `LARGE_DATA` P2 · Many courts **Expect:** Board folds with Show all / Show fewer `MOB.TOURNAMENT_DETAIL.SEATING.03`

### MOB.LESSON_REVIEW: Review lesson

Review a private lesson: time (Change), party (just me / me plus friends, friend names), pay online or at the desk, Book. The booking gate stands first; lessonIntentKey is kept across PHONE_REQUIRED, TERMS_REQUIRED and PRICE_CHANGED.

**Route:** `/lesson-review` · **Roles:** guest

**Source:** `apps/mobile/app/(coaching)/lesson-review.tsx`, `apps/mobile/src/features/coaching/errors.ts`, `apps/mobile/src/features/coaching/payment.ts`, `apps/mobile/src/lib/idempotency.ts`

**Components:** Book a private lesson

#### MOB.LESSON_REVIEW.T01 · P0 · Book a private lesson: main flow

- [ ] Book with pay at the desk **Expect:** coaching.guest.review.booked; the lesson opens `MOB.LESSON_REVIEW.BOOK.01`
- [ ] P1 · Increase party above the max (PARTY_TOO_LARGE) **Expect:** Inline under the stepper with the max people; stepper clamped `MOB.LESSON_REVIEW.BOOK.04`
- [ ] P2 · Tap Change **Expect:** Back to lesson times `MOB.LESSON_REVIEW.BOOK.12`

#### MOB.LESSON_REVIEW.T02 · P0 · Review lesson: money and totals

- [ ] **Book a private lesson** Book with pay online **Expect:** lesson-begin, the payment screen, Qi's page; success shows lessonBooked `MOB.LESSON_REVIEW.BOOK.02`
- [ ] **Book a private lesson** Read the price **Expect:** Price in IQD for the party size; per-person or total exactly as the server quotes `MOB.LESSON_REVIEW.BOOK.03`

#### MOB.LESSON_REVIEW.T03 · P2 · Review lesson: other parts

- [ ] Inspect Lesson review with the Maestro / Appium inspector **Expect:** Interactive elements carry the agreed testIDs, including lesson-review.book, lesson-review.hero, lesson-review.time, lesson-review.change, lesson-review.party, lesson-review.friend.<n>, lesson-review.mode, lesson-review.refusal, lesson-review.pay-desk-instead, lesson-review.degraded, lesson-review.error `MOB.LESSON_REVIEW.09`

#### MOB.LESSON_REVIEW.T04 · P0 · Review lesson: ge (1 of 2)

*Setup:* `OFFLINE` (No internet), `FLAKY_NETWORK` (Network drops on and off), `ARABIC_RTL` (Arabic, right to left), `DARK_MODE` (Dark / blue display mode), `LIGHT_MODE` (Light appearance), `SMALL_SCREEN` (Small station screen), `LARGE_TEXT` (Largest OS text size), `SCREEN_READER` (Screen reader on), `BACK_GESTURE` (Back gesture or button), `SESSION_EXPIRED` (Staff session expired), `NOT_SIGNED_IN` (No session)

- [ ] `OFFLINE` P1 · Open Lesson review with Wi-Fi and mobile data off (airplane mode) **Expect:** Coaching data is never persisted: offline the screen shows loading then an error with Retry; any lesson write fails at once with the network line and nothing is queued `MOB.LESSON_REVIEW.01`
- [ ] `FLAKY_NETWORK` P1 · Open Lesson review on a throttled connection (Network Link Conditioner / Android emulator 'Edge', or 3G with packet loss) and use its main action **Expect:** Loading shows a spinner or skeleton, requests time out with a clear error rather than hanging, and a retry succeeds once the connection improves; nothing is recorded twice `MOB.LESSON_REVIEW.02`
- [ ] **Book a private lesson** `FLAKY_NETWORK` Transport failure on Book then retry **Expect:** Same key; one lesson `MOB.LESSON_REVIEW.BOOK.11`
- [ ] `ARABIC_RTL` P1 · Switch the app to Arabic (Settings > Language) and open Lesson review **Expect:** Every string is Arabic (no English keys or English fallbacks), the layout mirrors (leading edge on the right), back chevrons and arrows point the Arabic way, numbers and phone numbers are not scrambled by bidi `MOB.LESSON_REVIEW.03`
- [ ] `DARK_MODE` P2 · Set Appearance to Dark and open Lesson review **Expect:** Background, cards, text and icons use the dark palette; no white flashes, no black text on navy, native bar chevron and title visible `MOB.LESSON_REVIEW.04`
- [ ] `LIGHT_MODE` P2 · Set Appearance to Light (and then Automatic with the phone in light mode) and open Lesson review **Expect:** Light palette throughout; status bar icons dark on light; Automatic follows the phone setting live `MOB.LESSON_REVIEW.05`
- [ ] `SMALL_SCREEN` P2 · Open Lesson review on a small phone (iPhone SE 3rd gen / 5-inch Android) with the keyboard open where there are fields **Expect:** Nothing is clipped or overlapped; the primary action (Book) is reachable by scrolling and is not hidden behind the keyboard or the tab bar `MOB.LESSON_REVIEW.06`
- [ ] `LARGE_TEXT` P2 · Set the OS text size to the largest (iOS Larger Text / Android Font size max) and open Lesson review **Expect:** Text grows without overlapping or being cut off mid-word; buttons still fit their labels; the screen still scrolls to every control `MOB.LESSON_REVIEW.07`
- [ ] `SCREEN_READER` P2 · Turn on VoiceOver (iOS) / TalkBack (Android) and swipe through Lesson review **Expect:** Every control is reached in reading order and announced with a meaningful label and role; the primary action is announced as 'Book' button `MOB.LESSON_REVIEW.08`
- [ ] `BACK_GESTURE` P1 · On iOS, swipe back from the left edge (right edge in Arabic) on Lesson review; on Android, press the system back button / back gesture **Expect:** The screen pops to the one beneath it with the native animation; if it was opened from a link with nothing beneath, it lands on the tabs instead of doing nothing `MOB.LESSON_REVIEW.10`
- [ ] `SESSION_EXPIRED` P1 · Let the session expire (revoke the refresh token in Supabase or sign the account out on the server) and return to Lesson review **Expect:** The failed token refresh signs the app out; RequireSession replaces the screen with Welcome (or an action shows the auth.sessionExpired line for AUTH_REQUIRED); no private data from the old session stays on screen `MOB.LESSON_REVIEW.11`
- [ ] `NOT_SIGNED_IN` Signed out, open Lesson review directly (link or adb/xcrun openurl) **Expect:** RequireSession shows a spinner while auth initialises, then replaces the screen with Welcome (Sign in / Create account / Keep browsing); the private screen never renders its data `MOB.LESSON_REVIEW.12`

#### MOB.LESSON_REVIEW.T05 · P0 · Review lesson: ge (2 of 2)

*Setup:* `APP_KILLED_MIDFLOW` (Station app closed or power cut mid-flow), `PRICE_CHANGED` (Price moved since the quote), `PHONE_REQUIRED` (No phone or unverified phone), `TERMS_REQUIRED` (Current terms not accepted), `SLOT_TAKEN` (Slot or seat taken by someone else first), `CONCURRENT_EDIT` (Two people change the same thing), `DEGRADED_LOCKOUT` (Venue trading offline (degraded mode)), `VENDOR_DOWN` (Third-party service down)

- [ ] `APP_KILLED_MIDFLOW` Kill the app (swipe it away) in the middle of Lesson review and reopen it **Expect:** Nothing is booked until Book succeeds; after an online payment started, the pending pointer resumes the payment screen `MOB.LESSON_REVIEW.13`
- [ ] **Book a private lesson** `PRICE_CHANGED` Price changed (PRICE_CHANGED) **Expect:** The new IQD price inline (priceChangedTo); profile refetched; Book again keeps the key `MOB.LESSON_REVIEW.BOOK.05`
- [ ] **Book a private lesson** `PHONE_REQUIRED` No phone (PHONE_REQUIRED) **Expect:** Complete your profile in back mode; key kept `MOB.LESSON_REVIEW.BOOK.06`
- [ ] **Book a private lesson** `TERMS_REQUIRED` P1 · Terms not accepted **Expect:** Accept terms; key kept `MOB.LESSON_REVIEW.BOOK.07`
- [ ] **Book a private lesson** `SLOT_TAKEN` P1 · Time taken meanwhile **Expect:** Toast, the slots refetch, back to the grid `MOB.LESSON_REVIEW.BOOK.08`
- [ ] **Book a private lesson** `CONCURRENT_EDIT` P2 · Payment mode changed by the branch **Expect:** Branch settings refetched; the mode choice re-rendered `MOB.LESSON_REVIEW.BOOK.09`
- [ ] **Book a private lesson** `DEGRADED_LOCKOUT` P1 · Venue degraded **Expect:** degraded.bookingRefused with the branch phone `MOB.LESSON_REVIEW.BOOK.10`
- [ ] **Book a private lesson** `VENDOR_DOWN` P1 · Online payment unavailable **Expect:** Pay at the desk instead offered `MOB.LESSON_REVIEW.BOOK.13`

### MOB.DELETE_ACCOUNT: Delete account

In-app account deletion (App Store / Play requirement): says what is deleted, requires typing the localised word (DELETE in English), revokes Sign in with Apple on iOS first, deletes server-side (app.delete_my_account), then unregisters push, purges keychain keys and caches, and lands on Welcome.

**Route:** `/delete-account` · **Roles:** guest

**Source:** `apps/mobile/app/delete-account.tsx`, `apps/mobile/src/features/profile/deletion.ts`, `apps/mobile/src/features/profile/localPurge.ts`, `apps/mobile/src/features/profile/purgeKeys.ts`

**Components:** Deletion flow

#### MOB.DELETE_ACCOUNT.T01 · P0 · Deletion flow: main flow

- [ ] Read the screen before typing **Expect:** 'This cannot be undone.' and the body saying the account, name and number go while bookings stay on the venue's books without a person attached `MOB.DELETE_ACCOUNT.FLOW.01`
- [ ] P1 · Type a wrong word (e.g. DELET), then the right word in lower case with spaces around it (' delete ') **Expect:** Delete stays disabled for the typo; the trimmed, case-insensitive match (confirmationMatches) enables it for ' delete ' `MOB.DELETE_ACCOUNT.FLOW.02`
- [ ] Email/phone account: type the word and Delete **Expect:** The account is deleted server-side, push token surrendered, keychain and caches purged, and Welcome replaces the stack `MOB.DELETE_ACCOUNT.FLOW.04`
- [ ] After deletion, try to sign in with the same phone or email **Expect:** The old account is gone; signing up again creates a new empty account (no old bookings, points or card) `MOB.DELETE_ACCOUNT.FLOW.05`
- [ ] After deletion, check the operator **Expect:** The bookings remain without a name or number attached; the audit log has the deletion `MOB.DELETE_ACCOUNT.FLOW.06`
- [ ] After deletion, check the phone for leftovers **Expect:** No session, no member card copy, no pending payment pointer, no cached profile or bookings; a new sign-up sees nothing of the old account `MOB.DELETE_ACCOUNT.FLOW.12`
- [ ] P2 · Double-tap Delete **Expect:** One deletion run (busy guard) `MOB.DELETE_ACCOUNT.FLOW.13`

#### MOB.DELETE_ACCOUNT.T02 · P2 · Delete account: other parts

- [ ] Inspect Delete account with the Maestro / Appium inspector **Expect:** Interactive elements carry the agreed testIDs, including delete-account.confirm, delete-account.confirm-word, delete-account.cancel `MOB.DELETE_ACCOUNT.09`

- [ ] **Deletion flow** `PLATFORM_IOS` iOS, Apple account: Delete **Expect:** The Apple sheet asks to confirm (profile.deleteAppleNote shown before); the grant is revoked, then the account deleted `MOB.DELETE_ACCOUNT.FLOW.07`

*Setup:* `OFFLINE` (No internet), `FLAKY_NETWORK` (Network drops on and off), `BACKEND_DOWN` (Server unreachable while the LAN is up), `ARABIC_RTL` (Arabic, right to left), `DARK_MODE` (Dark / blue display mode), `LIGHT_MODE` (Light appearance), `SMALL_SCREEN` (Small station screen), `LARGE_TEXT` (Largest OS text size), `SCREEN_READER` (Screen reader on), `SESSION_EXPIRED` (Staff session expired), `NOT_SIGNED_IN` (No session)

- [ ] `FLAKY_NETWORK` P1 · Open Delete account on a throttled connection (Network Link Conditioner / Android emulator 'Edge', or 3G with packet loss) and use its main action **Expect:** Loading shows a spinner or skeleton, requests time out with a clear error rather than hanging, and a retry succeeds once the connection improves; nothing is recorded twice `MOB.DELETE_ACCOUNT.02`
- [ ] **Deletion flow** `BACKEND_DOWN` Server refuses the delete **Expect:** The mapped error shows; nothing on the device is touched `MOB.DELETE_ACCOUNT.FLOW.11`
- [ ] `ARABIC_RTL` P1 · Switch the app to Arabic (Settings > Language) and open Delete account **Expect:** Every string is Arabic (no English keys or English fallbacks), the layout mirrors (leading edge on the right), back chevrons and arrows point the Arabic way, numbers and phone numbers are not scrambled by bidi `MOB.DELETE_ACCOUNT.03`
- [ ] **Deletion flow** `ARABIC_RTL` P1 · In Arabic, look at the word to type **Expect:** The Arabic word (حذف) is shown and must be typed; no Latin transliteration required `MOB.DELETE_ACCOUNT.FLOW.03`
- [ ] `DARK_MODE` P2 · Set Appearance to Dark and open Delete account **Expect:** Background, cards, text and icons use the dark palette; no white flashes, no black text on navy, native bar chevron and title visible `MOB.DELETE_ACCOUNT.04`
- [ ] `LIGHT_MODE` P2 · Set Appearance to Light (and then Automatic with the phone in light mode) and open Delete account **Expect:** Light palette throughout; status bar icons dark on light; Automatic follows the phone setting live `MOB.DELETE_ACCOUNT.05`
- [ ] `SMALL_SCREEN` P2 · Open Delete account on a small phone (iPhone SE 3rd gen / 5-inch Android) with the keyboard open where there are fields **Expect:** Nothing is clipped or overlapped; the primary action (Delete account) is reachable by scrolling and is not hidden behind the keyboard or the tab bar `MOB.DELETE_ACCOUNT.06`
- [ ] `LARGE_TEXT` P2 · Set the OS text size to the largest (iOS Larger Text / Android Font size max) and open Delete account **Expect:** Text grows without overlapping or being cut off mid-word; buttons still fit their labels; the screen still scrolls to every control `MOB.DELETE_ACCOUNT.07`
- [ ] `SCREEN_READER` P2 · Turn on VoiceOver (iOS) / TalkBack (Android) and swipe through Delete account **Expect:** Every control is reached in reading order and announced with a meaningful label and role; the primary action is announced as 'Delete account' button `MOB.DELETE_ACCOUNT.08`
- [ ] `SESSION_EXPIRED` P1 · Let the session expire (revoke the refresh token in Supabase or sign the account out on the server) and return to Delete account **Expect:** The failed token refresh signs the app out; RequireSession replaces the screen with Welcome (or an action shows the auth.sessionExpired line for AUTH_REQUIRED); no private data from the old session stays on screen `MOB.DELETE_ACCOUNT.11`
- [ ] `NOT_SIGNED_IN` Signed out, open Delete account directly (link or adb/xcrun openurl) **Expect:** RequireSession shows a spinner while auth initialises, then replaces the screen with Welcome (Sign in / Create account / Keep browsing); the private screen never renders its data `MOB.DELETE_ACCOUNT.12`

#### MOB.DELETE_ACCOUNT.T05 · P0 · Delete account: ge (2 of 2)

*Setup:* `VENDOR_DOWN` (Third-party service down), `PAYMENT_FAILED` (Online payment failed)

- [ ] **Deletion flow** `VENDOR_DOWN` iOS, Apple account with the apple-revoke function failing (NOT_CONFIGURED / 5xx) **Expect:** The account is still deleted; the failure is reported to telemetry (which currently has no backend, see MOB.TELEMETRY) `MOB.DELETE_ACCOUNT.FLOW.09`
- [ ] **Deletion flow** `PAYMENT_FAILED` P1 · Delete with a pending online payment **Expect:** The deletion still runs; the pending pointer is purged; the payment is handled by the reconciler `MOB.DELETE_ACCOUNT.FLOW.14`

### MOB.PLAY_SURVEY: Play survey

A sheet with the guest's game: level (required, no Skip), years playing, what they want, gender and age steps when missing, then suggestions. Prompted once after sign-up on a calm landing; editable from Edit profile.

**Route:** `/play-survey` · **Roles:** guest

**Source:** `apps/mobile/app/play-survey.tsx`, `apps/mobile/src/features/playProfile/usePlaySurveyPrompt.ts`, `apps/mobile/src/features/playProfile/logic.ts`, `apps/mobile/src/features/playProfile/suggest.ts`

- [ ] P2 · Inspect the play survey with the Maestro / Appium inspector **Expect:** Interactive elements carry the agreed testIDs, including play-survey.next, play-survey.level.<v>, play-survey.years.<v>, play-survey.wants.<v>, play-survey.age.<v>, play-survey.gender.<v>, play-survey.skip, play-survey.back, play-survey.finish, play-survey.done, play-survey.suggestion.<kind> `MOB.PLAY_SURVEY.09`
- [ ] P2 · Sign up a new account and land on the tabs **Expect:** The survey sheet opens once, not over a pending slot, match or lesson intent, never for staff `MOB.PLAY_SURVEY.13`
- [ ] On the level step **Expect:** No Skip button; Next disabled until a level is picked `MOB.PLAY_SURVEY.14`

- [ ] P2 · Finish **Expect:** playProfile.survey.saved; suggestions (open match, lesson, tournament) show and open their screens `MOB.PLAY_SURVEY.16`

- [ ] `PLATFORM_ANDROID` P2 · Android presentation **Expect:** Shown as a modal; back closes it `MOB.PLAY_SURVEY.19`

### MOB.STAFF_SESSION: Staff session and role switch

How one app becomes the staff phone: the staff row read after sign-in decides guest or staff, the gates keep a staff session out of the guest tabs, and the revoked and update-the-app screens. Every staff role, and every guest, passes through it.

**Roles:** cashier, prep, court_desk, manager, owner, head_barista, barista, head_chef, chef, driver, marketing, assistant_barista, waiter, shop_staff

**Source:** `apps/mobile/src/features/staff/StaffStatusProvider.tsx`, `apps/mobile/src/features/staff/status.ts`, `apps/mobile/src/features/staff/gate.ts`, `apps/mobile/src/features/staff/RequireStaff.tsx`, `apps/mobile/src/features/staff/GuestTabsGate.tsx`, `apps/mobile/src/features/staff/hint.ts`, `apps/mobile/src/features/auth/useFinishSignIn.ts`, `apps/mobile/src/features/auth/useSocialSignIn.ts`

**Components:** Staff status (guest, pending, staff, revoked, unsupported) · Google and Apple sign-in refused for staff · Route gates (RequireStaff, GuestTabsGate) · Staff Access: second jobs and blocked pages (0345) · Working venue · Staff sign-out · Show guest view · Screenshot guard · Activity ping (0341) · Undo instead of "Are you sure?" · Work photos (PhotoButton, staff-media)

#### MOB.STAFF_SESSION.T01 · P0 · Staff session and role switch: main checks

- [ ] Sign in with a staff account (email and password) on a fresh install **Expect:** The phone replaces sign-in with Today (/staff), titled "Hello, <name>" with "<Role> · <Venue>"; the guest tabs and the 3D court never mount, not even for a frame `MOB.STAFF_SESSION.01`
- [ ] Sign in as a guest who has never been staff **Expect:** The guest tabs appear exactly as before; no staff spinner, no Today `MOB.STAFF_SESSION.03`
- [ ] Sign out of staff and sign in as a guest on the same phone **Expect:** The guest gets the tabs; nothing from the staff account (Today, venue choice, reward track) is shown; the hint was cleared on sign-out `MOB.STAFF_SESSION.04`
- [ ] P1 · Sign in as staff account A, sign out, sign in as staff account B (different venue) **Expect:** Today shows B and B's venue; the venue remembered for A (tp.staff-venue:<A uid>) does not carry over `MOB.STAFF_SESSION.05`
- [ ] P2 · Sign in as staff with OTP on the phone sign-in path (if the account has a verified phone) **Expect:** The phone lands on Today the same way as the email path (useFinishSignIn reads the staff row first) `MOB.STAFF_SESSION.06`

#### MOB.STAFF_SESSION.T02 · P0 · Staff status (guest, pending, staff, revoked, unsupported): main flow

- [ ] On the operator, switch the signed-in staff account off (Staff page, deactivate) while the phone sits on Today in the foreground **Expect:** Within about 60 seconds the phone shows full-screen "This staff account is switched off" with "Ask the owner if you think this is a mistake. Sign out to use the app as a guest." and one Sign out button (staff.revoked.sign-out) `MOB.STAFF_SESSION.STATUS.01`
- [ ] Deactivate the account while the phone is in the background, then bring the app to the foreground **Expect:** The row is re-read on foreground and the revoked screen shows straight away `MOB.STAFF_SESSION.STATUS.02`
- [ ] On the revoked screen, press back, swipe back, or open a staff deep link **Expect:** Nothing but the revoked screen is reachable; the guest tabs never mount for a revoked account `MOB.STAFF_SESSION.STATUS.03`
- [ ] P1 · On the revoked screen press Sign out **Expect:** The phone signs out; signing in again as a guest account works normally; the device hint is cleared `MOB.STAFF_SESSION.STATUS.04`
- [ ] P1 · Re-activate the same account on the operator, then sign in again on the phone **Expect:** Today opens with the account's role `MOB.STAFF_SESSION.STATUS.05`
- [ ] P1 · Delete the staff row for an account this phone knew (hint present), then foreground the app **Expect:** The phone shows the revoked screen, not the guest tabs (no row plus a hint for this uid means revoked) `MOB.STAFF_SESSION.STATUS.06`
- [ ] P2 · Sign in with a retired-role account (prep) **Expect:** Today opens with the prep role's rows (Protocols, Requests, Notes, Suggestions, Incidents); nothing errors `MOB.STAFF_SESSION.STATUS.10`

#### MOB.STAFF_SESSION.T03 · P0 · Staff sign-out: main flow

- [ ] P2 · On Today press Sign out (staff.sign-out) **Expect:** A native alert "Sign out" with "You will need your email and password to sign back in." and Cancel / Sign out `MOB.STAFF_SESSION.SIGN_OUT.01`
- [ ] P1 · Confirm Sign out **Expect:** The phone signs out and lands on the guest app; the owner's Activity page shows the person as signed out on the phone within a minute `MOB.STAFF_SESSION.SIGN_OUT.02`
- [ ] Sign out, then sign in as a different staff member and open Requests **Expect:** Only the new person's requests show; nothing cached from the first person (sign-out clears every cache) `MOB.STAFF_SESSION.SIGN_OUT.05`

#### MOB.STAFF_SESSION.T04 · P1 · Activity ping (0341): main flow

- [ ] Sign in as a waiter, open Guest calls; on the owner's phone open Activity **Expect:** The waiter's Phone part shows online, last seen just now, screen /staff-calls and the app version `MOB.STAFF_SESSION.ACTIVITY_PING.01`
- [ ] P2 · Send the waiter's app to the background and wait a minute **Expect:** The owner's board shows the phone as away (background) `MOB.STAFF_SESSION.ACTIVITY_PING.02`
- [ ] P2 · Do a write on the waiter's phone (answer a call) **Expect:** The owner's board shows the last action under the Phone part, not the Operator part (requests carry x-touch-app: mobile) `MOB.STAFF_SESSION.ACTIVITY_PING.03`
- [ ] P2 · Sign in as a guest and use the app **Expect:** No staff_activity_ping calls are made (no row on the board) `MOB.STAFF_SESSION.ACTIVITY_PING.05`

#### MOB.STAFF_SESSION.T05 · P1 · Work photos (PhotoButton, staff-media): main flow

- [ ] Add a photo with "Take photo" on a checklist line that needs one **Expect:** "Uploading photo…" then the thumbnail; the line ticks `MOB.STAFF_SESSION.PHOTOS.01`
- [ ] P2 · Choose a photo from the library (no permission prompt) **Expect:** The system picker opens without asking for photo access and the upload works `MOB.STAFF_SESSION.PHOTOS.03`
- [ ] Upload a photo with a GPS-tagged original, then download it from the staff-media bucket **Expect:** The stored JPEG carries no EXIF, no location and no camera data `MOB.STAFF_SESSION.PHOTOS.04`
- [ ] P2 · Upload a 24-megapixel photo **Expect:** It uploads (long edge capped at 2048, well under the bucket's 5 MiB) `MOB.STAFF_SESSION.PHOTOS.05`
- [ ] P2 · Add photos up to the field's maximum **Expect:** The counter reads "<n> of <max> photos" and the add button stops offering more `MOB.STAFF_SESSION.PHOTOS.09`
- [ ] P2 · Remove a photo (its "Remove photo <n>" control) **Expect:** The thumbnail goes and the counter drops `MOB.STAFF_SESSION.PHOTOS.10`

#### MOB.STAFF_SESSION.T06 · P0 · Staff session and role switch: other parts

- [ ] **Google and Apple sign-in refused for staff** Sign in with Google as an ordinary guest **Expect:** The guest signs in normally; no refusal `MOB.STAFF_SESSION.SOCIAL_REFUSAL.05`
- [ ] **Route gates (RequireStaff, GuestTabsGate)** P1 · Signed in as staff, open a guest deep link that targets the tabs (a booking link, touchpadel:// to the Book tab) **Expect:** The phone lands on Today, not the tabs; Today is the only screen under it (back does not stack a second Today) `MOB.STAFF_SESSION.GATES.01`
- [ ] **Staff Access: second jobs and blocked pages (0345)** P2 · Try to block a page or add a second job for the owner account on the operator **Expect:** The operator refuses; the owner's phone keeps every owner tile `MOB.STAFF_SESSION.STAFF_ACCESS.06`
- [ ] **Working venue** P2 · Sign in as a staff member linked to exactly one venue **Expect:** No "Working at" picker on Today; every page reads that venue `MOB.STAFF_SESSION.VENUE.01`
- [ ] **Screenshot guard** P2 · Signed in as the owner, take a screenshot **Expect:** The screenshot works and no report is filed `MOB.STAFF_SESSION.SCREEN_GUARD.04`
- [ ] **Undo instead of "Are you sure?"** P2 · With VoiceOver or TalkBack on, withdraw a request **Expect:** The toast and its Undo action are announced and reachable before it disappears `MOB.STAFF_SESSION.UNDO.09`

#### MOB.STAFF_SESSION.T07 · P0 · Staff session and role switch: Who can and cannot use it

*Setup:* `WRONG_ROLE` (Signed in with a role that may not use this), `NOT_SIGNED_IN` (No session), `SECOND_JOB` (Person holds a second job (0345)), `STAFF_ACCESS_BLOCKED` (Owner blocked a page for this person (0345))

- [ ] **Route gates (RequireStaff, GuestTabsGate)** `WRONG_ROLE` P1 · Signed in as a waiter, open /staff-production by deep link **Expect:** The phone goes to Today (redirect-staff-home) `MOB.STAFF_SESSION.GATES.02`
- [ ] **Route gates (RequireStaff, GuestTabsGate)** `NOT_SIGNED_IN` Signed out, open /staff by deep link **Expect:** The phone shows the guest app (signed-out tabs) `MOB.STAFF_SESSION.GATES.03`
- [ ] **Route gates (RequireStaff, GuestTabsGate)** `WRONG_ROLE` Signed in as a guest (no staff row), open /staff-activity by deep link **Expect:** The guest is sent to the guest tabs; no staff content flashes `MOB.STAFF_SESSION.GATES.04`
- [ ] **Staff Access: second jobs and blocked pages (0345)** `SECOND_JOB` P1 · On the operator Staff page give a cashier the second job waiter, then wait 60 s on the phone's Today **Expect:** Today now also shows the waiter pages: Guest calls, Stock, Move stock, beside the cashier's; each opens without bouncing to Today `MOB.STAFF_SESSION.STAFF_ACCESS.01`
- [ ] **Staff Access: second jobs and blocked pages (0345)** `SECOND_JOB` P1 · Remove that second job on the operator and wait 60 s **Expect:** The waiter-only tiles disappear from Today; an open Guest calls page sends the person back to Today on the next re-check `MOB.STAFF_SESSION.STAFF_ACCESS.02`
- [ ] **Staff Access: second jobs and blocked pages (0345)** `SECOND_JOB` P2 · Give a court_desk account a second job and look at Start a protocol **Expect:** Start lists the kinds of the main role (Tournament); the server still decides any kind the second job adds `MOB.STAFF_SESSION.STAFF_ACCESS.03`
- [ ] **Staff Access: second jobs and blocked pages (0345)** `STAFF_ACCESS_BLOCKED` P1 · On the operator Staff page untick (block) the Stock page for a waiter, then wait 60 s on the waiter's phone **Expect:** Expected per 0345: the Stock row is not offered on the phone. KNOWN GAP: the phone reads blocked_areas but no mobile code applies it (only rows.ts extraRoles and gate.ts rolesOf are used), so the Stock tile still shows and opens. Record what you see and raise it `MOB.STAFF_SESSION.STAFF_ACCESS.04`
- [ ] **Staff Access: second jobs and blocked pages (0345)** `STAFF_ACCESS_BLOCKED` P1 · Block the Protocols area for a head chef and look at Today, Work alerts and a staff-step push **Expect:** Record whether the phone still shows Protocols, Start and the work list; per 0345 these are screen walls only and the RPCs still answer `MOB.STAFF_SESSION.STAFF_ACCESS.05`
- [ ] **Staff sign-out** `NOT_SIGNED_IN` After signing out, press the Android back button or swipe back **Expect:** No staff page is reachable from the guest app `MOB.STAFF_SESSION.SIGN_OUT.04`
- [ ] **Screenshot guard** `NOT_SIGNED_IN` P2 · Sign out of staff and take a screenshot as a guest **Expect:** Screenshots work again and nothing is reported `MOB.STAFF_SESSION.SCREEN_GUARD.08`

#### MOB.STAFF_SESSION.T08 · P1 · Staff session and role switch: With no internet

*Setup:* `OFFLINE` (No internet)

- [ ] Turn on airplane mode, kill the app and relaunch while signed in as staff **Expect:** A spinner, then after 10 s "Could not load" with "Checking your account is taking longer than usual. Check your connection and try again.", a Retry and a Sign out button; never the guest tabs `MOB.STAFF_SESSION.07`
- [ ] P2 · On the slow pending screen press Sign out (staff.pending.sign-out) while still offline **Expect:** The sign-out finishes (the activity ping waits 1.5 s at most) and the phone is signed out; or an error line shows under the button if sign-out itself failed `MOB.STAFF_SESSION.09`
- [ ] **Staff sign-out** Sign out with airplane mode on **Expect:** Sign-out completes locally within about 2 s (the ping gives up after 1.5 s) or an error shows under the button; the app does not hang `MOB.STAFF_SESSION.SIGN_OUT.03`
- [ ] **Undo instead of "Are you sure?"** Withdraw a request with airplane mode on and wait 5 s **Expect:** The row comes back and an error toast says "No connection. Check your internet and try again." `MOB.STAFF_SESSION.UNDO.06`
- [ ] **Work photos (PhotoButton, staff-media)** Start an upload, then turn on airplane mode **Expect:** "The photo did not upload. Try again." with "Upload the same photo again"; the form is not submitted without the photo `MOB.STAFF_SESSION.PHOTOS.06`

#### MOB.STAFF_SESSION.T09 · P1 · Staff session and role switch: Coming back online

*Setup:* `OFFLINE_THEN_RECONNECT` (Offline, then back online)

- [ ] From the slow pending screen, turn the connection back on and press Retry (staff.pending) **Expect:** The row is read again and Today opens `MOB.STAFF_SESSION.08`
- [ ] **Screenshot guard** Take a screenshot as a waiter with airplane mode on, then reconnect within a minute **Expect:** The report is retried after 2 s, 10 s and 60 s and arrives once the phone is back; the owner's list shows it `MOB.STAFF_SESSION.SCREEN_GUARD.06`
- [ ] **Activity ping (0341)** P2 · Put the waiter's phone offline for 3 minutes, then reconnect **Expect:** No error shows on the waiter's phone at any time; the board ages to offline and comes back online after reconnect `MOB.STAFF_SESSION.ACTIVITY_PING.04`
- [ ] **Work photos (PhotoButton, staff-media)** P2 · Fail an upload, reconnect, press "Upload the same photo again" **Expect:** The same photo uploads; only one object exists for that photo in staff-media `MOB.STAFF_SESSION.PHOTOS.08`

#### MOB.STAFF_SESSION.T10 · P1 · Staff session and role switch: Flaky or slow network, backend down

*Setup:* `FLAKY_NETWORK` (Network drops on and off), `SLOW_NETWORK` (Slow network)

- [ ] **Staff status (guest, pending, staff, revoked, unsupported)** `FLAKY_NETWORK` Put the phone on a flaky network so the 60 s re-check fails a few times while the account is still active **Expect:** The phone keeps showing Today (an errored read keeps the last answer); it never flips to the guest tabs or to revoked on a failed read `MOB.STAFF_SESSION.STATUS.09`
- [ ] **Route gates (RequireStaff, GuestTabsGate)** `SLOW_NETWORK` P2 · Open a staff page while the row read is still in flight on a slow connection **Expect:** A spinner, never the page's content or the guest tabs; after 10 s the Retry and Sign out screen `MOB.STAFF_SESSION.GATES.05`
- [ ] **Work photos (PhotoButton, staff-media)** `SLOW_NETWORK` P2 · Upload on a very slow connection (Network Link Conditioner, 3G or worse) **Expect:** After 45 s at most the upload stops with the failure line and a retry; the button does not spin forever `MOB.STAFF_SESSION.PHOTOS.07`

#### MOB.STAFF_SESSION.T11 · P1 · Staff session and role switch: Station app closed or power cut mid-flow

*Setup:* `APP_KILLED_MIDFLOW` (Station app closed or power cut mid-flow)

- [ ] Kill and relaunch the app while signed in as staff **Expect:** Splash, then Today directly; no flash of the guest Book tab (the device hint tp.staff-hint keeps the status pending until the row is read) `MOB.STAFF_SESSION.02`
- [ ] **Google and Apple sign-in refused for staff** Restore a Google session that was made before the staff row existed (cold start) **Expect:** On launch the session is refused with the same toast and signed out `MOB.STAFF_SESSION.SOCIAL_REFUSAL.04`
- [ ] **Show guest view** P2 · In the guest view, kill and relaunch the app **Expect:** The phone opens on Today, not in the guest view (the preview is never saved) `MOB.STAFF_SESSION.GUEST_PREVIEW.03`
- [ ] **Undo instead of "Are you sure?"** Withdraw a request and press the home button within 5 s **Expect:** The withdraw is sent at once as the app leaves the foreground; the operator shows it withdrawn `MOB.STAFF_SESSION.UNDO.04`

#### MOB.STAFF_SESSION.T12 · P0 · Staff session and role switch: Google or Apple session on a staff account

*Setup:* `SOCIAL_SIGN_IN` (Google or Apple session on a staff account)

- [ ] After using the paid assistant, sign out and sign in as a waiter on the same phone **Expect:** No owner chat, figure or chat title is visible anywhere. NOTE: queries under [assistant] are not in the persister's exclusion list (src/lib/queryClient.ts), so owner chat messages may sit in the plain AsyncStorage cache until sign-out clears it; raise it `MOB.STAFF_ASSISTANT.CHAT.18`

### MOB.COACH_GATE: Becoming a coach in the app (coach mode entry)

A coach is a guest: CoachStatusProvider reads coach_me while a reader is mounted; Profile's "Coach mode" row (guests) and Today's coach tile (staff who coach) open it; RequireCoach gates every screen; a retired coach reaches the statements only.
