## Website (Next.js on Vercel)

The club's public site: landing page, café menu behind the table QR codes, payment return, coaching and event pages, account and deletion pages, legal pages, and the files that make app links open the mobile app.

21 pages, 106 test points, 552 steps (61 P0 points).

### WEB.PLATFORM: Site platform: layout, locale routing, CSP and security headers

The document shell every page renders in (html lang/dir, fonts, theme tokens) and the request envelope proxy.ts puts on every response: locale redirect, per-request CSP nonce, static security headers.

**Route:** `/* (every request)`

**Source:** `apps/web/app/[locale]/layout.tsx`, `apps/web/proxy.ts`, `apps/web/next.config.ts`, `apps/web/src/lib/security/headers.ts`, `apps/web/src/lib/locales.ts`

**Components:** Content-Security-Policy with per-request nonce · Static security headers · Root layout and metadata defaults · PostHog analytics (café menu)

#### WEB.PLATFORM.T01 · P0 · Site platform: layout, locale routing, CSP and security headers: main checks

- [ ] Open https://www.touch-padel.com/ in a fresh private window whose browser language is Arabic **Expect:** A 307 lands on /ar, the page renders right to left and <html lang='ar' dir='rtl'> `WEB.PLATFORM.01`
- [ ] P1 · Open / in a private window whose only Accept-Language is en-US **Expect:** A 307 lands on /en and <html lang='en' dir='ltr'> `WEB.PLATFORM.02`
- [ ] P1 · Open / with Accept-Language set to fr-FR only (no en or ar) **Expect:** Falls back to /ar (the default), not /fr and not an error page `WEB.PLATFORM.03`
- [ ] P1 · On /ar click the language link to English, then type the bare domain again **Expect:** The tp-locale cookie wins over Accept-Language: you land on /en `WEB.PLATFORM.04`
- [ ] P1 · Open /privacy (no locale) and /coaching (no locale) **Expect:** A 307 to /{negotiated}/privacy and /{negotiated}/coaching, with the CSP header on the redirect response `WEB.PLATFORM.06`
- [ ] P2 · Load any page with DevTools Network open and filter by font **Expect:** The LamaSans woff2 faces load from this origin (/fonts/lama/...), each fetched once (preload with crossorigin matches), no Google Fonts or other font CDN request `WEB.PLATFORM.08`
- [ ] P2 · Fetch /fonts/lama/LamaSans-Regular.woff2 with curl -I **Expect:** Cache-Control: public, max-age=604800, stale-while-revalidate=2592000 (not immutable) `WEB.PLATFORM.09`

#### WEB.PLATFORM.T02 · P0 · Content-Security-Policy with per-request nonce: main flow

- [ ] Run curl -sI https://www.touch-padel.com/en and read content-security-policy **Expect:** Contains script-src 'nonce-...' 'strict-dynamic' 'self' (no 'unsafe-inline', no 'unsafe-eval'), frame-ancestors 'none', object-src 'none', base-uri 'self', form-action 'self', upgrade-insecure-requests `WEB.PLATFORM.CSP.01`
- [ ] Request /en twice and compare the nonce in the two CSP headers **Expect:** The nonce differs on every request `WEB.PLATFORM.CSP.02`

- [ ] Check connect-src in the CSP against NEXT_PUBLIC_SUPABASE_URL **Expect:** connect-src lists the Supabase origin and its wss:// twin, plus eu.i.posthog.com and eu-assets.i.posthog.com `WEB.PLATFORM.CSP.04`
- [ ] P2 · If NEXT_PUBLIC_POSTHOG_HOST is set to anything other than https://eu.i.posthog.com, load /ar/menu with the key set **Expect:** No CSP violation for the analytics host; if one appears, the host must be added to buildCsp or the env reverted `WEB.PLATFORM.CSP.05`
- [ ] P1 · Load an item photo and the hero photo on /ar/menu and watch Console **Expect:** img-src allows 'self', data:, blob: and the Supabase origin only; menu photos via /_next/image and the lightbox's direct Supabase URL both load without violation `WEB.PLATFORM.CSP.06`
- [ ] Open /api/t and /x.y/t (paths that used to escape the matcher) **Expect:** Both carry the CSP header and neither renders the table page with a token `WEB.PLATFORM.CSP.07`

- [ ] Run the Playwright spec e2e/tests/web-security-headers.spec.ts (pnpm e2e -- web-security-headers) **Expect:** All tests pass in both EN and AR projects `WEB.PLATFORM.CSP.10`

- [ ] curl -sI https://www.touch-padel.com/en **Expect:** Strict-Transport-Security: max-age=63072000; includeSubDomains; preload, X-Content-Type-Options: nosniff, X-Frame-Options: DENY, Referrer-Policy: strict-origin-when-cross-origin, Cross-Origin-Opener-Policy: same-origin, Permissions-Policy with camera=(), microphone=(), geolocation=(), payment=() `WEB.PLATFORM.HEADERS.01`

### WEB.APPLINKS: Universal links and Android app links

The proof files that let the iOS and Android apps claim /auth/*, /m/* and /c/* links on this domain (never /t/*).

**Route:** `/.well-known/apple-app-site-association, /.well-known/assetlinks.json`

**Source:** `apps/web/app/.well-known/apple-app-site-association/route.ts`, `apps/web/app/.well-known/assetlinks.json/route.ts`, `apps/web/src/lib/security/applinks.ts`

#### WEB.APPLINKS.T01 · P0 · Universal links and Android app links: main checks

- [ ] curl -sI https://www.touch-padel.com/.well-known/apple-app-site-association **Expect:** 200, content-type application/json, cache-control public, max-age=3600, no redirect (not /ar/.well-known/...) `WEB.APPLINKS.01`
- [ ] Read AASA paths **Expect:** Exactly /auth/*, /en/auth/*, /ar/auth/*, /m/*, /en/m/*, /ar/m/*, /c/*, /en/c/*, /ar/c/*; no /t/* `WEB.APPLINKS.03`
- [ ] P1 · Validate with Apple's AASA validator (or branch.io AASA validator) **Expect:** Passes with no errors for the production domain `WEB.APPLINKS.04`
- [ ] Compare the assetlinks fingerprint against Play Console > Setup > App integrity > App signing key certificate **Expect:** Exact match `WEB.APPLINKS.06`
- [ ] P1 · Run Google Digital Asset Links tester: https://digitalassetlinks.googleapis.com/v1/statements:list?source.web.site=https://www.touch-padel.com&relation=delegate_permission/common.handle_all_urls **Expect:** Returns the statement for com.kagu.touchpadel `WEB.APPLINKS.07`

What must be green before the website is called launch-ready: the Vercel production build of touch-padel-web, the CI gates, a performance budget and the legal copy check.

**Source:** `package.json`, `scripts/check-legal-placeholders.mjs`, `scripts/security/check-web-security.mjs`, `scripts/security/check-artifact-secrets.mjs`, `apps/web/next.config.ts`

#### WEB.RELEASE.T01 · P0 · Release gates: production build, CI, Lighthouse, legal placeholders: main checks

- [ ] Run pnpm security from the repo root **Expect:** Every sub-check passes (env-names, history, audit, data, web, quiet-errors, config-push, ...) `WEB.RELEASE.02`
- [ ] Run node scripts/security/check-artifact-secrets.mjs --only=web after a production build **Expect:** No service-role key or other secret in the built client bundle `WEB.RELEASE.03`
- [ ] Run LEGAL_STRICT=1 node scripts/check-legal-placeholders.mjs **Expect:** Must print 'PASS  no [FILL: …] placeholders left'. As of 2026-10-30 it FAILS with 2: legal.en.ts:40 [FILL: age] and legal.ar.ts:32 [FILL: العمر] (the supervision age) `WEB.RELEASE.04`
- [ ] Open /en/privacy and /ar/privacy and search the page text for [FILL **Expect:** No [FILL: ...] text visible anywhere on privacy, terms, support or delete-account `WEB.RELEASE.05`
- [ ] P2 · Run pnpm fonts:check **Expect:** Passes: the self-hosted LamaSans faces match the source `WEB.RELEASE.06`
- [ ] Push to main and follow the Vercel build of touch-padel-web to completion **Expect:** Build is Ready (green) with no build error; Next reports the route table with [locale] dynamic routes and the .well-known handlers static `WEB.RELEASE.07`
- [ ] P2 · Run Lighthouse (mobile) on /en/privacy and /en/coaching **Expect:** Performance >= 85, Accessibility >= 95, SEO >= 95 `WEB.RELEASE.11`
- [ ] P1 · Run the full Playwright site/cafe suite: site-landing, site-coaching, site-account, site-tournaments, pay-return, cafe-root, cafe-journey, cafe-menu-live, cafe-rtl-layout, web-security-headers **Expect:** All pass in both EN and AR projects `WEB.RELEASE.14`

### WEB.TABLE_QR: Table QR exchange

The printed table QR URL. proxy.ts swaps the token for an HttpOnly tp-table cookie and 307s to the token-less /{locale}/menu; the route handler repeats this if the proxy is bypassed; /{locale}/t is the old session URL, now a 307 to the menu.

**Route:** `/t/{token}, /{locale}/t/{token}, /{locale}/t`

**Source:** `apps/web/proxy.ts`, `apps/web/app/[locale]/t/[token]/route.ts`, `apps/web/app/[locale]/t/page.tsx`, `apps/web/src/lib/security/headers.ts`

**Components:** Table session boot

#### WEB.TABLE_QR.T01 · P0 · Table QR exchange: main checks

- [ ] Scan a real printed table QR (https://www.touch-padel.com/t/<token>) with an Arabic phone **Expect:** One 307 to /ar/menu; the address bar shows /ar/menu with no token; DevTools Application > Cookies shows tp-table=<token>, HttpOnly, Secure, SameSite=Lax, Path=/, expires in 12 h `WEB.TABLE_QR.01`
- [ ] P1 · Scan the same QR on an English phone with no tp-locale cookie **Expect:** Lands on /en/menu (Accept-Language negotiation) `WEB.TABLE_QR.02`
- [ ] P2 · Open /en/t/<token>?analytics=off **Expect:** Lands on /en/menu?analytics=off (query preserved, token removed) `WEB.TABLE_QR.03`
- [ ] curl -sI https://www.touch-padel.com/t/<token> **Expect:** 307 with Location /<locale>/menu, Set-Cookie tp-table, Cache-Control no-store, no-cache, must-revalidate, private, Referrer-Policy no-referrer, and the CSP header `WEB.TABLE_QR.04`
- [ ] Request /en/t/tok.x (dotted last segment the proxy matcher skips) **Expect:** The route handler still performs the exchange: 307 to /en/menu with the tp-table cookie and no-store/no-referrer; never renders the menu with a token in the URL `WEB.TABLE_QR.05`
- [ ] P1 · Open /ar/t and /t (no token) **Expect:** 307 to /ar/menu and /<negotiated>/menu, with CSP and no-store on the hop; not a permanent 308 `WEB.TABLE_QR.07`
- [ ] P2 · Open /ar/t/ (trailing slash) **Expect:** Lands on /ar/menu (no trailing slash) `WEB.TABLE_QR.08`
- [ ] On the menu after a scan, open DevTools Network, browse and order, and inspect every outbound request (PostHog, images, Supabase) **Expect:** No request URL or Referer header contains the table token `WEB.TABLE_QR.11`
- [ ] P1 · View source of /ar/menu after a scan and search for the token **Expect:** Known residual: it appears once in the RSC payload (passed to CafeApp); confirm it appears nowhere else (not in links, not in meta) `WEB.TABLE_QR.12`
- [ ] P2 · Scan a table QR, then within 12 h open /ar/menu from the landing page on the same phone **Expect:** Known residual: the table binds again (or shows Scan again if the session closed); confirm with the owner this is acceptable `WEB.TABLE_QR.14`

#### WEB.TABLE_QR.T02 · P0 · Table QR exchange: other parts

- [ ] Scan a valid QR and watch the top-left chip **Expect:** 'Linking table…' with a spinner, then 'Table 7' style label (table number isolated) `WEB.TABLE_QR.SESSION_BOOT.01`
- [ ] P1 · Send an order, then check that the session expiry was extended **Expect:** After the order succeeds the expiry timer re-arms from the refreshed guest_sessions.expires_at `WEB.TABLE_QR.SESSION_BOOT.06`

*Setup:* `INVALID_TOKEN` (Invalid, rotated, forged or malformed token / id)

- [ ] Scan a QR whose token was rotated in the operator (old printed card) **Expect:** Menu loads; table chip shows 'Scan the table QR code again' (state invalid); browsing works; sending asks for a scan `WEB.TABLE_QR.09`
- [ ] Hand-type /t/aaaaaaaa (a forged token) **Expect:** Same invalid state as a rotated token; no server error; no order possible `WEB.TABLE_QR.10`
- [ ] **Table session boot** P1 · Tap the Scan again chip **Expect:** The QR-required sheet opens explaining to scan the table code `WEB.TABLE_QR.SESSION_BOOT.07`

#### WEB.TABLE_QR.T04 · P0 · Table QR exchange: ge

*Setup:* `INVALID_LOCALE` (Unsupported first path segment), `LINK_EXPIRED` (Expired, used or malformed link), `SLOW_NETWORK` (Slow network), `BACKEND_DOWN` (Server unreachable while the LAN is up), `SESSION_EXPIRED` (Staff session expired), `ARABIC_RTL` (Arabic, right to left)

- [ ] `INVALID_LOCALE` P1 · Request /xx/t/<token> **Expect:** 404 (locale refused), no cookie set `WEB.TABLE_QR.06`
- [ ] `LINK_EXPIRED` P1 · Scan a table QR, close the tab, and 13 hours later open /ar/menu from the landing **Expect:** The cookie has expired: menu opens as a walk-in (no table chip) `WEB.TABLE_QR.13`
- [ ] **Table session boot** `LINK_EXPIRED` P1 · Leave the menu open past the session expires_at **Expect:** Chip switches to Scan again at the expiry time without any action `WEB.TABLE_QR.SESSION_BOOT.05`
- [ ] **Table session boot** `SLOW_NETWORK` P1 · Scan on Slow 3G **Expect:** Linking table… stays visible until bound; menu is browsable meanwhile; no double session (the boot is cached per token) `WEB.TABLE_QR.SESSION_BOOT.02`
- [ ] **Table session boot** `BACKEND_DOWN` P1 · Make anonymous sign-in fail (block /auth/v1 in DevTools) and scan **Expect:** Chip becomes the Scan again button (state error); browsing still works `WEB.TABLE_QR.SESSION_BOOT.03`
- [ ] **Table session boot** `SESSION_EXPIRED` Close the table session in the operator while the guest has the menu open, then try to send an order **Expect:** Toast 'This table session has expired. Please scan the QR code again.'; chip turns to Scan again; basket is kept `WEB.TABLE_QR.SESSION_BOOT.04`
- [ ] **Table session boot** `ARABIC_RTL` P2 · Check the chip in Arabic **Expect:** Arabic 'Table N' with the number reading correctly `WEB.TABLE_QR.SESSION_BOOT.08`

### WEB.MENU: Touch Cafe menu

The cafe menu for walk-ins and table guests. Walk-ins browse and build a basket; a table-bound guest (tp-table cookie) sends orders to the waiter, calls the waiter and follows order status live. Payment is at the desk.

**Route:** `/{locale}/menu`

**Source:** `apps/web/app/[locale]/menu/page.tsx`, `apps/web/src/components/cafe/CafeApp.tsx`, `apps/web/src/components/cafe/useCafeActions.ts`, `apps/web/src/components/cafe/CafeOverlays.tsx`, `apps/web/src/lib/menu.server.ts`, `apps/web/src/lib/menu.ts`

**Components:** Top bar · Cafe hero · Category pills · Menu sections and cards · Menu unavailable state · Item sheet · Basket sheet · Send to waiter (app.create_guest_order) · QR required sheet · Call waiter (bell) · Bell tutorial spotlight · Orders strip and orders sheet · Earn points chip (loyalty) · Venue degraded mode watch · Live menu refresh · Cafe footer · Toasts and scroll-to-top

- [ ] **Send to waiter (app.create_guest_order)** `FLAKY_NETWORK` Throttle to offline right after tapping Send, then reconnect and tap Send again with the same basket **Expect:** Second send with the same basket replays the same idempotency key: either one order or toast 'Already sent — this order is with the waiter. Your basket is untouched.' `WEB.MENU.SEND_ORDER.05`
- [ ] **Send to waiter (app.create_guest_order)** `SLOW_NETWORK` P1 · Make the RPC time out (DevTools throttle to a 30 s+ response or block the request) **Expect:** After the request timeout the button re-enables and a generic error toast shows; basket kept `WEB.MENU.SEND_ORDER.11`

- [ ] **Call waiter (bell)** `FLAKY_NETWORK` P2 · Kill the realtime connection (block wss) and acknowledge the call on the operator **Expect:** The status still updates within 60 s (safety poll) `WEB.MENU.WAITER.11`
- [ ] **Orders strip and orders sheet** `FLAKY_NETWORK` P1 · Block the realtime websocket and move an order to ready **Expect:** Status updates within 30 s (fallback poll while orders are in flight) `WEB.MENU.ORDERS.08`
- [ ] **Earn points chip (loyalty)** `BACKEND_DOWN` P2 · Make link_guest_session fail **Expect:** Quiet chip with failed text and a Retry button that re-attempts `WEB.MENU.EARN_CHIP.05`

## Backend + platform (Supabase, edge functions, CI/CD, vendors)

Everything the three apps stand on: database rules and money functions, edge functions, payment, OTP, push and AI vendors, scheduled jobs, storage, security gates, CI, deploys and the go-live data steps.

30 pages, 219 test points, 1135 steps (175 P0 points).

### BE.EDGE: Edge function platform (shared plumbing)

The 26 Supabase edge functions and their shared modules: verify_jwt pinning, body caps, timeouts, error mapping and secrets. Used by every app; owned by the developer and checked on hosted before launch.

**Route:** `https://lczijabnorujcgmbuqlw.supabase.co/functions/v1/*`

**Source:** `packages/db/supabase/functions/_shared/http.ts`, `packages/db/supabase/functions/_shared/auth.ts`, `packages/db/supabase/functions/_shared/supabase.ts`, `packages/db/fixtures/verify-jwt.json`, `packages/db/supabase/config.toml`, `packages/db/scripts/check-verify-jwt.mjs`

### BE.PAYMENTS: Online payments (Qi Card): deposits, tickets, lessons

Server half of online money: begin a Qi payment, poll and webhook it to a final state, sweep, cancel and refund. Paused chain-wide since 0340 until Qi is live.

**Components:** deposit-begin · deposit-status · deposit-webhook · deposit-reconcile (sweeper) · ticket-begin (open-match tickets) · lesson-begin · payments-fake (local only)

### BE.AUTH: Authentication and accounts

Guest phone + password with one WhatsApp/SMS code via OTPIQ, Apple and Google sign-in, Apple token revocation, desk-created walk-ins and owner-created staff accounts.

**Route:** `GoTrue (Supabase Auth) + send-sms-otp, apple-revoke, desk-customer-create, staff-admin` · **Roles:** guest, owner, court_desk, manager

**Source:** `packages/db/supabase/functions/send-sms-otp/index.ts`, `packages/db/supabase/functions/_shared/sms/index.ts`, `packages/db/supabase/functions/_shared/sms/otpiq.ts`, `packages/db/supabase/functions/apple-revoke/index.ts`, `packages/db/supabase/functions/desk-customer-create/index.ts`, `packages/db/supabase/functions/staff-admin/index.ts`, `docs/client/phone-otp-activation.md`, `docs/client/social-auth-setup-2026-09-01.md`

#### BE.RLS.T01 · P0 · Row-level security and grants per role: main checks

- [ ] Run pnpm --filter @touch/db test tests/rls-matrix.test.ts with the local stack up **Expect:** All 8 principals match the matrix for every table and RPC; no test skipped `BE.RLS.01`
- [ ] Run pnpm --filter @touch/db check:authz with the stack up **Expect:** Exits 0: every granted RPC is covered or listed publicByDesign with a reason `BE.RLS.02`
- [ ] On hosted run select relname from pg_class c join pg_namespace n on n.oid = c.relnamespace where n.nspname in ('public','app') and c.relkind = 'r' and not c.relrowsecurity **Expect:** Zero rows `BE.RLS.03`
- [ ] P1 · Open the Supabase dashboard Security Advisor on hosted **Expect:** Only the four accepted findings of docs/security/security-advisor-waiver-2026-09-06.md remain `BE.RLS.04`

### BE.MONEY: Money RPC invariants

Integer IQD everywhere, price computed server-side (payloads never carry a price), quote equals charge, PIN-gated adjustments, idempotent money writes, refunds capped at what is due.

**Route:** `app.* money RPCs` · **Roles:** cashier, court_desk, shop_staff, manager, owner, guest

**Source:** `packages/db/supabase/migrations/20261001000281_lesson_money.sql`, `packages/db/supabase/migrations/20260920000115_pin_grants_money_path.sql`, `packages/core/src/schemas/mutations.ts`, `packages/db/tests/helpers.ts`, `packages/db/supabase/migrations/20260827000049_replay_idempotency.sql`, `packages/db/CLAUDE.md`

**Components:** Quote equals charge · Manager PIN grants · Idempotent money writes · Refunds · Loyalty and discounts as money · hold_slot, confirm_booking, staff_create_reservation, cancel_reservation · open_tab, till_add_items, guest orders · settle_tab, settle_zero_tab, cancel_tab, compute_tab_totals · void_after_send, refund · split_evenly, split_by_item, merge_tabs · apply_discount, override_price, customer discounts, manager PIN · Online deposit rows (booking_payments, deposit_apply, deposit refunds) · open_day, close_day · open_till_shift, close_till_shift · main_cash_pay, move, count, void, hand_in_day · mark_wage_paid, give_wage_advance, undo_wage_advance, deductions · coach_statement_mark_paid, coach_statement_void · loyalty_redeem, loyalty_adjust · Touch Shop sales and sale rewards · claim_replay and the idempotency contract

#### BE.MONEY.T01 · P0 · Money RPC invariants: money and totals (1 of 5)

- [ ] Run pnpm --filter @touch/db check:invariants and check:locks on the stack **Expect:** Both exit 0 (views, search_path, lock order day_sessions to loyalty_accounts) `BE.MONEY.01`
- [ ] **Quote equals charge** On the phone book a 90-minute slot across a rate change boundary; compare Review price with reservations.price_iqd and the desk bill (booking_bill) **Expect:** All three are the same integer IQD `BE.MONEY.QUOTE_CHARGE.01`
- [ ] **Quote equals charge** Compare deposit_quote with deposit-begin amount_iqd **Expect:** Equal `BE.MONEY.QUOTE_CHARGE.04`
- [ ] **Quote equals charge** Compare match_quote share with the desk seat amount (match_money) **Expect:** Equal; seat money derived, never stored `BE.MONEY.QUOTE_CHARGE.05`
- [ ] **Quote equals charge** Settle a cafe tab and compare compute_tab_totals with the printed receipt **Expect:** Subtotal, discounts and total identical; IQD integers with no fractional part `BE.MONEY.QUOTE_CHARGE.06`
- [ ] **Refunds** Refund more than the payment **Expect:** REFUND_EXCEEDS_PAYMENT `BE.MONEY.REFUNDS.01`
- [ ] **Refunds** P1 · Refund a quantity larger than the line **Expect:** REFUND_QTY_EXCEEDS_LINE `BE.MONEY.REFUNDS.02`
- [ ] **Refunds** P1 · Refund a tournament entry above refund_due without the goodwill reason **Expect:** REFUND_EXCEEDS_DUE `BE.MONEY.REFUNDS.03`
- [ ] **Refunds** Check reports after a ticket or deposit refund **Expect:** Ticket and deposit money never enter revenue, cash or card; ticket_money_figures shows them `BE.MONEY.REFUNDS.05`
- [ ] **Loyalty and discounts as money** P1 · As manager gift 1,001 points in 24 h **Expect:** Refused; owners get a loyalty_gift push `BE.MONEY.LOYALTY_MONEY.02`
- [ ] **Loyalty and discounts as money** P2 · Void a line carrying an item reward before settle **Expect:** Reward comes back whole `BE.MONEY.LOYALTY_MONEY.03`
- [ ] **Loyalty and discounts as money** P1 · Set a standing customer discount and settle **Expect:** Tab row reason customer_discount; not on this bill waiver respected `BE.MONEY.LOYALTY_MONEY.04`

#### BE.MONEY.T02 · P0 · Money RPC invariants: money and totals (2 of 5)

- [ ] **hold_slot, confirm_booking, staff_create_reservation, cancel_reservation** Hold a 90-minute slot and compare the hold price_iqd with booking_quote for the same slot **Expect:** Identical whole-IQD integers; no decimals anywhere `BE.MONEY.R_BOOKING.01`
- [ ] **hold_slot, confirm_booking, staff_create_reservation, cancel_reservation** Confirm a slot with no rate rule **Expect:** NO_RATE; nothing written `BE.MONEY.R_BOOKING.07`
- [ ] **open_tab, till_add_items, guest orders** Send till_add_items with an extra price field in each item **Expect:** The price is ignored; line_total_iqd comes from the menu variant and modifiers `BE.MONEY.R_TAB_ADD.01`
- [ ] **open_tab, till_add_items, guest orders** P1 · Open a second live tab on a booking that already has one **Expect:** BOOKING_TAB_OPEN with detail = the existing tab id `BE.MONEY.R_TAB_ADD.02`
- [ ] **open_tab, till_add_items, guest orders** P1 · Add cafe lines to an open-match booking tab **Expect:** MATCH_BOOKING_NO_CAFE `BE.MONEY.R_TAB_ADD.05`
- [ ] **settle_tab, settle_zero_tab, cancel_tab, compute_tab_totals** Settle a cash tab of 23,750 IQD with tendered 25,000 **Expect:** One payments row, amount_iqd 23750, change_iqd 1250; the tab is settled `BE.MONEY.R_SETTLE.01`
- [ ] **settle_tab, settle_zero_tab, cancel_tab, compute_tab_totals** Settle a negative or zero amount, and an amount above what is due **Expect:** INVALID_AMOUNT with due and got in the detail `BE.MONEY.R_SETTLE.05`
- [ ] **settle_tab, settle_zero_tab, cancel_tab, compute_tab_totals** P1 · Settle a tab that already owes nothing **Expect:** ALREADY_PAID; settle_zero_tab closes it with a reason and no payment row `BE.MONEY.R_SETTLE.06`
- [ ] **settle_tab, settle_zero_tab, cancel_tab, compute_tab_totals** Apply a 12.5% tab discount on a 3-line tab with mixed tax groups and settle **Expect:** Discount = round(base x 1250 / 10000) whole IQD; the tax allocation per group rounds to whole IQD; subtotal - discount + tax (or inclusive) equals total_iqd `BE.MONEY.R_SETTLE.08`
- [ ] **settle_tab, settle_zero_tab, cancel_tab, compute_tab_totals** Cancel a tab that has an order line **Expect:** TAB_NOT_EMPTY with a detail naming what is on it `BE.MONEY.R_SETTLE.09`
- [ ] **settle_tab, settle_zero_tab, cancel_tab, compute_tab_totals** P1 · Take a part payment, add a line, then settle the rest **Expect:** The second settle recomputes totals; the tab stays awaiting_payment until net paid equals total `BE.MONEY.R_SETTLE.10`
- [ ] **void_after_send, refund** Refund 10,000 IQD on a 9,000 IQD payment **Expect:** REFUND_EXCEEDS_PAYMENT with paid/refunded in the detail `BE.MONEY.R_VOID_REFUND.01`

#### BE.MONEY.T03 · P0 · Money RPC invariants: money and totals (3 of 5)

- [ ] **void_after_send, refund** Void a sent line with a reason and a PIN **Expect:** Line voided, stock restocked if named, audit row written; without a reason REASON_REQUIRED `BE.MONEY.R_VOID_REFUND.07`
- [ ] **void_after_send, refund** P1 · Refund a tournament entry tab above refund_due without reason tournament_goodwill **Expect:** Refused (held to refund_due) `BE.MONEY.R_VOID_REFUND.08`
- [ ] **split_evenly, split_by_item, merge_tabs** Split 100,000 IQD evenly 3 ways **Expect:** Parts 33,334 / 33,333 / 33,333 summing exactly to 100,000 `BE.MONEY.R_SPLIT_MERGE.01`
- [ ] **split_evenly, split_by_item, merge_tabs** Merge a donor tab that has a payment into another **Expect:** DONOR_HAS_PAYMENTS `BE.MONEY.R_SPLIT_MERGE.05`
- [ ] **split_evenly, split_by_item, merge_tabs** P1 · Settle a tab that was merged away **Expect:** TAB_MERGED with the survivor id `BE.MONEY.R_SPLIT_MERGE.07`
- [ ] **apply_discount, override_price, customer discounts, manager PIN** Apply a percent discount of 0 and of 10001 basis points **Expect:** INVALID_VALUE (1..10000) `BE.MONEY.R_DISCOUNTS.01`
- [ ] **apply_discount, override_price, customer discounts, manager PIN** Apply an amount discount larger than the line **Expect:** Capped at the line base (least(value, base)); total never below zero `BE.MONEY.R_DISCOUNTS.02`
- [ ] **apply_discount, override_price, customer discounts, manager PIN** P1 · Set a standing customer discount as cashier with no PIN, then settle that customer's tab **Expect:** Applied as reason_code customer_discount; a not-on-this-bill waiver (p_kind none) is respected on refresh `BE.MONEY.R_DISCOUNTS.06`
- [ ] **apply_discount, override_price, customer discounts, manager PIN** P1 · Apply a customer court discount and read court_fee_remaining **Expect:** The booking fee remaining drops by app.court_fee_discount `BE.MONEY.R_DISCOUNTS.07`
- [ ] **Online deposit rows (booking_payments, deposit_apply, deposit refunds)** P1 · Request a staff refund of a ticket purchase **Expect:** PAYMENT_STATE detail ticket (tickets go back only by cash-out) `BE.MONEY.R_DEPOSITS.04`
- [ ] **Online deposit rows (booking_payments, deposit_apply, deposit refunds)** Check reports after a deposit and a ticket sale **Expect:** Neither appears in revenue, cash or card; ticket money only through ticket_money_figures `BE.MONEY.R_DEPOSITS.05`
- [ ] **open_day, close_day** Close the day with an open tab **Expect:** DAY_OPEN_TABS `BE.MONEY.R_DAY.03`

- [ ] **open_till_shift, close_till_shift** Close with counted cash 5,000 under expected **Expect:** cash_variance_iqd = -5000; expected = float + cash payments - cash refunds `BE.MONEY.R_SHIFT.05`
- [ ] **main_cash_pay, move, count, void, hand_in_day** Pay a cost from the safe, then from the bank **Expect:** Safe: balance drops by the amount; bank: listed with costs, safe unchanged `BE.MONEY.R_SAFE.02`

- [ ] **mark_wage_paid, give_wage_advance, undo_wage_advance, deductions** Mark a month paid where net is 900,000 and advances 300,000 **Expect:** paid_iqd 600,000; the month is frozen; a safe row is written when paid from the safe `BE.MONEY.R_WAGES.01`
- [ ] **mark_wage_paid, give_wage_advance, undo_wage_advance, deductions** Give an advance larger than what is still owed for the month **Expect:** Refused (at most net minus advances already given) `BE.MONEY.R_WAGES.03`

- [ ] **loyalty_redeem, loyalty_adjust** P1 · Redeem an item reward when the item is not on the tab, at the court desk **Expect:** REWARD_ITEM_NOT_ON_TAB for the court desk; at the cafe the item is ordered onto the tab first `BE.MONEY.R_LOYALTY.05`
- [ ] **Touch Shop sales and sale rewards** Settle a shop tab of 50,000 IQD with shop_sale_reward_pct 10 **Expect:** shop_sale_reward_rates freezes 10 on that tab; after the month closes the seller has 5,000 IQD reward `BE.MONEY.R_SHOP.01`
- [ ] **Touch Shop sales and sale rewards** P1 · Settle a shop tab as the owner **Expect:** No reward row for the owner (shop_reward_lines never counts the owner) `BE.MONEY.R_SHOP.03`

#### BE.MONEY.T17 · P0 · Money RPC invariants: ge

*Setup:* `EMPTY_DATA` (Nothing recorded yet), `SHIFT_NOT_OPEN` (Till shift state edge), `HOLD_EXPIRED` (Hold timed out), `ONLINE_PAYMENTS_PAUSED` (Online payments not live), `SANDBOX_ACCOUNT` (Account with profiles.payment_sandbox = true (store review account)), `STATION_KIND_MISMATCH` (Wrong kind of station for the action), `MONTH_PAID` (Pay month already marked paid (frozen)), `FEATURE_FLAG_OFF` (A feature switched off), `RETRYABLE_DB_ERROR` (Postgres answers a retryable error (40001, 40P01, 55P03, 57014, 53300, 53400)), `LARGE_DATA` (Large data volume)

- [ ] **Quote equals charge** `EMPTY_DATA` Book a court with no rate rule **Expect:** NO_RATE; slot not bookable `BE.MONEY.QUOTE_CHARGE.03`

- [ ] **open_till_shift, close_till_shift** `SHIFT_NOT_OPEN` Take a payment and a refund with no open shift at the station **Expect:** Refused or stamped per stamp_till_shift rules (refunds row records the shift open at that station) `BE.MONEY.R_SHIFT.06`
- [ ] **hold_slot, confirm_booking, staff_create_reservation, cancel_reservation** `HOLD_EXPIRED` P1 · Let a hold lapse, then confirm_booking **Expect:** HOLD_EXPIRED; the lapsed hold counts toward the hold ladder (tp_hold_strikes) `BE.MONEY.R_BOOKING.09`
- [ ] **Online deposit rows (booking_payments, deposit_apply, deposit refunds)** `ONLINE_PAYMENTS_PAUSED` With online_payments_live false, call set_deposit_settings to turn deposits on **Expect:** ONLINE_PAYMENTS_PAUSED `BE.MONEY.R_DEPOSITS.01`
- [ ] **Online deposit rows (booking_payments, deposit_apply, deposit refunds)** `SANDBOX_ACCOUNT` Run a sandbox account payment and read every report figure **Expect:** Adds 0 to every figure `BE.MONEY.R_DEPOSITS.06`
- [ ] **open_till_shift, close_till_shift** `STATION_KIND_MISMATCH` P1 · Close a shift from another station **Expect:** TILL_SHIFT_WRONG_STATION `BE.MONEY.R_SHIFT.04`
- [ ] **mark_wage_paid, give_wage_advance, undo_wage_advance, deductions** `MONTH_PAID` Undo an advance after its month is paid **Expect:** WAGE_ALREADY_PAID `BE.MONEY.R_WAGES.04`
- [ ] **loyalty_redeem, loyalty_adjust** `FEATURE_FLAG_OFF` P1 · Turn loyalty off, then redeem **Expect:** LOYALTY_OFF `BE.MONEY.R_LOYALTY.06`
- [ ] **claim_replay and the idempotency contract** `RETRYABLE_DB_ERROR` P1 · Hit a lock timeout (55P03) during a queued replay **Expect:** replay maps it to 503 RETRY_LATER, never recorded as a conflict `BE.MONEY.R_IDEMPOTENCY.05`
- [ ] **claim_replay and the idempotency contract** `LARGE_DATA` P2 · Count rows in app.rpc_replays and sync_replays on hosted **Expect:** Record the counts; there is no prune job for either (sync_replays is append-only), so watch growth `BE.MONEY.R_IDEMPOTENCY.06`

### BE.CRON: Scheduled jobs (pg_cron)

Every sweep, reminder, purge and nightly the system relies on. Schedules are best-effort DO blocks, so they must be asserted on hosted after every push.

**Route:** `cron.job`

**Source:** `packages/db/supabase/migrations/20260913000090_push_immediate_delivery.sql`, `packages/db/supabase/migrations/20261008000323_checklist_schedules.sql`, `packages/db/supabase/migrations/20261022000363_protocol_watch.sql`, `packages/db/CLAUDE.md`, `packages/db/supabase/migrations/20260824000021_degraded_sync.sql`, `packages/db/supabase/migrations/20260926000207_platform_settings.sql`

**Components:** Booking and hold jobs · Reminders and staff nudges · Money jobs · Assistant and housekeeping jobs · Job inventory on hosted · tp_hold_sweep (* * * * * (every minute)) · tp_degraded_sweep (* * * * *) · tp_expiry_flagging (0 2 * * * (02:00 UTC = 05:00 Baghdad)) · tp_telegram_sweep (10 seconds (falls back to every minute if the seconds syntax is unsupported)) · tp_telegram_prune (30 3 * * * (03:30 UTC)) · tp_push_sweep (30 seconds (fallback every minute)) · tp_assistant_job_tick (* * * * *) · tp_assistant_index_sweep (* * * * *) · tp_assistant_index_prune (45 3 * * *) · tp_assistant_prewarm (30 * * * * (hourly at :30)) · tp_protocol_tick (*/5 * * * *) · tp_release_review (20 4 * * * (04:20 UTC)) · tp_hiring_purge (40 3 * * *) · tp_price_promo_apply (*/5 * * * *) · tp_incident_purge (50 3 * * *) · tp_deposit_sweep (30 seconds (fallback every minute)) · tp_scan_sweep (* * * * *) · tp_match_sweep (30 seconds (fallback every minute)) · tp_hold_strikes (* * * * *) · tp_lesson_sweep (* * * * *) · tp_coach_statements (0 12 1 * * (12:00 UTC on the 1st)) · tp_tournament_sweep (* * * * *) · tp_loyalty_nightly (15 0 * * * (00:15 UTC = 03:15 Baghdad)) · tp_checklist_sweep (*/5 * * * *) · tp_reward_sweep (*/5 * * * *) · tp_assistant_cache_fill (20 1 * * * (01:20 UTC)) · tp_shop_reward_sweep (*/5 * * * *) · tp_protocol_remind (*/15 * * * *)

#### BE.CRON.T01 · P0 · Scheduled jobs (pg_cron): main checks

- [ ] On hosted run select jobname, schedule, active from cron.job order by 1 **Expect:** Present and active: tp_assistant_cache_fill, tp_assistant_index_prune, tp_assistant_index_sweep, tp_assistant_job_tick, tp_assistant_prewarm, tp_checklist_sweep, tp_coach_statements (0 12 1 * *), tp_degraded_sweep, tp_deposit_sweep, tp_expiry_flagging, tp_hiring_purge, tp_hold_strikes, tp_hold_sweep, tp_incident_purge, tp_lesson_sweep, tp_loyalty_nightly, tp_match_sweep, tp_price_promo_apply, tp_protocol_remind, tp_protocol_tick, tp_push_sweep, tp_release_review, tp_reward_sweep, tp_scan_sweep, tp_shop_reward_sweep, tp_telegram_prune, tp_telegram_sweep, tp_tournament_sweep `BE.CRON.01`
- [ ] On hosted run select jobid, status, count(*) from cron.job_run_details where start_time > now() - interval '24 hours' group by 1,2 **Expect:** No job with repeated failed status `BE.CRON.02`
- [ ] Check pg_net and pg_cron extensions on hosted: select extname from pg_extension **Expect:** pg_cron and pg_net installed `BE.CRON.03`

- [ ] Replace your avatar and wait 10 minutes **Expect:** The old object leaves the avatars bucket via avatar_purges `BE.CRON.J_PROTOCOL_TICK.01`

- [ ] **tp_coach_statements (0 12 1 * * (12:00 UTC on the 1st))** P1 · Make one pair fail (plant bad data) and run the procedure **Expect:** Other pairs still get their drafts (failing pair does not undo the others) `BE.CRON.J_COACH_STATEMENTS.02`

- [ ] **tp_incident_purge (50 3 * * *)** P1 · Plant an incident with purge_after yesterday and run the job **Expect:** Description reads [deleted after 365 days]; people_involved, place_detail, review_note empty `BE.CRON.J_INCIDENT_PURGE.01`
- [ ] **tp_match_sweep (30 seconds (fallback every minute))** P1 · Leave an open match filling past its deadline **Expect:** It is closed by the sweep and the seat tickets are released `BE.CRON.J_MATCH_SWEEP.01`

### BE.REALTIME: Realtime channels

Private broadcast topics kds, floor, courts (legacy and per-branch :<venue_id>), menu (public), session:<id> (cafe guest), ranks and ranks:<profile>.

**Route:** `realtime.messages broadcast topics` · **Roles:** guest, cashier, court_desk, manager, owner, waiter, barista, chef, prep

**Source:** `packages/db/supabase/migrations/20260824000022_realtime.sql`, `packages/db/supabase/migrations/20260926000224_realtime_per_venue.sql`, `packages/db/supabase/migrations/20261022000364_ranks_leaderboard.sql`, `apps/operator/src/lib/realtime.ts`, `apps/web/src/hooks/cafe/useSessionChannel.ts`, `packages/db/scripts/check-broadcast-payloads.mjs`

**Components:** kds and floor topics · courts topic · session, menu and ranks topics · kds:<venue_id> (ticket_status, item ready) · floor:<venue_id> (waiter_call, order_slip) · courts:<venue_id> (reservation, court_changed, slot_changed) · menu (menu_changed, settings_changed) · session:<guest_session_id> (order status, waiter_call_status) · ranks and ranks:<user_id> · Legacy building-wide literal topics kds, floor, courts

#### BE.REALTIME.T01 · P1 · session, menu and ranks topics: main flow

- [ ] Mark an order ready on KDS while the table session page is open **Expect:** Status updates on the web via session:<id> `BE.REALTIME.GUEST_TOPICS.01`
- [ ] Mark an item out of stock **Expect:** Web menu refetches on menu_changed; item shows unavailable `BE.REALTIME.GUEST_TOPICS.03`
- [ ] P2 · Confirm a ranks result **Expect:** ranks board broadcast {at} only; player topic ranks:<profile> {status} only `BE.REALTIME.GUEST_TOPICS.04`

#### BE.REALTIME.T02 · P0 · Realtime channels: other parts

- [ ] **kds and floor topics** Place an order on the web menu with the KDS open **Expect:** Ticket appears on KDS within 2 s (kds:<venue>) `BE.REALTIME.STAFF_TOPICS.01`
- [ ] **courts topic** Book on the phone while the desk calendar is open **Expect:** Desk shows the booking within 2 s without reload `BE.REALTIME.COURTS_TOPIC.01`

- [ ] **kds:<venue_id> (ticket_status, item ready)** With the KDS open at branch A, send an order **Expect:** A ticket_status event arrives on kds:<A> and the board refreshes in under 2 s `BE.REALTIME.TOPIC_KDS.01`
- [ ] **kds:<venue_id> (ticket_status, item ready)** P1 · Attach a delivery table to a counter order (order_set_delivery) **Expect:** The ticket is re-announced on kds and kds:<branch> `BE.REALTIME.TOPIC_KDS.04`
- [ ] **floor:<venue_id> (waiter_call, order_slip)** P1 · Raise a waiter call from a QR table at branch A with the waiter phone open **Expect:** A waiter_call event on floor:<A>; the phone list updates `BE.REALTIME.TOPIC_FLOOR.01`
- [ ] **floor:<venue_id> (waiter_call, order_slip)** P2 · Scan an order slip and watch floor **Expect:** order_slip events with slip_id and status only `BE.REALTIME.TOPIC_FLOOR.03`
- [ ] **courts:<venue_id> (reservation, court_changed, slot_changed)** P1 · Book at the desk while a guest views the same day on the phone **Expect:** The slot greys out on the phone within 2 s via courts:<branch> `BE.REALTIME.TOPIC_COURTS.01`
- [ ] **courts:<venue_id> (reservation, court_changed, slot_changed)** P2 · Deactivate a court in Settings **Expect:** court_changed with active false; the grid hides it `BE.REALTIME.TOPIC_COURTS.03`
- [ ] **ranks and ranks:<user_id>** P1 · As player A, subscribe to ranks:<player B id> **Expect:** No messages `BE.REALTIME.TOPIC_RANKS.02`

- [ ] **menu (menu_changed, settings_changed)** `NOT_SIGNED_IN` P1 · Mark an item out of stock with the web menu open as anon **Expect:** menu_changed arrives and the item shows unavailable after refetch `BE.REALTIME.TOPIC_MENU.01`

- [ ] **ranks and ranks:<user_id>** `NOT_SIGNED_IN` P2 · Confirm a result with the board open as anon **Expect:** A board event on ranks; the board refetches ranks_board `BE.REALTIME.TOPIC_RANKS.01`

#### BE.REALTIME.T04 · P0 · Realtime channels: A cafe QR anonymous session: role authenticated with is_anonymous true and no profile

*Setup:* `GUEST_ANON_SESSION` (A cafe QR anonymous session: role authenticated with is_anonymous true and no profile)

- [ ] **session:<guest_session_id> (order status, waiter_call_status)** P1 · Mark an order ready on the KDS with the table page open **Expect:** The table page updates through session:<id> `BE.REALTIME.TOPIC_SESSION.01`
- [ ] **session:<guest_session_id> (order status, waiter_call_status)** Subscribe to another table's session:<id> **Expect:** No messages (policy requires gs.auth_user_id = auth.uid(), not closed, not expired) `BE.REALTIME.TOPIC_SESSION.02`

#### BE.REALTIME.T05 · P1 · Realtime channels: With a second branch

*Setup:* `SECOND_BRANCH` (Two branches)

- [ ] **kds and floor topics** Subscribe to kds:<branch B> as a branch A barista **Expect:** Not authorized (app.is_staff_at) `BE.REALTIME.STAFF_TOPICS.02`

- [ ] **menu (menu_changed, settings_changed)** P2 · Change a public cafe setting at branch B with the branch A menu open **Expect:** settings_changed carries venue_id B; the branch A menu refetches but shows no change `BE.REALTIME.TOPIC_MENU.02`

*Setup:* `OFFLINE_THEN_RECONNECT` (Offline, then back online), `OLD_APP_VERSION` (Station build older than the server), `BACKEND_DOWN` (Server unreachable while the LAN is up), `REALTIME_LEGACY_TOPIC` (A client still listening on the building-wide literal topic (kds, floor, courts) instead of <topic>:<venue_id>)

- [ ] **Legacy building-wide literal topics kds, floor, courts** `REALTIME_LEGACY_TOPIC` P1 · As a branch B cashier, subscribe to the literal kds topic and send an order at branch A **Expect:** Today the branch B cashier receives branch A ticket events (policy checks is_staff at ANY branch for the literal topic). Decide to drop the literal sends and policy rows before a second branch opens `BE.REALTIME.LEGACY_TOPICS.01`
- [ ] **Legacy building-wide literal topics kds, floor, courts** `REALTIME_LEGACY_TOPIC` P2 · Subscribe to the literal courts topic as a guest and book at branch B **Expect:** Events from every branch arrive (payload has no personal data) `BE.REALTIME.LEGACY_TOPICS.02`

### BE.DEGRADED: Degraded mode (server)

When the owner turns the offline-mode switch on (0248, off by default) and a day is open (0247) with every till heartbeat stale, guests are refused inside the protected horizon (DEGRADED_LOCKOUT).

**Route:** `app.is_degraded, tp_degraded_sweep, db-ops clear-stale-till` · **Roles:** owner

**Source:** `packages/db/supabase/migrations/20260927000248_offline_mode_switch.sql`, `packages/db/supabase/migrations/20260927000247_degraded_only_while_trading.sql`, `.github/workflows/db-ops.yml`, `packages/db/supabase/migrations/20260926000210_booking_settings_per_venue.sql`, `packages/db/tests/degraded.test.ts`

**Components:** Offline-mode switch and lockout · is_degraded(venue) and venue_mode · DEGRADED_LOCKOUT across RPC families · degraded_periods and replay after recovery

### BE.CI: CI (ci.yml)

Every push to main and every PR: secret gates, lint/typecheck/test/build, deno check, Windows shell, mobile doctor + smoke + bundle, db (migrations from scratch, RLS, concurrency, types drift), e2e EN + AR.

**Route:** `.github/workflows/ci.yml`

**Source:** `.github/workflows/ci.yml`, `CLAUDE.md`, `.github/workflows/bench.yml`, `.github/workflows/db-drift.yml`

**Components:** CI jobs · Job: secret gates (gitleaks, env names, history, audit) · Job: lint / typecheck / test / build · Job: edge functions (deno check) · Job: operator shell (windows ABI + package smoke) · Job: mobile (doctor + bundle) · Job: db (migrations + RLS/concurrency tests) · Job: e2e (Playwright, EN + AR) · CI concurrency and triggers · Nightly: Bench (db) · Nightly: DB drift (nightly) · Other scheduled work outside GitHub

### BE.DEPLOY: Deploy (hosted) (deploy.yml)

Starts only from a green CI run on main; plans against the hosted ledger; deploys send-push, snapshots the ledgers, pushes migrations, deploys the other functions, checks verify_jwt.

**Route:** `.github/workflows/deploy.yml`

**Source:** `.github/workflows/deploy.yml`, `packages/db/scripts/pending-migrations.mjs`, `packages/db/scripts/check-verify-jwt.mjs`

**Components:** Deploy steps · Job: Plan (what this commit changes on the hosted project) · Job: Deploy (send-push -> migrations -> functions) · No approval gate on the staging environment · Manual dispatch inputs (include_all, skip_ci_check) · When a deploy fails

### BE.OPERATOR_RELEASE: Operator desktop release (operator-release.yml)

A tag builds Windows (x64 + ia32) and optionally macOS installers with hosted env baked in, signs if credentials exist, publishes to KaguSoftware/touchpadel-releases; stations auto-update.

**Route:** `tag operator-vX.Y.Z` · **Roles:** owner

**Source:** `.github/workflows/operator-release.yml`, `apps/operator-shell/electron-builder.config.cjs`, `docs/install-runbook.md`, `docs/client/operator-download-2026-09-05.md`

**Components:** Release jobs · Job: CI is green on the tagged commit · Job: prepare · Job: windows · Job: macos · Job: publish · Version-less download URLs and the update feed · Install and update on every station; Devices panel · Rollback to a previous tag

### BE.ENV: Environment variables and secrets per environment

One table of where each secret lives; service-role key only in packages/db/.env and GitHub Environment secrets.

**Route:** `local / CI / hosted Supabase / Vercel / EAS / GitHub` · **Roles:** owner

**Source:** `packages/db/supabase/functions/.env.example`, `API.md`, `SECURITY.md`, `docs/security/layer-1-rules-and-decisions.md`, `.github/workflows/operator-release.yml`, `.github/workflows/deploy.yml`, `apps/mobile/eas.json`, `apps/web/src/lib/security/applinks.ts`

**Components:** SUPABASE_ACCESS_TOKEN · PROJECT_REF · SUPABASE_DB_PASSWORD · SUPABASE_AUTH_SMS_TEST_OTP_CODE · OPERATOR_SUPABASE_URL · OPERATOR_SUPABASE_ANON_KEY · OPERATOR_GUEST_SITE_URL · RELEASES_GH_TOKEN · MAC_CSC_LINK · APPLE_ID · WIN_ESIGNER_USERNAME · WIN_SIGN_PUBLISHER_NAME · TELEGRAM_BOT_TOKEN · TELEGRAM_WEBHOOK_SECRET · GROQ_API_KEY · ANTHROPIC_API_KEY · POSTHOG_PERSONAL_API_KEY · SEND_SMS_HOOK_SECRET · SMS_PROVIDER · OTPIQ_API_KEY · APPLE_PRIVATE_KEY_P8 · PAYMENTS_PROVIDER · QI_SANDBOX_TERMINAL_ID · PAYMENTS_SITE_URL · RECEIPT_READER · EMBEDDING_PROVIDER · Vault secrets (table_token_secret, service_role_key, functions_base_url) · Vercel: NEXT_PUBLIC_SUPABASE_URL / _ANON_KEY (or _PUBLISHABLE_KEY) / _SITE_URL · Vercel: APPLE_TEAM_ID and ANDROID_SHA256_FINGERPRINTS · Vercel: NEXT_PUBLIC_POSTHOG_KEY/HOST, NEXT_PUBLIC_APP_STORE_URL, NEXT_PUBLIC_PLAY_STORE_URL, NEXT_PUBLIC_WEB_OAUTH · EAS env and credentials

### BE.MONITORING: Monitoring and alerting

There is no Sentry or crash reporter in any app (mobile telemetry.ts is a local seam with no reporter; HANDOFF still owes a Sentry DSN). Decide what watches production at launch.

**Route:** `Supabase logs, cron.job_run_details, manager_alerts, GitHub nightly jobs` · **Roles:** owner

**Source:** `apps/mobile/src/lib/telemetry.ts`, `HANDOFF.md`, `docs/store/app-store-submission.md`, `apps/operator/src/lib/telemetry.ts`, `.github/workflows/db-drift.yml`

**Components:** Crash reporting · Logs · Alerting and who gets paged · Uptime checks · Job and queue health

#### BE.MONITORING.T01 · P1 · Monitoring and alerting: main checks

- [ ] Decide crash reporting for launch **Expect:** Either no Sentry (privacy labels stay "no diagnostics") or Sentry added with Diagnostics > Crash Data declared first in both stores `BE.MONITORING.01`
- [ ] Set Supabase usage and spend alerts (project settings) and Vercel deploy failure notifications **Expect:** Owner and developer receive email on failure and quota `BE.MONITORING.02`
- [ ] Watch GitHub notifications for DB drift (nightly 23:00 UTC) and Bench (02:00 UTC) **Expect:** Someone reads red nightly runs within a day `BE.MONITORING.03`
- [ ] Read select kind, count(*) from manager_alerts where created_at > now() - interval '7 days' group by 1 **Expect:** Known kinds only (replay_conflict, etc.); someone owns clearing them `BE.MONITORING.04`

#### BE.MONITORING.T02 · P1 · Crash reporting: main flow

- [ ] Grep apps/*/package.json for sentry **Expect:** No match: no crash reporter ships in mobile, operator or web `BE.MONITORING.CRASH.01`
- [ ] Decide before launch whether to wire Sentry through setReporter **Expect:** Decision recorded; if added, App Privacy gets Diagnostics > Crash Data first `BE.MONITORING.CRASH.02`
- [ ] P2 · Force a render error on a test station **Expect:** Operator CrashScreen shows the fault with the raw error inside a collapsed details block for a manager to read out `BE.MONITORING.CRASH.03`

#### BE.MONITORING.T03 · P1 · Logs: main flow

- [ ] Open Supabase > Edge Functions > send-push > Logs **Expect:** Recent invocations visible with status codes; errors logged by logError without raw vendor text to the caller `BE.MONITORING.LOGS.01`

### BE.GO_LIVE: Go-live data steps (need Majed's explicit go)

Backup, hosted wipe of user data (dry run, stop, execute), pre-system padel reports, assistant cache init. Each step is irreversible or production-affecting and runs only on Majed's word.

**Route:** `packages/db/client-data/README.md "Go-live order"` · **Roles:** owner

**Source:** `packages/db/scripts/wipe-user-data.mjs`, `packages/db/fixtures/wipe-user-data.json`, `packages/db/scripts/db-legacy-reports.mjs`, `packages/db/scripts/assistant-cache.mjs`, `packages/db/scripts/go-live-reset.sql`, `packages/db/client-data/README.md`

**Components:** 1. Fresh backup · 2. Wipe user data · 3. Pre-system padel reports · 4. Assistant cache init · 5. After the data steps · Step 0: main is green and the go is explicit · Step 1: fresh backup of hosted · Step 2: hosted wipe dry run · Step 3: wipe execute · Step 4: load the pre-system padel reports · Step 5: assistant stored-days cache (only when Majed says data is in) · Step 6: after go-live · Alternative: go-live-reset.sql (older, trading record only)

#### BE.GO_LIVE.T01 · P0 · 2. Wipe user data: main flow

- [ ] Run DATABASE_URL=<hosted> pnpm db:wipe-user-data --hosted (dry run) while the club is closed **Expect:** Prints before/after counts, the checks pass, every kept login is listed, transaction ROLLED BACK `BE.GO_LIVE.WIPE.01`
- [ ] STOP and show Majed the kept logins (test staff, review accounts) **Expect:** Majed answers yes, or names accounts to remove or --keep-email to add (e.g. the review account) `BE.GO_LIVE.WIPE.02`

- [ ] On Majed's yes run with --execute, WIPE_CONFIRM=<db host>, SUPABASE_URL and SUPABASE_SERVICE_ROLE_KEY **Expect:** Commits; avatars keeps only kept profiles, staff-media emptied, menu-media untouched; append-only triggers re-enabled `BE.GO_LIVE.WIPE.04`

- [ ] If it refuses because a table is not in fixtures/wipe-user-data.json **Expect:** Refusal names the table; add it as keep or wipe in a commit, push, and re-run the dry run `BE.GO_LIVE.S2_WIPE_DRY.02`

WIPE_CONFIRM=<db host> pnpm db:wipe-user-data --hosted --execute **Expect:** Commits; checks pass (every wiped table empty except kept profiles, every kept table the same size); storage avatars keeps only kept profiles, staff-media empty, menu-media untouched `BE.GO_LIVE.S3_WIPE_EXECUTE.02`

## Cross-system journeys + role matrix

Journeys that start in one app and finish in another, the store submissions, and the role x system access matrix. A feature is not done until its whole journey passes here.

22 pages, 88 test points, 359 steps (61 P0 points).

### X.BOOK_DESK: Player books on mobile, desk sees it live, pays at the desk, receipt

The core money journey: a guest holds and confirms a court on the phone, the court desk sees it instantly, takes payment on the booking bill and prints a receipt.

**Route:** `mobile Book tab -> review -> success; operator /desk; till settle` · **Roles:** guest, court_desk, cashier, manager, owner

**Source:** `apps/mobile/app/(tabs)/index.tsx`, `apps/mobile/app/review.tsx`, `apps/mobile/app/success.tsx`, `apps/operator/src/features/desk/useTradingNight.ts`, `apps/operator-shell/src/main/print`, `packages/db/supabase/migrations/20261001000269_principal_lock_caps.sql`, `packages/db/supabase/migrations/20261001000280_lesson_reservation_guards.sql`

**Components:** 1. Hold on the phone (hold_slot) · 2. Confirm (confirm_booking) · 3. Desk sees it live · 4. Pay at the desk (booking_bill, open_tab, settle_tab) · 5. Receipt and books

#### X.BOOK_DESK.T01 · P0 · 2. Confirm (confirm_booking): main flow

- [ ] Tap Confirm on Review **Expect:** Success screen with booking reference; booking in Bookings tab; booking_confirmed push arrives `X.BOOK_DESK.CONFIRM.01`
- [ ] P1 · Confirm as a guest who has not accepted terms 2026-09-29 **Expect:** accept-terms screen first; TERMS_REQUIRED never reaches the guest as a raw code `X.BOOK_DESK.CONFIRM.05`
- [ ] P1 · Confirm with no phone on the profile (social account) **Expect:** PHONE_REQUIRED handled: complete-profile asks for the number `X.BOOK_DESK.CONFIRM.06`

- [ ] P1 · Guest cancels on the phone inside the free window **Expect:** Desk block disappears within 2 s; booking_cancelled push; reminder removed `X.BOOK_DESK.DESK_SEES.04`
- [ ] P1 · Guest tries to cancel inside the cancellation window **Expect:** Refused with the window hours from venue_settings.cancellation_window_hours; desk can still cancel `X.BOOK_DESK.DESK_SEES.05`

*Setup:* `CONCURRENT_EDIT` (Two people change the same thing), `GENDER_RESTRICTED` (Slot held for women or men by a court gender rule (0353)), `DEGRADED_MODE` (Venue offline mode on the server), `OFFLINE` (No internet), `TIMEZONE_EDGE` (Midnight / business-day boundary (Asia/Baghdad)), `DUPLICATE_REQUEST` (The same idempotency key or request id is sent twice), `HOLD_EXPIRED` (Hold timed out), `APP_KILLED_MIDFLOW` (Station app closed or power cut mid-flow), `SLOW_NETWORK` (Slow network), `OFFLINE_THEN_RECONNECT` (Offline, then back online)

## Release sign-off

The checklist is done when every line below is ticked.

- [ ] Every blocker in [Problems found](#problems-found-while-building-this-list) is fixed and every decision is made.
- [ ] Every P0 point is `pass` (or `n/a` with a written reason) on the production build of each app.
- [ ] Every P1 point is `pass`, or `fail` with an accepted workaround written next to it.
- [ ] Every failed P2 step is logged as an issue with its IDs.
- [ ] All "With no internet" and "Coming back online" points were run on a real station with the network physically cut.
- [ ] All "In Arabic" points were run with the device language set to Arabic, not only the in-app toggle.
- [ ] Mobile points were run on one iPhone and one Android phone with the store build (not Expo Go / Metro).
- [ ] Repo gates pass at the release commit: `pnpm typecheck`, `pnpm lint`, `pnpm test`, `pnpm security`, `pnpm --filter @touch/mobile test:smoke`, the db stack suite with `pnpm db:types` showing no diff.
- [ ] On `main` at the release commit, `ci.yml`, `deploy.yml` and the Vercel build are green; hosted migrations match the repo (0 pending).
- [ ] The operator tag for the release is cut and installed on every station; the Devices panel shows every station on it.
- [ ] Go-live data steps (backup, wipe dry run, report load, assistant cache init) were run only after the owner's explicit go.
